paper.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
paper.abstract: Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy. We present Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid CUA trained from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint through an end-to-end, progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL. To power this curriculum at scale, Mage-CUA-Forge replaces per-task agent construction with reusable, skill-conditioned generation workflows and application-specific pre

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是混合 computer-use agent 的训练问题：同一个 4B 多模态策略如何在 GUI 截图坐标操作和终端/代码执行之间学会正确路由，而不是只依赖像素点击，或在外部 orchestrator 中硬切换不同专家。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接贡献不强，更接近 agent post-training recipe 和合成环境工程。但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，训练数据质量不只由 teacher 模型决定，harness 的工具接口、上下文组织、提示和执行环境会强烈改变 teacher 轨迹分布。第二，复杂能力课程可以通过“技能 taxonomy + 可复用 workflow + 环境 preparer”来规模化生成，而不是为每个任务单独让 agent 从零构造环境。这对 long-horizon agent 数据合成、工具使用 SFT/RL 数据构建有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。模型侧，Mage-VL-Cowork 从一个通用多模态对齐 checkpoint 出发，训练成单一 hybrid CUA policy。它既观察全桌面截图并输出鼠标/键盘坐标动作，也可以在同一 episode 中运行 shell 命令、代码和应用库调用。训练侧采用五阶段课程：GUI-oriented midtraining、GUI agent SFT、coding/terminal SFT、hybrid CUA SFT、online hybrid RL。数据侧使用 Mage-CUA-Forge，先由 authoring agent 为应用和原子技能构建可复用 generation workflow，并配套 application-specific preparer 来生成具体应用状态，例如电子表格、邮件 profile、浏览器或桌面配置。每个任务包包含 instruction、environment setup script 和 rubric，并经过 gate nodes 做一致性检查。关键差异在 harness evolution：不是直接蒸馏默认 teacher rollout，而是先调整 scaffold、工具接口、提示、终端环境，并且删掉重叠或不合适的工具，得到 GUI、terminal、hybrid 等专用 harness，再用它们生成不同阶段需要的轨迹。
summary.experiments: 论文报告训练数据包含 293,806 个合成 desktop/web 任务，覆盖 6,915 个原子技能，收集 318,837 条 teacher trajectories。workflow-first 的生成方式使 recurring per-task expenditure 降低 82.6%。最终 4B Mage-VL-Cowork 在 OSWorld-Verified、50-step budget 下达到 66.0%。对比数字包括 Muse Glimmer-30B 65.9%、Qwen3.6-27B 63.9%、EvoCUA-32B 56.7%。课程消融显示，从 GUI SFT 的 45.56%，到 Hybrid SFT 的 55.84%，再到最终 RL 的 66.0%，累计提升 20.44 个百分点。最有信息量的结果是 hybrid SFT 和 RL 的增益，以及 evolved harness 相比默认 teacher harness 生成的轨迹更适合蒸馏。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看三处：第一，§3.1 的 harness evolution，尤其是为什么删工具有时比加工具更有效；第二，§3.2 的 Mage-CUA-Forge，关注 preparer 如何把“桌面应用状态”变成可复用数据资产；第三，§4 和 §6 的 curriculum 与消融，判断哪些提升来自 GUI/coding/hybrid SFT，哪些来自 RL。若只关心预训练，可跳过具体 OSWorld 对比，保留对数据生成闭环和训练阶段划分的理解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to train a single computer-use policy that can choose between visual GUI control and terminal or code execution. The key issue is not tool access alone, but learning when a GUI action is the right abstraction and when a command or library call is more reliable.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent post-training and synthetic-environment paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its useful lesson for pretraining-oriented work is about data generation. Teacher quality is mediated by the harness: tool schemas, prompts, context handling, and execution environments change the demonstrations a student receives. The workflow-first task generator is also relevant for building large-scale agent corpora without paying the full construction cost per task.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mage-VL-Cowork is a 4B multimodal computer-use agent initialized from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint. It consumes desktop screenshots and emits coordinate-level mouse and keyboard actions, while also being able to execute terminal commands and code in the same episode. Training follows a five-stage curriculum: GUI-oriented midtraining, GUI agent SFT, coding and terminal SFT, hybrid CUA SFT, and online hybrid RL. The data pipeline, Mage-CUA-Forge, builds a skill taxonomy and reusable generation workflows. Application-specific preparers materialize concrete desktop states, such as spreadsheets or mail profiles, and each generated task includes an instruction, setup script, and evaluation rubric. A central design choice is harness evolution: the authors tune and prune tool interfaces, prompts, scaffolds, and shell environments before large-scale teacher rollout, and instantiate separate GUI, terminal, and hybrid harnesses for different training stages.
summary_en.experiments: The training corpus contains 293,806 synthesized desktop and web tasks, 6,915 atomic skills, and 318,837 teacher trajectories. The reusable-workflow design reduces recurring per-task expenditure by 82.6%. On OSWorld-Verified with a 50-step budget, the 4B model reaches 66.0%, compared with 65.9% for Muse Glimmer-30B, 63.9% for Qwen3.6-27B, and 56.7% for EvoCUA-32B. The curriculum improves performance from 45.56% after GUI SFT to 55.84% after hybrid SFT and 66.0% after RL, a total gain of 20.44 percentage points.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on the harness-evolution section, especially the cases where removing tools improves demonstrations. Then read the data-generation section for the preparer and reusable-workflow design. Finally, inspect the curriculum and ablation results to separate gains from GUI SFT, hybrid SFT, and RL. The benchmark comparisons are less important than the data and harness design.

recommendation.zh: 看数据工厂和五阶段课程即可；分数可先放一边，293k 任务如何进 midtrain/SFT/RL 才是可迁移部分。
recommendation.en: Read the data factory and five-stage curriculum; the transferable part is how 293k generated tasks feed midtraining/SFT/RL, not the headline score.

paper.title: Stepwise-Querying: Distilling Reasoning without Access to Teacher Chain-of-Thought
paper.abstract: Reasoning distillation is widely used to transfer the reasoning capabilities of large language models to smaller students through teacher-generated supervision. In the black-box setting, however, teachers may expose only final answers and brief solutions, leaving intermediate calculations and validity conditions unavailable and thus limiting the reasoning supervision available for distillation. We propose Stepwise Querying, which elicits step-specific explanations without requiring access to the

stage_evidence.quote: tions for individual steps, the assembled solutions are then used for standard supervised fine-tuning. Across two teachers, two students, and four mathematics and code benchmarks, our method achieves the highest score in 14 of 16 comparisons

teacher's internal CoT. These assembled step-level explanations are then used as standard SFT data. The paper also introduces Stepwise Explanation Information Gain as a diagnostic for step-level explanatory value.
rying：不要求读取教师内部 CoT，而是对同一教师发起多个独立查询，分别请求某一步的中间推导、合法性检查和修正说明；再把这些 step-level 解释拼装成监督数据，用标准 SFT 训练学生模型。还提出 Stepwise Explanation Information Gain，作为诊断每步解释信息增益的指标。

summary.core_problem: 在无法访问教师模型完整 CoT 的黑盒条件下，如何为小模型构造更细粒度的推理监督数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是合成推理数据与蒸馏方法。它关注一个很实际的问题：闭源教师通常只给最终答案或短解，直接蒸馏会丢失中间计算、条件检查和纠错信号，学生模型学到的推理轨迹较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Stepwise Querying：不要求读取教师内部 CoT，而是对同一教师发起多个独立查询，分别请求某一步的中间推导、合法性检查和修正说明；再把这些 step-level 解释拼装成监督数据，用标准 SFT 训练学生模型。还提出 Stepwise Explanation Information Gain，作为诊断每步解释信息增益的指标。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个教师模型、两个学生模型，以及四个数学和代码 benchmark。方法在 16 个比较中的 14 个取得最高分。摘要未披露具体模型名称、参数量、训练样本数、合成数据成本、过滤策略和等 token / 等 FLOPs 对照。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beijing Normal University Institute of AI and Future Network。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to build fine-grained reasoning supervision for small students when a black-box teacher does not expose full chain-of-thought traces.
summary_en.importance: This is a synthetic reasoning-data and distillation contribution. It targets a practical bottleneck: closed teachers often return only final answers or brief solutions, so naive distillation misses intermediate calculations, validity checks, and correction signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Stepwise Querying sends multiple independent prompts to the same teacher to elicit step-specific derivations, validity checks, and corrections without accessing the teacher's internal CoT. These assembled step-level explanations are then used as standard SFT data. The paper also introduces Stepwise Explanation Information Gain as a diagnostic for step-level explanatory value.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses two teachers, two students, and four math and code benchmarks. The method obtains the best score in 14 out of 16 comparisons against three baselines. The abstract does not disclose model names, parameter counts, training-set size, synthetic-data cost, filtering policy, or equal-token/equal-FLOP controls.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the Institute of AI and Future Network at Beijing Normal University.

recommendation.zh: 作为黑盒教师合成数据技巧备查即可；缺少成本和等量对照时，不要把 14/16 胜出读成可扩展结论。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a black-box teacher data-generation trick; without cost and equal-budget controls, the 14/16 wins should not be read as a scaling claim.

institutions: Affiliation:Institute of AI and Future Network, Beijing Normal University

paper.title: Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation Improves Small Pointwise LLM Judges
paper.abstract: Agentic systems increasingly gate individual steps with a pointwise judge that scores a response against a criterion. Small language models are attractive for this role because they can be served and specialized efficiently. Such a judge must locate the criterion's decision boundary, but pointwise labels under-determine that boundary in fine-tuning: labeled responses to different queries differ along many dimensions at once, so they do not reveal which features decide the label. We introduce CPA

The paper addresses the problem that small pointwise LLM judges fine-tuned on single labeled responses may fail to identify the actual decision boundary.
vements. It mentions a second-order analysis of when CPA should outperform pointwise-only fine-tuning.
摘要未披露模型规模、合成样本数量、审核方式、baseline、任务集或提升幅度；仅说明有二阶分析论证 CPA 何时可能优于普通 pointwise fine-tuning。

summary.core_problem: 解决小型 pointwise LLM judge 在只用单点标签微调时难以学到判定边界的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是合成训练数据与 judge 训练方法。它和预训练不直接相关，但对 verifier / reward model 的训练信号质量有参考价值，尤其是如何把隐含判定标准变成更清晰的 pairwise supervision。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CPA，即 Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation。对每个 pointwise 样本，合成并审核一个同 query 下、目标标签相反的 counterfactual response，然后把原响应和 counterfactual response 组成 pairwise 判断任务；训练时联合使用 pointwise 数据和 pairwise 数据，部署时仍以 pointwise judge 方式打分。核心不是新 RL 算法，而是用合成反事实样本显式暴露决策差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型规模、合成样本数量、审核方式、baseline、任务集或提升幅度；仅说明有二阶分析论证 CPA 何时可能优于普通 pointwise fine-tuning。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the problem that small pointwise LLM judges fine-tuned on single labeled responses may fail to identify the actual decision boundary.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is synthetic training data for judge specialization. It is not pretraining work, but it is relevant to verifier and reward-model signal quality because it turns implicit criteria into explicit pairwise contrasts.
summary_en.technical_approach: CPA synthesizes and audits a counterfactual response for each pointwise item, using the same query but targeting the opposite label. The accepted pair is converted into a pairwise task asking which response satisfies the criterion. The judge is trained jointly on pointwise and pairwise data, then deployed in pointwise mode.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose model sizes, synthetic-data volume, audit procedure, baselines, datasets, or quantitative improvements. It mentions a second-order analysis of when CPA should outperform pointwise-only fine-tuning.

recommendation.zh: 作为 verifier 数据构造备查即可；关键看反事实审核是否干净，没披露实验细节前不要外推。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a verifier-data construction reference; the value hinges on clean counterfactual auditing, and the abstract is too thin for extrapolation.

summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 后训练阶段的合成任务与轨迹自举闭环；它不属于预训练数据工作，但对“生成—验证—再训练”的数据闭环设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: EvoMCP 根据 rollout feedback 识别学生模型已掌握能力和能力缺口，再做 task evolution：修改 verified seed tasks 的指令和可观测环境状态，同时保持 verifier 对齐；随后做 trajectory evolution，用可复用技能修复失败 teacher rollouts、精炼成功轨迹，最后把生成的 task-trajectory 对用于 SFT。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、MCP 环境数量、合成任务数量、训练 token 数、teacher 配置、等计算对照或最终提升幅度；只能确认其核心训练阶段是 SFT，数据来自闭环任务和轨迹演化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch caused by training MCP agents on static SFT data while the student’s capabilities and failure modes keep changing.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a synthetic task-and-trajectory bootstrapping loop for agent post-training. It is not pretraining data work, but it is relevant to generator-verifier-training loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoMCP uses rollout feedback to identify established capabilities and gaps, converts those gaps into executable tasks by adapting verified seed tasks while preserving verifier alignment, and evolves trajectories by repairing failed teacher rollouts and refining successful ones with reusable skills. The resulting task-trajectory pairs are used for supervised fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose model sizes, number of MCP environments, amount of synthetic data, teacher configuration, token budget, equal-compute comparisons, or effect sizes. The stated training stage is SFT with data produced by task and trajectory evolution.

recommendation.zh: 合成数据闭环方向对路，但摘要缺关键量化；先看数据演化和 verifier 对齐细节，别把结果当 scaling 证据。
recommendation.en: The closed-loop data idea is directionally relevant, but key quantities are missing; inspect verifier alignment and data evolution, not the headline gains.

paper.title: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
paper.abstract: Safety alignment for Large Language Models is heavily focused on English with limited multilingual representation, particularly damaging low-resource language performance. Related open training datasets are often limited in size or do not follow region-localized harmful topics to broaden the scope of alignment beyond cultures. We propose a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline to produce massive multilingual refusal and benign corpora, extracting safe templates from harmful prompts, tran

stage_evidence.quote: ranslation alone. The provided metadata does not disclose model sizes, exact corpus size, SFT/RL setup, training gains, or generation cost.
nglish-only evaluation 会误判多语言安全性：一些模型在英文中攻击失败，但翻译后攻击成功；文化本地化变体还能暴露单纯翻译无法发现的失败。具体训练模型、数据规模、SFT/RL 设置、提升幅度和成本未在提供摘要中披露。

summary.core_problem: LLM 安全对齐数据和评测长期偏英语，导致多语言尤其低资源语言中的拒答和安全边界被误判。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是合成/模板化安全数据构建与多语言安全评测分析。它不直接推进预训练，但对 post-train 数据覆盖、文化本地化安全样本和 multilingual alignment 的数据配方有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出可扩展的 template-based augmentation pipeline：从 harmful prompts 中抽取 safe templates，翻译到多语言，再用具有地区文化真实性的 harmful 与 benign entities 填槽，生成大规模 multilingual refusal 和 benign corpora。发布 MSafeTemp，覆盖 60 种语言，可用于多语言安全对齐与评测。
summary.experiments: 摘要披露 MSafeTemp 覆盖 60 种语言，并展示 English-only evaluation 会误判多语言安全性：一些模型在英文中攻击失败，但翻译后攻击成功；文化本地化变体还能暴露单纯翻译无法发现的失败。具体训练模型、数据规模、SFT/RL 设置、提升幅度和成本未在提供摘要中披露。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构为 ETH Zurich。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the English-centric nature of LLM safety alignment and evaluation, which can hide failures in multilingual and low-resource settings.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a synthetic/template-based safety data pipeline plus multilingual safety analysis. It does not directly affect pretraining, but it is relevant to post-training data coverage, culturally localized safety examples, and multilingual alignment recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline. It extracts safe templates from harmful prompts, translates them, and fills slots with culturally authentic harmful and benign entities. The resulting MSafeTemp corpus covers 60 languages and is intended for multilingual safety alignment and evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 60-language corpus and shows that English-only evaluation misjudges multilingual safety: attacks that fail in English can succeed after translation, and culturally localized variants reveal additional failures missed by translation alone. The provided metadata does not disclose model sizes, exact corpus size, SFT/RL setup, training gains, or generation cost.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliation: ETH Zurich.

recommendation.zh: 数据构造思路朴素但有用；看多语言攻击失效案例即可，别把模板填槽结果外推到通用安全对齐。
recommendation.en: The data recipe is simple but practical; read the multilingual failure cases, but avoid overgeneralizing template-filled data to general safety alignment.

summary.importance: 贡献类型是可验证代码领域的合成轨迹数据生成与筛选。它对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 generator-verifier 轨迹蒸馏、结构化 CoT 监督和可验证任务自举有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MCTS-SFT，把推理轨迹构造建模为对中间 reasoning states 的搜索，用 Monte Carlo Tree Search 将完整 Verilog rollout 的功能反馈回传到早期设计决策。进一步提出 Plan-MCTS，在紧凑硬件设计计划上搜索，显式表示接口、时序、状态、行为和更新规则；还研究 plan-preserving supervision，即把搜索得到的结构化状态保留进下游 SFT 目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型参数量、底座模型、训练样本数、pass@k 或具体提升幅度。可确认实验对象是 Verilog 生成，并比较了普通最终正确性筛选轨迹与 Plan-MCTS / plan-preserving supervision 这类搜索策展轨迹。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves SFT data for Verilog generation by searching for structured intermediate design decisions rather than selecting natural-language traces mainly by final RTL correctness.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is synthetic trace generation and curation for a verifiable code domain. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to generator-verifier data loops, trajectory distillation, and structured reasoning supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: MCTS-SFT formulates trace construction as search over intermediate reasoning states and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to propagate functional feedback from complete Verilog rollouts to earlier design decisions. Plan-MCTS searches over compact hardware-design plans covering interfaces, timing, state, behavior, and update rules, and plan-preserving supervision keeps the searched state in the SFT target.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose model size, backbone, training set size, pass@k, or exact gains. The experiments are in Verilog generation and compare final-correctness-based trace selection with Plan-MCTS and plan-preserving supervision.

recommendation.zh: 领域窄，但“把 verifier 信号回传到中间计划”值得记；不必读全文，方法图和消融表够用。
recommendation.en: Narrow domain, but propagating verifier signal into intermediate plans is worth noting; the method diagram and ablations should be enough.

paper.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful. Existing methods often focus on what experience to generate next, while paying less attention to when fresh experience should be introduced. Many also construct training targets through self-consistency or majority voting, making supervision depend on the model's own uncertain predictions. We address these two questions separately: t

summary.core_problem: 该工作研究零人工数据的多模态自我改进中，什么时候替换训练任务池。很多 recursive self-improvement 方法关注生成什么新任务，却忽略旧任务池何时已经缺少学习信号。另一个问题是，若训练标签来自模型自一致性或多数投票，模型错误可能被写回训练目标。A-RSI 将这两个问题拆开：用训练日志决定刷新时机，用可执行程序提供可检查答案。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发点在于数据课程和训练动态监控。它把“数据是否还值得训练”转化为一个训练侧信号问题，而不是依赖验证集分数。这个设定和大规模预训练中的数据 mixture 调度、去重后重复训练、RL 任务池更新有相似结构。更有价值的是，它没有让模型用自己的不确定预测当标签，而是用程序生成图像、问题和答案，降低了自训练中的标签污染风险。局限也明确：任务分布由固定模板库决定，refresh 只改变任务实例，不改变生成器和采样分布。
summary.technical_approach: A-RSI 包含两部分。第一部分是程序化任务管线。模型先写出一批固定模板，覆盖几何、图表、表格、计数等任务。每个模板定义参数空间、采样方式、图像绘制、问题生成和答案计算。任务实例由同一组底层参数同时生成图像、问题和 reference answer，这被称为 shared-configuration contract。系统会对候选模板和答案做程序检查与人工/独立审计，但并不声称每个渲染问题都有形式化证明。第二部分是训练日志控制器。Solver 在当前任务池上用 GRPO 训练，奖励包含正确性、格式和终止信号。每个训练 window 结束后，控制器读取日志，监控仍有 within-group reward variation 的 prompt 数量，以及训练侧 accuracy。当这些信号下降到预设条件时，替换整个 active pool，但保留模型权重。刷新策略不访问验证集或测试集分数，也不改变模板库、任务族比例和采样配额。
summary.experiments: 主要 Qwen 实验从 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的后初始化 checkpoint S_t 开始，初始 11 项 benchmark 平均分为 57.77。经过 8 个 continuation windows 和 800 个新任务后，分数提升到 61.05。MiMo 从公开基座 S_0 的 59.08 提升到 60.71。在相同 11 项 benchmark 协议下，A-RSI 用 800 个新任务达到 61.05，而 every-window refresh 使用 3,200 个新任务达到 60.64，说明过频刷新并不更好。在第 6 个 continuation window 对齐比较时，A-RSI 为 60.40，继续训练旧任务池为 58.35。作者还报告了 difficulty-aware 和 competence-aware 替换规则在固定任务族比例下没有超过随机采样。一个细节值得注意：分数提升可能来自更多回答在输出预算内完成，也可能来自已完成回答的正确性提升，因此实验把 completion 与 correction 分开分析。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。先看 Figure 2 和 Algorithm 1，确认训练循环中哪些部分会更新，哪些部分保持冻结。然后看 Section 3.1 的模板生成与 shared-configuration contract，判断程序化标签是否可信。Section 3.3 的 refresh condition 是关键，尤其是 within-group reward variation 如何统计、accuracy 阈值如何设定、是否对窗口长度 H 敏感。实验部分重点看 matched comparisons：A-RSI 对 every-window refresh、old-pool continued training、difficulty-aware/competence-aware replacement。若关心可复现性，需要进一步查看 Appendix 27.3 的池大小、GRPO 超参、任务族配额和奖励实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when to replace the training task pool in zero-data multimodal self-improvement. Many recursive self-improvement methods focus on what new tasks to generate, but they often keep training on a pool after its learning signal has weakened. A second issue is label reliability: self-consistency or majority voting can turn the model’s own mistakes into future supervision. A-RSI separates these two decisions: training logs decide when to refresh, while executable programs provide independently checkable answers.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea for foundation-model training is a training-dynamics-based data curriculum. The method treats data freshness as something that can be inferred from training-side signals, without using validation or test scores. This is relevant to data mixture scheduling, repeated exposure during continued pretraining, and RL task-pool maintenance. The programmatic task pipeline also reduces one common failure mode of self-training: using uncertain model predictions as labels. The limitation is also clear. The task generator is fixed; refreshing swaps task instances, not the generator, the template library, or the task-family distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: A-RSI has two main components. The first is a programmatic multimodal task pipeline. A base model writes fixed templates for task families such as geometry, charts, tables, and counting. Each template defines admissible parameters, sampling, image rendering, question construction, and answer computation. An instance is generated from a shared underlying configuration, and the reference answer is computed from that same configuration. The pipeline applies checks and audits, but it does not claim a formal proof for every rendered question. The second component is a training-log controller. The Solver is trained on the active pool with GRPO, using correctness, format, and termination rewards. After each training window, the controller checks how many prompts still have within-group reward variation, together with logged training accuracy. When the specified condition fires, the entire active pool is replaced while the model weights are kept. The controller does not look at validation or test performance, and the template library and task quotas remain fixed.
summary_en.experiments: In the main Qwen setting, training starts from a post-initialization Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct checkpoint S_t with an eleven-benchmark score of 57.77. After eight continuation windows and 800 fresh tasks, the score reaches 61.05. MiMo improves from 59.08 at the public base model S_0 to 60.71. Under the same eleven-benchmark protocol, A-RSI reaches 61.05 with 800 fresh tasks, while refreshing every window reaches 60.64 with 3,200 fresh tasks. At the matched sixth continuation window, A-RSI scores 60.40 versus 58.35 for continued training on the old pool. The paper also reports that difficulty-aware and competence-aware replacement rules do not outperform random sampling under fixed task-family shares. A useful diagnostic is the response-level analysis: benchmark gains are separated into improvements from finishing within the output budget and improvements from correcting already completed answers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with Figure 2 and Algorithm 1 to identify what is updated and what stays frozen. Then read the template construction and shared-configuration contract in Section 3.1 to assess label reliability. The key methodological part is Section 3.3: how within-group reward variation is counted, how accuracy is used, and whether the refresh rule depends on the window length H. In the experiments, focus on matched comparisons against every-window refresh, continued training on the old pool, and difficulty-aware or competence-aware replacement. For reproducibility, check Appendix 27.3 for pool sizes, GRPO settings, task-family quotas, and reward implementation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看的是“按训练信号衰减刷新任务池”而不是多模态包装；如果你在做合成数据闭环，先复现 refresh trigger，再看程序化可验证监督是否真能压住误差累积。
recommendation.en: What matters here is refreshing the task pool based on learning-signal decay, not the multimodal wrapper; if you work on synthetic-data loops, reproduce the refresh trigger first and then test whether programmatically verifiable supervision really suppresses error accumulation.

paper.title: Statistical Analysis of Synthetic Data with Verification: A Linear Regression Framework
paper.abstract: Synthetic data are widely used for training modern AI systems. However, their statistical understanding remains limited. It is well recognized in statistics that repeated self-training on synthetic data can amplify errors inherited from pre-trained models, leading to model collapse. Verification plays a crucial role in selecting high-quality synthetic data to help prevent model collapse and improve model performance. We study verified self-training in a linear regression framework, where a pre-t

summary.core_problem: 在“模型生成合成数据→验证筛选→再训练”的闭环里，验证强度与生成噪声如何共同影响误差放大/模型崩塌与最终风险。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制/理论分析：用可解的线性回归框架把“verified self-training”拆开，给出若干反直觉结论；对 LLM 合成数据、verifier 过滤阈值、以及递归训练稳定性有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 设定：预训练估计器生成带噪合成样本；verifier 按阈值筛选样本；再训练可为全参数更新或仅更新活跃子集（partial fine-tuning）。分析预测风险随验证阈值与生成噪声变化的相图/条件，解释何时会出现误差放大或反而受益。
summary.experiments: 以线性回归为主的理论推导与现象展示（非大模型实证）；对比不同 verification threshold、generation noise、full vs partial fine-tuning 下的风险变化与“模型崩塌”倾向。摘要未给出具体数值表格。

summary_en.core_problem: In a synthetic-data loop (generate → verify/filter → retrain), how verification tightness and generation noise jointly affect error amplification/model collapse and final risk.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic/theoretical contribution: a tractable linear-regression analysis of verified self-training with counterintuitive regimes; directly relevant to LLM synthetic data filtering and recursive training stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Setup: a pretrained estimator generates noisy synthetic samples; a verifier accepts samples via a threshold; post-training updates either all coordinates (full FT) or an active subset (partial FT). The paper derives conditions/phase behavior for prediction risk as a function of threshold and injected noise.
summary_en.experiments: Primarily theory-driven results in linear regression (not large-model empirics), comparing risk under different thresholds, noise levels, and full vs partial fine-tuning. No concrete headline numbers in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把“合成数据+verifier 阈值”拆成可分析的相图：更严不一定更好、加噪可能救场；读结论段和阈值/噪声条件即可。
recommendation.en: Gives a clean phase-style analysis of synthetic-data + verifier thresholds: stricter isn’t always better and noise can help; read the conditions/claims, not the algebra.

paper.title: Timestral
paper.abstract: We introduce Timestral, a family of four time series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting, with 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameters. Timestral sets a new state of the art on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, where Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two places on every metric. We achieve this with three ingredients: Decoupled Horizon Forecasting (DHF), which separates prediction tokens from the causally encoded context, so that longer horizons are trained without masking conte

summary.core_problem: 构建面向概率预测的时间序列基础模型，并解决长预测 horizon、未来协变量和因果上下文编码之间的建模冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献是领域基础模型的模型设计和训练流程。对 LLM 预训练研究的直接价值有限，但 synthetic pretrain → mixed post-train 的配方，以及预测 token 与上下文 token 解耦的设计，值得作为跨序列建模案例留意。
summary.technical_approach: Timestral 包含 5M、28M、123M、209M 四个规模。核心方法包括 Decoupled Horizon Forecasting，将预测 token 从因果编码的上下文中分离，避免长 horizon 训练时遮蔽上下文；协变量框架原生支持 known-future covariates；训练采用两阶段流程，先在大规模多样化合成语料上预训练，再用真实与合成混合数据进行 post-training，并扩展上下文。
summary.experiments: Timestral-209M 和 Timestral-123M 在 GIFT-Eval、TIME、fev-bench 的所有指标上占据前两名。摘要未给出训练 token 数、合成数据生成细节和相对 baseline 的具体提升幅度，但说明四个模型权重开放。

summary_en.core_problem: The work builds probabilistic time-series foundation models while addressing the interaction between long forecast horizons, future covariates, and causal context encoding.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly model design and a training recipe for a domain-specific foundation model. Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, but the synthetic-pretraining followed by mixed post-training pipeline is a useful sequence-modeling reference point.
summary_en.technical_approach: Timestral comes in 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameter sizes. It introduces Decoupled Horizon Forecasting, which separates prediction tokens from the causally encoded context so long horizons can be trained without masking useful context. It also adds a native covariate framework for known-future covariates and uses a two-stage training pipeline: synthetic-only pretraining followed by real-plus-synthetic post-training with longer context.
summary_en.experiments: Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M reportedly rank first and second on every metric across GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench. The abstract does not provide training-token counts, synthetic-data construction details, or exact gains over baselines, but states that all four model weights are released.

recommendation.zh: 扫 DHF 和两阶段训练就够；时间序列任务隔得较远，别把榜单结果直接外推到文本预训练。
recommendation.en: Skim DHF and the two-stage recipe; the time-series setting is far enough that leaderboard gains should not be over-transferred to text LMs.

summary.importance: 贡献类型是非文本 foundation model 的建模与训练报告。它和 LLM 预训练的关系不在任务本身，而在因果架构如何处理非文本序列、合成预训练语料如何进入两阶段训练、以及 forecast token 设计如何改变监督密度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Timestral 系列模型，包含 Decoupled Horizon Forecasting：将预测 token 与因果编码的上下文分离，使长 horizon 训练不需要遮蔽上下文，并让每个观测值既可作为预测目标又可作为后续上下文。还加入原生支持 known-future covariates 的因果协变量框架，并采用先大规模合成数据预训练、再用真实与合成混合数据 post-training 的两阶段流程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces time-series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting, targeting long-horizon prediction, future covariates, and limited real training data.
summary_en.importance: It is a non-text foundation-model architecture and training report. Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect: causal modeling for non-text sequences, synthetic-first pretraining, and forecast-token design that changes supervision density.
summary_en.technical_approach: Timestral uses Decoupled Horizon Forecasting, separating prediction tokens from the causally encoded context so longer horizons can be trained without masking context and each observation can serve as both target and later context. It also adds a causal framework for known-future covariates and a two-stage pipeline: synthetic-only pretraining followed by post-training on real and synthetic data with longer context.
summary_en.experiments: The family has 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameter models. The abstract reports that Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two positions on every metric across GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench. Weights are released on Hugging Face. Details of synthetic data generation, baselines, and training scale are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为非文本序列预训练备查即可；DHF 的监督组织值得看，榜单结果不应外推到语言建模。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a non-text sequence pretraining reference; DHF is worth inspecting, but the benchmark wins should not be extrapolated to language modeling.

paper.title: WebUniverse: Scaling Verified Training Data for Agentic Web Development
paper.abstract: Training agents for front-end web development requires demonstrations of code editing, execution, browser inspection and revision, yet public trajectories and reusable task environments remain limited. We introduce WebUniverse, a pipeline that constructs verifiable tasks with verified development trajectories from open-source repositories and real web pages. The tasks cover text-grounded application development in standalone and iterative settings and vision-grounded reproduction across pages an

summary.core_problem: 如何构建大规模、高质量且经过验证的训练数据，以提升 Agent 在前端 Web 开发任务上的能力？
summary.importance: 提出了 WebUniverse，一个用于构建可验证 Web 开发任务和轨迹的 pipeline，并发布了包含 15K 环境和轨迹的大规模数据集，显著提升了开源模型在 Web 开发任务上的表现。
summary.technical_approach: 从开源仓库和真实网页中提取数据，构建涵盖文本驱动和视觉驱动的 Web 开发任务。收集 Agent 轨迹，并根据功能或视觉要求进行验证。发布了 WebUniverse-Env（15K 可执行环境）和 WebUniverse-Mix（15K 验证轨迹）。
summary.experiments: 使用 WebUniverse-Mix 微调 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，在 Vision2Web 上得分从 51.7 提升至 68.3，WebGen-Bench 准确率从 34.5% 提升至 63.9%。

summary_en.core_problem: How to construct large-scale, high-quality, and verified training data to improve agent capabilities in front-end web development?
summary_en.importance: Introduces WebUniverse, a pipeline for constructing verifiable web development tasks and trajectories, and releases a large-scale dataset (15K environments/trajectories), significantly boosting open-source model performance on web development tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Extracts data from open-source repositories and real web pages to build text- and vision-grounded web development tasks. Collects agent trajectories and verifies them against functional or visual requirements. Releases WebUniverse-Env (15K executable environments) and WebUniverse-Mix (15K verified trajectories).
summary_en.experiments: Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on WebUniverse-Mix improves Vision2Web score from 51.7 to 68.3, and WebGen-Bench accuracy from 34.5% to 63.9%.

recommendation.zh: 构建了大规模可验证的 Web Agent 训练数据闭环，对关注 Agent 数据合成与后训练的研究员有参考价值，可重点看其验证机制的设计。
recommendation.en: Constructs a large-scale verifiable training data loop for Web Agents. Valuable for researchers focusing on agent data synthesis and post-training; the verification mechanism design is worth skimming.

stage_evidence.quote: Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on WebUniverse-Mix improves Vision2Web score from 51.7 to 68.3, and WebGen-Bench accuracy from 34.5% to 63.9%.

paper.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation enables post-training foundation models without relying on stronger external teachers. However, existing approaches rely on ground-truth question-answer pairs, human-curated problem sets, or other supervised signals. In this work, we reformulate on-policy self-distillation as a self-training framework, driven by self-generated question-answer pairs and privileged reasoning demonstrations. We push supervision to the limit: guided solely by coarse, high-level topic desc

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：能否在没有人工题目、标准答案、外部教师模型的条件下，让大语言模型通过自己生成训练问题和推理监督来持续改进。已有 SFT 依赖人工示范，RLVR 依赖可验证答案，on-policy distillation 依赖更强教师，on-policy self-distillation 虽然去掉外部教师，但仍常依赖真实解答或特权上下文。OPST 试图把这部分监督也去掉，只保留粗粒度 topic descriptors，让模型自己生成 query、answer 和 privileged information，再用内部过滤和 on-policy self-distillation 训练自己。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口有直接启发。它不是单纯的数据合成，而是在研究一个更强的闭环：模型自己决定训练分布，自己构造特权信息，并在自己实际访问的状态上获得 dense token-level supervision。这个设定接近 continual pretrain / self-improvement 的极限版本：没有 curated prompt set，也没有 gold answer。贡献的量级主要在范式层面。它说明 post-training 的监督可以从“人工题目 + 人工答案”进一步退化到“粗主题 + 自生成课程”，但仍能带来跨任务收益。对基座研究员来说，关键启发是训练信号密度、on-policy 分布匹配、课程难度自适应、以及 synthetic supervision 的质量控制可以一起设计，而不是把数据生成、过滤、训练目标分开处理。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 On-Policy Self-Training。流程分为生成、过滤、训练、迭代四步。第一步，给定粗粒度主题 τ，模型生成问题 x 和 privileged information，通常包含答案或推理相关上下文。这里没有人工题目，也没有标准答案。第二步，对生成样本做 intrinsic filtering。pseudo-verification 检查问题是否成形：模型需要在新的上下文和 paraphrase 条件下重新得到一致答案。consensus gate 检查问题是否仍有训练价值：如果当前 student 在多次 on-policy rollout 中已经稳定给出同一答案，则样本被丢弃；如果模型尚不稳定，样本会被保留。这个 gate 会随模型能力变化而改变，因此课程难度会自动移动。第三步，用 on-policy self-distillation 训练。student 只看问题，teacher 看问题加 privileged information；teacher 在 student 实际访问的状态上给 dense next-token targets。这个不对称设计是核心：SFT 或 RL 会把生成答案当作直接优化目标，监督质量被生成答案上限限制；OPST 则把生成答案作为 teacher 的上下文，让 teacher 从自身参数知识中生成更丰富的推理轨迹。第四步，多轮迭代，并用 EMA teacher 降低自举训练中的分布漂移和错误放大。相比传统 self-training，它不从人工 problem set 出发；相比 OPD，它不需要外部教师；相比 OPSD，它把 privileged information 也变成模型自生成。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖语言推理和视觉语言场景。语言侧在 Gemma 4 E2B 上验证，OPST 在没有人工 curated questions 或 answers 的条件下使 MMLU 提升 10.2 个百分点，并在 GSM8K、GPQA、HellaSwag 上取得一致收益。更重要的是，in-domain self-training 没有明显破坏 out-of-distribution 能力，部分 OOD 任务也有提升，这说明 dense on-policy distillation 和过滤机制对 catastrophic forgetting 有缓解作用。视觉语言侧，Visual OPST 只使用 unlabeled images，让模型围绕图像自生成问题和特权信息，再做相同的 self-training，VQAv2 提升 6.9 个百分点。消融的核心信息来自三点：直接 SFT 自生成答案不如把答案作为 teacher privileged context；consensus gate 能避免训练已经掌握的样本，使课程保持有效难度；EMA teacher 对多轮自训练稳定性有帮助。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法部分的 3.1 到 3.6。3.1 的 data-free post-training 设定定义了这项工作的边界；3.3 的问题和 privileged information 生成决定了自训练数据分布；3.4 的 pseudo-verification 与 consensus gate 是质量控制核心；3.5 的 teacher/student 非对称条件是最关键的训练目标设计；3.6 的迭代和 EMA teacher 关系到稳定性。图 1 和图 2 应重点看，它们分别说明数据闭环和 on-policy self-distillation 的条件差异。实验部分应重点看过滤消融、SFT/RL/OPSD 对比、多轮曲线、OOD 保持情况，以及 Visual OPST 是否只是 VQA 数据增强还是形成了可迁移的多模态自训练机制。值得深挖的问题是：topic descriptors 的覆盖度是否决定上限；pseudo-verification 会不会偏向模型已有知识；consensus gate 是否会系统性丢掉高难但可学样本；多轮自训练在更大模型和更长训练中是否会出现模式收缩。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a language model can improve itself without curated prompts, gold answers, or a stronger teacher. Standard SFT needs demonstrations, RLVR needs verifiable answers, on-policy distillation needs an external teacher, and on-policy self-distillation usually still needs privileged context such as a ground-truth solution. OPST removes the curated problem set as well: given only coarse topic descriptors, the model generates its own queries, answers, and privileged information, then trains on them through an on-policy self-distillation loop.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is the training loop, not the headline data synthesis. OPST ties together self-generated curricula, intrinsic filtering, dense token-level supervision, and on-policy state distribution matching. For pretraining researchers, this is a useful model of how post-training may feed back into continual pretraining: the model controls both the prompt distribution and the supervision source, while the objective still provides dense gradients instead of a sparse trajectory reward. The contribution is mainly conceptual and procedural. It shows that a coarse topic prior can be enough to seed a self-improvement loop, provided that data quality, difficulty selection, and teacher-student asymmetry are designed together.
summary_en.technical_approach: On-Policy Self-Training has four main stages. First, from a topic descriptor, the model synthesizes a question and privileged information, typically including an answer or reasoning context. No human-written problem or reference solution is used. Second, the generated samples are filtered. Pseudo-verification checks whether the problem is well formed by asking the model to reproduce the answer in a fresh context and under paraphrasing. A consensus gate checks whether the problem is still useful for the current student: if the student already reproduces the answer consistently across on-policy rollouts, the sample is discarded. This makes the curriculum move as the student improves. Third, training uses on-policy self-distillation. The student sees only the question, while the teacher sees the question plus the synthetic privileged information and provides dense next-token targets at states visited by the student. This asymmetry matters: SFT or RL would optimize directly against the synthetic answer, while OPST uses that answer as context that lets the teacher generate a richer reasoning trajectory from its parametric knowledge. Fourth, the loop is repeated across rounds, with an EMA teacher used to reduce self-induced distribution drift.
summary_en.experiments: The reported language experiments use Gemma 4 E2B. Without curated questions or answers, OPST improves MMLU by 10.2 points and also improves GSM8K, GPQA, and HellaSwag. The paper also reports that in-domain self-training does not substantially damage out-of-distribution behavior; in some cases OOD performance improves as well. This is important because naive synthetic SFT often trades target-domain gains for capability erosion. The vision-language extension, Visual OPST, uses unlabeled images only and improves VQAv2 accuracy by 6.9 points. The most informative ablations are the comparisons against direct SFT on generated answers, the role of the consensus gate, and the effect of the EMA teacher in multi-round training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Sections 3.1 through 3.6 closely. Section 3.1 defines the data-free post-training setting. Section 3.3 explains how the model creates its own problem distribution. Section 3.4 is central because pseudo-verification and the consensus gate determine whether the loop learns or amplifies noise. Section 3.5 contains the key teacher-student asymmetry. Section 3.6 is relevant for stability in repeated self-training. Figures 1 and 2 are the fastest way to understand the data loop and the conditioning difference between teacher and student. In the experiments, focus on the filtering ablations, comparisons against SFT/RL-style baselines, multi-round curves, OOD retention, and the Visual OPST setup. Open questions include whether topic descriptors cap diversity, whether pseudo-verification favors existing model knowledge, and whether the consensus gate discards hard but learnable examples.

recommendation.zh: 如果实验对照干净，这会把“无人工题库也能自举提升”的门槛大幅拉低；重点盯数据生成约束、退化/崩塌迹象和跨域保持的证据。
recommendation.en: If the controls are clean, it meaningfully lowers the bar for bootstrapped improvement without curated tasks; scrutinize generation constraints, collapse signals, and cross-domain retention evidence.

paper.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model l

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：能否在不使用外部长文本语料、不依赖更强 teacher model 的情况下，让模型自己构造长上下文可验证任务，并通过 RL 提升长上下文推理能力。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 pretrain/post-train 接口有清晰启发。长上下文能力的瓶颈常被理解为 context length、位置编码或注意力效率，但 RL 阶段的数据也同样关键：任务必须足够长、需要跨证据整合、难度适中，并且答案可自动验证。LongZero 的贡献在于把“零数据 RL”从短数学、代码、游戏任务扩展到长上下文任务。它的关键价值不是具体 benchmark 分数，而是给出一种避免真实语料泄漏和 teacher 依赖的数据构造顺序：先固定短规格中的问题、证据和答案，再扩展成长上下文。
summary.technical_approach: LongZero 使用待训练模型自己生成训练集，然后用 GRPO 训练。核心设计是反转生成顺序。常规做法是先生成长文档，再让模型基于长文档出题；这会把模型当前的长上下文理解弱点带入数据生成和验证过程。LongZero 先让模型生成短结构化 specification，里面固定问题、支持证据和答案；随后再把这些证据扩展成多个长文档或长对话。这样答案由构造过程决定，而不是由模型事后阅读长文本判断。数据分为两类：一类是 reasoning data，在虚构世界中生成实体和事实，将其渲染为 8 篇不同体裁的文档，再提出需要多跳整合的问题；另一类是 retrieval data，类似 MRCR，需要在长对话中定位并复现某个早先回复。训练前，模型会对同一问题多次作答，只保留有时答对、有时答错的样本，因为这类样本能给 GRPO 提供非零组内相对奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 实验在两个 base model 上进行，并评估五个长上下文推理 benchmark。结果显示，LongZero 生成的任务能迁移到通用长上下文推理评测，而不只是拟合自造格式。它还和两个依赖外部语料的合成数据 baseline 对比，并取得更好的结果。消融上最关键的点是任务过滤：只保留模型多次采样中既有正确也有错误的样本，这和 RLVR 中的有效学习信号一致。给出的全文片段没有包含具体分数、模型规模和训练 token 数，因此不宜补写精确数值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。优先读 LongZero 方法部分，特别是 top-down generation、reasoning/retrieval 两类数据格式、难度控制变量，以及基于多次作答的样本过滤规则。实验部分重点看五个长上下文 benchmark 的迁移结果、与外部语料 baseline 的对比，以及 filtering、context length、hop 数和 distractor 数的消融。如果做 RL 数据合成，最值得深挖的是“答案先验固定，再扩展上下文”的构造顺序。

summary_en.core_problem: The core problem is whether an LLM can improve long-context reasoning through RL without external documents, human annotation, or a stronger teacher model.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the interface between pretraining, continual pretraining, and RL-based post-training. Long-context improvement is often discussed in terms of architecture, positional encoding, and attention efficiency, but the RL data problem is equally central. Useful long-context RL data must be long, diverse, difficult, evidence-grounded, and automatically verifiable. LongZero provides a zero-data construction that avoids two common confounders: answering from parametric knowledge rather than the context, and training or evaluating on leaked public text.
summary_en.technical_approach: LongZero uses the model being trained to synthesize its own long-context tasks, then optimizes it with GRPO. The key design is to reverse the usual generation order. Instead of writing a long document first and then asking questions about it, the model first writes a compact structured specification containing the question, supporting evidence, and answer. Only after the answer is fixed does it expand the evidence into long contexts. This reduces reliance on the model’s ability to accurately read and verify long text during data creation. The method generates two data types. Reasoning data define fictional worlds, entities, and facts, render them into eight documents of different genres, and ask multi-hop questions requiring evidence integration. Retrieval data follow the MRCR style, where the model must locate and reproduce a specific earlier response from a long conversation. Before RL, the model answers each candidate question multiple times; only questions with mixed success and failure are kept, since they provide non-zero relative reward under GRPO.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on two base models and five long-context reasoning benchmarks. The reported results show that training on self-generated LongZero tasks transfers to general long-context reasoning benchmarks. The method is also compared with two synthetic-data baselines that rely on external corpora and performs better in the reported setting. The most important experimental insight is the filtering rule: samples that are always solved or always failed carry little GRPO signal, while partially solved samples produce useful within-group contrast. The provided content does not include exact benchmark scores, model sizes, or training-token counts, so precise numerical claims should be checked in the tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim should focus on the LongZero method section. The most useful parts are the top-down task generation procedure, the two task families, the difficulty controls over context length, hop count, and distractors, and the multi-sample filtering rule. In the experiments, prioritize transfer to the five long-context benchmarks, comparison with external-corpus baselines, and ablations on filtering and task construction. For RL data synthesis, the main design worth reusing is fixing the answer in a short specification before expanding the context.

recommendation.zh: 值得看它怎么把 zero-data RL 扩到长上下文；若任务构造足够干净，这会直接影响你对“长样本必须靠外部语料”的先验，但先别太信分数，重点审合成与验证闭环。
recommendation.en: Read it for the task-construction trick that extends zero-data RL to long context; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that long-context RL must depend on external corpora, but inspect the synthesis/verification loop before trusting the gains.

paper.title: Ask to Distill: Learning to Synthesize Data for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) can succeed with surprisingly few training questions, motivating a view of questions as carriers of distributional knowledge transfer. How can we assess whether a newly generated question is valuable for distillation, and learn to generate better questions---without access to its correct answer? We introduce Ask-to-Distill (\method), a framework that treats synthetic questions as distribution elicitors and optimizes the teacher supervision they expose along student-g

summary.core_problem: 在不依赖参考答案、正确性奖励或逐候选更新学生模型的前提下，如何评估并学习生成“对 on-policy distillation（OPD）最有价值”的训练问题（prompts），使得这些问题能诱导学生产生合适轨迹，从而暴露出高质量、可学习的 teacher token-level 监督信号。
summary.importance:
这篇更贴近 pretrain↔posttrain 接口：它把“数据构造”从传统的带答案合成，转成“为蒸馏诱导分布监督信号”的 prompt 合成，并给出了无需答案的可优化目标。对预训练研究的具体启发在两点：
- 数据价值的定义可以是“诱导到的监督密度/可教性（teachability）”，而不是样本本身的语义覆盖；这与数据课程、数据筛选、以及用模型差异做数据打分的思路同构。
- 支持集（student support）视角很关键：单纯最大化 teacher–student divergence 会奖励不可学习区域（teacher 质量集中在学生采样不到的 token 上），A2D 用 teacher 在学生候选 token 上的概率质量来区分“可纠正的分歧”和“支持集外分歧”。这对做蒸馏、持续训练时的 token/序列加权有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
A2D 把“问题”视为 distribution elicitor：问题本身不提供答案，而是决定学生会走到哪些状态（prefixes），从而决定 teacher 在这些状态上能提供多少有效监督。

整体流程分两阶段：先训练问题生成器（synthesizer），再用生成的问题做标准 OPD。

1) Synthesizer 初始化与训练方式
- 用 student 初始化一个问题生成策略（prompt policy），用 RL 训练它。
- 训练时 teacher 与用于打分的 student 都冻结；不需要对每个候选问题做一次学生更新来估计收益（避免昂贵的 inner-loop）。

2) 无答案的“问题价值”奖励（distributional surrogate）
- 核心信号由 token 级的 teacher–student 差异构成，但不是直接用 KL/JS 之类的全量差异。
- 引入 support-aware 的可教性项：结合“teacher–student disagreement”与“teacher 在 student 候选 token 上的概率质量”。直觉是：如果 teacher 的偏好主要落在学生会采样/会考虑的 token 上，这种分歧更可能通过蒸馏被纠正；反之分歧集中在支持集外，奖励它只会诱导不可学习的轨迹。
- 把 token 信号沿着 student rollout 轨迹聚合成 question-level reward。

3) 防止奖励投机（reward hacking）的约束项
- 长度控制：用次线性长度归一化 + 软响应预算惩罚，避免通过拉长回答来堆 token 信号。
- 多样性：加入 batch-level diversity term，避免 synthesizer 收敛到狭窄题型反复刷分。

4) 生成数据的整理
- 训练后对问题做格式过滤、词法与语义去重；语义去重使用冻结的 Qwen3-Embedding-4B，仅用于去重，不参与奖励优化。

与常见“合成问答对用于 SFT”不同，A2D 不需要参考答案；与“用 reward/正确性做 task generation”不同，它优化的是 teacher 分布监督的可用性，而不是任务成功率。
summary.experiments:
文中实验覆盖多个 student–teacher 规模组合，以及数学推理、代码生成、agentic 任务等下游评测，主要比较对象是：真实问题库上的 OPD、以及不经优化的自生成问题等。

从全文主张与给出的结论性结果看：
- A2D 生成的问题用于 OPD 后，在所评估的 student–teacher pairs 的平均分上超过 real-bank OPD。
- 分析显示：优化后的问题能在更短的学生回答里诱导更“密”的分布监督信号（即单位长度的有效监督更高），说明收益不是简单来自更长 rollouts。
- 组件消融围绕奖励的几部分：support-aware 项、长度项、多样性项；作者用这些消融来证明如果只追 divergence 或不控长度/多样性，会出现退化（例如偏向长回答或模式坍塌）。

你给的全文片段没有包含具体表格数字（提升幅度、问题数量、训练步数、模型参数等），因此这里无法可靠复述精确数值；精读时建议直接从实验表与附录抓这些关键量。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 Introduction 里“question as distribution elicitor”的定义，以及为什么 OPD 的数据价值是 pair-dependent（依赖特定 student–teacher）。
- 精看 Method 里 reward 的构成：support-aware token 信号如何定义、如何沿轨迹聚合、长度归一化与预算惩罚怎么写、多样性项如何实现。这部分决定了它是否真能避免 divergence/长度投机。
- 看 reward-component ablations：验证每个约束项是否必要，尤其是去掉长度/多样性后出现的失败模式。
- 看 learning-signal analyses：作者如何证明“更短回答也能获得更密监督”，这关系到数据效率。

如果要深挖到可复现/可迁移：重点关注（a）student 候选 token 集合如何定义（top-k? nucleus? beam?），（b）teacher mass-on-support 的计算细节与数值稳定性，（c）batch diversity 的具体形式（基于 n-gram 还是 embedding 距离），以及（d）去重与过滤对最终 OPD 的贡献占比。

summary_en.core_problem: How to score and learn to generate prompts that are maximally useful for on-policy distillation (OPD) without reference answers, correctness rewards, or per-candidate student updates—i.e., prompts that drive the student into trajectories where the teacher provides learnable token-level supervision.
summary_en.importance: This sits squarely at the pretrain↔post-train interface: it reframes synthetic data generation from producing labeled QA pairs to producing prompts that elicit high-value distributional supervision for a specific student–teacher pair. Two concrete takeaways for foundation-model training: (1) data value can be defined by elicited teachable supervision density rather than semantic coverage; (2) the student-support view matters—maximizing raw teacher–student divergence can reward unlearnable regions, so weighting by teacher probability mass on the student’s candidate tokens is a principled guardrail that also relates to token/sequence reweighting in distillation and continual training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Ask-to-Distill (A2D) treats a prompt as a distribution elicitor: it determines which prefixes the student visits, hence where teacher token distributions become available for OPD.

Two-stage pipeline:
1) Train a prompt synthesizer before OPD.
- Initialize the synthesizer from the student.
- Optimize it with RL while keeping the scoring student and the teacher frozen.
- Crucially, the method avoids an expensive inner loop: it does not update the student per candidate prompt to estimate value.

2) A no-answer, distributional surrogate reward for prompt value.
- The reward aggregates token-level signals along student rollouts.
- Instead of rewarding pure disagreement (which can be dominated by support-mismatch), it uses a support-aware notion of teachability: combine teacher–student discrepancy with the teacher’s probability mass on the student’s candidate tokens, aiming to capture “corrective preference within student support” rather than “divergence outside support”.

Anti-gaming terms:
- Length control via sublinear length normalization plus a soft response-budget penalty to prevent inflating reward by longer outputs.
- A batch-level diversity term to prevent mode collapse into a narrow prompt family.

Curation:
- After training, prompts are format-filtered and lexically/semantically deduplicated; a frozen Qwen3-Embedding-4B is used only for semantic deduplication, not for reward computation.

Compared to synthetic SFT data, A2D does not need reference answers; compared to task-generation via success rewards, it optimizes the usability of teacher distributional supervision rather than task correctness.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates across multiple student–teacher scale pairs and task families (math reasoning, code generation, agentic tasks), comparing OPD using A2D-generated prompt banks against OPD using real prompt banks and unoptimized self-generated prompts.

Key reported claims:
- OPD trained on A2D prompts exceeds real-bank OPD on average across the evaluated student–teacher pairs.
- Analyses indicate optimized prompts elicit denser supervision with shorter student responses, suggesting gains are not merely from longer rollouts.
- Reward-component ablations (support-aware term, length control, diversity) are used to show failure modes when optimizing disagreement alone or when removing anti-gaming constraints.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables (exact gains, prompt counts, training steps, model sizes), so exact figures cannot be quoted reliably here; they should be taken directly from the main experiment tables and appendix during reading.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Read the introduction for the “prompt as distribution elicitor” framing and why prompt utility is student–teacher pair dependent.
- Focus on the reward definition: how student support is defined, how teacher mass-on-support is computed, how token signals are aggregated, and how length/diversity constraints are implemented.
- Check reward ablations to understand which term prevents which failure mode (length inflation vs mode collapse vs unteachable divergence).
- Read the learning-signal analysis that argues for higher supervision density with shorter responses—this is the data-efficiency core.

For deeper reproducibility/transfer: inspect (a) the exact definition of the student candidate set (top-k / nucleus / beam), (b) numerical stability of the support-mass computation, (c) the diversity term implementation (n-gram vs embedding distance), and (d) how much dedup/filtering contributes relative to the RL-trained synthesizer.

paper.title: RACE: Learning Multimodal Search through Referential Abstraction and Compositional Evidence
paper.abstract: Training multimodal search agents requires tasks that make visually grounded search necessary for determining the answer. Textual identity clues and unused target evidence allow shortcuts in synthetic questions, weakening supervision for visual search and evidence integration. We propose RACE, an image-conditioned task synthesis framework that constructs dependencies from images to targets and from target-specific evidence to answers. Referential Abstraction (RA) replaces identity-revealing text

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多模态搜索训练数据里的“捷径监督”问题：问题文本常常泄露目标身份，或者最终答案只依赖部分实体证据，导致模型不必真正看图、搜索、整合多条证据也能答对。
summary.importance: 它对基座研究的直接价值不在模型架构，而在多模态 agent / VLM 后训练数据构造。RACE 给出了一套检查和构造任务依赖的方法：从图像到目标、从目标证据到答案，每一步都要成为解题所必需的条件。这类设计比单纯堆复杂问题更有用，因为它减少了合成数据中的伪难度，也更接近训练“视觉定位—外部搜索—证据组合”的能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成。第一是 Referential Abstraction，简称 RA。它把实体身份从文本里拿掉，改成图像中的可见引用，例如位置、外观、遮挡、相对关系；也可以用模糊关系引用，让多个图中候选都视觉上可行，再通过检索到的实体事实唯一确定目标。为了避免文本泄露，系统会对所有候选做搜索，要求只有一个候选满足条件，并用 question-only probe 检查仅凭问题文本是否能恢复身份或答案。第二是 Compositional Evidence，简称 CE。它要求答案依赖每个被选目标的证据，可以是同一张图里的多个实体，也可以是多张图各提供一个必要实体。关键约束是：事实组合必须共同决定一个答案，移除任一指定贡献后答案应不再确定。数据从真实图像出发，包括社交媒体照片、Bilibili 视频帧和 MovieNet 电影图像。未标注图像通过轻量过滤、视觉分析和检索建立目标身份；MovieNet 则利用已有身份—图像对应关系。最终由 teacher 解题，只保留最终答案被判定正确的轨迹用于 SFT。
summary.experiments: 主要实验是用 12K 条 RACE 合成轨迹对 Qwen3.5-27B 做监督微调。平均准确率在 10 个 benchmark 上从 53.5 提升到 56.0。论文还报告，在 4 个主要 benchmark 上，模型在第一轮之后继续使用视觉工具的比例都有提升，说明数据确实推动了多轮视觉搜索，而不是只提升了表面答题格式。消融的核心看点是 RA 和 CE 分别对应两类失败：没有 RA 时，文本身份线索会绕过看图；没有 CE 时，多实体问题可能只使用一个实体的证据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解论文把“身份泄露”和“未使用实体证据”统一成依赖断裂问题。方法部分重点看 RA 的两类引用、唯一匹配约束、question-only probe，以及 CE 的“移除任一贡献后答案不确定”条件。实验部分重点看 Table 1 和工具使用统计。Appendix C 值得扫一遍，里面的 synthesis algorithm 和 refinement procedure 对做多模态 SFT 数据管线更有参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets shortcut supervision in multimodal search data. Synthetic questions often leak the target identity in text, or mention multiple entities while the final answer depends on only one of them. In those cases, a model can answer without doing visually grounded target resolution, search, and evidence integration.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in data construction for multimodal agents and VLM post-training, not in model architecture. RACE gives a concrete way to enforce task dependencies: the image must determine which target is relevant, and target-specific evidence must determine the answer. This is a useful design principle for synthetic data, because it removes many forms of artificial difficulty that do not train the intended capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: RACE has two core operations. Referential Abstraction removes identity-revealing text and replaces it with image-grounded references. These can be specific visual references, such as position, appearance, occlusion, or spatial relation, or ambiguous relational references that require searching over multiple depicted candidates and selecting the one whose retrieved evidence satisfies a condition. The construction searches all candidates, requires a unique match, rules out alternatives, and uses a question-only probe to detect identity or answer leakage. Compositional Evidence then builds questions whose answer depends on every selected target’s evidence. The targets can come from one image or from several images, and the construction requires that removing any designated contribution leaves the answer underdetermined. The data starts from real images, including social media photos, Bilibili video frames, and MovieNet imagery. For unannotated images, filtering, visual analysis, and retrieval establish candidate identities; MovieNet provides identity-image provenance. A teacher solves the resulting tasks, and only trajectories with correct final answers are kept for SFT.
summary_en.experiments: The main result fine-tunes Qwen3.5-27B on 12K synthesized trajectories. Average accuracy across ten benchmarks rises from 53.5 to 56.0. The paper also reports increased use of visual tools beyond the first round on all four primary benchmarks, which is important because the goal is to train iterative visual search rather than only improve final answer formatting. The key ablation logic separates the two shortcut sources: without RA, text can reveal the target; without CE, multi-entity questions can fail to require all entity evidence.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with Figures 1 and 2 to understand how identity leakage and unused entity evidence are framed as broken dependencies. In the method section, focus on the two RA forms, the unique-match requirement, the question-only leakage probe, and the CE condition that every selected contribution must be necessary. In the experiments, read Table 1 and the visual-tool-use analysis. Appendix C is worth scanning if you build multimodal SFT data pipelines, since it contains the synthesis algorithm and refinement details.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法部分；RA/CE 是干净的 anti-shortcut 设计，可迁移到内部工具使用数据合成。
recommendation.en: Skim the method: RA/CE is a clean anti-shortcut design that can transfer to internal tool-use data synthesis.

paper.title: TIRE: Top-Down Formula Instantiation with Reliable Execution for Physics Problem Synthesis
paper.abstract: Advancing physics reasoning in large language models requires scalable training data that connect physical laws, concrete problem scenarios, and verifiable numerical answers. Expert-designed problems offer top-down control over physical laws, conditions, and scenarios, but require costly human effort. LLM-based synthesis from texts scales efficiently, but model-generated answers and assessments leave supervision vulnerable to hallucinations. We introduce TIRE, a framework for Top-Down Formula In

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“再做一个物理题数据集”，而是物理推理训练数据里一个长期存在的结构性问题：现有数据要么来自人工命题，质量高但规模小；要么直接让 LLM 从文本生成题目和解答，规模大但监督信号不可靠。物理题比纯数学更难，因为它不仅要算对，还要保证自然语言场景、物理定律、适用条件、参数设定和数值答案彼此一致。TIRE 试图把“专家自上而下命题”的可控性，与“程序执行可验证”的可靠性，以及“LLM 生成自然语言”的扩展性放到同一条流水线上。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它给“可验证科学推理数据如何规模化构造”提供了一个比直接 LLM 合成更稳的范式：先有结构化物理关系和可执行程序，再生成自然语言题面与教师推理，而不是反过来先写题再猜答案。第二，它把监督信号锚定在执行结果上，而不是锚定在 teacher model 本身上，这一点对高质量 reasoning SFT 和后续 RL 都很关键。量级上，这不是改变基座建模范式的工作，但在“如何构造高信噪比、可控、可扩展的科学推理训练数据”这个问题上，方法设计是扎实的，尤其适合作为合成 reasoning data pipeline 的参考模板。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是三段式：Physical Knowledge、Top-Down Formula Instantiation、Teacher Distillation，并且三段都由程序执行信号贯穿。

第一段是物理知识表示。作者从 PHYSICS 和 SciBench 中抽取 3,051 条 formula records，把每条记录组织成可复用的物理关系、变量定义、适用条件以及必要的语义约束。这里的关键不是把公式当字符串存起来，而是把它变成后续可实例化、可执行、可检查的知识单元。

第二段是 top-down instantiation。流程是先把公式翻译成可执行程序，再做 Program Validation，确保公式实现和变量关系没有写错；之后对变量采样或设定具体数值，生成满足适用条件的实例，并通过 Instance Execution 得到参考答案 y*。这个顺序很重要：先执行出答案，再去写题面。这样自然语言生成只是“表达一个已经成立的物理实例”，而不是让模型在开放空间里同时发明场景、关系和答案。相比直接 prompting LLM 生成题目+解答，这种做法把错误空间压缩了很多。

第三段是 teacher distillation。作者仍然使用 teacher model 生成 reasoning trace，但不直接信任 teacher 的过程或结论，而是用执行得到的参考答案做 Answer Verification，只保留最终答案与 y* 一致的轨迹 τ。也就是说，teacher 的角色从“真值来源”降级为“语言化解释器”。这和很多合成 CoT 数据工作不同：后者常常把 teacher 输出整体当监督，容易把幻觉和错误推理一并蒸馏进去。

从设计取舍看，TIRE 的重点不是追求形式化证明级别的完整 correctness，而是建立一个更现实的中间层：结构化知识 + 可执行验证 + 语言表达分离。它没有完全解决物理场景语义真实性的问题，例如题面措辞是否总是自然、是否覆盖复杂多步建模，但它显著提高了数值监督的可信度和题目构造的可控性。
summary.experiments:
数据方面，作者构建了 TIRE-19k，共 19,144 个样本，覆盖 9 个物理子领域，底层依托 3,051 条公式记录。每个样本都包含自然语言问题、执行得到的参考答案，以及通过答案校验筛出的 teacher reasoning trace。

实验设置上，论文在 3 个 backbone、4 个 benchmark 上比较 TIRE-19k 与已有物理推理数据，在相同训练数据量条件下，TIRE 在 domain 内表现和 out-of-domain 泛化上都更好。摘要和正文给出的主结论是：同等数据预算下，TIRE-19k 优于现有数据构造路线，说明提升主要来自数据质量与监督可靠性，而不只是样本数增加。

更有信息量的是消融。作者分别验证了几个关键部件：
1. top-down formula instantiation 相比直接文本生成更有效，说明“先公式实例、后语言表达”的顺序是有用的；
2. reliable execution 带来的 reference answer 是关键，没有执行锚点时，teacher trace 的噪声会明显上升；
3. teacher comparison 显示该框架对不同 teacher 都成立，说明收益不是绑定某一个强 teacher；
4. 在 SFT 之后继续做 GRPO 还能进一步提升，说明这类 execution-grounded 数据不仅适合监督学习，也能为基于结果奖励的后训练提供较干净的起点。

从可解释性上看，这篇实验最值得注意的不是单个 benchmark 数字，而是它证明了一个数据构造原则：当答案可由独立程序给出时，teacher 只负责生成可读推理，而不负责定义真值，训练信号会稳很多。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓方法主线，再看数据构造细节，预计 20–30 分钟能把核心吃透。

优先看 Introduction 里作者对物理数据构造难点的拆解，尤其是“物理不同于数学”的那段：物理题需要同时满足场景、定律、适用条件和数值一致性。这个问题定义是整篇工作的出发点。

然后看 Method 总图和三模块描述。重点盯三件事：
1. formula record 到 executable program 的转换方式；
2. Program Validation / Instance Execution / Answer Verification 三个程序化检查点分别在防什么错误；
3. teacher trace 为什么只做筛选，不做真值来源。

实验部分建议重点看：
- 与现有数据集在等数据量下的对比；
- ablation，特别是去掉 execution grounding 或改成直接生成时性能怎么掉；
- teacher comparison；
- SFT 后接 GRPO 的结果。

如果只想判断这篇工作是否值得后续复用，核心问题只有两个：一是公式知识库的构造成本和覆盖面是否可接受；二是程序验证能否扩展到更复杂、多公式联立、带单位换算和条件分支的物理题。这两个点决定它更像一个可扩展范式，还是一个当前规模下有效的工程方案。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in physics reasoning data: expert-written problems are controlled and reliable but expensive, while LLM-generated problems scale but often mix correct language with incorrect physics, invalid assumptions, or hallucinated answers. Physics is harder than pure math here because correctness requires consistency across the natural-language scenario, the governing law, applicability conditions, parameter instantiation, and the final numerical answer. TIRE is designed to combine top-down control from structured physics knowledge with execution-grounded supervision and scalable language generation.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is methodological rather than architectural. For pretraining and post-training research, it offers a clean recipe for building high-signal scientific reasoning data: derive the answer from executable structure first, then generate the problem and reasoning around that anchor. This reduces the common failure mode where the teacher model becomes both generator and judge. The contribution is meaningful for reasoning data construction, especially for domains where answers can be independently computed. It is not a new LM paradigm, but it is a solid template for controllable, verifiable synthetic data pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TIRE has three modules: Physical Knowledge, Top-Down Formula Instantiation, and Teacher Distillation, all tied together by program-based verification.

The first module represents reusable physics knowledge as formula records. These records are not treated as plain text snippets; they encode the physical relation, variable semantics, and applicability conditions needed for downstream instantiation. The dataset is grounded in 3,051 such records extracted from PHYSICS and SciBench.

The second module is the core design choice: top-down instantiation. A formula is translated into an executable program, validated through Program Validation, then instantiated with concrete parameter values that satisfy the formula’s validity conditions. The program is executed to obtain a reference answer y*. This ordering matters. Instead of asking an LLM to jointly invent a scenario, choose a law, assign values, and solve it, TIRE first constructs a valid physical instance and only then verbalizes it as a natural-language problem. That sharply narrows the error surface.

The third module is teacher distillation. A teacher model generates reasoning traces, but those traces are not trusted by default. TIRE keeps only traces whose final answer matches the execution-derived reference via Answer Verification. This turns the teacher into a language explainer rather than the source of truth. That is a notable departure from many synthetic CoT pipelines, where the teacher’s full output is directly used as supervision.

The broader design logic is clear: separate semantic generation from numerical correctness, and let deterministic execution define the target whenever possible. The framework does not fully solve realism or coverage of complex multi-law physics problems, but it substantially improves controllability and label reliability.

recommendation.en: A pipeline that ensures numerical correctness of synthetic data by front-loading symbolic execution; offers some inspiration for researchers focused on complex reasoning data synthesis (e.g., math/physics), focus on the specific design of formula instantiation.

paper.title: How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies
paper.abstract: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this questi

summary.core_problem: 在 agentic RL（面向工具/环境交互的强化学习）里，“训练数据量”不再能用 rollout token 或轨迹条数这种单一标量刻画。一次数据采样同时包含任务规格（task）、环境实例与 API/动力学（environment）、交互轨迹（trajectory）以及奖励信号（reward）。现代合成流水线还能分别在 task/environment/trajectory 三个轴上扩容，且成本与收益曲线不同。论文要解决的问题是：在给定合成预算与训练算力下，应该优先扩哪一类数据（造更多任务、造更多世界/环境、还是在同一任务环境上采更多轨迹），以及合成数据在各轴上能替代多少真实数据。
summary.importance:
贡献点不在提出一个新的 RL 算法，而是把“agentic 数据”从标量变成可优化的设计空间，并给出可拟合、可定价、可做预算分配的 scaling 框架。对预训练研究的直接启发有三类：
1) 数据轴分解：把过去 token-count scaling 的思路迁移到“结构化数据”上，强调不同数据维度的边际收益不同，且会决定训练瓶颈在哪里。
2) 合成数据的可替代性度量：用 per-axis discount（合成折扣）与 critical synthetic-to-real ratio（崩溃阈值）把“合成数据有用但会塌”这件事量化，给数据配比与课程学习提供了可操作指标。
3) 预算分配的闭式解：在拟合到 per-axis scaling 指数后，把数据生成与模型规模一起纳入 compute-optimal 规划，形成类似 Chinchilla 但面向 agentic RL 的配方。对做 tool-use / SWE agent / UI agent 的 mid-train 或 RL pretrain 团队，这类结论能直接影响数据管线投资顺序（先造世界/环境，再造任务，最后才是重复采样轨迹）。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步，彼此强耦合：
1) 轴分解与拟合（Section 4）：把训练语料形式化为数据张量：任务集合 ST、环境集合 SE、以及每个 (t,e) 单元格里的轨迹数 n_{t,e}，并定义三条“基数轴”——任务数 DT=|ST|、环境数 DE=|SE|、轨迹轴 Dτ（可理解为在覆盖的 (t,e) 上的采样密度/总轨迹量），外加一个奖励密度控制变量（reward density，用来控制奖励信号稀疏/密集程度或正负样本比例一类的可调旋钮）。在控制其它轴不变的条件下，分别扩展某一轴并拟合性能-数据的幂律指数 αT、αE、ατ。
2) 合成“定价”（Section 5）：用真实数据拟合出的 scaling law 作为公共尺子，把不同合成方法在每个轴上产生的数据折算成“real-equivalent”。用 κ∈[0,1] 表示合成折扣（同样数量的合成数据，相当于 κ 倍真实数据的效果），并测量合成/真实比例 r 的临界点 r*：当合成占比超过 r* 后性能开始系统性塌陷或收益显著变差。论文报告了 rE*≈9.4、rT*≈3.4、rτ*≈1.4，并给出机制解释：越“接地外部真值”的轴（环境/world 的真实交互约束更强）越能承受更高的合成占比；轨迹轴最容易因为自举偏差/奖励模型偏差/行为克隆式的模式坍缩而先塌。
3) 预算分配优化（Section 6）：在给定总 compute 预算 C 下，把模型规模 N 与三轴数据预算 (DE,DT,Dτ) 一起做 constrained optimization，得到 compute-optimal 的 scaling 配方：DE*∝C^0.34，DT*∝C^0.27，Dτ*∝C^0.13，N*∝C^0.26。直观含义是：算力变大时，最该优先扩的是“环境/世界多样性”，其次是任务多样性，轨迹密度增长最慢；重复采样同一 (t,e) 的更多轨迹边际收益最低。论文还把 environment 进一步拆成 world 多样性与 environment-structure 多样性，得到更细的指数排序：αW>αV≈αT>ατ，从而把“造新世界”与“改环境结构/API 表面”区分开。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖面强调稳健性而不是单点刷榜：
- 模型与算法：Qwen3-4B/8B/14B；同时覆盖 GRPO 与 PPO 两类 agentic RL 训练范式。
- 任务域：数学+代码、SWE、web、UI/tool application 等五个域（文中称 five domains）。
- 设置数量：作者称总计 21 个 settings（不同模型家族/算法/域组合）。
关键结果与数字：
1) 反例证明“token 标量”失效：在 Qwen3-8B 上做两次训练，保持总 tokens 与 FLOPs 相同，仅改变 (task, environment, trajectory) 的预算切分，最终 success rate 相差 14 个百分点；单轴幂律无法同时拟合。
2) per-axis scaling 指数的稳定排序：跨模型、算法、域，观察到 αE>αT>ατ；进一步细分环境后得到 αW>αV≈αT>ατ。
3) 合成塌陷阈值：rE*≈9.4，rT*≈3.4，rτ*≈1.4，显示“环境轴”可承受远高于“轨迹轴”的合成占比。
4) compute-optimal 配方并做 held-out compute scale 验证：用推导出的指数给出 DE/DT/Dτ/N 随 C 的幂次增长，并在未参与拟合的算力规模上验证该分配能预测更优的 allocation（文中表述为 validate the predicted allocation at a held-out compute scale）。
从消融角度，最值得注意的是：当你已经覆盖足够多的 (t,e) 单元格后，继续在同一格子里 resample trajectory 的收益很快进入低回报区，且更容易触发合成偏差累积。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议按“先框架、再数字、最后机制”走：
- 先看 Introduction + Figure 1：理解为什么同 tokens/FLOPs 也会差 14pp，以及作者要把问题从“多收数据”改成“怎么分配预算”。
- 重点读 Section 4：数据张量定义、三轴基数与 reward density 的操作化方式、以及 per-axis scaling 的拟合流程。这里决定了后面所有结论是否可信。
- 重点读 Section 5：κ（discount）与 r*（collapse threshold）的定义与测量方式。建议带着两个问题读：r* 是怎么判定“塌”的（指标/统计准则）？κ 的估计是否会被训练不稳定或评测噪声污染？
- 重点读 Section 6：从拟合指数到 compute-optimal 幂次配方的推导，尤其是约束条件里如何把“合成折扣/成本”纳入。
- 最后回看环境细分（world vs environment-structure）的实验：它直接对应工程决策——是投入去做更多可交互世界，还是在同一世界上扩 API/界面复杂度。
值得深挖的点：reward density 这个控制变量在不同域的作用是否一致；以及 rτ* 很低时，是否意味着很多 RL pipeline 的“多 rollouts”其实在买低效数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Agentic RL data is not a single scalar like “rollout tokens”. Each sample jointly contains a task specification, an environment instance (API surface + dynamics), an interaction trajectory, and a reward signal—each produced by different synthesis components with different costs and saturation behaviors. The paper asks a pretraining-style question in this new setting: given a fixed synthesis/compute budget, which axis should be scaled (more tasks, more environments/worlds, or more trajectories per task-environment), and how far can synthetic data substitute for real data on each axis before performance collapses?
summary_en.importance: The main value is a usable scaling framework for agentic RL that turns “data” into a structured design space and makes budget allocation solvable rather than heuristic. For foundation-model pretraining researchers, it contributes: (1) a principled axis decomposition that mirrors token-based scaling laws but for structured interaction data; (2) a quantitative notion of synthetic-data substitutability via per-axis discounts and collapse thresholds, directly informing data mixture and curriculum decisions; (3) a compute-optimal allocation recipe (data axes + model size) analogous in spirit to Chinchilla, but tailored to agentic RL where environment diversity can dominate returns. Practically, it argues that investing in new environments/worlds tends to beat resampling more trajectories under the same environments.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The approach is intentionally end-to-end and depends on three coupled steps:
1) Axis decomposition and per-axis scaling fits (Sec. 4): formalize the training corpus as a tensor over tasks T, environments E, and trajectories per (t,e) cell. Define cardinalities DT=|T|, DE=|E|, and a trajectory axis Dτ capturing sampling density/volume, plus a reward-density control knob. Fit independent power-law exponents αT, αE, ατ by varying one axis while controlling others.
2) Pricing synthesis with a common ruler (Sec. 5): use the real-data scaling laws to convert synthetic data into “real-equivalent” units. Introduce κ∈[0,1] as an axis-specific discount (effectiveness of synthetic vs real) and identify a critical synthetic-to-real ratio r* where performance degradation/collapse begins. Reported thresholds are strongly ordered: rE*≈9.4, rT*≈3.4, rτ*≈1.4, with a mechanistic interpretation tied to how strongly each axis is grounded by external truth.
3) Compute-optimal allocation (Sec. 6): solve a constrained optimization over model size N and axis budgets (DE,DT,Dτ) under total compute C, incorporating synthesis costs/discounts. Derive closed-form scaling prescriptions: DE*∝C^0.34, DT*∝C^0.27, Dτ*∝C^0.13, N*∝C^0.26. Further refine the environment axis into world diversity vs environment-structure diversity, yielding αW>αV≈αT>ατ, which maps cleanly to engineering choices (build new worlds vs expand API/structure).
summary_en.experiments:
Coverage is designed to test robustness across models, algorithms, and domains rather than a single benchmark:
- Models/algorithms: Qwen3-4B/8B/14B; both GRPO and PPO.
- Domains: five domains including math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool-use.
- Total: 21 experimental settings (as stated).
Key quantitative takeaways:
1) A direct failure case for scalar “token” scaling: two Qwen3-8B runs with identical total tokens and FLOPs but different (task, environment, trajectory) allocations differ by 14 percentage points in success rate.
2) Stable exponent ordering across settings: αE>αT>ατ; with environment split, αW>αV≈αT>ατ.
3) Synthetic mixture limits: collapse thresholds rE*≈9.4, rT*≈3.4, rτ*≈1.4, implying trajectory-heavy synthetic rollouts are the most fragile.
4) The compute-optimal allocation derived from fitted laws is validated at a held-out compute scale, supporting the claim that the fitted exponents are predictive for budget planning.
A practical interpretation consistent with the reported numbers: once coverage over (t,e) cells is decent, additional trajectory resampling yields the lowest marginal gains and hits synthetic bias issues earliest.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order that matches the dependency chain:
- Start with the Introduction and the motivating figure showing a 14pp gap under equal tokens/FLOPs; it clarifies why allocation, not quantity, is the bottleneck.
- Spend most time on Sec. 4 (definitions + fitting protocol). The credibility of everything else hinges on how DT/DE/Dτ and reward density are operationalized and controlled.
- Then Sec. 5 for κ and r*: check how “collapse” is detected, what metrics are used, and whether the estimation is robust to training noise.
- Sec. 6 for the optimization and the derived exponents; verify how synthesis costs/discounts enter constraints and why the resulting powers take those values.
- Finally, focus on the environment split (world vs structure). This is the most actionable part for teams deciding between generating new interactive worlds versus enriching existing environments.
Deep-dive prompts: whether reward density behaves consistently across domains; and whether common RL practices that emphasize more rollouts are implicitly spending budget on the least efficient axis.

recommendation.zh: 把 agentic RL 的“数据量”拆成可操作的三轴并给出指数排序，能直接改你对合成预算分配的 prior；重点看指数拟合的置信区间与是否跨 domain 真稳。
recommendation.en: The 3-axis decomposition plus exponent ordering can genuinely change how you allocate synthetic RL budgets; focus on the fit confidence intervals and whether the ordering holds cleanly across domains.
