paper.title: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
paper.abstract: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks ge

summary.core_problem: 如何为“长时程 coworker agent”合成可执行的训练环境：不仅要生成看起来合理的用户请求，还要让多服务记录一致、工具接口可用、环境状态可变且可验证，并且能用程序化 grading 检查来给 SFT/RL 提供可靠训练信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身关联较弱，但对 agent 后训练的数据与环境构造有直接启发：把“数据合成”推进到“可执行环境合成”，用验证与修复闭环提高训练信号质量；同时把能力需求（workflow 依赖、安全约束）显式化，减少纯文本合成带来的不可检验与 reward hacking 空间。
summary.technical_approach:
CoworkEnv 的主线是 capability-guided 的环境生成流水线：
- 先由开发者定义能力覆盖计划（服务组合、难度、业务场景、安全约束）。
- 让 LLM 基于服务目录与格式规范生成：用户请求、初始服务记录、工具接口、结构化 completion checks、禁止动作等。
- 用程序化验证与 feedback repair 保证一致性与可执行性（记录引用一致、工具能读写状态、grading 能检查关键副作用）。
- 用 teacher 执行收集并筛选 demonstrations 做 SFT；再让 student 在环境中交互拿 rollouts 与 reward 做 RL。
- 任务变化来源包括：跨服务 workflow 组合、以及带 permitted/prohibited actions 的安全场景。
summary.experiments: 文中给出的主要量化结果是 SFT 增益：在 Claw-Eval 上把 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 微调成 PocketWorker-8B，均分从 46.6 提升到 64.1；Multi-turn 子集提升 31.9 分。另有在 ClawMark 上的 SFT-only 扩展评测。RL 方面主要展示可训练性与配置对比：比较 GRPO、Dr.GRPO、GDPO、GiGPO 等配置，训练 reward 在构造任务上约 3 个 epoch 内上升（更偏“可行性证据”而非最终能力上限）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Method 里“环境由哪些可执行部件组成”（请求/记录/工具/检查/禁止动作）以及 programmatic validation + repair 的设计，这是区别于纯合成数据集的关键。
- 再看实验部分的 SFT 提升与 Multi-turn 分项，理解这些环境到底在训练什么能力。
- RL 配置对比可以快速扫一遍，主要看 credit assignment/advantage 估计在此类环境里的敏感性。
预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可抓住框架与数据形态；要复用到自家任务，需要更细读任务规范与验证逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: How to synthesize executable training environments for long-horizon “coworker” agents where requests, multi-service records, tool APIs, mutable workspace state, and grading checks are all coherent—so that both SFT demonstrations and RL rewards are grounded in verifiable execution rather than plausible text.
summary_en.importance: Only indirectly related to foundation-model pretraining, but relevant to post-training data/environment construction. The key takeaway is pushing synthetic data into synthetic *executable environments* with programmatic validation and repair, which improves training-signal reliability and reduces reward hacking opportunities common in text-only task synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CoworkEnv is a capability-guided environment synthesis pipeline:
- Define a capability coverage plan (service combinations, difficulty, business scenarios, safety constraints).
- Use an LLM conditioned on service catalogs and output specs to generate: user request, initial service records, tool interfaces, structured completion checks, and prohibited actions.
- Apply programmatic validation plus feedback-driven repair to ensure cross-record consistency, tool executability, and check correctness.
- Collect teacher executions to curate SFT demonstrations; use student interactions to gather rollouts and rewards for RL.
- Provide task variation via multi-service workflow composition and safety scenarios with explicit permitted/prohibited actions.
summary_en.experiments: Main quantitative evidence is from SFT: fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct into PocketWorker-8B improves mean score on Claw-Eval from 46.6 to 64.1, with a +31.9 gain on the Multi-turn subset. They also run an SFT-only evaluation extension on ClawMark. RL results are presented as feasibility/configuration comparisons (GRPO, Dr.GRPO, GDPO, GiGPO), showing reward improvement over roughly three epochs on the constructed tasks rather than a definitive end-to-end capability ceiling.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim priorities:
- Method section: the exact environment components (request/records/tools/checks/prohibited actions) and the validation+repair loop—this is the core contribution.
- Experimental section: focus on the Multi-turn breakdown to understand what capabilities the environments actually train.
- RL configuration comparisons can be read quickly; treat them as sensitivity notes on credit assignment/advantage estimation.
Time: ~20–30 minutes for the framework; deeper reuse requires reading the task specification and validation logic carefully.

paper.abstract: Existing quality control for long-context instruction-tuning data is a one-shot judgment inside the generation pipeline that leaves only a scalar, revealing neither which document parts an answer uses nor how many reasoning steps it writes down; the data can thus be neither audited nor controlled. We formalize data quality as a property of the alignment structure among document, question, and answer, and build LongForge, which pairs an analyzer that measures long-context data with a synthesizer

summary.core_problem: 长上下文指令微调数据的质量控制长期停留在标量打分或一次性过滤，无法回答两个关键问题：答案到底用了文档中的哪些证据，以及答案是否写出了可追踪的推理链。LongForge 将质量定义为文档、问题、答案之间的结构化对齐关系，而不是单个分数。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练方向的直接价值在于长上下文数据的可审计化。它不是简单提出一个新的长文 QA 数据集，而是给出了一套可复用的数据诊断框架。对继续预训练、long-context SFT、长文合成数据筛选都有参考意义。尤其是 breadth 和 depth 的拆分很有用：前者衡量答案覆盖了多少独立证据，后者衡量答案是否显式组合多步信息。两者相关性很低，说明长上下文能力不能只靠文档长度或 hop 数来代理。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分为 analyzer 和 synthesizer。Analyzer 将一个样本表示成 evidence-assertion reasoning graph。证据节点是文档中的原文 span，断言节点是答案句子，超边表示若干证据或已有断言共同支持一个答案句子。这个约束很关键：图不能引入文档外证据，也不能生成答案中没有写出的推理链，因此测到的是样本本身，而不是分析模型的补全能力。在图上计算四个维度：breadth 是使用的不同证据 span 数；depth 是经过 paraphrase contraction 后从证据到终端断言的最长路径；correctness 是推理步骤被输入支持的比例；completeness 是问题要求的信息点被非孤立断言回答的比例。Synthesizer 将 analyzer 放入生成闭环。Correctness 和 completeness 用作生成门控，并把失败原因反馈给模型重答；breadth 和 depth 不在生成时硬性优化，而是在建训练集时按读数混合，避免诱导形式化的多步答案。
summary.experiments: 论文测量了 7 个主流长上下文指令数据集，发现两个结构性问题。第一，breadth 随文档长度增长很慢：median breadth 为 5，答案平均只覆盖 12.1% 的文档；文档长度增加 10 倍，证据使用量只增加约 40%。第二，depth 偏低：43.4% 样本没有写出显式中间推理，breadth 与 depth 的 Pearson 相关系数只有 0.070。此外，23.3% 的推理步骤不受证据支持，10.2% 的样本不完整。基于同一个合成池，作者构造 LongForge-1 和 LongForge-N 两种混合。LongForge-1 的 breadth 和 depth 略高于基线；LongForge-N 将同一文档下的 QA 组织成多轮对话。在两个 backbone 上，它们在 6 个长上下文 benchmark 上分别比最强基线平均高 2.2–3.0 分和 3.1–4.7 分。在相同 QA 对上提高 breadth/depth 的收益约为 1.16 分。结果对文档来源和合成模型较稳，短上下文能力没有明显退化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的图构造和四个指标定义，尤其是 evidence span、assertion sentence、hyperedge 的约束；这些定义决定了指标是否可信。再看数据诊断部分的 breadth-depth 分布、coverage 随文档长度变化、unsupported step 和 incomplete sample 的统计。生成部分可重点看为什么 correctness/completeness 用作 gate，而 breadth/depth 只用于建集混合。实验部分关注 LongForge-1 与 LongForge-N 的对比，以及相同 QA 下调整结构分布的消融。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context instruction data is usually filtered by a scalar score or a one-shot verifier. That hides the two properties that matter for training: which document spans are actually used, and whether the answer exposes the reasoning steps that connect evidence to claims. LongForge reframes data quality as a structured alignment problem over document, question, and answer.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution is a data-auditing interface for long-context training. It is relevant to continued pretraining, long-context SFT, and synthetic data construction because it separates document length from actual evidence use. The breadth-depth split is particularly informative: broad evidence coverage and explicit multi-step reasoning are nearly orthogonal in existing data, so neither document length nor planned hop count is a reliable proxy for training signal quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: LongForge has an analyzer and a synthesizer. The analyzer reconstructs each QA example into an evidence-assertion reasoning graph. Evidence nodes are verbatim spans from the document. Assertion nodes are the answer sentences. A hyperedge represents a reasoning step where evidence spans and/or previous assertions support one assertion. This design prevents the analyzer from inventing external evidence or adding reasoning chains not present in the answer. Four graph-based metrics are then computed: breadth, the number of distinct evidence spans used; depth, the longest evidence-to-terminal-assertion path after paraphrase contraction; correctness, the fraction of supported reasoning steps; and completeness, the fraction of requested information points answered by supported assertions. The synthesizer uses correctness and completeness as gates, with failure reasons fed back for re-answering. Breadth and depth are measured and later controlled through dataset mixing rather than optimized directly during generation, which reduces the risk of producing answers that look multi-step only on the surface.
summary_en.experiments: The analysis covers seven mainstream long-context instruction datasets. The median breadth is 5, and answers cover only 12.1% of the document on average. A tenfold increase in document length raises evidence usage by only about 40%. Depth is also low: 43.4% of examples contain no explicit intermediate reasoning, and the Pearson correlation between breadth and depth is only 0.070. The analyzer also finds 23.3% unsupported reasoning steps and 10.2% incomplete samples. From one synthesis pool, the authors build LongForge-1 and LongForge-N. Across two backbones and six long-context benchmarks, LongForge-1 improves over the strongest baseline by 2.2–3.0 average points, while LongForge-N improves by 3.1–4.7 points. On the same QA pairs, increasing breadth and depth contributes about 1.16 points. Short-context performance remains comparable to the baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the graph definition and the four metrics in Section 3, since the value of the work depends on whether those constraints make the measurements faithful. Then check the dataset diagnosis tables and plots: breadth versus document length, depth distribution, unsupported steps, and incomplete answers. In the synthesis part, pay attention to the decision to gate on correctness and completeness while controlling breadth and depth through mixture construction. The key experiment is the comparison between LongForge-1, LongForge-N, and baseline long-context instruction data.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该当作后训练数据论文看：先读数据诊断部分，尤其 breadth/depth 正交这个观察，可能直接改你做 long-context SFT 的筛数方式。
recommendation.en: Read it as a post-training data paper: the diagnosis section matters, especially the breadth-vs-depth orthogonality, which may change how you filter long-context SFT data.

paper.title: Learning from Unverified Peers via Shared Residual Distillation
paper.abstract: A language model can generate several solutions to the same problem, some leading to correct answers and others to incorrect ones. Many post-training methods turn these trajectories into learning signals using supervision from reference answers, verifiable feedback, or external teachers. Without such supervision, learning from the model's own generations becomes less straightforward, as their correctness cannot be reliably assessed. An incorrect solution may nevertheless contain useful intermedi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体但很有意思的 post-train 学习问题：在没有参考答案、没有可验证 reward、也没有外部 teacher 的情况下，模型能不能仅从自己为同一道题采样出的多条“未经验证”的解题轨迹里学到东西，而且不必先判断哪条是对的。难点在于，错误解往往混有局部正确推理，若只按最终答案做二元筛选，会丢掉大量可用监督；但如果不筛选，又很容易把噪声学进去。
summary.importance: 它对预训练的直接影响有限，因为这是后训练方法；但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口很有启发。第一，它提出了一种不依赖 verifier 或标注答案的自蒸馏路径，适合低监督、弱反馈场景。第二，它把“同题多样本中的局部共识”当成学习信号，而不是把最终正确性当唯一标准，这个思路对 reasoning data synthesis、self-improvement、甚至未来的 latent reasoning / dense supervision 设计都有参考价值。第三，从结果看，小中等规模模型在数学推理上有明显提升，同时一般能力基本不掉，说明这种训练信号并不只是过拟合某个 reward 形式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Shared Residual Distillation，简称 SRD。它建立在 on-policy self-distillation 框架上，但去掉了参考答案和外部 teacher。核心做法不是直接让学生模仿某一条 peer solution，而是比较“不同 peer 作为附加条件时，冻结教师分布相对一个共同参照发生了哪些一致的变化”。

更具体地说，对同一道题 x，当前策略会采样 K 条解题轨迹。训练某一条 student trajectory 的某个前缀时，作者从同题样本里随机选 M 条 peer solution，再额外取一条来自其他题目的 cross-problem solution 作为 control。冻结的初始模型分别在“student prefix + 某条同题 peer”和“student prefix + cross-problem control”条件下给出 next-token 分布。两者之差可以看成该 peer 对教师分布施加的 residual shift。SRD 不直接平均这些 shift，而是做一个很保守的聚合：只保留那些在多个 peer 上方向一致的坐标，并把保留坐标的幅度截到所有支持该方向的 peer 中最小的那个。然后把这个 shared residual 加回冻结模型在 student 原始输入下的分布，形成 teacher target，学生再用 forward KL 去拟合。

这个设计有几个关键点。第一，cross-problem control 的作用是消掉“给模型额外看一段解答文本”带来的通用风格偏移，只保留与当前题目相关的 peer-induced change。没有这个参照，模型可能学到的是 generic solution-format bias，而不是题目局部推理信息。第二，取最小支持幅度而不是平均，是为了抑制错误 peer 带来的过强偏移，属于一种保守的交集式蒸馏。第三，学生训练时只看题目和自己的前缀，不看 peer；peer 只在训练时用于构造 teacher，因此推理时没有额外开销。这一点和 privileged-information distillation 的设定一致。

和 GRPO、RLVR 的区别很清楚：SRD 不需要 reward，也不需要按答案对错给 trajectory 排序。和标准 OPD 的区别在于，teacher 不是外部更强模型；和 OPSD 的区别在于，训练时也没有 reference answer，只利用同题 peer 的共享局部信号。论文真正的新意就在这里：把“多条未经验证解之间的一致残差”当成 dense token-level supervision。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在数学推理上做，基座是 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B。摘要给出了最核心的 AIME24–26 avg@12 结果：1.7B 从 11.02 提到 16.20，4B 从 19.07 提到 45.46，8B 从 21.39 提到 54.44。这个提升幅度对 4B 和 8B 尤其明显，说明方法在中等规模模型上能把同题采样中的有效局部信号挖出来，而不只是做轻微 regularization。论文还报告了 Harvard–MIT Mathematics Tournament 基准上的增益，并指出 IFEval 和 MMLU-Pro 基本保持与对应 base model 相当，说明数学强化没有明显牺牲通用能力。

从摘要和方法描述看，消融重点至少包括两项。第一，cross-problem residual reference 是有效的；去掉它，teacher target 会混入更多非题目相关的分布偏移。第二，conservative magnitude selection，也就是取最小支持幅度，而不是更激进的平均或累加，会带来更稳的效果。这与方法目标一致：在没有 correctness signal 的前提下，宁可只学 peer 之间稳定重合的局部信息，也不要放大单条错误轨迹的偶然偏移。

全文片段没有给出训练步数、采样 K/M、数据规模、以及全部 ablation 数字，因此不宜编造更细的实验配置。但仅从已给结果看，SRD 不是小修小补：它在无 verifier、无答案监督的设定下，给出了可观的 reasoning gain，而且 general benchmarks 没有明显回退。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 前半段，把 SRD 放到 RLVR、GRPO、OPD、OPSD 这条谱系里，弄清它到底去掉了哪些监督源。然后重点看方法部分关于 residual 的定义、cross-problem control 的构造，以及“方向一致 + 最小幅度”这个聚合规则。这里是整篇论文最需要想明白的地方，因为它决定了为什么错误 peer 不会轻易把 teacher target 拉偏。

接着看主结果表，重点关注三种模型规模上的增益是否一致，以及 IFEval/MMLU-Pro 是否保持稳定。最后看 ablation，尤其是去掉 cross-problem reference、替换 residual 聚合策略后的变化。如果时间有限，40 分钟左右可以抓住方法主线；如果要判断能否迁移到更一般的 post-train 场景，建议进一步思考两个问题：一，这种 shared residual 是否适用于代码、定理证明、长链工具使用；二，当 peer 多样性不足或同题样本高度同质时，SRD 的信号会不会塌缩。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise post-training question: can a model improve from its own unverified peer solutions when there are no reference answers, no verifiable rewards, and no external teacher? The challenge is that incorrect trajectories may still contain useful local reasoning, so filtering only by final-answer correctness throws away potentially valuable supervision, while learning from all samples naively would absorb too much noise.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper rather than a pretraining one, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. It offers a way to extract dense supervision without answer labels or verifiers, which matters in weak-supervision settings. More importantly, it treats local agreement across multiple same-problem samples as the learning signal, instead of treating final correctness as the only source of truth. That idea is useful for self-improvement, reasoning-data generation, and future work on dense supervision for reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is Shared Residual Distillation (SRD), an on-policy self-distillation scheme without privileged reference answers. The key idea is not to imitate any single peer solution. Instead, SRD measures how different same-problem peers consistently shift a frozen model’s token distribution relative to a shared control.

For a problem x, the current policy samples K trajectories. When training on a student-generated prefix, the method selects M same-problem peers and one cross-problem solution as a control. A frozen copy of the initial model predicts next-token distributions under two conditions: the student prefix plus a same-problem peer, and the student prefix plus the cross-problem control. Their difference is a peer-induced residual shift. SRD then aggregates these residuals conservatively: it keeps only coordinates whose direction agrees across peers, and sets the retained magnitude to the smallest supporting magnitude among those peers. This shared residual is added back to the frozen model’s distribution under the original student input, producing a teacher target. The student is trained with forward KL on that target.

Three design choices matter. First, the cross-problem control removes generic distribution shifts caused by simply appending a solution-like text, so the retained residual is more problem-specific. Second, the minimum-supported magnitude acts as a conservative intersection rule, reducing the influence of noisy or wrong peers. Third, peers are used only to construct the teacher during training; the student itself conditions only on the problem and its own prefix, so inference cost does not increase.

Compared with RLVR or GRPO, SRD needs no reward and no answer-level ranking. Compared with standard on-policy distillation, it does not rely on an external stronger teacher. Compared with prior on-policy self-distillation, it does not require reference answers. The novelty is the use of shared peer-induced residuals as dense token-level supervision.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiments are on mathematical reasoning with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B base models. The headline AIME24–26 avg@12 numbers reported in the paper are substantial: 11.02 to 16.20 for 1.7B, 19.07 to 45.46 for 4B, and 21.39 to 54.44 for 8B. The gains are especially large for 4B and 8B, suggesting that SRD can extract useful local supervision from same-problem samples rather than acting as a mild regularizer. The paper also reports improvements on the Harvard–MIT Mathematics Tournament benchmarks.

On general-capability checks, performance on IFEval and MMLU-Pro is maintained relative to the corresponding base models, which is important because it suggests the reasoning gains are not coming from a narrow trade-off. The ablations highlighted in the abstract indicate that two ingredients matter: the cross-problem residual reference and the conservative magnitude rule. That is consistent with the method’s goal: in the absence of correctness signals, it is safer to learn only the stable overlap among peers than to amplify any single trajectory’s bias.

The provided excerpt does not include full training details such as dataset size, K/M choices, number of updates, or complete ablation tables, so it would be unsafe to invent those specifics. Still, the reported benchmark gains are large enough to make the method notable within label-free reasoning post-training.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction to place SRD relative to RLVR, GRPO, OPD, and OPSD. The paper is easiest to understand once that supervision spectrum is clear. Then read the method section carefully, especially the definition of the residual, the role of the cross-problem control, and the agreement-plus-minimum-magnitude aggregation rule. That is the conceptual center of the paper.

After that, inspect the main result tables across the three model sizes and check whether the gains are consistent. Then go to the ablations: the most informative comparisons are removing the cross-problem reference and replacing the conservative residual aggregation with more aggressive alternatives. A 40-minute skim should be enough to capture the main mechanism. If you want to think beyond the paper, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the same shared-residual idea transfers to code or tool-use reasoning, and what happens when peer diversity is low or same-problem samples become too homogeneous.

recommendation.en: Cleaner than typical self-training: it learns from shared residual directions without correctness labels; read the method and error-rate ablations first.

paper.title: CoTranslator: Reverse to Forward Chain-of-Thought Translator for Reasoning Distillation
paper.abstract: Reasoning distillation requires chain-of-thought (CoT) data with correct answers, but obtaining such data efficiently remains challenging. Forward CoT generation (FCG) followed by rejection sampling (RS) produces verified, question-only responses, yet may require many teacher calls for difficult problems. Reverse CoT generation (RCG) is cheaper because it conditions on the known answer, but access to this answer can lead to post-hoc rationalization and a mismatch with the student's answer-free i

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 reasoning distillation 里的数据生成瓶颈。学生模型要学会推理，通常需要带有正确答案的高质量 chain-of-thought 数据。最常见做法是让教师从问题出发生成 forward CoT，再用 rejection sampling 保留答对的样本；问题是难题上采样成本很高。另一条路是给教师问题和答案，让它生成 reverse CoT，这样便宜很多，但会产生 post-hoc rationalization：推理过程只是对已知答案的事后解释，而不是从问题出发的可学习推导。论文的核心问题是，能否把便宜的 reverse CoT 转换成更接近 verified forward CoT 分布的数据，从而在较低教师成本下得到更适合蒸馏的推理轨迹。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-train / reasoning data construction，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有现实意义。原因很简单：高质量推理数据越来越像一种稀缺训练信号，而不是随手可得的副产物。CoTranslator 给出的启发是，数据生成不一定非要直接从目标分布昂贵采样，也可以先从便宜但有偏的分布采样，再学习一个分布校正器。这个思路对合成推理数据、RL 前的数据准备、甚至某些 curriculum 设计都有参考价值。它的贡献量级主要体现在成本-效果折中：在明显更低的 teacher compute 下，保留了大部分 rejection sampling 的收益，并且比直接用 reverse CoT 或语义抑制类方法更稳。
summary.technical_approach:
方法的关键是把 reverse CoT 到 verified forward CoT 的差异显式建模成一个 translation 问题，而不是继续在 prompt 上做约束。

设问题为 q，正确答案为 a。Forward CoT 分布是教师仅看 q 生成推理；rejection sampling 从中筛出最终答案等于 a 的样本。Reverse CoT 分布则是教师在输入里同时看到 (q, a) 后生成推理。作者认为学生真正需要学习的是 rejection-sampled forward CoT 的分布，而不是 reverse CoT 的分布。

于是他们先构造一个小规模配对集。对同一个问题，采一个 reverse CoT 响应 x，再从 forward CoT 多次采样，保留第一个答对的响应 z，形成 (x, z) 配对。然后训练一个 translator G_phi，用 teacher forcing 从 x 预测 z。一个重要设计是：translator 只看 reverse CoT 文本 x，不额外输入问题 q 或答案 a。这样做有两个目的。第一，和文中的分布推导保持一致，目标是学习从 source response 到 target response 的映射。第二，避免模型直接走 question-answer bypass，继续利用显式答案信息投机。

训练好 translator 后，大规模数据构造时每个问题只需一次 reverse teacher call 得到 x，再一次 translator call 得到 z_hat，最后用 (q, z_hat) 训练学生。相比 rejection sampling 可能需要多次 forward teacher call 才拿到一个可用样本，这个流程把高成本部分压缩成一次便宜采样加一次较小模型翻译。

与已有 semantic suppression 或结构约束方法相比，区别在于它不试图让 reverse CoT 自己“少泄露答案”，而是直接学习一个目标分布映射器。论文附录还给了 distribution recovery 相关分析，说明在一定条件下 translator 输出分布可以逼近 rejection-sampled forward 分布。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖六个学生模型和六个数学 benchmark，并做了三个迁移设置：迁移到新数学数据集、换教师模型、迁移到 STEM 题目。摘要和正文给出的关键数字有几项。

第一，效果对比。对 Qwen3-4B-Base 这类 4B 学生，CoTranslator 相比 semantic suppression 平均准确率最高提升 5.82 个百分点。说明仅仅抑制答案泄露不够，显式分布翻译更有效。

第二，成本-性能折中。两个 4B 学生在仅用 rejection sampling 估算算力的 35.9% 时，保留了其平均准确率的 95.0%。这是全文最核心的结果，因为它直接回答了“为什么不用 RS 直接生成”的问题：RS 更干净，但太贵；CoTranslator 用较小配对集训练 translator 后，可以在大规模生成阶段显著降本。

第三，泛化。translator 不重训即可迁移到新数学数据集、不同教师和 STEM 领域。4B 和 8B 学生在 STEM 上平均分别提升 4.88 和 4.31 个百分点。这个结果说明 translator 学到的不是某个数据集模板，而是某种从 answer-conditioned rationale 到 question-grounded rationale 的改写规律。

第四，分析实验。作者检查了生成结果与 RS 响应的相似度，以及 answer-dependent shortcuts 的减少情况。结论是 CoTranslator 生成的数据在分布上更接近 RS，同时比原始 reverse CoT 更少依赖已知答案痕迹。这部分虽然不是最终任务分数，但对理解方法为何有效很关键。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读偏精读。先看方法部分对三种分布的定义：FCG、RCG、RS。只有把目标分布想清楚，才知道作者为什么把问题写成 translation，而不是普通数据过滤。随后看 paired data construction 和 translator 训练目标，尤其注意 translator 不输入 q 和 a 这一设计，这里是方法成败的关键。

实验部分优先看三类表：一是与 RS、RCG、semantic suppression 的主结果对比；二是 compute cost 对比；三是 transfer 实验。若时间有限，30-40 分钟可以抓住主线。若要深挖，建议看附录里的 distribution recovery 推导，以及分析实验中关于 shortcut 的定量指标。

阅读时可以带着两个问题。第一，translator 学到的是“风格改写”还是“因果上更接近 forward reasoning 的结构变换”；第二，这种方法在数学之外是否仍成立，尤其在答案验证器不可靠、推理空间更开放的任务上会不会退化。前者关系到蒸馏数据质量，后者关系到方法外推边界。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central bottleneck in reasoning distillation: generating large amounts of high-quality chain-of-thought data with verified correctness. Standard forward CoT generation plus rejection sampling is reliable but expensive, especially on hard problems where many teacher samples may be needed before one is accepted. Reverse CoT generation is much cheaper because the teacher sees the correct answer, but that creates post-hoc rationalization and a train-test mismatch: the student must reason without answer access at inference time. The core question is whether cheap reverse CoTs can be transformed into data that better matches the distribution of verified forward CoTs.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface because reasoning data is increasingly a scarce training signal. The main contribution is methodological: instead of sampling directly from an expensive target distribution, the paper samples from a cheaper but biased source distribution and learns a translator toward the desired one. That idea is relevant beyond math distillation. It suggests a general recipe for synthetic reasoning data construction, and more broadly for situations where high-quality supervision is expensive but a lower-quality proxy is cheap. The practical contribution is a favorable cost-quality trade-off: much lower teacher compute while retaining most of the benefit of rejection-sampled forward CoTs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key move is to formulate the gap between reverse CoT and verified forward CoT as a translation problem rather than a prompting problem.

Let q be the question and a the correct answer. Forward CoT (FCG) samples reasoning from the teacher conditioned only on q. Rejection sampling (RS) keeps only those forward samples whose extracted final answer matches a. Reverse CoT (RCG) instead conditions the teacher on both q and a. The authors argue that the student should ideally learn from the RS distribution, not from raw RCG outputs.

To do this, they build a small paired dataset. For each question, they sample one reverse CoT response x, then sample forward CoTs until they obtain the first accepted response z with the correct final answer. This yields paired examples (x, z). A translator model G_phi is then fine-tuned with teacher forcing to predict z from x.

A crucial design choice is that the translator only receives the reverse CoT text x, not the original question q or answer a. This serves two purposes. First, it matches the paper’s distributional derivation, where the goal is to map source responses to target responses. Second, it blocks a direct question-answer shortcut and forces the model to learn how to rewrite answer-conditioned rationales into outputs closer to accepted forward reasoning.

Once trained, the translator is used at scale: each new question requires one reverse teacher call to produce x and one translator call to produce z-hat, and the student is then trained on (q, z-hat). Compared with RS, which may need many forward teacher calls per accepted sample, this pipeline compresses the expensive part into one cheap teacher sample plus one translation step.

Relative to prior semantic suppression or structural-guidance methods, the difference is conceptual. Those methods still generate under answer access and try to reduce leakage. CoTranslator instead learns an explicit distributional correction from RCG-style outputs toward RS-style outputs. The appendix further provides a distribution-recovery analysis to justify this framing.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover six student models and six math benchmarks, with transfer tests to a new math dataset, a different teacher model, and STEM problems.

The first headline result is quality. For students such as Qwen3-4B-Base, CoTranslator improves average accuracy over semantic suppression by up to 5.82 percentage points. That indicates that merely hiding answer cues is not enough; explicit translation toward the verified forward distribution works better.

The second result is the cost-performance trade-off. The two 4B students retain 95.0% of the average accuracy of rejection sampling while using only 35.9% of its estimated compute. This is the central empirical claim of the paper. RS remains the cleaner target, but it is expensive; CoTranslator uses a small paired set to train a translator and then amortizes that cost over large-scale data generation.

The third result is transfer. Without retraining, the translator generalizes to a new math dataset, a different teacher, and STEM tasks. Average STEM gains are 4.88 points for 4B students and 4.31 points for 8B students. This suggests the translator is learning a reusable transformation from answer-conditioned rationales to more question-grounded ones, rather than memorizing a dataset-specific template.

The paper also includes analysis showing that translated outputs are closer to RS responses and exhibit fewer answer-dependent shortcuts than raw reverse CoTs. Those analyses are important because they explain why the downstream gains appear, not just that they do.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one is worth a careful skim, close to a light read. Start with the formal definitions of FCG, RCG, and RS. The paper only makes sense once the target distribution is clear. Then read the paired-data construction and the translator objective, paying special attention to the decision not to feed q or a into the translator. That is the most consequential design choice in the method.

In the experiments, prioritize three groups of results: the main comparison against RS, RCG, and semantic suppression; the compute-cost comparison; and the transfer results. A 30-40 minute pass is enough to capture the main idea. If you want the deeper layer, read the appendix on distribution recovery and the shortcut analyses.

Two questions are worth carrying while reading. Is the translator learning a superficial style rewrite, or a structural transformation that is genuinely closer to forward reasoning? And how far does the method extend beyond math, especially when answer verification is weak and the reasoning space is less constrained? Those questions define the boundary of the approach.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据生成成本曲线和失败样例；若 paired set 很小仍稳，内部数学蒸馏管线应复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the data-cost curve and failure cases; if the small paired set is enough, this should be reproduced in an internal math-distillation pipeline.

paper.title: GRADS: Graph-Regulated Agentic Data Synthesis with Controllable Difficulty
paper.abstract: Deep research agents are increasingly deployed to retrieve precise information from large corpora, yet multi-hop, long-horizon tasks remain challenging. Synthetic data generation has emerged as a scalable solution, with existing pipelines typically expanding seed tasks to increase their apparent depth and breadth. However, this expansion does not reliably translate into necessary reasoning: newly introduced evidence may be only weakly coupled to the answer, creating a mismatch between intended a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 agentic search / deep research 数据合成里的一个关键失真：很多合成流程会把问题做得更长、更绕、证据更多，但这些新增证据未必是求解所必需的，于是“标称难度”并不等于“实际推理难度”。如果训练数据的难度标签不可信，后续的 SFT、RL、课程学习和评测都会被污染。GRADS 的核心问题因此不是单纯生成更多 QA，而是生成难度可控、且这种难度能在求解时真实体现出来的数据。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接关系有限，它更偏 post-train 数据工程；但对基座研究仍有启发，尤其是数据质量与训练信号设计。它给出的重要判断是：数据复杂度不能靠表面结构近似，必须靠必要推理链来定义。作者用 evidence graph 把“需要几步推理”从模糊直觉变成了可操作对象，这对合成 reasoning data、tool-use data、search agent data 都有参考价值。另一个值得注意的点是，文章把 difficulty control、source grounding、answer verification 放在同一流水线里，而不是先生成再事后筛。对于做持续训练或中期训练的人，这种思路比单纯扩大合成数据量更稳，因为它直接约束了训练信号的真实性和可解释性。
summary.technical_approach: GRADS 的方法核心是 evidence graph。图中的节点是 source-grounded claims，边表示到达答案所必需的推理步骤，图深度用来表示题目的目标难度。作者据此构建一个 graph-regulated synthesis loop，而不是像常见方法那样通过增加实体、约束、干扰信息来“看起来更难”。整个流程包括 seed selection、evidence expansion、question-answer construction、verification 几个环节，但 difficulty control 不是由探索过程自然产生，而是由 evidence graph 的结构显式约束。这个设计把 exploration 和 difficulty control 解耦：agent 可以在大语料里自由搜索候选证据，但最终被接受的样本必须满足目标图深度和必要性要求。为了解决真实大规模语料难以穷举的问题，作者先对原始记录做清洗和聚类，并提供统一的本地与在线搜索工具。为了解决 LLM 合成答案不可靠的问题，每个答案都附带由 atomic claims 组成的 rubric，并且每条 claim 都要绑定 verbatim source spans，再由 verification subagents 逐项核验。和已有 graph sampling 或 task extension 方法相比，GRADS 的关键区别是它不把图当作素材来源，而是把图当作难度约束器；不把“证据更多”当作“推理更深”的替代品。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个异构领域：GitHub issue tracking、实验粒子物理、security。作者构建了对应 benchmark 和 post-training corpus，并与三类合成基线比较。最关键的结果有两点。第一，只有 GRADS 生成的数据在 requested difficulty 从 Easy 到 Hard 提升时，delivered reasoning depth 也单调增加；同时，不同能力层级的 solver 在这些数据上的得分会随难度单调下降。这说明它控制的是实际求解难度，而不是题面长度。第二，用 GRADS 轨迹对 4B 模型做 SFT，在每个领域都显著优于未训练模型，并且在相同样本数和优化步数下优于所有基线。作者还指出，SFT 已经贡献了大部分增益，后续 RL 主要继续改善 tool use 和 answer termination，使 4B 模型达到中等规模 Sonnet 4 solver 的水平。当前给出的正文片段没有完整表格，因此无法可靠复述每个 benchmark 的绝对分数、样本规模和增益百分比；但从实验设计上看，最值得看的不是单一平均分，而是 difficulty monotonicity、verification 通过率、以及 SFT 与 RL 的增益拆分。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点不在模型细节，而在数据构造原则。先看 Introduction，确认作者批评的是“名义多跳不等于真实多跳”。然后直接看 evidence graph 的定义和合成流程图，理解 difficulty 是如何被结构化约束的。实验部分优先看三类图表：requested vs delivered difficulty 的对应关系、不同 solver 的难度曲线、以及用合成数据做 SFT/RL 的训练收益。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主要内容。值得深挖的地方有两个：一，evidence graph 的必要性判定在多解问题上是否稳定；二，verification subagent 会不会把数据分布推向“更容易被规则验证”的样本，从而牺牲开放性和自然性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central failure mode in synthetic data for deep-search agents: many pipelines make questions look harder by adding more evidence, more entities, or more constraints, but the added material is often not necessary for solving the problem. As a result, nominal difficulty diverges from realized reasoning difficulty. That breaks both evaluation and training, because difficulty labels stop being trustworthy signals. GRADS is designed to synthesize QA data whose requested difficulty is actually reflected in the solver’s reasoning path.
summary_en.importance: This is more post-training data work than core pretraining, but it is still relevant to foundation-model research through the lens of data quality and supervision design. The paper makes a useful point: complexity should be defined by necessary inference structure, not by surface expansion. By introducing an evidence graph whose depth corresponds to required reasoning depth, it turns a vague notion of 'harder data' into something operational. That matters for synthetic reasoning data, search-agent training, curriculum design, and benchmark construction. Another practical contribution is that difficulty control, source grounding, and answer verification are built into one generation pipeline rather than treated as separate cleanup stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core abstraction is the evidence graph. Nodes are source-grounded claims, and edges represent necessary inference steps needed to reach the answer. Graph depth is used as the target difficulty variable. GRADS then runs a graph-regulated synthesis loop with seed selection, evidence expansion, QA construction, and verification, but difficulty is not left to emerge from exploration. Instead, the accepted sample must satisfy structural constraints on the evidence graph. This explicitly decouples exploration from difficulty control: agents can search broadly over large corpora, but only examples with the intended necessary-inference depth are retained. To handle large real-world corpora, the pipeline cleans and clusters raw records and exposes unified local and online search tools. To control hallucination, each answer is paired with a rubric of atomic claims, each tied to verbatim source spans, and verification subagents check every item before acceptance. Relative to prior graph-sampling or task-extension methods, the key difference is that the graph is used as a regulator of realized difficulty, not merely as a source of raw material.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans three heterogeneous domains: GitHub issue tracking, experimental particle physics, and security. For each domain, the authors build both a benchmark and a post-training corpus. The most important result is monotonicity: among the compared synthesis methods, only GRADS yields delivered reasoning depth that increases monotonically with requested difficulty, and correspondingly only GRADS produces solver scores that decrease monotonically from Easy to Hard. This pattern holds across solvers at three capability tiers, which supports the claim that the generated difficulty is real rather than cosmetic. On the training side, SFT on GRADS trajectories improves a 4B model in every domain and beats all baselines at matched sample count and optimizer steps. The paper also notes that SFT provides most of the gain, while subsequent RL mainly improves tool use and answer termination, bringing the 4B model up to the level of a mid-sized Sonnet 4 solver. The excerpt does not include exact tables, sample counts, or score deltas, so I cannot safely quote numbers. The most informative experimental sections should be the requested-vs-delivered difficulty analysis, solver difficulty curves, and the SFT-versus-RL gain breakdown.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. The main value is the data-construction principle, not model architecture. Read the introduction first to see the critique of synthetic multi-hop data that only appears difficult. Then go straight to the definition of the evidence graph and the synthesis pipeline figure. In the experiments, focus on three things: the alignment between requested and delivered difficulty, the monotonic solver-performance curves across difficulty levels, and the downstream gains from SFT and RL on the synthesized data. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough for the main ideas. Two questions are worth probing further: whether necessary-inference depth remains stable when multiple valid solution paths exist, and whether the verification pipeline biases the dataset toward examples that are easier to rubric-check but less natural or open-ended.

recommendation.zh: 合成数据里“伪难度”是常见坑，这篇用依赖图把必要证据钉死；只看难度控制指标与验证环节，若验证器太强会高估可迁移性。
recommendation.en: It tackles the common “fake difficulty” issue in synthetic data via dependency graphs; read the difficulty-control metrics and verification loop—overpowered verifiers can inflate transfer claims.

paper.title: Cowork-Gym: Synthesizing Interactive Work Environments at Scale
paper.abstract: Cowork agents navigate dependencies across tools and files while adapting to changing user requirements and edits to shared workspaces. Scaling such environments requires maintaining consistency among task objectives, executable resources, user behavior, and success criteria. We introduce Cowork-Gym, a framework that synthesizes Cowork environments through a build-execute-revise loop that uses execution evidence and review feedback to validate and repair generated environments. To capture realis

summary.core_problem: 如何大规模合成高质量的“协同工作（Cowork）”环境，以训练和评估 Agent 在动态、交互式工作空间中处理多步任务的能力。
summary.importance: 提供了一个可扩展的框架，用于生成包含动态用户交互和共享工作空间状态变化的复杂 Agent 训练数据。这对于提升模型在真实工作场景（如软件开发、数据分析）中的协作和适应能力具有直接价值，验证了合成环境在 Post-train 阶段的有效性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Cowork-Gym 框架。通过分类引导（taxonomy-guided）和资源驱动（resource-grounded）两种方式生成任务。引入“构建-执行-修改”循环，利用沙箱执行和验证器反馈来修复生成的环境。核心创新是设计了一个有状态的用户模拟器（stateful user simulator），它能根据 Agent 的进度通过对话和直接修改工作空间来提供反馈，模拟真实的协作过程。
summary.experiments: 合成了涵盖 14 个场景的 6.49 万个环境。使用这些数据对 Qwen 9B、27B 和 35B 模型进行 SFT 和 RL 训练。在 6 个 Agent 基准测试中，训练后的模型在 18 组对比中有 17 组超越了基座模型。27B 模型在 PawBench 和 ClawEval 上取得最高分，甚至超过了千亿参数规模的模型。
summary.reading_guide: 建议阅读环境合成流程（特别是“构建-执行-修改”循环的细节）以及有状态用户模拟器的设计。实验部分关注不同规模模型在合成数据上的 Scaling 表现，以及 RL 训练带来的额外收益。

summary_en.core_problem: How to synthesize high-quality 'Cowork' environments at scale to train and evaluate agents in handling multi-step tasks within dynamic, interactive workspaces.
summary_en.importance: Provides a scalable framework for generating complex agent training data that includes dynamic user interactions and shared workspace state changes. This is directly valuable for improving models' collaboration and adaptation capabilities in real-world scenarios (e.g., software development, data analysis), validating the effectiveness of synthetic environments in the post-training phase.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Cowork-Gym framework. Generates tasks through both taxonomy-guided and resource-grounded routes. Introduces a 'build-execute-revise' loop that uses sandbox execution and verifier feedback to repair generated environments. The core innovation is a stateful user simulator that provides feedback based on the agent's progress through dialogue and direct workspace edits, simulating real collaboration.
summary_en.experiments: Synthesized 64.9K environments across 14 scenarios. Used this data to train Qwen 9B, 27B, and 35B models via SFT and RL. Across 6 agentic benchmarks, the trained models outperformed their base checkpoints in 17 out of 18 comparisons. The 27B model achieved the highest scores on PawBench and ClawEval, surpassing models with over 100B parameters.
summary_en.reading_guide: Recommend reading the environment synthesis pipeline (especially the details of the 'build-execute-revise' loop) and the design of the stateful user simulator. In the experiments, focus on the scaling performance of different sized models on synthetic data and the additional gains from RL training.

recommendation.zh: 阿里 Qwen 团队在 Agent 数据合成上的重要工作，其 build-execute-revise 的合成 pipeline 和基于执行反馈的 RL 值得后训练研究员参考。
recommendation.en: Important work from Alibaba's Qwen team on agent data synthesis. The build-execute-revise pipeline and execution-feedback-based RL are highly relevant for post-training researchers.

paper.title: From Copying to Composition: How Language Models Develop In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) allows language models to adapt their behavior from instructions and demonstrations in a prompt, but accuracy alone does not reveal how contextual information controls their predictions. We study the acquisition and trainability of ICL with a controlled diagnostic that separates copying a nearby demonstration from integrating information across the prompt. Across 17 models, about a third prefer the copied answer, a few are undecided, and the rest prefer the rule-consist

summary.core_problem: ICL 的准确率提升并不能说明模型到底是在复制邻近示例，还是在组合整段上下文中的规则信息；这篇工作要分离并追踪这两种机制的形成过程。
summary.importance: 这是较干净的机制分析。价值在于把 ICL 从“会不会做”拆成“靠复制还是靠组合”，并用 checkpoint 分析与匹配训练实验连接到预训练数据形态，对 pretrain 研究员很有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者设计了一个受控诊断任务，显式区分两种行为：复制最近的冲突示例答案，或根据提示中定义的规则给出一致答案。随后在 17 个模型上做横向比较，并沿训练 checkpoint 追踪注意焦点与行为转变。进一步做 matched training experiments：用合成文档先定义 ending 再提问，观察是否把模型推向 compositional response；同时比较 definition examples 的微调效果。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 17 个模型。结果显示，大约三分之一模型偏向复制答案，少数不确定，其余偏向规则一致答案；后者通常也有更高准确率，并更多受任务相关 token 控制而非最近冲突示例控制。checkpoint 分析显示，模型会在准确率仍接近随机前，就先学会把注意力从冲突示例转向任务相关 token。匹配训练中，合成定义型文档能推动 compositional behavior，而仅在定义示例上微调效果较弱。摘要未给出具体模型名和参数量。

summary_en.core_problem: Accuracy alone does not reveal whether in-context learning comes from copying a nearby demonstration or composing rule information across the prompt; this paper isolates and tracks these mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: This is a relatively clean mechanistic study. Its value is that it decomposes ICL from 'can it do the task' into 'copying versus composition', then connects the transition to checkpoint dynamics and training data format, which is directly useful for pretraining researchers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a controlled diagnostic that separates two behaviors: copying the answer from a nearby conflicting example, or producing the rule-consistent answer based on definitions in the prompt. They evaluate 17 models, analyze training checkpoints to track attention and behavioral shifts, and run matched training experiments where synthetic documents define endings before querying them. They also compare this with fine-tuning on definition examples.
summary_en.experiments: Across 17 models, about one third prefer the copied answer, a few are undecided, and the rest prefer the rule-consistent answer. The latter group also tends to achieve higher accuracy and show stronger control by task-relevant prompt tokens rather than the nearest conflicting example. Checkpoint analysis shows that models begin prioritizing relevant prompt tokens well before accuracy rises above chance. In matched training, synthetic definition-style documents shift models toward compositional responses, while fine-tuning on definition examples is less effective. The abstract does not list model names or parameter counts.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对 ICL 形成时序的 prior：先学会看对 token，再学会答对；建议立刻复现它的 checkpoint 诊断，而不是只盯最终 accuracy。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on ICL development: models learn to attend to the right tokens before they learn to answer correctly; replicate the checkpoint diagnostic, not just the final accuracy.

stage_evidence.quote: here synthetic documents define endings before querying them. They also compare this with fine-tuning on definition examples.

, synthetic definition-style documents shift models toward compositional responses, while fine-tuning on definition examples is less effective. The abstract does not list model names or parameter counts.

paper.title: Qwenfant: Train Big Character-level BabyLMs on Concise Parallel Text
paper.abstract: This work concerns our submission for the Multilingual track of the 2026 BabyLM Challenge. We improve on our baseline using data that has been summarized and translated by an LLM, showing that higher-quality data can come from synthetic sources. We further improve with 2 simple changes: using a larger model, and using a character-level vocabulary. Both of these changes require LoRA-style fine-tuning for realizing their full potential. We dub our final Qwen3-based model Qwenfant, which, at the ti

summary.core_problem: 在 BabyLM 多语言小数据设定下，如何用更精炼的数据、合成翻译和字符级词表提升小模型语言能力。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在小数据预训练和 tokenizer/data 选择：论文显示经过摘要和翻译的合成并行文本可以提高数据质量，字符级 vocabulary 与更大模型在该挑战中有效。它不是通用大规模预训练 recipe，但对 data quality、tokenization 和 constrained pretraining 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于 Qwen3 构建 Qwenfant，使用 LLM 生成的 summarized and translated parallel text 改善训练语料；同时采用更大模型和字符级 vocabulary。由于这些改动和现有 Qwen3 权重之间存在适配问题，作者使用 LoRA 风格微调来释放收益。
summary.experiments: 这是 2026 BabyLM Challenge Multilingual track 的参赛系统。最终 Qwen3-based Qwenfant 在提交时排名该赛道第 1。摘要没有给出模型规模、数据量、baseline 分数或各组件消融幅度。
summary.authors_note: Alexander Fraser 长期从事机器翻译和多语言 NLP 研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to improve multilingual BabyLM-style low-data training using concise synthetic parallel text and character-level tokenization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about data quality and tokenizer choice in a constrained pretraining setting. It suggests that summarized and translated synthetic text can be useful, and that a character-level vocabulary can work well with a larger model and LoRA adaptation. The result is relevant to data and tokenizer research, but it is not a general large-scale pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build Qwenfant on top of Qwen3. They improve the data by using LLM-generated summarized and translated parallel text, then add two simple changes: a larger model and a character-level vocabulary. LoRA-style fine-tuning is used to make these changes effective with the Qwen3-based setup.
summary_en.experiments: The system is submitted to the Multilingual track of the 2026 BabyLM Challenge. At submission time, the final Qwen3-based Qwenfant model ranks first in that track. The abstract does not report model size, dataset size, baseline scores, or ablation deltas.
summary_en.authors_note: Alexander Fraser is known for work in machine translation and multilingual NLP.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据和字符词表消融；BabyLM 排名可参考，但外推到大规模预训练要很保守。
recommendation.en: Read only the data and character-vocabulary ablations; the BabyLM ranking is useful but weak evidence for large-scale pretraining.

paper.title: Facts Don't Speak Louder than Words: The Behavioral Essence of Long-CoT Distillation
paper.abstract: While long chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation significantly improves the reasoning abilities of language models, its underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. Current pipelines generally rely on rejection sampling to gather reasoning traces across diverse prompts, assuming that factual correctness and broad problem coverage are indispensable. Surprisingly, we find that training exclusively on flawed reasoning trajectories or a restricted prompt set yields nearly comparable performance. Dr

summary.core_problem: 解决长 CoT 蒸馏到底是在注入新知识，还是在教会模型一种可迁移的推理行为模式这个机制问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练与推理增强交界处的一篇机制型工作。价值不在又做了一个蒸馏配方，而在于它直接挑战了“高质量、事实正确、覆盖广”的长 CoT 数据才是关键燃料这一常见前提，对合成推理数据和蒸馏管线设计有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Behavioral Hypothesis：长 CoT 蒸馏的主要作用是让学生模型对齐到结构化推理行为，而不是记住教师给出的事实内容。为验证这一点，他们构造了几个去知识化设定：只用有缺陷的推理轨迹训练、只在受限提示集合上训练、甚至只在模型已掌握的问题上微调，以尽量隔离“新知识注入”因素，观察推理能力是否仍提升。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模和数据量，但给出了关键实验结论：仅用错误推理轨迹或受限 prompt 集，性能也与常规长 CoT 蒸馏接近；只在已掌握问题上做微调，仍能带来显著推理增益。这类结果通常意味着 baseline 是标准 rejection-sampling 长 CoT 蒸馏流程，比较不同数据真实性、覆盖度和新颖性条件下的下游推理表现。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks a mechanism question: does long-CoT distillation mainly inject new knowledge, or does it teach a transferable reasoning behavior?
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-oriented paper at the interface of post-training and reasoning. Its value is not another distillation recipe, but a direct challenge to the common assumption that long-CoT needs factually correct, broad-coverage traces as the key ingredient. That matters for synthetic reasoning data design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes the Behavioral Hypothesis: the main effect of long-CoT distillation is behavioral alignment to structured reasoning patterns rather than memorization of factual content from teacher traces. To test this, it constructs knowledge-reduced settings: training only on flawed trajectories, only on a restricted prompt set, and even fine-tuning only on previously mastered problems to isolate behavior from novel knowledge injection.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or corpus scale, but it gives the central findings: training only on flawed reasoning traces or a restricted prompt set yields performance close to standard long-CoT distillation; fine-tuning only on already-mastered problems still brings substantial reasoning gains. The implied baseline is a standard rejection-sampled long-CoT distillation pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接动摇“推理蒸馏主要靠知识覆盖”的默认设定；建议先看反常识实验，再决定你们的合成 CoT 数据是否还值得重做清洗。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the default view that reasoning distillation is mostly about knowledge coverage; read the counterintuitive ablations first before spending more effort on cleaning synthetic CoT data.

paper.title: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
paper.abstract: Data-centric scaling of RLVR has focused on collecting or generating verifiable training problems. However, corpus size alone does not determine whether the dataset provides a useful learning signal for a target policy. To guide the synthesis of effective RLVR data, we experimentally characterize dataset effectiveness as a function of its problems, the target policy, and the training rollout budget. Under this characterization, we show that a large open-source math corpus pooled from widely used

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 数据扩展中“数据量大但对当前策略几乎没有学习信号”的问题，尤其是大量样本落入全成或全败的 zero-advantage trap。
summary.importance: 这是数据合成与 RL 后训练接口上的关键问题。贡献不只是再造一批数学题，而是明确指出 RLVR 数据有效性取决于题目、目标策略和 rollout 预算三者耦合；这对合成推理数据、课程设计和 continual post-training 都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先实验刻画 dataset effectiveness：在固定 target policy 和 rollout budget 下，若一个问题在所有 rollout 中都成功或都失败，就几乎不给策略梯度提供区分信号，形成 zero-advantage trap。作者发现一个由常用 RLVR 数学数据集汇总而成的大型 open-source corpus 中，约 88% 样本都落在这个陷阱里。为此提出 MagicBeanStalk：递归式数据合成框架，目标不是盲目增大语料，而是生成既覆盖困难题所需 reasoning operations 与组合，又把难度校准到“部分 rollout 成功、部分失败”的可学习区间。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示核心实验在数学 RLVR 场景，分析对象是一个汇总自常用数据集的大型开源语料。关键发现是约 88% 问题对给定策略和 rollout 预算处于零优势区间；简单 filtering 只能保留剩余可学样本，却无法把真正困难题转化为可学信号。MagicBeanStalk 通过递归合成更有效的数据，目标是在相同训练预算下提升 RLVR 学习效率。需要重点看正文中对 target policy、rollout budget、成功率分布和最终 RL 提升的量化结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Aviral Kumar、Jan Kautz、Yejin Choi，属于强化学习、生成模型与推理训练都较活跃的一线研究者组合。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the RLVR data-scaling problem where large datasets still provide almost no learning signal because most problems are either always solved or always failed by the current policy.
summary_en.importance: This matters at the interface between data synthesis and RL post-training. The contribution is not just another math corpus, but the claim that RLVR dataset effectiveness is jointly determined by the problem set, the target policy, and the rollout budget. That is directly relevant to synthetic reasoning data, curriculum design, and continual post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first characterizes dataset effectiveness experimentally: for a fixed target policy and rollout budget, a problem gives little policy-gradient signal if every rollout succeeds or every rollout fails, creating a zero-advantage trap. The authors report that roughly 88% of a large open-source math corpus pooled from widely used RLVR datasets falls into this regime. They then propose MagicBeanStalk, a recursive data-synthesis framework that aims not to maximize corpus size, but to generate problems that both require the reasoning operations needed for hard tasks and are difficulty-calibrated so that some rollouts succeed and some fail.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates math RLVR experiments on a large pooled open-source corpus. The headline finding is that about 88% of problems lie in the zero-advantage regime for a given policy and rollout budget; simple filtering can concentrate the remaining useful subset but cannot turn hard problems into learnable signal. MagicBeanStalk is designed to synthesize more effective training problems under the same training budget. The main paper should be checked for the exact target policies, rollout budgets, success-rate histograms, and downstream RL gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Aviral Kumar, Jan Kautz, and Yejin Choi, a combination with strong track records in RL, generative modeling, and reasoning-oriented training.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对“多收集可验证题就能扩 RLVR”的 prior；先复现它的成功率分桶统计，若 88% 零优势在你内部数据也成立，数据合成目标函数就该立刻改。
recommendation.en: This should change your prior that more verifiable problems automatically scale RLVR; reproduce the success-rate bucket analysis first, and if the 88% zero-advantage pattern holds on your internal data, your synthesis objective needs to change immediately.

stage_evidence.quote: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis

paper.title: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation
paper.abstract: Continual post-training faces a dual challenge of acquisition and retention: models must learn new capabilities while preserving prior knowledge. While Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) mitigates this using self-supervision with in-context demonstrations, it relies on strong in-context learning and instruction-following abilities. Consequently, SDFT fails on smaller models critical for low-latency, on-device use. To enable continual learning at smaller scales, we first identify the root cause

summary.core_problem: 小模型在持续后训练（continual post-training）中同时做到“学新能力”和“少遗忘”很难，尤其现有自蒸馏式方法依赖强 ICL/指令跟随，导致小模型直接失效。
summary.importance: 把“小模型 continual post-train 为什么失败”归因到可测的分布偏移，并给出一个工程上可落地的替代监督来源（同家族略大模型做 aligner），对 on-device/低延迟模型的持续迭代有直接价值；同时也提供了一个可操作的诊断指标（distribution shift ↔ acquisition/forgetting 线性相关）。
summary.technical_approach: 先分析 SDFT 在小模型上的失败原因：后训练后模型分布相对基座的 shift 越大，学习新任务越差、遗忘越严重，呈线性相关，暗示需要“in-distribution learning”。提出 SynthSelf：用一个“同家族、略大”的 aligner 代替小模型自己做 in-context rewrite/自监督，生成更贴近目标分布的监督信号；再结合 off-policy supervision 与 rejection sampling 提升监督质量与稳定性，从而让小模型也能做持续后训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集与数值；可确认的是对比对象包含 SDFT，并评估 acquisition 与 forgetting，并报告它们与 distribution shift 的线性相关关系；其余细节需看正文实验表格与设置（尤其是 aligner 大小、同家族约束、拒绝采样阈值与持续训练轮次）。

summary_en.core_problem: Continual post-training for small LMs fails to balance acquiring new skills and retaining old ones, because prior self-distillation methods rely on strong ICL/instruction-following that small models lack.
summary_en.importance: It turns the vague “small models fail at continual post-training” into a measurable diagnosis (distribution shift correlates linearly with acquisition/forgetting) and proposes a practical supervision workaround (a slightly larger same-family aligner), which is directly relevant for on-device/low-latency model iteration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Diagnose why SDFT breaks on small models: larger post-training distribution shift from the base model correlates linearly with worse acquisition and more forgetting, implying the need for in-distribution learning. Propose SynthSelf: outsource SDFT-style in-distribution rewriting to a minimally larger same-family aligner, then use off-policy supervision plus rejection sampling to deliver higher-quality supervision without pushing the small model too far off-distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or exact gains. It reports (i) comparisons against SDFT, (ii) acquisition/forgetting metrics, and (iii) a linear correlation between these metrics and distribution shift; key details (aligner size, thresholds, continual steps) require the main paper.

recommendation.zh: 把 continual post-train 的失败归因到“分布偏移”这个可量化指标很实用；重点看它怎么定义 shift、以及 aligner+rejection 是否真比直接 SFT 干净。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the shift-based diagnosis for continual post-training; focus on how they measure distribution shift and whether aligner+rejection is actually cleaner than plain SFT.

stage_evidence.quote: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation

paper.title: Turnslide: Scalable Multi-Turn Data Synthesis by Walking a Finite-State Machine
paper.abstract: Small language models are inexpensive to serve and can run on private infrastructure, but base models are often not good enough at multi-turn tool calling, and fine-tuning them needs per-API data that rarely exists. Existing synthesis methods are too expensive for high-scale fine-tuning, as they often require mock operational environments for different domains and multiple LLM calls per generated conversation turn. We introduce a fully automated, lightweight synthesis framework that models each

summary.core_problem: 解决小语言模型缺少多轮工具调用训练数据的问题，尤其是在每个 API 都重新构造交互环境和多次调用大模型生成样本成本过高的情况下。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 tool-use 后训练的数据合成方法。它不是预训练数据工作，而是为 SLM/LLM 的多轮工具调用 SFT 构造可扩展轨迹；对预训练研究员的价值在于观察“结构化状态约束 + 少量生成调用”是否能替代昂贵环境模拟。
summary.technical_approach: Turnslide 将每个 API 建模为有限状态机，用抽象状态决定当前允许调用哪些工具，先生成状态合法的工具序列，再用一次 LLM 调用把工具序列翻译成完整对话样本。方法不把多样性最大化作为目标，而是显式设定轮数、工具序列和任务复杂度的目标分布。
summary.experiments: 论文用生成轨迹微调小语言模型，并以下游多轮工具调用表现衡量数据质量。摘要称 FSM 生成显著提升下游表现，但未在给定片段中披露具体模型大小、API 数量、数据规模、基线方法或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the lack of multi-turn tool-use training data for small language models, especially when per-API environments and repeated LLM calls make existing synthesis pipelines expensive.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training data synthesis method for tool calling. It is not pretraining data work, but it is relevant because it tests whether structured state constraints plus minimal generation can replace costly environment simulation for scalable tool-use supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: Turnslide represents each API as a finite-state machine. Abstract states determine which tools may be called, valid tool sequences are sampled first, and a single LLM call turns each sequence into a full training conversation. Instead of optimizing for open-ended diversity, the method targets distributions over turn count, tool sequence, and task complexity.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates data quality by fine-tuning small language models on the generated trajectories and measuring downstream multi-turn tool-calling performance. The abstract reports significant improvement, but the provided excerpt does not include model sizes, API counts, dataset sizes, baselines, or exact gains.

recommendation.en: Read the method: FSM constraints reduce tool-call synthesis from environment simulation to sequence sampling, a cheap baseline for internal SFT data pipelines.

paper.title: Effective Synthetic Data Curation Requires Group-Level Signals
paper.abstract: Synthetic data now is essential to LLM training, used to strengthen advanced capabilities such as autonomous and long-horizon task execution. Yet recent work shows that training on it at scale can degrade model generation, making it important to decide what synthetic data is worth training on. While current data curation practices do so with individual-level signals (i.e., estimates of each data sample's training utility in isolation), across pre-training and post-training settings we show that

summary.core_problem: 解决合成数据筛选只看单样本效用、却忽略样本之间相互作用，导致大规模训练时数据策展失真的问题。
summary.importance: 这是直接打到当前合成数据训练核心假设的一篇数据工作。贡献不是再造一个打分器，而是指出 synthetic data curation 需要从 individual-level signal 转向 group-level signal；这对预训练和后训练的数据混配、课程设计、数据去留都有方法论意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者比较两类数据效用估计：单样本信号只估计样本独立训练价值，组级信号则显式考虑样本组合后的交互效应。论文先构造在 individual-level influence 下看似等价、但 group composition 不同的 synthetic datasets，证明它们训练结果可显著分化；再提出基于组级效用的策展方式，在 pre-training 与 post-training 场景中验证其优越性。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验同时覆盖 pre-training 和 post-training 两种设置，并比较按 individual-level 与 group-level 信号筛选后的下游表现差异。核心结果是：仅依赖单样本信号会错过组合效应，导致看似同分的数据集训练效果差很多；按组级信号策展能带来更好的 downstream performance。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和增幅，需看正文确认 setup 是否足够干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Chenyan Xiong。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a key failure mode in synthetic-data curation: judging samples only by individual utility while ignoring interactions among samples during training.
summary_en.importance: This directly challenges a central assumption in current synthetic-data pipelines. The contribution is not another scorer, but the claim that effective curation must move from individual-level signals to group-level signals. That matters for pretraining and post-training data mixture, curriculum, and retention decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper contrasts two notions of utility estimation: individual-level signals that score each sample in isolation, and group-level signals that account for interaction effects among samples. It constructs synthetic datasets that look indistinguishable under individual influence estimates but differ in composition, then shows that training outcomes diverge sharply. It further proposes curation based on group-level utility and validates it in both pre-training and post-training settings.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, experiments cover both pre-training and post-training regimes and compare downstream performance after curation by individual-level versus group-level signals. The key result is that individual-only scoring misses composition effects, so datasets with similar per-sample utility can train very differently, while group-level curation performs better. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact gains, so the cleanliness of the setup needs to be checked in the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Chenyan Xiong.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得立刻进内部 ablation：它在修正“样本独立打分即可做合成数据筛选”的默认前提，先看构造性反例和 pre/post-train 两组实验是否干净。
recommendation.en: This should go straight into internal ablations: it challenges the default assumption that sample-wise scoring is enough for synthetic-data curation; first inspect the constructive counterexample and the pre/post-train setups.

paper.title: No Model Required: Text Entropy Rate Filtering Mitigates Iterative Fine-Tuning Collapse
paper.abstract: Iterative fine-tuning on synthetic data causes \emph{model collapse}: output diversity narrows as rare patterns are progressively lost, a signature most visible as phrase-level repetition. Existing mitigations either require model log-probabilities, an external oracle, or continued access to real human data. Here we develop a new approach grounded in mathematical information theory: the non-parametric Kontoyiannis entropy rate estimator $h_k$, computed entirely from raw text via match-length sta

summary.core_problem: 迭代用合成数据做微调会出现 model collapse（多样性丢失、短语级重复），现有缓解往往需要模型 logprob/外部判别器或真实人类数据；论文要在“完全无模型访问”的条件下做数据过滤。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据质量/过滤方法：用纯文本的非参数信息论指标替代 logprob 过滤，适合闭源模型、跨代自蒸馏、以及合成数据管线的前置质检；对“合成数据能否闭环”这一 pretrain↔posttrain 问题给了可操作工具。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Kontoyiannis 熵率估计器 hk（基于 match-length 统计）直接从原始文本估计 entropy rate，并据此过滤低熵/高重复样本；强调不需要任何模型打分或 oracle。与常见的 logprob-based filtering 做对照，评估对多样性与重复的影响。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3.1-8B 上做 6 代 QLoRA 单谱系（single-lineage）合成数据迭代微调的 collapse 实验：logprob 过滤在多样性指标上无显著收益（p>0.23）；hk 过滤带来 +42% unique trigrams、+30% vocabulary、-19% repetition（摘要给出）。未见摘要中报告下游能力保持/退化与过滤阈值敏感性。

summary_en.core_problem: Iterative fine-tuning on synthetic data leads to model collapse (diversity loss and phrase-level repetition). Existing mitigations often require model log-probs, external oracles, or access to real human data; this work targets model-free filtering.
summary_en.importance: A data-quality/filtering contribution: it replaces logprob-based filtering with a non-parametric information-theoretic signal computed from raw text, useful for closed models and synthetic-data pipelines where model scoring is unavailable or undesirable.
summary_en.technical_approach: Apply the non-parametric Kontoyiannis entropy-rate estimator hk (match-length statistics) to raw text and filter low-entropy/high-repetition samples. No model scoring is used. Compare against established logprob-based filtering on diversity/repetition metrics.
summary_en.experiments: Six-generation QLoRA single-lineage collapse experiment on Llama-3.1-8B: logprob filtering shows no significant diversity benefit (p>0.23), while hk filtering yields +42% unique trigrams, +30% vocabulary, and -19% repetition (as reported in the abstract). The abstract does not clarify downstream capability retention or threshold sensitivity.

recommendation.zh: 这是少见的“无模型访问”的合成数据质检信号：先复现它在你们的合成闭环里能否同时保能力再谈；logprob 过滤失效这一点值得警惕。
recommendation.en: A rare model-free QC signal for synthetic-data loops—replicate it in your pipeline and check capability retention; the reported failure of logprob filtering is the part that should update your priors.

paper.title: When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora
paper.abstract: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. We audit that possibility in GooseReason-0.7M. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface

summary.core_problem: 审计合成 RLVR 语料中“正确答案来自人类文本、错误选项来自模型生成”这一 provenance artifact 是否会变成可利用捷径。
summary.importance: 这是后训练数据质量和因果审计工作。RLVR 数据构造越来越依赖自动生成错误选项，如果 correctness 与 provenance 纠缠，策略模型可能学到来源识别而不是推理能力；这会直接影响推理训练数据的可信度。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 GooseReason-0.7M 为对象，先用只看五个表面统计量、不看语义的分类器检测人类 gold 与合成 distractor 是否可分；再区分总体与 code 子集，并通过人工检查解释异常信号。随后进行干预实验，构造 paraphrase-matched 条件，用于区分“artifact 可检测”和“模型实际使用 artifact”。
summary.experiments: 在 315,499 个选项上，仅凭五个表面统计量的分类器 AUROC 为 0.562，略高于随机。聚合结果掩盖了异质性：code 子集 AUROC 为 0.416，低于随机；人工检查显示，code distractor 多是对 gold answer 的单操作符变异，而不是自由生成的错误答案，因此两类在表面上几乎相同。摘要截断处未给出 paraphrase-matched 干预的完整数值结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits whether a provenance artifact in synthetic RLVR corpora—gold answers from human text and distractors from model generation—becomes an exploitable shortcut.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training data-quality and causal-auditing paper. RLVR pipelines increasingly generate wrong options automatically; if correctness is entangled with provenance, a policy may learn source detection instead of reasoning, undermining reasoning-training data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using GooseReason-0.7M, the authors first test whether human gold answers and synthetic distractors are separable using a classifier that sees only five surface statistics and no semantics. They then analyze aggregate and code subsets separately, using manual inspection to explain anomalous signals. Finally, they run an intervention with paraphrase-matched conditions to separate artifact detectability from actual model use.
summary_en.experiments: Across 315,499 options, a classifier using only five surface statistics reaches AUROC 0.562, barely above chance. The aggregate hides heterogeneity: the code subset scores 0.416, below chance. Manual inspection shows that code distractors are often single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, making the two classes nearly identical by construction. The provided abstract truncates before reporting the full paraphrase-matched intervention results.

recommendation.zh: 读表面特征审计和干预设计；它给 RLVR 合成数据一个更干净的坏味道检测模板。
recommendation.en: Read the surface-feature audit and intervention design; it is a clean template for detecting bad smells in synthetic RLVR data.

stage_evidence.quote: When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora

paper.title: Invent a Dataset: Measuring dataset generation abilities with zero seed
paper.abstract: Building datasets remains one of the most manual and brittle parts of AI development. In this technical report, we focus on the most extreme but also most prevalent setting real world practitioners face: a zero data regime. Here, practitioners don't have any data for the capability they want to learn. We introduce Invent-A-Dataset which is a prompt based system to go from dataset description to realistic and large scale post-training datasets. We evaluate Invent-A-Dataset against five frontier m

summary.core_problem: 在完全没有种子数据的情况下，仅凭任务描述生成可用于后训练的大规模数据集。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是合成数据系统和后训练数据方法。它瞄准实际训练中常见但难处理的 zero-data regime，并直接比较多个 frontier model API 的数据生成能力，重点不在单条样本质量，而在规模化后的质量、多样性和下游训练收益。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Invent-A-Dataset，一个 prompt-based dataset generation system，从 dataset description 出发自动生成 realistic large-scale post-training datasets。方法核心应包括任务分解、样本生成、质量控制和多样性控制；摘要强调它不依赖 seed examples。
summary.experiments: 评估覆盖 5 个 frontier model APIs，包括 Anthropic、Google、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Zai；覆盖 8 类任务，数据规模最高 20K samples。相对基线质量提升 17%，多样性提升 19%；多样性优势随规模扩大，从 200 samples 时接近持平，到 20K samples 时达到 37% relative gains，并带来明显下游训练收益。摘要未给出具体被训练模型规模和完整 downstream 数字。
summary.authors_note: Sara Hooker 是数据中心机器学习、模型效率和开放研究方向的知名研究者；供给信息未列出作者机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to generate large-scale post-training datasets from only a task description, with zero seed examples.
summary_en.importance: This is a synthetic-data system and post-training data contribution. It targets the practical zero-data regime and compares dataset generation across frontier model APIs, focusing on quality, diversity, scaling behavior, and downstream training gains rather than isolated sample quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Invent-A-Dataset is a prompt-based dataset generation system that maps a dataset description to realistic large-scale post-training datasets. The key design appears to involve task decomposition, sample generation, quality control, and diversity control, with no reliance on seed examples.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation compares against five frontier model APIs from Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Zai, across eight task types and dataset sizes up to 20K samples. It reports 17% relative quality gains and 19% relative diversity gains. The diversity gap grows with scale, from parity at 200 samples to 37% relative gains at 20K samples, and the generated datasets improve downstream training. The abstract does not provide the full trained-model sizes or complete downstream numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: Sara Hooker is a well-known researcher in data-centric ML, model efficiency, and open research; the supplied metadata does not list author affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计和多样性随规模变化；如果结论稳，zero-seed 合成数据的瓶颈可能不是质量而是去重与覆盖控制。
recommendation.en: Read the evaluation design and diversity scaling; if robust, zero-seed synthesis may be limited more by deduplication and coverage control than raw quality.

paper.title: Self-Evolving Algorithm-Design Agents: Escaping In-Context Evolutionary Stagnation via Population-Curated Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly participating in complex real-world tasks in the form of algorithm-design agents, designing and refining algorithms. Many successful algorithm-design agents adopt pure in-context evolutionary frameworks, but they may quickly plateau in domains that require specialized knowledge. Parametric adaptation offers a way to internalize specialized knowledge, but conventional training requires abundant domain-specific corpora while high-quality algorithms are scarce

summary.core_problem: 在需要专业知识的复杂算法设计任务中，纯上下文进化（in-context evolution）方法容易陷入停滞，而传统的参数化微调又面临高质量领域数据稀缺的困境。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于自我生成的算法进行参数化自我进化的新范式，有效缓解了上下文进化的停滞问题，并提高了强化学习在算法设计任务中的样本效率。这为在数据稀缺的专业领域构建强大的自我进化 Agent 提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 Population-Curated Policy Optimization (PCPO) 方法。首先，通过诊断实验揭示了上下文进化停滞的原因（幻觉上下文强化了偏差输出）。然后，引入“改进链”（Improvement Chain）概念，证明学习已访问的算法可以提高生成相邻高质量算法的概率。PCPO 维护一个全局种群来保存高质量的自我生成算法，并采用混合策略更新：在线策略（on-policy）更新促进探索，离线策略（off-policy）更新利用种群中的精英算法进行正则化学习，引导策略向更优的相邻算法转移。
summary.experiments: 在芯片物理设计的全局布局（学习率调度设计）和 GPU 内核设计任务上进行了评估。在全局布局任务中，PCPO 在在线设置下取得了最大的性能提升，并在仅使用 4 个训练用例的情况下，泛化到 12 个测试用例，超越了现有的上下文进化方法（如 OpenEvolve），且样本效率高于 GRPO。在 GPU 内核设计任务中，PCPO 实现了平均 8.27 倍的加速。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对上下文进化停滞的分析，以及 PCPO 方法的混合策略更新机制（on-policy 探索 + off-policy 精英学习）。实验部分关注 PCPO 在数据稀缺情况下的泛化能力和样本效率优势。

summary_en.core_problem: In complex algorithm-design tasks requiring specialized knowledge, pure in-context evolution methods often plateau quickly, while traditional parametric fine-tuning suffers from a scarcity of high-quality domain data.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel paradigm for parametric self-evolution based on self-generated algorithms, effectively mitigating the stagnation of in-context evolution and improving the sample efficiency of reinforcement learning in algorithm design. This provides a new direction for building robust self-evolving agents in data-scarce specialized domains.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Population-Curated Policy Optimization (PCPO). First, diagnostic experiments reveal the cause of in-context evolutionary stagnation (hallucinated context reinforces biased outputs). Then, it introduces the "Improvement Chain" concept, demonstrating that learning visited algorithms increases the probability of generating neighboring high-quality algorithms. PCPO maintains a global population to store high-quality self-generated algorithms and employs a hybrid policy update scheme: on-policy updates promote exploration, while off-policy updates use elite algorithms from the population for regularized learning, shifting the policy towards better neighboring algorithms.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on global placement (learning rate schedule design) in chip physical design and GPU kernel design. In global placement, PCPO achieved the largest performance improvement in an online setting and generalized to 12 test cases after training on only 4, outperforming existing in-context evolution methods (e.g., OpenEvolve) with higher sample efficiency than GRPO. In GPU kernel design, PCPO achieved an average speedup of 8.27x.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of in-context evolutionary stagnation in the Introduction and the hybrid policy update mechanism of PCPO (on-policy exploration + off-policy elite learning). In the experiments, pay attention to PCPO's generalization ability and sample efficiency advantages in data-scarce scenarios.

recommendation.en: Read the theory motivation and curation rule; if the setup is clean, it is a useful testbed for when self-generated samples become parametric knowledge.
