paper.title: Let Training Guide Selection: Online Synthetic Data Filtering via Real-Anchored Utility
paper.abstract: Synthetic data can scale training supervision when real-world data are limited, but noise and distribution mismatch can reduce its value. Existing synthetic data selection methods often emphasize fidelity or diversity rather than the learner's evolving needs. We propose FROST, an online framework that estimates synthetic-data utility through gradient feedback anchored in real training data. It calibrates batch utility against recent history to determine when filtering is needed and filters sampl

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：当训练中混入大量 synthetic data 时，怎样不依赖外部 verifier、也不额外留出验证集，而是直接根据当前模型的训练动态，在线判断哪些合成样本对“真实分布上的目标”有帮助、哪些只是噪声甚至有害。它针对的不是离线数据筛选，而是训练过程中随模型状态变化而变化的样本效用估计。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口都有启发，但量级偏方法增量，属于可以借鉴思路的工作，不是必须精读的范式论文。它最有价值的点是把 synthetic data 选择从“看样本像不像真数据”转成“看这个样本的梯度方向是否支持真实数据目标”。这个视角更贴近训练本身，也更适合模型不断变化的场景。对于做合成预训练语料、蒸馏数据、SFT/RL 合成数据筛选的人，这篇提供了一个不依赖单独 reward model 或 held-out set 的在线过滤框架。局限也很明显：论文里的 LLM 部分是 text-to-SQL fine-tuning，不是大规模 pretraining；因此它对基座训练的直接证据还不够强，更像一个可迁移的选择准则。
summary.technical_approach:
FROST 的核心设计有两层：样本效用估计，以及何时触发过滤。

第一层是 real-anchored utility。训练第 t 步同时采样真实 batch 和合成 batch。作者维护一个由近期真实 batch 梯度构成的指数滑动平均，作为“真实目标方向”的平滑参考。对每个 synthetic sample，计算其梯度与这个 real-gradient reference 的对齐程度，用作 utility 分数。直觉上，如果一个合成样本产生的更新方向和真实数据近期推动的优化方向一致，它更可能帮助模型在真实分布上变好；如果方向相反或偏离很大，则更可能是噪声或分布错配。

第二层是 conditional filtering。作者认为单样本梯度分数噪声很大，如果每个 batch 都硬过滤，容易误删有用样本。因此先在 batch 级别聚合 utility，得到 batch mean，再和近期历史做校准，判断当前 batch 是否落在“正常效用带”内。若 batch 整体效用处于中间区间，则整批保留，不做样本级过滤；只有当 batch 明显偏高或偏低、属于 out-of-band 时，才进一步用 IQR 阈值在 batch 内做 sample-level filtering。这个设计的用意是避免把局部噪声放大成过度筛选，同时保留坏 batch 里的好样本，而不是整批丢弃。

从方法定位看，它和常见的 synthetic selection 不同之处有三点。第一，不依赖预训练特征提取器去做 fidelity/diversity 打分，因此没有对整个候选池做重预处理的成本。第二，不需要 held-out validation set 或外部 judge，而是直接复用训练中的真实 batch 作为锚点。第三，它是 online 的，utility 会随模型参数变化而更新，而不是一次性静态打分。

如果从预训练角度延伸，这个方法隐含了一个重要假设：真实数据梯度的 EMA 可以作为稳定的目标代理。这个假设在小规模 fine-tuning 上较合理，但在大规模混合预训练里是否仍然成立，要看 real/synthetic 比例、梯度噪声尺度、以及不同数据域之间的冲突程度。
summary.experiments:
论文覆盖了三个场景：图像分类、LLM fine-tuning 的 text-to-SQL，以及工业广告重排。与匹配丢弃比例的基线相比，FROST 在公开基准上能过滤约 20%–30% 的 synthetic data，同时比“使用全部合成池训练”取得更好的真实任务表现。

具体数字上，图像分类在 3 个 synthetic image generators 上带来 0.58%–1.14% 的绝对准确率提升；text-to-SQL 的 LLM fine-tuning 提升 0.9%。工业场景里更关键：直接使用完整 noisy synthetic pool 会让指标相对 real-only 基线退化 0.211% NE，而 FROST 不仅消除了退化，还转成了 0.096% 的相对 NE 提升。作者还强调，在成熟广告系统里 0.02% 已可视为显著，因此这个量级在工业上是有意义的。

从研究者视角，更该关注的是实验设计而不是绝对数值。作者做的是 matched drop ratio 对比，也就是在相同丢弃比例下比较不同选择策略，尽量把收益归因到“选得更准”而不是“只是少喂了数据”。另外，论文主张 batch-level gating + sample-level filtering 的组合优于始终逐样本过滤，这一点如果有消融表，值得重点看，因为它决定了方法是否真的解决了梯度噪声问题。

不过也要看到边界：LLM 实验是下游 fine-tuning 任务，规模和训练动态都与基座预训练差得很远。论文没有证明这种 real-anchored gradient utility 在大规模 next-token 预训练、合成 web text 混合、或 reasoning synthetic corpora 上同样稳定有效。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Method，把 real-anchored utility 与 conditional filtering 的逻辑吃透，再看 text-to-SQL 实验和主要消融。预计 20 到 30 分钟足够判断这套方法是否值得迁移到自己的数据管线。

阅读重点有四个。第一，看 utility 分数的具体定义，是全参数梯度、投影梯度，还是某种近似；这直接决定方法的计算成本和可扩展性。第二，看 real-gradient EMA 的更新频率和稳定性处理，因为这一步决定锚点是否可靠。第三，看 batch mean 校准和 IQR 阈值的细节，理解为什么作者不做每步硬过滤。第四，看消融里不同 drop ratio、不同 synthetic quality、以及是否存在 early-training/late-training 行为差异。

如果你做的是预训练数据研究，可以把它当成一个思路原型：用训练信号而不是静态数据特征来做合成数据选择。但在真正上大规模之前，需要先回答计算开销、梯度近似、以及多域混合时参考梯度是否失真的问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to filter synthetic training data online, using the learner’s own training dynamics, without relying on an external verifier or a held-out validation set. The goal is to decide which synthetic samples actually help optimization toward the real-data objective and which ones are noisy or distribution-mismatched, while training is still in progress.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and post-training pipelines, the main value is conceptual rather than paradigm-shifting. The paper moves synthetic-data selection away from static notions such as fidelity or diversity and toward a training-aware criterion: whether a synthetic sample’s gradient supports the direction induced by real data. That is a useful lens for synthetic corpora, distillation data, and instruction-tuning data curation. The limitation is that the LLM evidence is only on text-to-SQL fine-tuning rather than large-scale pretraining, so the paper should be read as a transferable selection principle, not as strong evidence for foundation-model pretraining at scale.
summary_en.technical_approach:
FROST has two main ingredients: real-anchored utility estimation and conditional filtering.

For utility estimation, each training step draws both a real batch and a synthetic batch. The method maintains an exponential moving average of gradients from recent real batches, which serves as a smoothed reference direction for the real-data objective. Each synthetic sample is then scored by the alignment between its gradient and this real-gradient reference. The intuition is straightforward: if a synthetic sample pushes parameters in a direction similar to what recent real data prefers, it is more likely to be useful; if it points away, it is more likely to be harmful or off-distribution.

The second ingredient is conditional filtering. The authors argue that per-sample gradient utility is noisy, so filtering every batch aggressively can remove useful supervision. They first aggregate utilities at the batch level and compare the batch mean against recent history to determine whether the batch falls inside a moderate utility band. Batches inside the band are kept as-is. Only out-of-band batches trigger sample-level filtering, where interquartile-range thresholds are used to retain or discard examples within the batch. This design is meant to avoid overreacting to stochastic gradient noise while still rescuing good samples from otherwise weak batches.

Relative to common synthetic-data selection methods, FROST differs in three ways. It does not require a separate pretrained feature extractor for fidelity/diversity scoring, so it avoids expensive offline preprocessing of the full synthetic pool. It does not need a held-out validation set or an external judge, because the real training stream itself provides the anchor. And it is online: utility is recomputed as the model evolves, rather than assigned once in a static preprocessing stage.

From a pretraining perspective, the hidden assumption is that an EMA of real-data gradients is a stable proxy for the target objective. That seems plausible in moderate-scale fine-tuning, but it is less obvious in large mixed-corpus pretraining where gradient noise, domain conflict, and real/synthetic ratios can be very different.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates FROST on image classification, LLM fine-tuning for text-to-SQL, and a large industrial ads re-ranking system. On the public benchmarks, it filters out roughly 20% to 30% of synthetic data while outperforming training on the full synthetic pool.

The reported gains are 0.58% to 1.14% absolute accuracy improvement across three synthetic image generators, and 0.9% improvement on text-to-SQL fine-tuning. The industrial result is more telling in practical terms: using the full noisy synthetic pool causes a 0.211% relative NE regression compared with the real-only baseline, while FROST turns that into a 0.096% relative NE improvement. The authors note that gains around 0.02% are already considered meaningful in mature production recommenders, so the industrial effect size is not trivial.

Methodologically, the matched-drop-ratio comparison is important. The paper compares selection methods under the same synthetic-data discard rate, which makes the gains more attributable to better selection rather than simply using less data. Also worth checking is the ablation on batch-level gating plus sample-level filtering versus always-on per-sample filtering, since that is the part intended to control gradient-noise sensitivity.

The main caveat is scope. The LLM experiment is a downstream fine-tuning task, not large-scale language-model pretraining. The paper does not establish that real-anchored gradient utility remains stable or cost-effective for next-token pretraining with large synthetic corpora or reasoning-heavy synthetic mixtures.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim read, start with the Introduction and Method to understand the logic of real-anchored utility and conditional filtering. Then read the text-to-SQL experiment and the main ablations. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to decide whether the idea is portable to your own data pipeline.

Focus on four details. First, inspect how utility is computed in practice: full gradients, projected gradients, or some approximation. That determines scalability. Second, check how the real-gradient EMA is updated and stabilized, because the whole method depends on the anchor being reliable. Third, read the calibration rule for batch means and the IQR-based sample filtering, since that is where the paper tries to avoid over-filtering under noisy gradients. Fourth, look for behavior across different drop ratios, synthetic-data quality levels, and training stages.

If your interest is pretraining data rather than downstream fine-tuning, treat this as a prototype idea: use training signals instead of static data features to select synthetic data. Before scaling it up, the open questions are compute overhead, gradient approximation quality, and whether the real-gradient anchor remains meaningful under multi-domain mixed training.

recommendation.zh: 基于真实数据梯度反馈的在线合成数据过滤机制，对 post-train 阶段如何高效利用合成数据有启发，值得关注其 utility 评估的设计。
recommendation.en: Online synthetic data filtering based on real-data gradient feedback; offers insights for efficient synthetic data utilization in post-training, worth checking its utility estimation design.

paper.title: Learning to Discover Interesting Mathematics
paper.abstract: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly able to solve advanced mathematical problems, including many that have been open for decades. This opens the door to expansion of mathematical knowledge at unprecedented scale. Yet, while LLMs may be able to conjecture and prove more and more theorems, it remains open whether this new mathematical knowledge is interesting or useful. We define intrinsic interestingness of a theorem as the ratio between the length of its proof and the l

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决自动数学发现中的“价值函数”问题：模型不只是生成可证明的 Lean 定理，还要判断哪些定理值得继续探索。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要在训练信号设计，而不是常规预训练数据或模型结构。论文把数学发现拆成可验证生成、条件证明难度估计、定理价值评估三个环节，并给出一个可以训练的 value model。这个思路对 RL-for-reasoning、证明器辅助训练、以及用形式系统构造高质量推理奖励都有参考价值。它强调奖励不应只看“是否证明成功”，还要看陈述复杂度、证明复杂度、以及对后续证明的压缩作用。
summary.technical_approach: 核心对象是条件证明难度 V(T|P)，即在给定前提集合 P 时证明目标定理 T 的难度。论文用 Lean 4 和 mathlib 的形式化证明作为可观测环境，把证明难度近似为形式证明代码长度或证明成本。基于 mathlib 的依赖图，作者训练或后训练一个 27B 模型来预测 V(T|P)，目标是在没有真正写出证明前估计证明难度。随后定义 intrinsic interestingness 为“证明长度 / 定理陈述长度”。直觉是：容易陈述但难以证明的命题更有信息密度。论文还定义 utility：一个定理加入已有数学上下文后，能在多大程度上缩短后续定理的证明。utility 更接近“可复用抽象”的价值，而 interestingness 更容易局部计算。作者进一步显示二者有较强相关性，因此 interestingness 可以作为近似奖励使用。最后，这个指标被用于后训练定理生成模型，并作为递归数学发现过程中的推理时剪枝信号。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三类。第一，27B 条件证明难度预测模型在预测证明难度上优于若干 frontier LLM，说明专门的 premise-conditioned value model 比通用模型直接判断更可靠。第二，用 interestingness 指标后训练语言模型后，生成定理的平均 interestingness 提高约 4 倍；同时，被判定为 substantially 或 fully contained in mathlib 的生成陈述比例从 91.9% 降到 30.6%，说明模型不只是复述已有库中的定理形态。第三，作者把 interestingness 用作推理时 pruning，在一个递归发现设置中找到了一些不在 mathlib 中的非平凡陈述。需要注意的是，这些结果更像是价值函数和发现流程的原型验证，还不是一个完整的自动数学研究系统。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看三个部分：一是 V(T|P) 的建模定义，尤其是前提集合如何影响证明难度；二是 interestingness 与 utility 的定义和相关性实验，这是论文最关键的训练信号论证；三是后训练生成模型和递归发现的实验设置，关注它如何避免只生成 mathlib 中已有或近似已有的命题。若时间有限，可以跳过较长的数学发现愿景叙述，直接看 proof difficulty modeling、interestingness/utility metric、generation post-training 和 discovery case study。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the value-function problem in autonomous mathematical discovery: a model should not only generate Lean-verifiable theorems, but also decide which theorems are worth pursuing.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is mainly about training-signal design. The paper separates mathematical discovery into verifiable generation, premise-conditioned proof-difficulty estimation, and theorem-value estimation. This is useful for RL-style reasoning training, theorem-prover-assisted data generation, and reward construction from formal systems. A key point is that the reward should not stop at proof success. It should also capture statement length, proof difficulty, and whether a theorem compresses future proofs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central object is the conditional proof-difficulty function V(T|P), the difficulty of proving a target theorem T given an available premise set P. Lean 4 and mathlib provide the formal environment, and proof difficulty is operationalized through formal proof length or proof cost. Using the dependency structure in mathlib, the authors post-train a 27B model to predict V(T|P) before the proof is actually constructed. They then define intrinsic interestingness as proof length divided by statement length. The intended signal is high information density: a theorem that is short to state but hard to prove is more interesting. They also define utility as the amount by which adding a theorem to the mathematical context compresses later proofs. Utility captures reusable abstraction, while interestingness is easier to estimate locally. The paper reports a strong correlation between the two, which motivates using interestingness as a practical reward. The metric is then used both for post-training theorem generation and for inference-time pruning in recursive discovery.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical results are concentrated in three areas. First, the 27B premise-conditioned proof-difficulty predictor outperforms several frontier LLMs on proof-difficulty prediction, suggesting that a specialized value model is more reliable than direct judgment by a general model. Second, post-training a theorem generator with the interestingness signal increases mean interestingness by roughly 4x. The fraction of generated statements judged substantially or fully contained in mathlib drops from 91.9% to 30.6%, indicating less direct reuse of existing library statements. Third, using interestingness as an inference-time pruning criterion in a recursive discovery loop yields nontrivial statements that are not present in mathlib. These results are best read as a prototype for value-guided discovery rather than a complete autonomous mathematics system.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is sufficient. Focus on three parts: the definition and training setup for V(T|P), the relationship between interestingness and utility, and the post-training plus recursive-discovery experiments. The most important technical content is how proof difficulty is made premise-conditioned and how a local reward is justified as a proxy for downstream mathematical utility. Readers with limited time can skip the broader motivation and go directly to proof-difficulty modeling, the interestingness/utility validation, and the discovery case studies.

recommendation.zh: 用 proof length / statement length 来量化定理的 interestingness 是个很巧妙的 heuristic，值得关注其在合成高质量数学数据上的潜力。
recommendation.en: Quantifying theorem interestingness via proof length / statement length is a clever heuristic; worth watching for its potential in synthesizing high-quality math data.

paper.title: VLA-Precision: Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping for Efficient Real-World Online RL of Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models enable broad manipulation but remain unreliable in tasks demanding precision and repeatability. Applying real-world online reinforcement learning (RL) to VLA post-training enables autonomous trial-and-error improvement beyond demonstrations alone, but exposes two bottlenecks: 1) unreliable value signals can induce policy drift; 2) large-VLA overhead constrains throughput and sample efficiency. To address these challenges, we present VLA-Precision, a

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 模型在高精度、可重复机器人操作任务中不可靠，以及真实在线 RL 后训练容易 value drift、吞吐低的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLA 后训练与真实机器人在线 RL 系统。它主要服务机器人操作，不是基座 LLM 预训练论文；可借鉴之处是大多模态策略在真实环境中如何用干预、偏好和回报信号稳定后训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VLA-Precision，包括 Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping 算法和 ACoB-Stream 架构。方法在早期用人为或系统干预引导行为学习，提高策略和在线经验质量；随着自主经验积累，再用全局回报传播和局部偏好排序校准 value estimate，形成相对动作优势信号，降低策略漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调真实世界在线 RL 和精密 manipulation 任务，但未给出 VLA 参数规模、机器人平台、任务数量、样本量、baseline 或提升幅度。实验重点应是对比演示学习、常规在线 RL、无干预引导或无偏好排序等变体。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unreliable precision and repeatability in pretrained vision-language-action models, and the value drift and low throughput that appear during real-world online RL.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLA post-training and real-robot online RL system contribution. It is not central to base LLM pretraining, but its signal-design choices are relevant to stabilizing large multimodal policies after pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: VLA-Precision combines the Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping algorithm with the ACoB-Stream architecture. Early intervention-guided behavior learning improves the policy and the quality of online experience; later, accumulated autonomous experience is used with global return propagation and local preference ranking to calibrate value estimates and produce relative action advantages.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the method targets real-world online RL for precision manipulation, but gives no model size, robot setup, task count, baseline list, or numerical improvements. Key ablations should isolate intervention guidance, return propagation, preference ranking, and streaming throughput.

recommendation.zh: 机器人味道较重，预训练侧只需知道它把干预数据、偏好排序和回报传播组合成在线 RL 稳定器。
recommendation.en: Mostly robotics-specific; for pretraining work, just note the stabilizer that combines interventions, preference ranking, and return propagation.

paper.title: Training Object Permanence in World Models
paper.abstract: Object permanence and solidity are hallmarks of human cognitive priors. Recent studies show that video generation models, a paradigmatic class of current world models, have begun to show emerged reasoning abilities, making them ideal candidates for building human-like physical intelligence. Do video models have emerged object permanence in them? If not, could we train them with a core-cognition inspired dataset? We introduce WROP (World Reasoning with Object Permanence), a data infrastructure of

summary.core_problem: 当前的视频生成模型（世界模型）在处理物体遮挡和碰撞等基本物理规律时经常失败，缺乏人类认知中的“客体永久性”（Object Permanence, OP）和“物体坚固性”（Object Solidity, OS）。
summary.importance: 构建了专门针对视频生成模型物理常识（OP 和 OS）的合成数据集和评测基准，并证明了通过特定认知科学启发的数据进行后训练，可以显著提升模型的物理推理能力。这为构建具备真实物理常识的世界模型提供了数据和评测基础。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 WROP (World Reasoning with Object Permanence) 数据基础设施。使用 Blender 构建了 150 个基于认知科学启发的任务生成器，分为 6 个认知类别（3 个 OP，3 个 OS）。生成器在保持核心物理结构（如轨迹、遮挡关系）不变的前提下，随机化表面参数（速度、光照、视角等），生成了 150 万个训练样本和 300 个测试样本。任务形式为视频续写：输入前半段视频（事件发生前），模型需生成包含物理事件及其后果的后半段。此外，基于该数据集对一个 16B 的世界模型进行了后训练（PWM-WROP）。
summary.experiments: 在包含 14 个模型（涵盖续写、参考图生成、编辑模型）的盲测人类评估中，经过 WROP 数据后训练的 PWM-WROP 模型在续写模型中排名第一（Elo 1679.5），仅次于两个商业参考图生成系统。在相同分辨率下，PWM-WROP 在 LPIPS 和 MS-SSIM 等自动指标上也取得了最佳的 target-fit 效果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Dataset 部分（Section 3）关于任务分类（OP 和 OS 的 6 个子类）和数据生成逻辑（结构参数与表面参数的分离）。这部分展示了如何将认知科学概念转化为可计算的视频生成任务。

summary_en.core_problem: Current video generation models (world models) frequently fail at basic physical laws like occlusion and collision, lacking "Object Permanence" (OP) and "Object Solidity" (OS) inherent in human cognition.
summary_en.importance: Establishes a synthetic dataset and benchmark specifically targeting physical common sense (OP and OS) in video generation models, and demonstrates that post-training on cognitive-science-inspired data significantly improves physical reasoning. This provides a crucial data and evaluation foundation for building world models with genuine physical understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces WROP (World Reasoning with Object Permanence), a data infrastructure. Built 150 cognitive-science-inspired task generators in Blender, categorized into 6 cognitive families (3 OP, 3 OS). Generators randomize surface parameters (speed, lighting, camera angle) while preserving core physical structures (trajectories, occlusions), yielding 1.5M training and 300 test samples. The task is video continuation: given the first half (pre-event context), the model generates the second half containing the physical event and its consequence. Furthermore, a 16B world model (PWM-WROP) was post-trained on this dataset.
summary_en.experiments: In a blind human evaluation across 14 models (continuation, reference-to-video, and edit models), the WROP-post-trained PWM-WROP ranked first among continuation models (Elo 1679.5), trailing only two commercial reference-to-video systems. At matched resolutions, PWM-WROP also achieved the best target-fit metrics (LPIPS, MS-SSIM).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Dataset section (Section 3) for the task taxonomy (the 6 subcategories of OP and OS) and the data generation logic (separating structural and surface parameters). This illustrates how cognitive science concepts are translated into computable video generation tasks.

recommendation.zh: 读任务设计和失败案例即可；可控合成物理数据比榜单分数更有用，能检验视频模型的捷径学习。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and failure cases; the controlled physical data is more useful than the ranking for probing shortcut learning in video models.

paper.title: What Should a Self-Teacher See? Privileged Context Design for On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: More privileged information does not always make a better teacher. We study this tension in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where a frozen copy of the base model scores the student's own rollouts under privileged context, conventionally a complete reference solution that bundles the final answer with one particular reasoning path. Holding the student view and training fixed within each scale, we compare that default against three abstractions compiled offline, a named strategy, a method-inde

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 on-policy self-distillation 里的一个关键但常被默认处理的问题：当学生模型只看到题目，而冻结教师在给学生轨迹打分时可以额外看到“特权上下文”，教师到底应该看多具体的信息？传统做法通常把完整参考解答喂给教师，默认信息越多越好。作者要检验的恰恰是这个默认前提是否成立。全文给出的答案是否定的：在 OPSD 里，教师看到完整解法未必是最好的监督形式；更抽象、但语义上对题目仍有指导性的上下文，有时能训练出更好的学生。
summary.importance: 这项工作的意义在于，它把“监督信号设计”从一个实现细节提升成了训练目标的一部分。对预训练和后训练接口都有启发。很多蒸馏、self-improvement、RL-with-verifier 或 reasoning data synthesis 工作，默认把更详细的参考轨迹当成更强 supervision，但这篇文章说明，教师优势来自信息不对称时，关键不是信息量，而是信息如何改变教师在学生前缀上的条件分布。完整解答可能把教师分布过度锚定在某一条参考路径上，压缩学生自己的探索空间；而更抽象的策略提示、方法无关 framing，反而能给出更稳的 token-level guidance。对做 reasoning pretrain / mid-train 的人，这意味着“参考答案怎么表示”本身就是可优化变量，而不是数据预处理小问题。
summary.technical_approach:
作者把 privileged context 设计成一个受控干预问题。训练集是问题-参考解答对，但学生始终只看问题 x；冻结教师是学生初始 checkpoint 的拷贝，在训练时对学生自己 rollout 出来的前缀给出 next-token 分布。唯一变化的是教师额外看到的上下文表示 c_l(x)。

围绕同一份 problem-solution 数据，作者离线编译出多种上下文层级。L1 是完整解答；L2 是 named strategy，即给出方法名称或策略标签；L3 是 method-independent framing，更强调解题视角或结构，不绑定具体步骤；L4 是 problem category，只给更高层的题型归类；L5 是 answer-only，只保留最终答案，不给过程。另有一个控制条件，把完整解答截成固定 10% 前缀再加答案，用来区分“语义抽象”与“单纯缩短上下文”。这些上下文都通过固定模板和 bridge wording 注入教师 prompt，学生侧 prompt、rollout 过程、loss、训练数据、教师 checkpoint 都保持不变。

方法上的关键点有两个。第一，作者明确把评价目标定义为“训练后学生的效用”，而不是教师分布与学生分布的某种静态距离。也就是说，context utility 只能通过训练后的学生表现来判断。第二，他们把 initial teacher-student KL 当作诊断量，而不是优化目标。这个设计很重要，因为它允许作者检验一个常见直觉：更强的分布位移是否意味着更好的教学信号。实验最后表明并非如此。

从机制理解上，完整解答给教师的是一条具体 derivation，因此教师在学生偏离参考路径时，可能更倾向于把分布拉回那条路径；抽象提示则保留了“往哪走”的信息，但减少了“必须怎么走”的约束。对于 on-policy 轨迹，这种差异会直接改变蒸馏信号的形状，而不只是强弱。
summary.experiments:
主实验在 competition mathematics 上做，学生模型是三个尺度的 Qwen3：1.7B、4B、8B。评测覆盖三个 in-domain 数学 benchmark 和四个 transfer benchmark。作者在每个尺度内固定训练流程，只改变 privileged context 类型，并用多种 reporting rule，包括 peak mean、endpoint 等，避免只看单一 checkpoint。

核心结果有三点。第一，简洁的中间抽象层级可以优于完整解答。在 primary runs 中，最佳 intermediate context 相比 full solution，在 in-domain peak mean 上 4B 提升 1.4 分，8B 提升 1.6 分，同时 hint token 存储量少一个数量级。并且在三随机种子下，L3 和 L4 相对 L1 在 4B、8B 的四种 reporting rule 上都呈现正向平均增益。第二，answer-only 在较大模型上 surprisingly competitive：4B 和 8B 上距离 full solution 的 in-domain peak mean 不到 0.2 分，但在 1.7B 上落后 1.76 分。这说明随着学生能力上升，教师未必需要提供具体过程，保留“目的地”就可能足够。第三，initial KL 不决定教学效果。完整解答在所有尺度上都诱导出最大的初始 teacher-student KL，但并没有在 4B、8B 上带来最好的训练后成绩。item-level 分析还显示，不同 context 改变的是“学生最终会解出哪些题”，而不是简单整体抬升或压低。

另外一个值得注意的实验是重编译上下文。作者用 Qwen3-8B 重新生成这些抽象上下文后，在较大尺度上仍保留 peak 优势，说明效果不只是某个特定 compiler 模型的偶然产物。还有补充实验涉及 heterogeneous assignment 和 learned routing，不过主结论已经很清楚：不存在 universally best 的 context，最优抽象层级依赖学生规模和任务。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但要抓住定义。先看 Introduction 前两页，作者把 privileged context 从“教师额外信息”提升为“监督机制的一部分”，这个 framing 很重要。然后重点看 context level 的构造表或示意图，弄清 L1 到 L5 分别保留了什么、去掉了什么。接着看主结果表，尤其是 4B、8B 上 L3/L4 与 L1 的对比，以及 answer-only 与 full solution 几乎持平这一点。最后看 initial KL 的分析图，这部分直接反驳了“分布差得越大，蒸馏越有效”的简单直觉。

如果只花 25 分钟，建议顺序是：任务设定图 → context taxonomy → 主表 1 → 多 seed 结果 → KL 诊断。阅读时不要把它当成数学推理论文，而要把它当成“训练信号设计”论文。最值得深挖的是两件事：一是为什么抽象提示在中大模型上更好，是否因为减少了 reference-path bias；二是这种结论能否迁移到 reasoning SFT、RFT、以及带 verifier 的 self-training。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a central but often under-specified design choice in on-policy self-distillation: what privileged context should the frozen self-teacher see when supervising the student’s own rollouts? The standard choice is a full reference solution, which implicitly assumes that more information yields better teaching. The paper tests that assumption directly and finds that it does not generally hold. In OPSD, a full worked solution can be worse than more abstract context forms, even though those forms contain less procedural detail.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is to recast privileged-context design as part of the supervision mechanism, not a prompt-formatting detail. That matters beyond this specific setup. In self-improvement, reasoning distillation, verifier-guided training, and some RL-adjacent pipelines, detailed reference traces are often treated as strictly better supervision. This paper shows that when the teacher’s advantage comes from information asymmetry rather than superior capability, the key question is not how much information the teacher gets, but how that information reshapes the teacher distribution over the student’s on-policy prefixes. Full solutions may over-anchor the teacher to one derivation path and reduce useful exploration. More abstract hints can preserve directional guidance while leaving room for alternative trajectories. For people working on reasoning pretraining or mid-training, that makes representation of reference information an optimization target in its own right.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is a controlled intervention on teacher-only context. The training data consists of problem-solution pairs. The student always sees only the problem x. The teacher is a frozen copy of the student’s initial checkpoint and provides next-token distributions on the student’s own sampled prefixes. The only thing that changes across runs is the privileged context policy c_l(x) supplied to the teacher.

From the same problem-solution pairs, the authors compile several context levels offline. L1 is the full solution. L2 is a named strategy, giving a method label or strategy cue. L3 is a method-independent framing, which keeps the structural perspective but avoids committing to a specific derivation. L4 is a problem category, an even higher-level abstraction. L5 is answer-only, preserving the destination but removing the path. There is also a control condition that keeps only a fixed 10% prefix of the original solution plus the answer, which helps separate semantic abstraction from simple context shortening. Prompt templates and bridge wording are controlled, and within each model scale the student prompt, rollout procedure, loss, teacher checkpoint, and training set are held fixed.

Two methodological choices are especially important. First, the paper defines context utility by post-training student performance, not by a static property of the teacher distribution. That is the right target for this problem. Second, initial teacher-student KL is treated only as a diagnostic. This allows the authors to test a common intuition—that larger distributional displacement means better teaching—and show that it fails here.

Mechanistically, the difference is easy to state. A full solution gives the teacher one concrete derivation, so when the student deviates from that path the teacher may push probability mass back toward the reference trajectory. Abstract context keeps information about what kind of solution is appropriate while relaxing how it should be reached. In on-policy distillation, that changes the shape of the supervision signal, not just its strength.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiments are on competition mathematics. Students are Qwen3 models at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B. Evaluation includes three in-domain math benchmarks and four transfer benchmarks. Within each scale, the training pipeline is fixed and only the privileged context type changes. Results are reported under multiple rules, including peak mean and endpoint-style summaries, to avoid overfitting conclusions to a single checkpoint selection scheme.

There are three main findings. First, concise intermediate abstractions can outperform full solutions. In the primary runs, the best intermediate context improves in-domain peak mean over the full-solution condition by 1.4 points at 4B and 1.6 points at 8B, while using roughly an order of magnitude fewer hint tokens. Across three seeds, L3 and L4 show positive mean gains over L1 at 4B and 8B under all four reporting rules. Second, answer-only context is surprisingly competitive at larger scales: it comes within 0.2 points of the full-solution condition at 4B and 8B, but trails by 1.76 points at 1.7B. This suggests that as the student becomes stronger, preserving the destination may matter more than exposing a full path. Third, initial KL does not rank teaching utility. Full solutions induce the largest initial teacher-student KL at every scale, yet they do not produce the best trained students at 4B or 8B. Item-level analysis further shows that context changes which problems the student ends up solving, not just the overall average.

A useful robustness check recompiles the abstract contexts with Qwen3-8B and still preserves the peak advantage at larger scales, which argues against the effect being an artifact of one specific offline compiler. The supplementary studies on heterogeneous assignment and learned routing are secondary; the main result already stands: there is no universally best privileged context, and the preferred abstraction level depends on student scale and task.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a good skim paper, but the framing matters. Start with the introduction, especially the argument that privileged context is part of the supervision mechanism rather than auxiliary metadata. Then read the context taxonomy carefully so that L1 through L5 are clear. After that, go straight to the main result table, focusing on the 4B and 8B comparisons between L3/L4 and L1, and on the answer-only condition staying nearly tied with full solutions. Finish with the KL diagnostic section, which directly challenges the idea that larger teacher-student divergence automatically means better distillation.

If you have about 25 minutes, read in this order: setup figure, context construction section, main table, multi-seed results, KL analysis. The right lens is not “math reasoning method” but “training signal design.” Two questions are worth deeper follow-up: whether the gains come mainly from reducing reference-path bias, and whether the same pattern transfers to reasoning SFT, verifier-guided self-training, or RL-style reasoning pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 反常识结论：在自蒸馏/RM打分时，给教师模型提供高度抽象的 hint（如解题策略）比提供完整推导过程效果更好，且 token 更省。值得关注其在 RL 数据合成中的应用。
recommendation.en: Counter-intuitive finding: When scoring in self-distillation/RM, providing the teacher with highly abstract hints (e.g., problem-solving strategies) yields better results and saves tokens compared to full derivations. Worth noting for RL data synthesis.

paper.title: On Mitigation of Subliminal Learning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Knowledge distillation can transmit unintended behavioral traits from a teacher model to a student through training data that appear semantically unrelated to those traits, a phenomenon known as subliminal learning. Although recent work has established this effect, its training dynamics and mitigation remain underexplored. We study subliminal learning in open-weight language models ranging from 1.5B to 8B parameters, covering the Qwen, Gemma, and Llama families in number-sequence and chain-of-th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注蒸馏和合成数据微调中的隐性行为迁移：学生模型会从看似与目标特质无关的数据中继承教师模型的偏好、风格或安全相关倾向。论文重点不是再次证明现象存在，而是追踪微调过程中的动态，并测试可操作的缓解方法。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口有直接启发。它提醒合成数据蒸馏的风险不只来自显式内容污染，也来自教师模型分布中的弱信号。对基座研究员来说，关键点是：数据语义过滤不足以保证行为隔离；KL 约束的时间位置会影响特质迁移；早期训练阶段可能决定很多后续难以观察的行为漂移。贡献量级偏中等，属于风险建模和训练 recipe 层面的实证研究。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在数字序列补全和 GSM8K CoT 蒸馏两个设置中研究 subliminal learning。教师和学生通常使用同一初始化的开源 instruction 模型，因为已有工作显示这种隐性迁移在共享初始化时更稳定。教师通过 system prompt 被注入目标偏好，再生成训练数据；数据中过滤显式提及目标特质的样本。核心缓解方法是 liminal training：在有偏数据微调时加入对参考模型的 KL 正则，并采用退火式 schedule。直觉是让模型学习任务相关信号，同时限制其在早期偏离原有分布，从而压低不可见特质的吸收。作者将其与改写数据、冻结层等自然基线比较，并进一步分析 KL 强度和 schedule 的影响。一个重要观察是早期加权正则比后期加权正则更有效，说明隐性特质迁移可能在训练早段形成。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct、Gemma-3-4B-IT、Llama-3-8B-Instruct。数字序列数据由有偏教师生成 30,000 次，再采样到 7,500 条。CoT 设置使用 GSM8K，过滤掉最终答案错误的教师样本，用 GSM8K accuracy 衡量任务学习。每个配置跑 3 个固定随机种子。特质评估使用 50 个固定 probe prompt，例如询问最喜欢的动物，跟踪目标 token 及其大小写、前导空格等 tokenizer 变体的起始生成概率。结果显示，特质概率在训练中并非单调上升，可能出现短暂峰值、反转和迁移失败。liminal training 在保留相当一部分 GSM8K 任务收益的同时，较稳定地抑制偏好或风格迁移。论文还把目标特质从动物偏好扩展到法语回答风格，说明该方法不只适用于简单偏好 token。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Methods，重点看 Section 3.3、4.1、4.2、4.3、4.4。Section 4.1 可看不同缓解策略的比较；Section 4.2 是最值得停留的部分，能看到 KL schedule 与正则强度如何形成任务收益和特质抑制的 trade-off；Section 4.4 对训练动态的非单调性有参考价值。预计阅读 30–45 分钟即可抓住主要信息。若关注合成数据蒸馏安全，可以进一步看 Appendix B 的 prompt 与样本构造。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how unintended traits can transfer from a teacher model to a student through distillation data that does not explicitly mention those traits. Its main focus is not only whether subliminal learning happens, but how the trait signal evolves during fine-tuning and how it can be mitigated without losing the intended task gain.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the interface between synthetic-data training, distillation, and alignment. It shows that semantic filtering of generated data is not enough: hidden distributional cues in teacher outputs can still move the student toward the teacher’s preferences or response style. The most useful lesson for pretraining and mid-training practice is that KL regularization timing matters. Early regularization appears more effective than late regularization, suggesting that some unwanted behavioral drift is established in the early phase of adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate subliminal learning in two settings: number-sequence completion and GSM8K chain-of-thought distillation. A biased teacher is created through a system prompt, and its outputs are used as fine-tuning data after filtering explicit mentions of the target trait. Teacher and student usually share the same underlying model initialization, following prior evidence that subliminal transfer is more reliable in that regime. The proposed mitigation, liminal training, fine-tunes on the biased data while adding an annealed KL penalty to a reference model. The goal is to let the student absorb task-relevant information while discouraging early distributional drift that may carry latent traits. The method is compared with paraphrasing and layer freezing, and the paper separately studies the strength and timing of the KL regularizer.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct, Gemma-3-4B-IT, and Llama-3-8B-Instruct. For number sequences, the biased teacher is prompted 30,000 times and each dataset is subsampled to 7,500 examples. For CoT distillation, the teacher generates GSM8K reasoning traces, and samples with incorrect final answers are removed. Each configuration uses three fixed random seeds. Trait acquisition is measured throughout training with 50 bias-eliciting probes, tracking the probability of target-token variants at the start of the response. The main empirical finding is that trait probabilities can be highly non-monotonic, with transient spikes and reversals. Liminal training is the most consistent mitigation among the tested methods, and it can suppress both animal-preference transfer and a French response-style trait while preserving much of the GSM8K improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should focus on the experimental setup and the mitigation results. Sections 3.3 and 4.1 explain the proposed training recipe and compare it with paraphrasing and layer freezing. Section 4.2 is the most informative part for training practice because it studies KL strength and schedule. Section 4.4 is useful for understanding why final-checkpoint-only evaluation can miss important dynamics. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes.

recommendation.en: Read the trajectory plots: the main lesson is that distillation contamination is not captured by final metrics, and early KL control deserves an internal replication.

paper.title: Euston: Training Away Mathematical Sycophancy Without Losing the Mathematics
paper.abstract: Reasoning language models are trained to produce solutions, not to refuse them, and this bias persists when the problem they are handed is false. Asked to prove a corrupted theorem, a strong model will typically comply and produce a confident derivation of something untrue. We present Euston, an 8B mathematical claim-verification model trained to resist exactly this. Training data were generated with GraphSynth, a probabilistic factor-graph generator that couples attribute-level diversity to dec

summary.core_problem: 如何解决推理模型在面对错误数学命题时产生的“阿谀奉承（sycophancy）”问题（即倾向于为错误命题提供看似合理的推导，而不是指出其错误），同时在强化学习微调过程中不损害模型原有的通用数学推理能力。
summary.importance: 直击了当前推理模型作为验证器（verifier）使用时的一个核心痛点。该研究不仅提供了一个高质量的成对数学命题验证数据集构建方法，还通过严格的评估协议（同时监控判别能力和通用能力）证明了：通过高质量的合成负样本进行 RL，可以在不牺牲通用数学能力的前提下，显著提升模型的拒答/判伪能力。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 数据生成：使用 GraphSynth 管道，基于真实 arXiv 论文中的数学命题，生成结构良好且语义非平凡的“成对”正负样本（True/False），避免模型利用表面特征进行捷径学习。2) 训练配方：采用 GRPO 算法对 DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B 进行微调。奖励函数设计极简且无 API 依赖（zero-API）：仅提取最终的 \boxed{...} 答案，与 Ground Truth（True/False）匹配则给 1.0，否则 0.0。3) 评估策略：将通用数学能力（AIME 2026）作为强制性的监控指标，任何提升判别能力但降低 AIME 成绩的实验均视为失败。
summary.experiments: 在严格控制的实验下，模型（Euston）在平衡的 held-out 验证集上，判别准确率提升了 27.5 个百分点，同时在 AIME 2026 上的表现没有统计学意义上的下降。消融实验表明，性能提升大约一半归因于模型学会了输出可解析的判决结果，另一半才是真正的判断力提升。对比实验（SFT vs GRPO，不同数据源）证明，决定是否能在不损害通用能力的情况下提升判别能力的关键，在于生成的负样本质量，而非优化器本身。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Data Generation with GraphSynth 部分，理解如何生成高质量、难以通过表面启发式规则区分的负样本，这是整个工作的基石。其次关注 Evaluation Protocol，体会作者将通用能力（AIME）作为强制约束的严谨态度，这对于避免 RL 过程中的 reward hacking 和能力退化具有重要指导意义。

summary_en.core_problem: How to mitigate the 'sycophancy' problem in reasoning models when faced with unsound mathematical statements (i.e., the tendency to provide plausible derivations for false statements rather than identifying them as false), without degrading the model's general mathematical reasoning capabilities during reinforcement learning fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: Addresses a critical pain point when using current reasoning models as verifiers. This study not only provides a method for constructing a high-quality paired mathematical claim verification dataset but also demonstrates through a rigorous evaluation protocol (monitoring both discrimination and general capabilities) that RL with high-quality synthetic negative samples can significantly improve a model's ability to reject/falsify claims without sacrificing general mathematical proficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Data Generation: Utilizes the GraphSynth pipeline to generate structurally well-formed and semantically non-trivial 'paired' positive and negative samples (True/False) based on mathematical statements from real arXiv papers, preventing the model from learning shortcuts via surface features. 2) Training Recipe: Fine-tunes DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B using the GRPO algorithm. The reward function is minimalist and zero-API: it extracts the final \boxed{...} answer, awarding 1.0 for a match with the Ground Truth (True/False) and 0.0 otherwise. 3) Evaluation Strategy: Mandates general mathematical capability (AIME 2026) as a monitoring metric; any run that improves discrimination but degrades AIME performance is considered a failure.
summary_en.experiments: Under strictly controlled experiments, the resulting model (Euston) improved discrimination accuracy by 27.5 percentage points on a balanced held-out validation set, with no statistically significant drop in performance on AIME 2026. Ablation studies show that roughly half of the performance gain is attributable to the model learning to emit a parseable verdict, while the other half represents genuine improvement in judgment. Comparative experiments (SFT vs GRPO, different data sources) prove that the quality of the generated negative samples, rather than the optimizer itself, is the decisive factor in whether discrimination can be improved without compromising general capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the 'Data Generation with GraphSynth' section to understand how high-quality negative samples, difficult to distinguish via surface heuristics, are generated; this is the foundation of the work. Next, pay attention to the 'Evaluation Protocol' to appreciate the authors' rigorous approach of using general capability (AIME) as a hard constraint, which provides important guidance for avoiding reward hacking and capability degradation during RL.

recommendation.en: Reveals severe hallucination/sycophancy issues in reasoning models like R1 when faced with false premises, and provides an effective solution based on synthetic data + GRPO, highly inspiring for RL post-training and data synthesis.

paper.title: Beyond Task Completion: Training Capable and Safe Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have made rapid progress in completing complex tasks through graphical user interfaces, yet post-training centered on task success alone does not induce reliable safety behavior. A reliable CUA must condition its execution on risk: it should complete ordinary benign tasks, avoid environmental hazards and continue when a safe completion path remains, and refuse when the goal is harmful or no safe path exists. To learn this conditional policy, we develop Safety and Capab

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：图形界面上的 computer-use agent 不能只学“把任务做完”，还必须学会在执行过程中根据风险状态决定继续、绕开危险后继续，还是直接拒绝。现有 CUA 后训练大多把成功率当主目标，安全更多依赖外部 guardrail 或事后检测。论文关注的是如何把安全决策内生到策略里，并且不把安全简单做成“多拒绝”。
summary.importance: 它与预训练主线的距离比纯 LLM pretrain 论文更远，但对 post-train 接口有现实意义，尤其是多模态 agent 的轨迹监督、可验证任务合成、以及 capability 与 safety 的联合优化。对基座研究员的启发主要在训练信号设计：如果奖励只看任务完成，模型不会自然学出风险条件化策略；需要把“安全继续”和“必要拒绝”拆成不同监督来源。另一个有价值的点是数据构造方式。作者不是单独收集一批安全案例，而是把普通 GUI 任务系统化地变形成带风险版本，使 capability 与 safety 数据分布更对齐。这种 paired synthesis 思路，对 tool-use、web agent、甚至代码执行 agent 的后训练都可迁移。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由数据生成和两阶段训练两部分组成。先看问题形式化。作者区分两类安全场景：一类是 environment-risk task，用户目标本身是正当的，但环境里有危险操作或陷阱，正确行为是避开风险后继续完成任务；另一类是 explicit-misuse task，用户目标本身有害，应直接拒绝。这个区分很重要，因为如果把两类都压成一个“拒绝/不拒绝”标签，模型会倾向于保守停机，牺牲有用性。

为此，论文提出 SCOPE-Gen。它从正常 GUI 任务出发，自动注入可检测的 forbidden events 或风险元素，同时保持原始用户目标和完成判定器不变，构造出与原任务配对的安全感知版本。这样得到三类轨迹监督：能力轨迹教模型如何完成普通任务；risk-handling 轨迹教模型在有风险但可安全完成时如何绕开危险继续执行；refusal 轨迹教模型在目标有害或无安全路径时停止。奖励设计采用 completion reward 与 safety reward 的乘积形式，只有“完成且未触发风险”才拿满分。这个设计避免了单纯完成导向，也避免了只靠安全分类器做外部拦截。

训练上分两阶段。第一阶段是 joint SFT，把能力、安全继续、拒绝三类行为一起学进去，先建立条件化策略。第二阶段再做 capability-oriented online RL，继续提升任务完成率，同时观察安全是否保持。这里的取舍很明确：先用监督把决策边界立住，再用 RL 往能力方向推，而不是一开始就让 RL 在混合目标上自己摸索。论文实例化在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，并构建了 SATraj-OS 作为 capability–safety trajectory dataset。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在 OSWorld 和 OS-BLIND 上评估能力与安全。文中给出的关键数字是：只做 capability-only training 能提升任务执行，但不会自然带来可靠的攻击规避。加入联合 capability–safety SFT 后，SCOPE-SFT 在 OSWorld 上达到 49.72%，在 OS-BLIND 上达到 66.30% attack-avoidance rate，对应 capability–safety harmonic mean 为 56.83%。在此基础上继续做偏能力导向的在线 RL，SCOPE-RL 把 OSWorld 提升到 54.17%，同时仍保留 64.30% 的 attack-avoidance，综合分数达到 58.80%。

消融结果是全文最有信息量的部分。作者发现 refusal trajectories 贡献了大部分 OS-BLIND 上的攻击规避提升，也就是“什么时候必须停”这件事比较容易直接教会；但 risk-handling trajectories 的作用在于，在相近的 attack-avoidance 水平下保住任务效用，避免模型把安全学成过度拒绝。两者结合后，策略更接近作者想要的条件化行为：普通任务正常做，遇到可绕开的风险继续做，遇到有害目标再拒绝。

从研究设计看，最值得注意的不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是 capability-only → joint SFT → capability-oriented RL 这条训练路径展示出的非对称性：安全行为不会从能力优化中自然涌现，但在先学会安全边界后，再做能力强化，并不一定显著破坏安全。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看引言和方法开头，弄清作者为什么强调 safe continuation，而不是把安全等同于 refusal。随后重点看 SCOPE-Gen 的任务配对机制、奖励定义，以及三类轨迹各自承担什么监督角色。结果部分优先看主表和 refusal / risk-handling 的消融，这比单纯看总分更能说明方法设计是否合理。

如果只花 30 分钟，建议读：Introduction、Method 中对两类安全场景的定义、SCOPE-Gen 流程图、主结果表、以及 trajectory type ablation。需要带着一个问题去读：作者的方法到底是在学“安全策略”，还是在学“更保守的拒绝器”。消融部分基本就是回答这个问题的关键证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific failure mode of computer-use agents: task-success training alone does not produce a policy that conditions execution on risk. A reliable GUI agent should complete benign tasks, continue safely when hazards are avoidable, and refuse when the goal is harmful or no safe path exists. Existing post-training pipelines mostly optimize completion and leave safety to external filters or after-the-fact checks.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant at the pretrain–posttrain interface, especially for multimodal agents trained from trajectories. The main lesson is about training signals. If the objective only rewards task completion, safety-aware behavior does not emerge on its own. The paper also offers a useful data-construction pattern: instead of collecting a separate pool of safety examples, it systematically transforms ordinary GUI tasks into paired safety-aware variants, keeping capability and safety supervision distributionally aligned. That idea is portable to tool-use agents, web agents, and code-execution agents.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method combines paired task synthesis with two-stage post-training. The authors distinguish two safety settings. In environment-risk tasks, the user goal is benign but the interface contains hazards; the correct behavior is safe continuation, not refusal. In explicit-misuse tasks, the goal itself is harmful and should be refused. This distinction is central, because collapsing both into a single refuse/not-refuse label would push the model toward conservative shutdown behavior.

To support this, they introduce SCOPE-Gen, an automated pipeline that starts from normal GUI tasks and injects detectable forbidden events or risky interface elements while preserving the original user goal and completion evaluator. This produces paired tasks and three complementary trajectory types: capability trajectories for ordinary execution, risk-handling trajectories for safe continuation under environmental hazards, and refusal trajectories for harmful goals or no-safe-path cases. The reward is defined as the product of completion reward and safety reward, so full credit requires both successful completion and hazard avoidance.

Training proceeds in two stages. First, joint SFT teaches the model all three behaviors together, establishing a conditional execution policy. Second, capability-oriented online RL further improves task completion while monitoring whether safety is retained. The design choice is deliberate: use supervised data to shape the decision boundary first, then use RL to push capability, rather than expecting RL to discover the right safety-capability tradeoff from scratch. The instantiated model is based on Qwen3.5-9B, and the trajectory dataset is SATraj-OS.
summary_en.experiments:
The main evaluations are on OSWorld for capability and OS-BLIND for attack avoidance. The headline numbers are clear. Capability-only training improves execution but does not reliably induce attack avoidance. After joint capability-safety SFT, SCOPE-SFT reaches 49.72% on OSWorld and 66.30% attack-avoidance on OS-BLIND, with a capability-safety harmonic mean of 56.83%. After subsequent capability-oriented online RL, SCOPE-RL improves OSWorld to 54.17% while retaining 64.30% attack avoidance, yielding the best aggregate score of 58.80%.

The ablations are the most informative part. Refusal trajectories account for most of the gain in attack avoidance on OS-BLIND, meaning that explicit supervision is effective for teaching when to stop. Risk-handling trajectories play a different role: they preserve task utility at comparable attack-avoidance levels by teaching the model to continue safely instead of over-refusing. Together, the two trajectory types produce a more balanced conditional policy.

The broader takeaway from the training path—capability-only, then joint SFT, then capability-oriented RL—is that safety does not emerge automatically from capability optimization, but once a safety-aware boundary is learned, further capability improvement does not necessarily erase it.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, start with the introduction and the early method section to understand why the paper separates safe continuation from refusal. Then focus on the SCOPE-Gen pipeline, the paired-task construction, and the reward definition. In the results, prioritize the main benchmark table and the ablations over trajectory types. Those sections reveal whether the method is actually learning a safety-aware execution policy or merely becoming more conservative.

If you only have about 30 minutes, read the introduction, the formal definition of the two safety settings, the SCOPE-Gen overview, the main results table, and the refusal-versus-risk-handling ablations. The key question to keep in mind is whether the model learns conditional safety behavior rather than a generic tendency to refuse. The ablation section is where that question is answered most directly.

paper.title: Boosting Deepresearch and LongContext Ability with Self-Generated Deepresearch Rollouts Traces
paper.abstract: Deepresearch (DR) agents interact with real-world web environments through multi-turn search and visit, causing their contexts to grow rapidly over time. We observe that, even after DR Agentic Reinforcement Learning (DR-RL), 61.6% of the model's remaining prediction errors can still be attributed to insufficient long-context understanding, including longcontext hallucination and failures in cross-document evidence integration. It motivates us to further break the bottleneck of DR-RL by strengthe

summary.core_problem: 这项工作关注 Deepresearch agent 的一个训练瓶颈：标准 DR-RL 提升了搜索和工具使用能力，但剩余错误中有大量来自长上下文理解不足，尤其是长轨迹下的证据幻觉和跨文档信息整合失败。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口有直接启发。论文指出，RL 的正反馈可能偏向短轨迹：模型较早找到证据并快速结束任务时更容易得到成功信号；长轨迹往往包含重复搜索、噪声证据和信息混乱，因此成功样本少，长上下文能力得不到充分训练。DR-to-Long 的价值在于把 agent rollout 重新组织成长上下文 QA 训练数据，用同一批交互轨迹同时服务 agent 能力和 long-context 能力。这比单纯加长 context window 更接近训练信号问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两层。第一层是 DR Rollouts to Long-Context QA，即 DR-to-Long。给定一个 Deepresearch 轨迹，保留原始问题，把访问过的网页展开为长上下文证据；未使用或弱相关页面成为有干扰性的上下文。成功 rollout 可以直接转成长上下文 QA，因为最终答案说明上下文中已有足够证据。失败 rollout 更难，但可能缺少必要信息；论文用同一问题的成功 rollout 中的高价值 search snippets 和网页 summaries 补充进去，在保留失败轨迹噪声和干扰项的同时保证答案可推导。第二层是 DLD-RL 训练流程：先进行短阶段 DR-RL 生成 rollout traces；再用 DR-to-Long 构造 LongQA 数据并做 LongQA-RL；最后恢复完整 DR-RL。这个流程把 agent 轨迹当成可再利用的数据源，而不是只把它作为一次性 RL episode。
summary.experiments: 论文先用更强模型分析多个现有 DR 模型在 benchmark 上的 1,000 条错误轨迹，发现 61.6% 的错误与长上下文理解不足有关。DR-to-Long 可通过控制展开网页数量构造 64K–128K token 的训练样本，也可以在无额外标注下扩展到 million-token 实例。实验在两个 Deepresearch-SFT 初始化模型上进行。相对持续做标准 DR-RL，DLD-RL 在三个 Deepresearch benchmark 上平均相对提升约 7.3%，在三个长上下文 benchmark 上平均相对提升约 13.5%。分析还显示，经过 LongQA-RL 后，agent 行为发生变化，例如更频繁调用 Visit 工具查看完整网页，而不是过度依赖搜索片段。论文还报告，使用经过补全的失败 rollout 构造数据，比只用成功 rollout 更有效，因为前者保留了更接近真实长轨迹的噪声和干扰。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟左右。优先看 Fig. 1：它同时给出错误归因和 DR-RL 与 DLD-RL 的训练曲线，是理解动机的核心。然后看 DR-to-Long 的数据构造细节，尤其是失败 rollout 如何用成功 rollout 的 snippets 和 summaries 补全；这部分决定方法是否只是数据拼接，还是有效构造了有答案保证的困难长上下文样本。实验部分重点看三处：成功 rollout-only 与 augmented failed rollout 的对比，LongQA-RL 前后长上下文 benchmark 的变化，以及恢复 DR-RL 后 agent benchmark 是否继续提升。若从基座训练角度阅读，可关注它对 continual pretrain、long-context mid-training、agent RL 数据再利用的启发。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a bottleneck in Deepresearch agents: after standard DR-RL, many remaining failures are still caused by weak long-context understanding, especially hallucinations over long histories and failures to integrate evidence across multiple documents.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. It argues that DR-RL provides uneven supervision: short successful trajectories produce clean positive signals, while long trajectories are more likely to contain repeated searches, noisy evidence, and confusion, and therefore contribute fewer useful successes. The proposed data loop turns agent rollouts into long-context QA training instances, making the same interaction traces useful for both agent learning and long-context reasoning. This is a more training-signal-oriented approach than merely increasing the context window.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two components. DR-to-Long converts Deepresearch rollouts into multi-document long-context QA. The original question is paired with expanded webpages from the trajectory; visited pages provide evidence, while retrieved but unused pages act as hard distractors. Successful rollouts can be converted directly because their final answers indicate that the collected context is sufficient. Failed rollouts are more challenging but may miss required evidence, so the method augments them with compact, high-value search snippets and webpage summaries from a successful rollout of the same question. This preserves the noise and distractors of failed trajectories while restoring answer sufficiency. On top of this data conversion, DLD-RL follows a three-stage loop: short DR-RL to generate traces, LongQA-RL on the converted long-context data, and then resumed DR-RL for agent performance.
summary_en.experiments: The paper analyzes 1,000 erroneous trajectories from existing DR models using a stronger model and attributes 61.6% of the errors to insufficient long-context understanding. DR-to-Long can generate 64K–128K-token training instances by controlling the number of expanded webpages, and it can scale to million-token instances without extra annotation. Experiments are run on two models initialized from Deepresearch-SFT checkpoints. Compared with continuing standard DR-RL alone, DLD-RL gives about 7.3% average relative improvement across three Deepresearch benchmarks and about 13.5% average relative improvement across three long-context benchmarks. The analysis also reports behavioral changes: after LongQA-RL, the agent uses the Visit tool more often to inspect full pages. Augmented failed-rollout data is reported to be more effective than data built only from successful rollouts.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim takes about 20 minutes. Start with Figure 1, which contains the error decomposition and the comparison between pure DR-RL and DLD-RL training curves. Then read the DR-to-Long construction carefully, especially how failed rollouts are repaired with snippets and summaries from successful rollouts of the same question. In the experiments, focus on the comparison between successful-only data and augmented failed-rollout data, the long-context benchmark gains after LongQA-RL, and whether DR performance continues to improve after resuming DR-RL. For foundation-model training, the most useful angle is the reuse of agent trajectories for long-context mid-training or continual training.

recommendation.en: What matters here is the interface—turning agent rollouts into long-context supervision—not the headline result; read the error attribution and data construction, then consider reproducing it if you work on web agents or long-context SFT.

paper.title: SynthDemo-RL: Breaking the Zero-Reward Barrier in VLA Adaptation with LLM-Guided Synthetic Demonstrations
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly relies on human teleoperation demonstrations, while reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse binary rewards faces an exploration challenge when successful trajectories are rarely sampled. We propose SynthDemo-RL, a teacher-student framework in which an automated teacher converts simulator-privileged state into successful manipulation trajectories, a VLA student is distilled from them by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and PPO with binary task

summary.core_problem: 在缺乏人类遥操作演示的情况下，如何利用稀疏二元奖励通过强化学习（RL）微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型？
summary.importance: 提出了一种结合 LLM 引导的合成演示和 PPO 的框架，解决了在稀疏奖励下 RL 探索困难的问题，为 VLA 模型的自适应提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SynthDemo-RL 框架：首先，自动化教师（利用模拟器特权状态）生成成功的操作轨迹；然后，通过监督微调（SFT）将这些轨迹蒸馏给 VLA 学生模型；最后，使用带有二元任务成功奖励的 PPO 算法对学生模型进行改进。
summary.experiments: 在 LIBERO-PRO 基准测试（无演示数据）上，对于仅在原始 LIBERO 任务上微调的 pi_0.5 策略，57 个任务中有 27 个成功率为 0%。使用 SynthDemo-RL 后，在相同的 PPO 配方和计算资源下，成功率得到提升（具体提升幅度摘要未详述，但强调了突破零奖励障碍）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to fine-tune Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models using reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse binary rewards in the absence of human teleoperation demonstrations?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a framework combining LLM-guided synthetic demonstrations and PPO to address the exploration challenge in RL with sparse rewards, offering a new approach for VLA model adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the SynthDemo-RL framework: First, an automated teacher (using simulator-privileged states) generates successful manipulation trajectories; then, these trajectories are distilled into a VLA student model via supervised fine-tuning (SFT); finally, the student is refined using PPO with binary task-success rewards.
summary_en.experiments: On the LIBERO-PRO benchmark (no demonstrations), a pi_0.5 policy fine-tuned only on original LIBERO tasks had 0% success on 27 out of 57 tasks. SynthDemo-RL improved success rates under the same PPO recipe and compute (specific improvements not detailed in abstract, but emphasizes breaking the zero-reward barrier).

recommendation.zh: 利用合成数据做 SFT bootstrapping 然后接 PPO 的标准套路在 VLA 上的应用，作为 robotics RL 的 literature 备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Standard SFT bootstrapping with synthetic data followed by PPO applied to VLA; keep as literature reference for robotics RL, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: CodeMidas: Scaling Agentic Coding RL Environments from Code Itself
paper.abstract: Training capable coding agents via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse tasks with reliable verifiers. Open-source codebases offer a rich source of such tasks, while existing methods typically rely on development artifacts such as issues and commits, limiting the range of tasks that can be extracted. To better scale RL environments, we present CodeMidas, an agentic pipeline that turns implemented functionality in existing codebases into executable RL environments using source code as its

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：如何不依赖 issue、commit、现成测试或文档，而是直接从开源代码里抽取“已实现功能”，把它改造成可用于 coding agent 强化学习的可执行环境。难点不在于生成一个题目描述，而在于同时满足三件事：任务要覆盖真实软件工作、奖励要足够可靠、环境要能规模化构造。已有做法大多绑在开发痕迹上，任务分布受仓库记录质量限制，也容易偏向修 bug 或补测试这类窄分布。CodeMidas 试图把“代码本身”变成任务来源，用原始实现的可观察行为来反推规范、构造 verifier，并把目标实现从代码库里挖掉，形成一个真实但可验证的 RL 训练环境。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的意义主要有两层。第一，它提供了一条可扩展的 post-train 数据生产路线：不是人工写题，也不是从 issue tracker 捡现成样本，而是把大规模代码语料转成带执行奖励的环境。这对 coding RL 的数据供给很关键，因为 RL 的瓶颈往往不是算法，而是高质量、低泄漏、可验证任务的供给。第二，它给出了一个很实用的判断：任务质量比任务数量更重要，但高质量任务在扩大到几千规模后仍然继续带来收益。文中 3k 清洗任务优于 8k 未清洗任务，这对合成训练数据、程序化环境构造、甚至更一般的 agent RL 数据管线都有直接启发。若把 coding agent 看成面向软件语料的持续后训练，这篇工作的价值在于把“静态代码数据”转成“交互式训练信号”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一条多阶段 agentic environment construction pipeline。输入只有源代码仓库本身，不使用任务特定的 issue、PR、文档或人工规格。第一步是功能发现与任务设计。系统让 agent 检查代码结构、构建配置和公共入口，优先选择需要跨文件理解、具有公开接口且行为可观察的功能单元，支持 CLI、纯函数库接口和有状态 API。这里的关键不是简单抽函数，而是挑选“能写成行为规范、又不把实现细节锁死”的目标功能。

第二步是代码库改造。CodeMidas 会把目标功能从原仓库中移除或留空，保留其余项目结构、依赖和上下文，形成 solver 可操作的开发起点。这样做比从零给一个编程题更接近真实软件工作：模型需要在原项目约束下补全缺失实现，而不是在孤立函数上做 HumanEval 式补题。

第三步是基于执行的测试构造。系统运行原始代码，通过执行轨迹、返回值、状态变化、文件输出、CLI 输出等可观察行为来生成测试期望。这里的设计重点是“behavioral specification”而不是“implementation matching”：测试要约束外部行为，但允许不同内部实现。文中明确强调要避免把原实现细节直接编码进 verifier，否则会把任务退化成补全原代码。为此，测试构造结合执行证据、边界情况扩展和一致性检查，尽量让 verifier 接受替代性正确实现。

第四步是环境一致性检查。构造后的环境需要保证：原始正确实现能通过 verifier；移除目标实现后的起始环境不能 trivially 通过；容器化依赖、构建脚本和测试注入流程都稳定。这一步更像数据工程里的 validity gate，避免把噪声环境送进 RL。

第五步是 rollout-based filtering，也是这篇工作最有信息量的部分。作者不是只看静态构造结果，而是先让 agent 在候选环境上 rollout，再用这些 rollout 反过来筛任务。过滤信号包括：对抗性 rollout 检查是否存在泄漏或 reward hacking 路径；solution review 判断 verifier 的通过/失败是否真的符合题意；以及 success rate 统计，用来剔除过难、过易或奖励不稳定的任务。也就是说，任务质量不是由生成器单方面决定，而是由“环境 × agent 行为”共同定义。这比只做静态 test generation 更接近真实 RL 需求。

最终得到的数据集包含 5,545 个可验证任务，来自 3,185 个开源代码库，覆盖 23 种编程语言和 15 个技术领域。训练时使用 GRPO 在 MiMo-V2.5 上做 RL。论文还分析了训练后 agent 行为变化，发现模型会更多探索代码库，并更频繁地执行自写检查，这说明学到的不只是 benchmark-specific patching，而是更一般的工作流策略。
summary.experiments:
数据规模上，最终保留 5,545 个任务，来源于 3,185 个代码库，覆盖 23 种语言、15 个技术域。训练对象是 MiMo-V2.5，优化方法用 GRPO。外部评测上，五个 benchmark 全部提升。文中给出的代表性数字包括：DeepSWE pass rate 从 10.0% 提升到 21.7%；ProgramBench 的 Almost Solved 分数从 4.5 提升到 21.5；Terminal-Bench v2.1 从 63.7% 提升到 72.2%。这些任务类型横跨 issue repair、整程序构建、代码翻译和 terminal 操作，说明训练信号有一定迁移性。

更关键的是规模与质量实验。作者比较了高质量任务从 1k、3k 到 5,545 的扩展，SWE-bench Pro、DeepSWE 和 CodeMidas Val 上都呈现单调收益。与此同时，一个 3k 的清洗子集在这三个指标上都优于一个 8k 的未清洗基线，说明环境清洗、过滤和 verifier 可靠性比粗放扩容更重要。这一点对 RL 数据建设比单纯 benchmark 提升更有参考价值。

行为分析部分也值得看。随着 RL 进行，agent 更倾向于主动浏览代码库、执行更多样的自验证步骤，而且“agent-written checks”与更高成功率相关。作者还观察到这种行为变化也出现在外部任务上，作为泛化的辅助证据。虽然这类行为指标不如 pass rate 硬，但它解释了性能提升来自什么策略变化，而不是只给结果曲线。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但方法和数据构造部分值得认真看。优先看 Introduction 里对现有 issue/commit/test 驱动环境构造的局限分析，能帮助判断这项工作的边界。然后重点看 Method 的四段：任务设计与代码库改造、execution-grounded test construction、execution consistency check、post-rollout filtering。真正的创新不只是“从代码生成题目”，而是把执行证据和 rollout 过滤接到一起，形成一个面向 RL 的环境生产线。

实验部分建议重点看三类图表：一是外部 benchmark 提升，确认迁移是否真实；二是 1k/3k/5.5k 与 8k 未清洗基线的对比，这里最能体现作者对数据质量的处理；三是 agent 行为分析，尤其是代码探索和自验证行为的变化。如果时间有限，先看 Figure 1、数据集统计表、scale/quality ablation 和行为分析图，30 到 45 分钟可以抓住主线。

深挖时可以带着几个问题读：测试到底约束了多少“行为”而不是“原实现”；post-rollout filtering 是否会把任务分布偏向当前 agent 擅长的区域；以及这种从已实现功能反推任务的方式，能否迁移到多模态 agent 或更一般的软件环境构造。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical bottleneck in coding RL: how to build large numbers of executable training environments directly from source code, without relying on issues, commits, documentation, or pre-existing tests. The hard part is not merely generating prompts. It is producing tasks that are realistic, verifiable, and scalable at the same time. Prior pipelines are tied to development artifacts, so their task distribution is constrained by repository history and often skewed toward bug-fix style supervision. CodeMidas instead treats implemented functionality itself as the raw material, then turns that functionality into a task statement, a modified codebase, and a hidden verifier.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is at the data-to-RL interface. It offers a scalable way to convert static code corpora into interactive RL environments with executable rewards. That matters because coding RL is often bottlenecked less by the optimizer than by the supply of diverse, trustworthy tasks. The paper also makes a useful empirical point: task quality dominates raw count, but scaling high-quality tasks from 1k to 3k to 5.5k still yields steady gains. The result that a cleaned 3k subset beats an uncleaned 8k baseline is especially relevant for anyone building synthetic post-training data or programmatic RL environments.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CodeMidas is an agentic pipeline for environment construction. The only task-specific input is a source repository. It does not consume issues, PRs, or human-written specs. First, the system identifies candidate functionality by inspecting repository structure, build metadata, and public entry points. It prioritizes functionality with observable behavior and nontrivial codebase context, including CLI tools, pure library functions, and stateful APIs. The selection criterion is important: the target should admit a behavioral specification while leaving implementation freedom open.

Second, the repository is adapted into a development starting point. The target implementation is removed or blanked out, while the rest of the project structure, dependencies, and surrounding context are preserved. This makes the task closer to real software work than isolated function completion.

Third, CodeMidas constructs tests grounded in execution of the original code. It runs the original implementation and uses observable outputs, return values, state transitions, file effects, and CLI behavior to infer expected behavior. The design goal is behavioral verification rather than implementation matching. The verifier should reject wrong solutions but still accept alternative correct implementations, so the pipeline tries to avoid overfitting tests to the original code path.

Fourth, the environment is checked for execution consistency. The original implementation must pass; the stripped starting point must not pass trivially; the containerized dependencies and grading flow must be stable. This is a data validity gate more than a modeling contribution, but it is essential for RL.

Fifth, and most interestingly, the paper adds rollout-based filtering. Candidate environments are probed with agent rollouts before RL training. The pipeline uses adversarial rollouts to detect leakage and exploitability, solution reviews to assess whether verifier outcomes align with the stated requirements, and rollout success rates to remove tasks that are too noisy, too easy, too hard, or reward-misaligned. This is a strong design choice: task quality is defined not only statically, but through interaction with actual agent behavior.

The final dataset contains 5,545 verifiable tasks from 3,185 open-source repositories, spanning 23 programming languages and 15 technical domains. RL is then run with GRPO on MiMo-V2.5. The paper also studies behavioral changes during training, showing increased repository exploration and more self-written checks by the agent.
summary_en.experiments:
The constructed dataset has 5,545 tasks from 3,185 repositories, covering 23 languages and 15 domains. MiMo-V2.5 is trained with GRPO on these environments. The trained policy improves on all five external benchmarks. Reported headline numbers include DeepSWE pass rate rising from 10.0% to 21.7%, ProgramBench Almost Solved increasing from 4.5 to 21.5, and Terminal-Bench v2.1 pass rate improving from 63.7% to 72.2%. The gains span issue repair, whole-program construction, code translation, and terminal interaction, which suggests transfer beyond the exact training distribution.

The scale-versus-quality study is more informative than the benchmark table alone. Increasing the number of high-quality tasks from 1k to 3k to 5,545 yields progressively better results on SWE-bench Pro, DeepSWE, and CodeMidas Val. At the same time, a cleaned 3k subset outperforms an 8k baseline built without cleaning and filtering on all three metrics. That is a strong signal that verifier reliability and environment curation matter more than naive expansion.

The behavioral analysis is also useful. As RL progresses, agents explore repositories more and perform more varied self-verification. Agent-written checks correlate with higher success rates, and similar behavior shifts appear on external tasks. These are softer signals than pass rate, but they help explain what the policy is learning.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim-level read, focus on the motivation and the construction pipeline. The introduction is worth reading because it clearly explains why issue/commit/test-driven environment generation is limiting. In the method section, pay attention to four pieces: task design and repository adaptation, execution-grounded test construction, execution consistency checks, and post-rollout filtering. The real contribution is not just “generate tasks from code,” but “close the loop with execution evidence and rollout-based quality control.”

In the experiments, prioritize three things: external benchmark transfer, the 1k/3k/5.5k scaling study against the uncleaned 8k baseline, and the behavioral analysis of repository exploration and self-checking. If time is limited, Figure 1, the dataset statistics, the scale/quality ablations, and the behavior plots should be enough to capture the main ideas in about 30–45 minutes.

Questions worth keeping in mind while reading: how much of the verifier is truly behavioral rather than implementation-specific; whether rollout-based filtering biases the task distribution toward the current agent’s competence; and whether this pipeline could generalize to broader agent environments beyond coding.

paper.title: Reflective Recovery: A Self-Supervised Method for Reasoning by Learning from Mistakes
paper.abstract: Data-driven fine-tuning is widely adopted to enhance reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its simplicity and efficiency. However, mainstream imitation learning methods that rely exclusively on perfect reasoning trajectories suffer from a Scaling Collapse: when the problem set is limited, increasing positive examples fails to yield continuous improvement. However, during inference, an LLM can not guarantee that every intermediate step is correct and is therefore prone to errors. Once

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是推理微调中的错误状态覆盖问题。常见的 RFT 只学习正确轨迹，问题集固定时继续采样更多正例会很快遇到收益衰减，甚至退化。模型在推理中一旦走到错误中间状态，训练分布里没有对应的恢复样本，因此很难自己修正。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练目标本身，而在 post-train 训练信号设计。论文把失败轨迹从被丢弃的副产品变成训练资源，提示一个更稳的方向：推理能力不只来自模仿正确答案，还来自覆盖错误前缀和恢复路径。这对 RFT 数据扩展、self-correction 数据构造、RL 前的数据冷启动都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Reflective Recovery，采用自监督的 sample-resample 流程。先让模型对同一批题目采样多条推理轨迹，按最终答案把失败轨迹分出来。然后从失败轨迹中截取错误前缀，把这个前缀和一条能走向正确答案的 continuation 配对，构造恢复训练样本。训练时模型看到的不是从空白状态生成完美解法，而是从一个已经偏离的推理上下文中重新找回正确路径。它不引入外部 critic、reward model 或 RL 更新，因此工程成本接近普通 SFT/RFT。和 RFT 的关键差别是数据分布：RFT 只强化正轨迹，Reflective Recovery 有意把模型自己的错误状态纳入训练。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了 RFT 的 scaling collapse：在 AIME 2025 上，RFT 训练数据从 8k 增到 10k 时，性能从 35.3% 降到 30.0%。Reflective Recovery 在 AIME、Minerva 等推理 benchmark 上优于 outcome-based RFT，并且在数据规模增加时表现更稳定。文中还做了归因分析，观察到模型在生成过程中出现更明确的检查、发现错误、修正路径的行为。给出的实验重点不是单点分数，而是正例扩展失效与错误恢复数据带来的 scaling 行为差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。建议先看 Figure 2，确认 scaling collapse 的定义和实证形态；再看 Methodology 中 sample-resample 数据构造，重点判断错误前缀如何截取、正确 continuation 如何获得、是否会引入答案泄漏或模板化恢复；最后看 Section 4.5 的 attribution analysis，判断所谓 reflective 行为是训练分布诱导出的表面模式，还是确实提高了中间错误恢复率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a coverage gap in reasoning fine-tuning. Standard RFT learns only from successful trajectories. When the prompt set is fixed, adding more sampled positives quickly gives diminishing returns and can even hurt performance. Once the model enters an erroneous intermediate state at inference time, the training distribution offers little guidance for recovery.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model training lies in the design of post-training signals. Failed trajectories are treated as useful supervision rather than discarded samples. This is relevant to RFT scaling, self-correction data construction, and cold-start data before RL, because robust reasoning needs exposure to both correct paths and recoverable error states.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reflective Recovery uses a self-supervised sample-resample pipeline. The model first samples multiple reasoning trajectories for each problem. Failed trajectories are identified by the final answer. The method then extracts erroneous prefixes from these failures and pairs each prefix with a correct continuation that reaches the right solution. Training therefore asks the model to recover from a biased context, instead of only imitating a clean solution from the beginning. No external critic, reward model, or RL loop is required. The main difference from RFT is the training distribution: RFT reinforces successful trajectories, while this method deliberately includes the model's own error states.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports a scaling-collapse case for RFT on AIME 2025: when the RFT dataset grows from 8k to 10k examples, accuracy drops from 35.3% to 30.0%. Reflective Recovery outperforms outcome-based RFT on reasoning benchmarks including AIME and Minerva, and shows more stable behavior as data size increases. The attribution analysis suggests that the trained model more often performs in-context checking, error detection, and path correction. The main evidence is the change in scaling behavior, not only a single benchmark score.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, around 20 to 30 minutes. Start with Figure 2 to understand the claimed scaling collapse. Then read the sample-resample construction in the methodology, especially how error prefixes are selected, how correct continuations are obtained, and whether the construction risks answer leakage or recovery templates. Section 4.5 is worth checking to see whether the reflective pattern corresponds to real mid-trajectory recovery.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation 即可；把失败轨迹当 recovery 数据是 clean idea，值得放进内部推理 SFT 对照。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; treating failed traces as recovery data is a clean idea worth adding to internal reasoning-SFT comparisons.

paper.title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
paper.abstract: Scientific code repositories encode decades of human knowledge in executable models, methods, and tools. Yet fragmented toolchains, implicit domain conventions, and specialized correctness criteria make this knowledge difficult to convert into reliable learning experience-a challenge we call the scientific experience bottleneck. We introduce ScienceIDE, infrastructure for turning the world's scientific code into programmable environments for scientific agents. Guided by expert-defined scientific

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：大量科学代码库包含可执行的知识和外部可验证信号，但由于依赖复杂、数值容差隐含、任务目标不标准，很难直接转化为 agent 可学习的 SFT、RL 和评测环境。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的价值主要在 post-train 数据和可验证环境构建。它不是一个新的基础模型训练目标，但它尝试把科学软件变成可复用的交互经验来源。对 RL pretrain / continual post-training 有启发：高质量经验不只是文本数据，而是带有运行时、检查器、容差策略和失败轨迹的环境。尤其是科学计算场景，奖励不能简单写成单元测试是否通过；物理量、数值误差、参考实现和约定差异都需要被显式建模。
summary.technical_approach: ScienceIDE 的核心是把一个科学代码仓库拆成带科学职责的 module，再把 module 包装成可执行 environment。专家定义科学边界、验收标准和数值等价关系，agent 辅助检查依赖、构建源码、运行测试和例子、提出模块划分、实现环境适配器。每个 environment 绑定私有 verifier、固定输入、graded outputs 和 pass policy。pass policy 支持逐点比较，例如 |c-r| ≤ a + ρ|r|，以同时处理绝对误差和相对误差。任务生成由 factory 完成，同一个 environment 可以生成修复、实现、复现、加速等任务；agent 的交互轨迹可以用于 SFT，verifier 输出可以用于在线 RL 奖励，也可以保留任务或环境做评测。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的 registry 已包含 2,515 个 repair 任务、295 个 implementation 任务和 2 个 acceleration 任务。作者报告 hard subset 上 task-balanced budget exhaustion 为 37.3%，说明当前 agent 在长程科学代码任务中经常耗尽预算。Fable/Astra 的 trace review 显示，reference-convention mismatches 是主要失败来源之一。这一点很有信息量：很多失败不是单纯代码能力不足，而是科学约定、参考输出和数值等价关系没有被模型正确恢复。实验重点不是单一模型分数，而是验证这套基础设施能把仓库、任务、检查器和轨迹组织成可学习的闭环。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 ScienceIDE 架构图和对象定义：module、environment、factory、check、episode 分别承担什么职责。然后看 pass policy 和 verifier 设计，这部分决定奖励是否可信。实验部分建议关注任务规模、hard subset 的 budget exhaustion，以及 Fable/Astra 失败案例。对做 RL 数据的人，最值得深挖的是环境构建中的专家成本如何摊销，以及 verifier 是否能避免模型学到只适配检查器的短路策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the scientific experience bottleneck: scientific repositories contain executable knowledge and externally checkable signals, but their fragmented dependencies, implicit numerical conventions, and domain-specific acceptance criteria make them hard to turn into learnable agent environments.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model work is in post-training data and verifiable environment construction. This is not a new pretraining objective. Its contribution is an infrastructure pattern for converting scientific software into reusable interaction experience for SFT, online RL, and evaluation. The useful lesson is that high-quality experience is not just text or tasks; it includes runtimes, private verifiers, calibrated tolerances, provenance, and failure trajectories. Scientific computing is a good stress test because reward design cannot be reduced to ordinary unit-test passing.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScienceIDE decomposes a versioned scientific codebase into modules defined by scientific responsibility and executable coverage. Each approved module is packaged as an environment with runtime dependencies, checks, editable workspaces, and a private verifier. Domain experts define the scientific boundaries and acceptance criteria, while agents help inspect repositories, build code, run official tests and examples, propose module boundaries, and implement environment adapters. A check consists of fixed inputs, graded outputs, and a pass policy. One pass policy compares values using |c-r| ≤ a + ρ|r|, combining absolute and relative tolerances. Task factories reuse an environment to generate repair, implementation, reproduction, and acceleration tasks. Episodes then produce artifacts, trajectories, and measured outcomes that can feed SFT, RL rewards, or held-out evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The current registry contains 2,515 repair tasks, 295 implementation tasks, and 2 acceleration tasks. On the hard subset, task-balanced budget exhaustion is reported as 37.3%, indicating that agents often fail by running out of interaction budget on long-horizon scientific coding tasks. In the Fable/Astra trace review, reference-convention mismatches account for a large share of failures. This is a useful diagnostic: failures often arise from missed scientific conventions and numerical equivalence contracts, not only from generic coding weakness. The experimental contribution is mainly to demonstrate a scalable environment and task production pipeline rather than to optimize one model score.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is appropriate. Focus on the definitions of module, environment, factory, check, and episode, since these are the reusable abstractions. Then read the verifier and pass-policy design, because reward reliability depends on those details. In the results, look at the task counts, the hard-subset budget exhaustion rate, and the Fable/Astra failure analysis. For RL data work, the key issue to inspect is whether expert effort is amortized across many task families and whether the verifier design reduces shortcut learning against the checks.

recommendation.en: Extends the SWE-bench paradigm to scientific computing codebases, building verifiable environments for data synthesis and RL. Highly valuable for those working on domain-specific agents and post-train data synthesis.
