paper.title: Salesforce Koa: An Enterprise Language Model for Agentic Tool Use
paper.abstract: We present Salesforce Koa, an enterprise language model built by post-training the open-weight Nemotron-3-Super-120B foundation model with reinforcement learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Salesforce Koa is trained on public and synthetically generated data, with no customer data, to improve tool use and agentic capabilities while preserving strong general-purpose performance. Its distinctive component is a simulation-to-reward pipeline that expands workflow specifications

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是企业场景里一个很实际的问题：开源基座模型能不能在不使用客户私有数据的前提下，被后训练成稳定的 tool-using agent，而且在强化 agentic tool use 之后不明显伤到通用能力。难点不在单轮 function calling，而在多轮、带状态、带业务约束的工作流执行。企业任务往往依赖组织特定 schema、API、权限和流程，公开 benchmark 上的工具调用数据并不能直接覆盖这类分布。作者要解决的核心矛盾，是如何把“企业 agent 的声明式工作流定义”转成可执行、可打分、可用于 RL 的训练环境，让模型学到任务完成而不是只学会模仿调用格式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是新的 pretrain 范式，而是一个较完整的 post-train 到 agent specialization 的工程闭环。价值主要有三点。第一，它展示了 open-weight 大模型在企业 agent 方向上，能通过 RL 而不是依赖大量真实交互数据完成较强定制，这对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口很有参考意义。第二，它把 agent specification 直接接到 reward construction 上，这种“从程序化工作流到训练信号”的做法，对后续合成数据、mid-training、tool-use curriculum 都有启发。第三，文中一个重要观察是：从已经做过 RL post-training 的强 base 出发，继续做 RL 对多轮工具使用提升明显，而额外 SFT 收益很小。这不是普适结论，但对如何分配后训练预算有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法主线很清楚：以 Nemotron-3-Super-120B 为底座，直接做 GRPO 强化学习，不先走一个新的 SFT checkpoint。关键创新不在 RL 算法本身，而在 specification-driven task construction。

具体看，企业域使用 Agent Script 来描述 agent：里面包含 router、subagent、typed actions、tool scope 和自然语言工作流指令。作者先做一个静态抽取，把这些声明式定义编译成 typed workflow graph。这个图里有工具参数 schema、状态读写、副作用、路由条件、循环与终止配置。也就是说，训练环境不是从对话日志反推出来，而是从 agent 的程序化定义直接生成。

然后，simulation pipeline 会把一个 specification 扩展成 scenario-conditioned 和 persona-conditioned 的多轮 session。scenario 决定用户需求和会触发哪些 workflow，persona 决定模拟用户在对话中的行为方式。训练样本既可以从对话开头开始，也可以从中间某个 prefix 开始，让策略在不同深度的状态上学习决策，而不是只学第一步。

执行层由 NeMo Gym 承担。对于没有真实后端的环境，作者用一个冻结 helper model 同时扮演三种角色：customer simulator、tool/function emulator、coverage judge。也就是用户回复、工具返回、任务是否完成的评分，都由外部服务提供。策略模型只负责在环境中 rollout。奖励核心是 grounded task-resolution reward，重点看任务是否真正通过工具调用被解决，而不是只看表面格式或局部步骤。这个设计比 token-level imitation 更接近最终 agent 目标。

优化上使用 GRPO。文中强调 joint training 多环境时，通过 agent_ref 做环境分发，并通过重复样本控制不同环境曝光率。这说明作者把多环境混训当成一个重要工程问题来处理，而不是只做单 benchmark 微调。整体上，这套方法更像“把 agent authoring system 变成 RL data engine”。
summary.experiments:
实验结论集中在三类评测：公开 tool-use、agentic reasoning，以及企业 CRM 相关 benchmark。总体结果是，Koa 相比其 open-weight base 有稳定提升，最明显的增益出现在 multi-turn tool use；同时在若干设置下超过 GPT-4.1 这一强专有基线，但仍低于最强 frontier 模型。全文给出的主信息不是单点刷分，而是能力轮廓：RL 带来的收益主要集中在需要状态跟踪、工具选择、参数填写和任务闭环的场景。

从文中描述看，作者还做了一个范围受限的 SFT vs RL 对比。起点不是纯 base，而是“已经 RL-post-trained 的 base”。在这个前提下，继续做 RL 能显著提升多轮工具使用，而 SFT 几乎没有额外收益。这个结果很重要，但需要按作者自己的限定来读：它更像说明在高质量可执行 reward 存在时，RL 对 agentic behavior 的塑形强于 imitation；并不意味着一般情况下 SFT 不重要。

另一个值得注意的实验设计点，是训练数据完全来自公开资源和合成交互，没有客户数据。若结果仍能覆盖企业 CRM benchmark，说明 specification + simulator 这条路至少在一部分 enterprise workflow 上是可行的。文段里没有完整展开所有数字、训练步数和 token 规模，但从方法和结果组织看，重点应放在不同 benchmark 分项、multi-turn 子集、以及 appendix 中 SFT/RL ablation 和分布式训练细节。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，先看 Introduction、Methodology 里关于 Agent Script→typed workflow graph→simulation→reward 的链路，再看主实验表里 multi-turn tool use 和 enterprise CRM 的分项结果。这样能抓住文章真正的新意。

如果要精读，建议重点看三处。第一，环境构建部分，弄清楚 workflow graph 里哪些信息是静态编译得到的，哪些是在 rollout 中动态决定的。这里决定了 reward 是否足够 grounded。第二，helper model 的三重角色设计。要留意 customer simulator、tool emulator、coverage judge 是否会引入同源偏差，尤其 judge 和 rollout 环境若共享建模假设，可能高估真实泛化。第三，Appendix J 的 SFT vs RL 对比。这里最值得深挖的是起始 checkpoint、数据配比、reward 稀疏度，以及为什么 RL 能继续拉开 multi-turn gap。

带着问题去读会更有效：这种 spec-driven RL 能否迁移到更开放的 tool ecosystem；reward 是否过度依赖模拟器；如果把这套机制前移到 continual pretraining 或 mid-training，会不会比纯 post-training 更稳。
summary.authors_note: Salesforce Research 团队工作，围绕 Agentforce/Agent Script 生态展开。文中明确依托 Salesforce 的企业 agent 平台与声明式 agent 配置语言，说明作者背景偏企业级 agent 平台、tool-use 与 post-training 工程。具体作者名单在给定内容中未完整展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a practical question for enterprise LLM deployment: can an open-weight foundation model be specialized into a reliable tool-using agent for enterprise workflows, without customer data, and without giving up too much general capability? The hard part is not single-turn function calling. It is multi-turn, stateful workflow execution over organization-specific schemas, APIs, and policies. Public tool-use datasets do not naturally cover that distribution. The central problem is therefore how to turn declarative agent specifications into executable RL environments with grounded rewards, so the model learns task completion rather than merely imitating tool-call syntax.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. Its value comes from three places. First, it shows a credible path for specializing open-weight models into enterprise agents through RL, even without real customer interaction logs. Second, it connects agent specifications directly to reward construction, which is useful for thinking about synthetic data generation, tool-use curricula, and structured post-training signals. Third, the paper reports an important empirical observation: starting from an already strong RL-post-trained base, additional RL materially improves multi-turn tool use, while extra SFT adds little. That is not a universal claim, but it is informative for allocating post-training budget.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The overall recipe is straightforward: start from Nemotron-3-Super-120B and apply GRPO directly, rather than first building a new SFT checkpoint. The main contribution is not a new RL algorithm. It is specification-driven task construction.

In the enterprise setting, the workflow is authored in Agent Script, which defines routers, subagents, typed actions, tool scopes, and natural-language instructions. A static extraction pass compiles this declarative specification into a typed workflow graph. The graph encodes tool argument schemas, state effects, routing conditions, and loop or termination logic. In other words, the training environment is generated from the agent program itself, not reverse-engineered from logs.

A simulation pipeline then expands each specification into scenario-conditioned and persona-conditioned multi-turn sessions. The scenario determines the user need and which workflows are exercised. The persona controls the simulated customer behavior. Training examples can start from the initial user request or from an intermediate dialogue prefix, so the policy learns decisions at different depths of the interaction rather than only the first move.

Execution is handled by NeMo Gym. In environments without production backends, a frozen helper model plays three roles during rollout: customer simulator, tool or function emulator, and coverage judge. The policy model only acts in the environment. The reward is a grounded task-resolution reward, centered on whether the task is actually solved through successful tool use, not whether the response merely looks plausible. That makes the signal much closer to the real agent objective than token-level imitation.

Optimization uses GRPO. The paper also notes practical details for joint training across multiple environments: agent_ref dispatch selects the environment per example, and exposure is controlled by repeating examples before shuffling. This is a useful systems detail. The broader picture is that the agent authoring system becomes a data and reward engine for RL.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans public tool-use benchmarks, agentic reasoning benchmarks, and enterprise CRM-style benchmarks. The main result is consistent: Koa improves over its open-weight base, with the clearest gains on multi-turn tool use. In some settings it surpasses GPT-4.1 as a strong proprietary baseline, while still trailing the strongest frontier models. The paper is more informative about capability shape than about a single headline score. The gains are concentrated in settings that require state tracking, tool selection, argument filling, and end-to-end task closure.

A notable ablation is the scoped SFT-versus-RL comparison. The starting point is not a raw base model, but an already RL-post-trained base. Under that condition, further RL substantially improves multi-turn tool use, whereas SFT contributes little. The right reading is narrow: when high-quality executable rewards are available, RL can shape agentic behavior more effectively than imitation on this starting point. It should not be generalized into a blanket statement against SFT.

Another important experimental fact is that training uses only public and synthetic data, with no customer data. If the model still transfers to enterprise CRM benchmarks, that supports the viability of the specification-plus-simulator route for at least a meaningful subset of enterprise workflows. The provided content does not include the full table of numbers, training steps, or token counts, so the most useful places to inspect are the benchmark breakdowns, the multi-turn subsets, and the appendices covering SFT/RL ablations and distributed training details.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a fast read, focus on the Introduction and the Methodology sections that describe the chain from Agent Script to typed workflow graph to simulation to reward. Then inspect the main tables for multi-turn tool use and enterprise CRM results. That is enough to capture the real contribution.

For a closer read, there are three places worth spending time on. First, the environment construction details: which parts of the workflow graph are statically compiled and which are decided during rollout? That determines how grounded the reward really is. Second, the helper model design. Since the same external model serves as customer simulator, tool emulator, and coverage judge, it is worth checking for shared-bias issues and whether the judge may overestimate generalization. Third, Appendix J on SFT versus RL. The key questions are the starting checkpoint, data mixture, reward sparsity, and why RL continues to widen the gap on multi-turn behavior.

Useful questions to keep in mind while reading: can this specification-driven RL pipeline transfer to a more open tool ecosystem; how much does it depend on simulator fidelity; and would some of this machinery be even more effective if moved earlier into continual pretraining or mid-training rather than pure post-training?
summary_en.authors_note: Salesforce Research, closely tied to the Agentforce and Agent Script ecosystem. The work clearly comes from a team with strong enterprise agent platform and post-training engineering experience. The full author list is not available in the provided content.

paper.title: Beyond Verified Answers: Solver-Informed Self-Distillation for Bootstrapping Operations Research Language Models
paper.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language descriptions into operations research (OR) formulations. Post-training techniques including reinforcement learning and on-policy self-distillation have further improved this capability. However, three limitations remain in training LLMs for OR formulations. First, training commonly relies on synthetic formulations validated by human experts or stronger models, constraining scalable supervision. Second, credit assignment is either

summary.core_problem: 提升 LLM 将自然语言问题转写为运筹优化 formulation 的能力，同时减少人工验证、强模型评审和额外过程监督的依赖。
summary.importance: 这是领域推理后训练方法，核心价值在于用 solver artifact 作为低成本 dense supervision。对预训练研究员的间接启发是：外部可验证器产生的中间产物可能比最终答案 reward 更适合做信用分配。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 SOLID，即 Solver-Informed Self-Distillation。模型先生成 OR formulation，再用求解器在自身 rollout 上产生 artifact feedback，把这些反馈转化为自蒸馏信号。方法避免使用部署时不可用的 privileged solver context 直接作为模型输入，从而减轻训练-推理 style mismatch。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据量、具体 benchmark 名称或提升幅度。实验主张是自有 rollout 产生的 solver-artifact feedback 能在无需额外 evaluator 的情况下改进 OR formulation 能力，并提供比 outcome reward 更细的监督。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Jiao Tong University 和 Fudan University；未能从给定信息确认知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve LLMs that translate natural-language problems into operations-research formulations, while reducing dependence on human validation, stronger-model judging, or separate process supervisors.
summary_en.importance: This is a domain-specific post-training method. Its broader value is the use of solver artifacts as low-cost dense supervision, suggesting that intermediate outputs from external verifiers may provide better credit assignment than final-answer rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, SOLID, performs solver-informed self-distillation. The model generates OR formulations, solver artifacts are collected from its own rollouts, and these artifacts are converted into distillation feedback. The method avoids feeding privileged solver context at deployment time, reducing train-test style mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, benchmark names, or numerical gains. It claims that solver-artifact feedback from the model's own rollouts can improve OR formulation ability without an extra evaluator and with denser supervision than outcome rewards.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Fudan University; no widely known author background can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 领域味较重，但 solver artifact 做信用分配值得记；看方法和数据构造即可，不必追指标。
recommendation.en: Domain-heavy, but solver artifacts as credit assignment are worth noting; read the method and data construction, not the headline metrics.

paper.title: When Synthetic Data Hurts: On Catastrophic Forgetting in Skill Retrieval for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on external skills retrieved at runtime, making skill selection from large repositories a critical challenge. We present a production skill router over 34,396 skills and a large-scale study of skill retrieval using limited real supervision and synthetic data. We found that the synthetic-data fine-tuning improves in-distribution retrieval but it causes catastrophic forgetting on real and out-of-distribution (OOD) data. We evaluate several forgetting mitigation fine-tu

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在大规模技能库中做 skill retrieval 时，使用合成数据微调会提升分布内效果却损伤真实与 OOD 检索的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个较实用的负面结果加微调配方：它提醒大家，合成数据并不总是免费增益，尤其在检索器/路由器这类表征模型上会引入明显遗忘。这对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有间接启发，但不是基座级方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个面向 34,396 个技能的生产级 skill router，分析 limited real supervision + synthetic data 的微调行为，并引入 continual learning 风格的遗忘缓解方法，包括 embedding-anchor regularization、LwF、EWC 和 L2-init。
summary.experiments: 在 0.6B Qwen 检索器与 reranker 上评估真实、合成和 OOD 技能检索。结论是：纯合成数据微调虽改善 in-distribution，但会造成真实/OOD 性能下降；加入遗忘缓解后，既保住 OOD，又让合成分布内检索提升 13.98%。摘要未给出更大模型或更强检索基线。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Manulife，工作偏生产系统中的 agent skill routing。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how synthetic-data fine-tuning improves in-distribution skill retrieval for LLM agents but hurts real-data and OOD retrieval through catastrophic forgetting.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a practical negative result plus a mitigation recipe: synthetic data is not a free lunch for retrievers/routers. This has indirect relevance to the pretrain–posttrain interface, though it is not a foundation-model method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a production skill router over 34,396 skills and analyze fine-tuning under limited real supervision plus synthetic data, then apply continual-learning-style mitigations such as embedding-anchor regularization, LwF, EWC, and L2-initialization.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate a 0.6B Qwen retriever and reranker on real, synthetic, and OOD skill retrieval. Synthetic-only tuning helps in-distribution retrieval but degrades real/OOD performance; mitigation methods preserve OOD and improve synthetic in-distribution retrieval by 13.98%. No larger-scale or stronger retrieval baselines are evident from the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Manulife, and the work is positioned around production agent skill routing.

recommendation.zh: 负面结果比方法本身更值得看：合成数据把检索器表征拉偏这件事很像 continual pretrain 的坑，只看实验表和 ablation 就够了。
recommendation.en: The negative result matters more than the method: synthetic data can skew retriever representations in a way that rhymes with continual pretraining failures; the tables and ablations are enough.

paper.title: SQL-Zero: Self-Evolving Text-to-SQL
paper.abstract: Training a competitive Text-to-SQL agent usually depends on human-annotated natural-language/SQL pairs, which are expensive, domain-specific, and a bottleneck for scaling to new databases. We show it is possible to train a competitive solver with zero annotated pairs. We introduce SQL-Zero, a proposer-solver self-play in which a challenger and a solver start from the same base LLM and the only ground truth is execution against the database itself. The challenger generates SQL pairs calibrated to

summary.core_problem: 训练具有竞争力的 Text-to-SQL Agent 通常依赖于昂贵的人工标注数据（NL-SQL 对），这限制了其向新数据库的扩展。本文探讨是否能在零标注数据的情况下，仅通过执行反馈训练出强大的 Text-to-SQL 求解器。
summary.importance: 证明了在 Text-to-SQL 任务中，完全不依赖人工标注的 NL-SQL 对，仅靠自我对弈（Self-Play）和数据库执行反馈也能实现显著的性能提升。这为降低特定领域 Agent 的数据标注成本提供了一种可行的范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 SQL-Zero 框架，采用提议者-求解器（proposer-solver）的自我对弈机制。挑战者（Challenger）和求解器（Solver）均初始化自同一个基础 LLM。挑战者负责生成 SQL 优先的任务（先生成 SQL，再生成对应的自然语言问题），并通过难度奖励（针对当前求解器“困难但可解”）和模板级重复惩罚（防止多样性崩溃）进行优化。求解器则通过 GRPO 算法在挑战者生成的任务上进行训练，唯一的真实标签是针对数据库的执行结果。两者交替更新。
summary.experiments: 在 BIRD 数据库上进行无标签训练。结果显示，SQL-Zero 在 3B 和 7B 模型上分别比零样本基础模型提升了 6.6 分和 7.3 分。3B 模型在 Spider 测试集和 Spider-Syn 迁移集上每次迭代都有提升；而 7B 模型仅在第一次迭代保持了迁移能力。与使用官方评估器和统一 schema prompt 的匹配 BIRD-gold 实验相比，自我对弈的估计值超过了人工标注的对照组，但配对测试未显示出显著差异。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读第 3 节 SQL-Zero 的方法设计，特别是挑战者的难度奖励和模板级去重机制，这是保证自我对弈不崩溃的关键。第 4 节的实验结果可以快速浏览，关注 3B 和 7B 模型在迁移能力上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: Training competitive Text-to-SQL agents typically relies on expensive human-annotated NL-SQL pairs, bottlenecking scalability to new databases. This paper investigates whether a strong solver can be trained with zero annotated pairs, relying solely on execution feedback.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that significant performance gains in Text-to-SQL can be achieved entirely without human-annotated NL-SQL pairs, using only self-play and database execution feedback. This offers a viable paradigm for reducing data annotation costs for domain-specific agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces SQL-Zero, a proposer-solver self-play framework. Both the challenger and solver are initialized from the same base LLM. The challenger generates SQL-first tasks (generating SQL then the corresponding NL question), optimized via a difficulty reward (targeting 'hard but solvable' for the current solver) and a template-level repetition penalty (to prevent diversity collapse). The solver is trained on these tasks using GRPO, with database execution as the sole ground truth. The two roles are updated alternately.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on BIRD databases without labels. SQL-Zero improves upon the zero-shot base model by 6.6 points at 3B and 7.3 points at 7B. The 3B model improves on Spider test and Spider-Syn transfer sets at every iteration, while the 7B model only sustains transferability in the first iteration. Compared to a matched BIRD-gold experiment using the official evaluator and a unified schema prompt, self-play estimates exceeded the human-annotated control, though paired tests did not show a significant margin.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the design of SQL-Zero, particularly the challenger's difficulty reward and template-level deduplication, which are crucial for preventing self-play collapse. Briefly review Section 4 for experimental results, noting the difference in transferability between the 3B and 7B models.

recommendation.zh: 读 self-play 难度校准和 GRPO 细节；“无标签胜过 gold”很诱人，但先看显著性和泄漏控制。
recommendation.en: Read the self-play difficulty calibration and GRPO details; the no-label-beats-gold claim needs significance and leakage checks.

paper.title: Xiaomi-TabLDM: A Tabular Foundation Model Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce Xiaomi-TabLDM, a tabular large data foundation model for classification and regression via in-context learning, which delivers superior prediction accuracy without requiring task-specific fine-tuning. Pretrained exclusively on synthetic data generated from structural causal models (SCMs), our model enables more flexible context utilization and more efficient capacity scaling.   i) A new performance standard. Strong regression performance across benchmarks: Xiaomi-TabLDM ranks 1st on

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个无需针对每个数据集重新训练，即可通过上下文学习（In-Context Learning）在多样化表格数据上实现强泛化预测的表格基础模型？
summary.importance: 展示了表格基础模型（Tabular Foundation Models）在回归任务上的巨大潜力，并通过引入稀疏专家计算和灵活的上下文利用机制，在提升模型容量的同时控制了推理成本。这为结构化数据的通用预测提供了一个强有力的 Baseline，推动了表格数据处理从“一数据集一模型”向“预训练+上下文学习”范式的转变。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 Xiaomi-TabLDM，一个基于 Transformer 的上下文学习模型。核心创新包括：1) 列级特征嵌入：使用双流特征分组和 Set Transformer 提取列表示，增强对特征排列的鲁棒性；2) 行级特征聚合：引入轻量级 Attention Residual (AttnRes) 连接，替代传统的加性残差；3) 稀疏专家计算：在保持激活计算量有限的前提下，扩大模型总容量；4) 大规模合成数据预训练与测试时计算扩展。
summary.experiments: 在 TALENT、TabArena、BCCO 和 OpenML-CTR23 四个基准上评估。在回归任务上表现尤为突出：在 OpenML-CTR23 上排名第一，在 TabArena 上回归 Elo 排名第二。与 TabFM 相比，在 TabArena 回归任务上，训练时间减少 82%，预测时间减少 68%，同时取得了更高的 Elo 分数。在同等参数规模下，性能优于 TabPFN-3。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Overall Framework 部分，特别是列级特征嵌入（Set Transformer 的应用）和行级特征聚合（AttnRes 的设计）。实验部分可重点看其在回归任务上的表现以及与 TabPFN 系列的对比，这反映了当前表格基础模型的 SOTA 水平。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a tabular foundation model that achieves strong generalization across diverse tabular datasets via in-context learning, without requiring dataset-specific retraining?
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates the significant potential of tabular foundation models, particularly for regression tasks. By incorporating sparse expert computation and flexible context utilization, it scales model capacity while controlling inference costs. This provides a strong baseline for general-purpose structured data prediction and advances the paradigm shift from dataset-specific models to 'pretraining + in-context learning'.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Xiaomi-TabLDM, a Transformer-based in-context learning model. Key innovations include: 1) Column-wise feature embedding: uses dual-stream feature grouping and a Set Transformer to extract column representations, enhancing robustness to feature permutation; 2) Row-wise feature aggregation: introduces lightweight Attention Residual (AttnRes) connections to replace standard additive residuals; 3) Sparse expert computation: expands total model capacity while keeping activated computation limited; 4) Large-scale synthetic pretraining and test-time compute scaling.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on TALENT, TabArena, BCCO, and OpenML-CTR23. Excels in regression: ranks 1st on OpenML-CTR23 and 2nd in regression Elo on TabArena. Compared to TabFM on TabArena regression, it reduces training time by 82% and prediction time by 68% while achieving a higher Elo. Outperforms TabPFN-3 at a comparable model scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Overall Framework, specifically the column-wise feature embedding (application of Set Transformer) and row-wise feature aggregation (design of AttnRes). In the experiments, pay attention to its performance on regression tasks and the comparison with the TabPFN series, which reflects the current SOTA for tabular foundation models.

recommendation.zh: 小米提出的表格数据基础模型，完全使用合成数据预训练，展示了 ICL 在结构化数据上的潜力，关注其合成数据生成逻辑和模型架构设计。
recommendation.en: A tabular foundation model by Xiaomi, pretrained entirely on synthetic data, demonstrating the potential of ICL on structured data. Pay attention to its synthetic data generation logic and model architecture design.

paper.title: From Terminology to Diagrams: Visual-Instruction Generation for Scientific Diagram Understanding
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in visual question answering with natural images. However, they continue to struggle with scientific diagrams, which are designed to convey functional or relational meaning rather than literal scenes. We therefore introduce a framework for generating large-scale diagram-grounded instruction data by leveraging terminology derived from scientific curricula. Our approach systematically extracts domain concepts, synthesizes atomic fa

summary.core_problem: 科学图示理解缺少大规模、结构化的图文指令数据，导致 VLM 在 diagram 场景上明显掉点。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态数据构建与合成监督流程，属于 VLM 数据侧工作；对做多模态预训练的人有一点参考，但更偏垂直图示理解，不是通用基座突破。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从科学课程术语出发，抽取领域概念、合成原子事实、从网页检索相关图示，再自动生成图示 caption 与选择题监督，构建 SciGram 数据集。方法核心是 terminology-driven 的数据生成管线，而不是新模型架构。
summary.experiments: 构建了 19.4 万张 diagrams 和 140 万条 visual instructions，微调后在 TQA、ScienceQA、AI2D 等 diagram-centric benchmark 上优于仅用通用图文数据训练的模型。摘要未给出参数规模与具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Language Technology Research Laboratory 与 Expert.ai。

summary_en.core_problem: Scientific diagram understanding lacks large-scale structured instruction data, causing VLMs to underperform on diagram-centric inputs.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is multimodal data construction and synthetic supervision for VLMs. It is somewhat relevant to multimodal pretraining, but remains fairly domain-specific rather than a general foundation-model advance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper starts from curriculum terminology, extracts domain concepts, synthesizes atomic facts, retrieves relevant diagrams from the web, and generates diagram captions plus multiple-choice supervision to build the SciGram dataset. The novelty is the terminology-driven data pipeline, not a new model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: SciGram contains 194K diagrams and 1.4M visual instructions. Models fine-tuned on it improve on diagram-centric benchmarks such as TQA, ScienceQA, and AI2D over models trained only on generic image-text data. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Language Technology Research Laboratory and Expert.ai.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心多模态数据合成，可看它怎样把术语表变成图文监督；但场景偏科学图示，外推到通用 pretrain 要打折。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look if you care about multimodal data synthesis from structured terminology, but the scientific-diagram setting limits how much you should generalize to broad pretraining.

paper.title: Quantifying Error Tolerance in Synthetic Data: An Atomic-level Operand vs. Operator Perturbation Study
paper.abstract: Synthetic data generation has become a cornerstone for advancing large language models. However, the lack of the quantitative analysis for error tolerance became a critical bottleneck. Consequently, current filtering strategies fluctuate between two extremes: they are either overly aggressive, risking the exclusion of potentially valuable samples, or overly permissive, failing to eliminate erroneous samples effectively. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces Atomic Tree Operation Modeling (AT

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是合成指令数据中的“错误容忍度”如何量化。现有过滤方法通常只按表面正确性或模型打分过滤，容易走向两端：过严会丢掉仍有训练价值的样本，过松会保留破坏任务映射关系的样本。作者把问题具体化为：同样是错误，哪些错误会伤害 SFT 学到的能力，哪些错误模型可以容忍。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练数据研究的价值在于，它把“数据质量”从粗粒度标签推进到可操作的结构维度。论文给出的核心结论是：模型更依赖 operator，即样本中稳定的逻辑关系、任务模式、推理算子；对 operand，即具体实体、数值、名称等可替换内容，容忍度更高。这个结论会影响合成数据过滤、数据去重、数据改写和课程构造。它提示数据筛选不应只追求事实字段完全干净，而应优先保证关系、规则和推理路径不被破坏，同时保留足够多的 operator 覆盖。需要注意的是，实验主要在 SFT 数据上验证，直接外推到大规模预训练语料仍需要谨慎。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 ATOM，Atomic Tree Operation Modeling。作者把一条 instruction-response 拆成若干原子函数单元，形式为 A=<x,f,y>，即 f(x)→y。f 是 operator，表示抽象逻辑规则或关系谓词，例如 CapitalOf、FoundedBy、Contains；x 是 operand，表示具体输入实体或数值；y 是输出结果。基于这个表示，作者可以控制两类扰动。Operand perturbation 会替换 x，并同步更新 y，使 f 仍然成立，因此逻辑关系保持有效。Operator perturbation 保持 x 不变，但修改 y，使 f(x)→y 失效，因此破坏样本的映射规则。和传统错误分类相比，ATOM 不是按语法、风格、事实类型做表面标注，而是把错误放到“是否破坏操作规则”的层面。论文还构建了 ATOM operator tree，用来生成 Atomic-QA，并进一步提出 Atomic-X pipeline，把已有数据集转换为可控原子操作形式，得到 Atomic-Alpaca 和 Atomic-MetaMath，用于检验结论是否只依赖自建数据。
summary.experiments: 关键实验给出了明显的不对称性。使用 Atomic-QA 注入可控扰动后，operand 被随机字符串替换时，下游性能只出现约 2.0% 相对下降；operator 被破坏时，性能出现约 18.2% 相对下降。CKA 分析显示，operand 扰动训练得到的内部表示仍与原始 Atomic-QA 训练得到的表示保持较高对齐，说明模型主要抓住了操作结构，而不是具体实体表面形式。作者还用 operator-centered 原则构造 Atomic-QA 和 Atomic-LIFD 子集，强调保留 operator 覆盖和结构多样性。它们在 4 个模型 backbone、10 个 benchmark task 上稳定优于 Alpaca、LIMA、WizardLM、Magpie 等标准指令数据基线。Atomic-X 在 Alpaca 和 MetaMath 上的实验也支持同一趋势：保持 operator 有效比保留 operand 精确更关键。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法部分对 Atomic Function、operator tree 和两类 perturbation 的定义。这是论文的主干。实验部分重点看三类结果：第一，operand perturbation 与 operator perturbation 的性能曲线，特别是不同扰动比例下的退化斜率；第二，CKA 表征分析，它解释为什么 operand 错误没有显著改变模型学习到的内部结构；第三，Atomic-QA、Atomic-LIFD、Atomic-Alpaca、Atomic-MetaMath 与 Alpaca/LIMA/WizardLM/Magpie 的对比，判断结论是否只在合成 QA 上成立。值得深挖的是 operator tree 的覆盖度如何定义、原子拆解是否依赖强模型标注、以及这个框架能否扩展到开放文本预训练数据。若用于实际数据管线，优先关注 operator-preserving rewrite 和 operator-validity filter，而不是简单事实核验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to quantify error tolerance in synthetic instruction data. Existing filters tend to be either too strict, removing samples that may still teach useful behavior, or too permissive, retaining samples that corrupt the mapping the model should learn. The concrete question is not whether a sample contains an error, but which kind of error actually harms supervised fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a more structural view of data quality. The paper argues that models are much more sensitive to corrupted operators, meaning the logical relation or transformation rule in a sample, than to corrupted operands, meaning replaceable entities, names, values, or inputs. This has direct implications for synthetic-data filtering, rewriting, deduplication, and curriculum design. The practical message is to preserve valid and diverse operations first, rather than discarding samples solely because some surface operands are noisy. The evidence is strongest for SFT-style data; applying the same principle to large-scale pretraining corpora would require additional validation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework is ATOM, short for Atomic Tree Operation Modeling. Each response is decomposed into atomic functions written as A=<x,f,y>, or f(x)→y. Here f is the operator, an abstract rule or relational predicate such as CapitalOf, FoundedBy, or Contains; x is the operand, the concrete input instance; y is the result. This representation enables controlled perturbations. Operand perturbations replace x and update y accordingly, so the operator remains valid. Operator perturbations keep x fixed but alter y, breaking the mapping defined by f. The key difference from surface-level error taxonomies is that ATOM tests whether an error preserves or destroys the functional relation being learned. The authors build an ATOM operator tree to synthesize Atomic-QA, and introduce an Atomic-X pipeline to convert existing datasets into atomic-operation form, producing Atomic-Alpaca and Atomic-MetaMath for generalization tests.
summary_en.experiments: The central result is a strong asymmetry. When operands are replaced, even by random strings, downstream performance drops by only about 2.0% relative. When operators are corrupted, performance drops by about 18.2% relative. CKA analysis shows that models trained with operand-perturbed data retain internal representations aligned with those trained on the original Atomic-QA, suggesting that they learn the operation structure rather than memorizing surface operands. The authors also construct Atomic-QA and Atomic-LIFD subsets using an operator-centered principle that preserves broad operator coverage and structural diversity. Across four model backbones and ten benchmark tasks, these datasets outperform standard instruction-data baselines including Alpaca, LIMA, WizardLM, and Magpie. Additional Atomic-X experiments on Alpaca and MetaMath support the same conclusion.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the definition of Atomic Function, the operator tree construction, and the two perturbation mechanisms carefully; they are the core of the work. In the experiments, focus on three parts: the performance curves under increasing operand and operator perturbation ratios, the CKA representation analysis, and the comparisons among Atomic-QA, Atomic-LIFD, Atomic-Alpaca, Atomic-MetaMath, and common instruction-data baselines. The most useful details for a data researcher are how operator coverage is measured, how reliable the atomic decomposition is, and whether operator-preserving filters can be implemented at scale. For production data pipelines, the immediately actionable idea is to filter for operator validity and operator diversity rather than relying only on factual-field exactness.

recommendation.zh: 应在内部合成数据过滤上复现；若结论成立，过滤目标要从样本洁净度改成operator正确性。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing in internal synthetic-data filters; if true, the target should shift from sample cleanliness to operator correctness.

paper.title: One Symptom, Three Levers: A Critical Review of On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation trains a language model on its own generations while a teacher scores them token by token. It combines the dense supervision of imitation learning with the on-policy sampling of reinforcement learning. But it requires a second, larger model to act as teacher. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) removes that cost. The teacher is the model itself, conditioned on privileged information the student will not have at test time, such as a reference solution, a plan, or environment

summary.core_problem: 这不是一篇提出新算法的论文，而是一篇围绕 On-Policy Self-Distillation（OPSD）的批判性综述。它要回答的核心问题是：当 teacher 不是更强模型，而只是“拿到特权信息的自己”时，OPSD 产生的 dense token-level signal 为什么既高效又容易出问题；这些问题究竟来自哪里，又有哪些真正有效的控制杠杆。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口研究的意义在于，它把近一年很热的 self-distillation reasoning 路线拆开讲清楚了。很多工作把 OPSD 当成“比 RLVR 更便宜的 dense supervision”，但这篇综述指出，症状并不只是一个实现细节，而是由信息不对称带来的结构性偏差：teacher 看到参考解、计划或环境反馈，student 测试时却看不到，因此训练信号天然可能诱导 shortcut、熵塌缩和能力回退。对做 post-train、mid-train、RL pretrain 接口的人，这篇文章的价值在于帮你辨认哪些改法是在修补同一个病灶，哪些只是换了表述。
summary.technical_approach:
文章的组织方式比一般 survey 更像问题剖析。它先把 OPSD 放回方法谱系里：SFT 提供 dense 但 off-policy 的信号；RL/RLVR 变成 on-policy，但奖励稀疏；on-policy distillation 用外部 teacher 恢复 token-level dense signal；OPSD/SDPO 则把 teacher 换成“带 privileged information 的自己”。这条脉络讲得很清楚，也解释了 OPSD 为什么同时继承了 imitation learning、RL 和 privileged learning 的优点与缺点。

全文的主线是“一个症状，三个杠杆”。从给出的内容看，这个症状主要指 OPSD 中最突出的失败模式：dense self-distillation 信号会把模型过快拉向 teacher 条件分布，导致多样性下降、探索受限、甚至学到依赖特权信息的行为。围绕这个症状，文章把控制手段归纳为三类杠杆：
1）where to apply the signal：信号施加在什么 token、什么阶段、什么轨迹片段上；
2）what to show the teacher：teacher 拿到哪类 privileged information，参考解、hint、plan、环境反馈各自引入什么偏差；
3）when to let the guidance change：训练过程中 teacher guidance 是固定、退火、门控还是分阶段切换。

文章还专门强调 KL 方向的差异。它回顾了 forward KL 与 reverse KL 在 on-policy distillation 中的不同作用：forward KL 倾向覆盖 teacher 的多模态分布，reverse KL 更容易收缩到单一模式。MiniLLM 一类工作推动了 reverse KL 在 LLM 上的使用，但在 OPSD 场景里，这种 mode-seeking 倾向会进一步放大熵塌缩问题。这个讨论对理解为什么有些 OPSD 训练“看起来收敛很快，但泛化和探索变差”很关键。

从方法论上，这篇综述最有用的地方不是罗列论文，而是把很多后续变体放进统一因果框架：它们大多是在调节 privileged teacher 与 on-policy student 之间的信息落差，以及由此产生的偏置-方差-探索三角关系。
summary.experiments:
作为 critical review，它不提供新的统一实验，而是整理已有文献中的共识与争议。文中明确提到，早期结果显示 OPSD 在数学推理上能以远少于 RL 的生成 token 成本，取得接近 RL 的准确率；这也是该方向迅速扩张的原因。但文章强调，后续文献已经反复观察到几个主导性失败模式：

1）entropy / diversity collapse：student 被 dense teacher signal 牵引后，输出分布变窄，推理路径更单一；
2）capability regression：某些原有能力在持续自蒸馏后退化，尤其当训练目标过度偏向参考解风格时；
3）privileged-information dependence：teacher 利用参考解或环境反馈给出的 token-level 分布，可能让 student 学到测试时不可获得的信息结构，形成 train-test mismatch；
4）limited discovery：相比 RLVR，OPSD 更擅长强化已有推理模式，不擅长发现基模原本不会的全新策略。

文章的实验价值主要体现在证据整理：哪些现象在数学推理里已较稳定，哪些结论仍依赖具体实现，如 KL 形式、teacher 信息类型、是否做 annealing、是否只在错误 token 或高不确定 token 上施加蒸馏等。若你关心的是“OPSD 能不能替代 RL”，这篇文章给出的答案偏谨慎：它在信号密度和样本效率上有明显吸引力，但其偏差不是靠简单调参就能完全消除的。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按问题线索读，而不是按文献列表读。

先看开头关于 SFT → RLVR → OPD → OPSD 的谱系梳理，确认作者如何定义 OPSD 与普通 on-policy distillation、以及与 SDPO 的关系。接着重点看讨论 KL 方向、特权信息、失败模式的部分，这几段决定了全文的判断框架。之后再看“三个杠杆”各自对应的方法族，尤其留意作者区分“已经较明确的结论”和“仍有争议的点”的地方。

如果你正在做 reasoning post-train，建议重点看：哪些 token 应该蒸馏、teacher 应该看到多少额外信息、guidance 是否需要退火。这三件事直接影响训练是否会塌缩。预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟；若只做快速筛选，读引言、方法谱系图、KL 讨论和 failure modes 小节即可。

summary_en.core_problem: This is not a new algorithm paper but a critical review of On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). Its central question is: when the teacher is not a stronger external model but the same model with privileged information, why does the resulting dense token-level signal look attractive in practice yet repeatedly produce the same pathologies? The paper tries to separate what is intrinsic to the setup from what is merely an implementation choice.
summary_en.importance: The paper matters because OPSD sits exactly at the pretrain–posttrain interface that many reasoning researchers now care about. It is often presented as a cheaper dense-supervision alternative to RLVR, but this review argues that its main failure modes are structural, not incidental. The asymmetry that creates the learning signal also creates bias: the teacher sees reference solutions, plans, hints, or environment feedback that the student will not have at test time. That can induce shortcut learning, entropy collapse, and capability regression. For anyone working on RL-style post-training, self-improvement, or continual reasoning training, this review is useful because it organizes a fast-moving area around a few recurring mechanisms rather than a long list of papers.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper is organized as a diagnosis rather than a catalog. It first places OPSD in a lineage: SFT gives dense but off-policy supervision; RL and RLVR move to on-policy learning but with sparse end-of-trajectory rewards; on-policy distillation restores dense token-level supervision using an external teacher; OPSD and SDPO replace that teacher with the same model under privileged conditioning. This framing is one of the paper’s strengths because it makes clear which advantages and liabilities OPSD inherits from imitation learning, RL, and learning with privileged information.

The main analytical frame is the title’s “one symptom, three levers.” The dominant symptom is that dense self-distillation can over-concentrate the student toward the privileged teacher distribution, reducing diversity and encouraging reliance on information unavailable at inference time. The three levers are then organized as:
1) where to apply the signal — which tokens, trajectory segments, or training phases should receive distillation pressure;
2) what to show the teacher — what kind of privileged information is exposed, such as reference solutions, plans, hints, or environment feedback, and what bias each introduces;
3) when to let the guidance change — whether teacher guidance should be fixed, annealed, gated, or staged over training.

A particularly useful part of the review is its treatment of KL direction. It revisits the difference between forward KL and reverse KL in on-policy distillation: forward KL encourages mode covering, while reverse KL is more mode seeking. In LLM distillation, reverse KL became popular partly through MiniLLM-style formulations, but in OPSD that same tendency can amplify entropy collapse. This helps explain why some self-distillation runs look sample-efficient and stable early on, yet end up with poorer exploration and weaker generalization.

The paper’s real contribution is conceptual unification. Many later variants are shown to be different ways of managing the information gap between privileged teacher and on-policy student, and the resulting trade-off among bias, variance, and exploration.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it by problem structure, not by citation list. Start with the historical lineage from SFT to RLVR to on-policy distillation to OPSD/SDPO. That section gives the cleanest mental model for why OPSD exists at all. Then move to the discussion of KL direction, privileged information, and the dominant failure modes. Those sections define the paper’s analytical lens.

After that, read the three levers one by one: where the signal is applied, what the teacher is allowed to see, and when the guidance should change. Pay attention to where the authors distinguish relatively stable conclusions from still-disputed claims. If you are actively training reasoning models, the most actionable parts are the discussions of token selection, privileged-information design, and annealing schedules.

Estimated reading time is 30 to 45 minutes. For a quick pass, the introduction, the lineage overview, the KL discussion, and the failure-mode sections are enough.

recommendation.zh: 不是新方法，但它把 self-training collapse 讲得比多数论文诚实；做 RL/OPSD 的人应先读失败机制，再决定要不要继续堆 privileged signal。
recommendation.en: Not a new method, but it is more honest than most papers about self-training collapse; read the failure modes before adding more privileged signal to your RL/OPSD stack.

paper.title: Unsupervised Post-Training of Foundation Models: A Survey
paper.abstract: Foundation-model post-training usually relies on human labels, preference data, stronger teachers, or executable verifiers. We study Unsupervised Post-Training (UPT): update-bearing adaptation on unlabeled inputs whose learning signal is derived from same-lineage model artifacts rather than an external oracle. We catalog 80 strict UPT methods and organize them by the object that supplies the update signal: a prediction statistic, a sample relation, a self-generated target, or an internal evaluat

summary.core_problem: 梳理不依赖人工标签、偏好数据、强教师或外部 verifier 的无监督后训练方法，并分析这些内部信号何时有效、何时会放大错误。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述和框架整理。它对 pretrain 研究的价值在于补全 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口：模型自身统计量、样本关系、自生成目标和内部评估器能否提供稳定训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 Unsupervised Post-Training 为在无标签输入上进行参数更新，学习信号来自同源模型产物而非外部 oracle。作者整理 80 个严格符合定义的方法，并按更新信号来源分类：prediction statistic、sample relation、self-generated target、internal evaluator。另提出 Input Visibility × Update Persistence 的二维视角，用于映射部署场景和选择 UPT 方法。
summary.experiments: 这是 survey，摘要未显示统一复现实验或新模型训练结果。主要产出是方法 taxonomy、失败模式分析和评估选择框架，重点讨论内部信号与任务结构如何决定收益或递归错误放大。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey organizes unsupervised post-training methods that adapt foundation models on unlabeled inputs without human labels, preference data, stronger teachers, or external verifiers.
summary_en.importance: This is a taxonomy and framework contribution. For pretraining researchers, its value is in clarifying the interface between base models and update-bearing adaptation when the training signal comes from the model’s own artifacts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines Unsupervised Post-Training as parameter-updating adaptation on unlabeled inputs where the learning signal is derived from same-lineage model artifacts rather than an external oracle. It catalogs 80 strict UPT methods and groups them by signal source: prediction statistics, sample relations, self-generated targets, and internal evaluators. It also introduces an Input Visibility by Update Persistence view for deployment regimes and method selection.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, the abstract does not report a unified reproduction or new model-training experiment. The contribution is a taxonomy, an analysis of when internal signals help or amplify errors, and a framework for UPT selection and evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 综述可作索引；真正要看的是内部信号分类和错误递归条件，不必逐篇跟 80 个方法。
recommendation.en: Use it as an index; the useful part is the signal taxonomy and failure conditions, not the full list of 80 methods.

paper.title: ADE: Agentic Data Evolution Framework for Human-Centered Objectives
paper.abstract: Aligning large language models to human-centered objectives is difficult when targets are non-executable and context-dependent, limiting reliable verification and scalable supervision. Although synthetic data expands coverage, weak verification shifts the bottleneck from generation to selection. Noisy signals destabilize iterative refinement and can cause silent regressions. We propose Agentic Data Evolution (ADE), a data-centric framework that organizes synthetic supervision as evolving data sn

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是在弱可验证的人类中心目标上构造合成监督数据。目标包括价值取向、情感支持、创造性表达等，这类数据很难用确定性规则或标准答案筛选，因此迭代改写容易把更流畅但更差的样本错误纳入数据集。
summary.importance: 该工作更偏 post-training 数据构造，但对基座研究中的数据闭环有参考意义。它强调生成不是主要瓶颈，选择和准入才是弱监督场景的瓶颈。这个思路可迁移到 SFT、偏好数据、AI feedback 数据和持续数据更新：当 judge 信号噪声较大时，不应把每轮生成结果直接覆盖旧数据，而应采用保守的 pairwise admission，降低静默退化风险。限制也很清楚：主要场景是教育类弱可验证目标，对通用预训练数据筛选的直接适用性有限。
summary.technical_approach: ADE 将数据构造建模为连续演化的数据快照 D^(t) → D^(t+1)，而不是一次性 generate-then-filter。核心流程是 Observation–Variation–Selection。Observation 阶段由角色化 LLM agent 对样本进行路由和批注，识别主要改进维度。Variation 阶段基于批注生成候选修订，包含保守修订和探索性修订。Selection 阶段把候选答案与当前父答案进行比较，只有在比较证据支持改进时才提交更新，否则保留原样本。这个 steady-state admission 加 elitist preservation 是方法的关键：数据集逐步吸收有把握的改进，而不是让不确定修订进入后续演化轨迹。相比普通自我改写或多 agent 生成，它更重视数据快照级别的非退化更新。
summary.experiments: 作者用三类证据验证 ADE。Intrinsic validation 显示答案质量能随演化轮次持续提升。Extrinsic validation 显示，用演化后的监督数据进行 post-training 后，模型在 DEV300 上的行为更好。Human-calibrated validation 中，专家在 66.11% 的案例中偏好演化后的答案。额外实验报告了在不同 post-training 方法、不同模型规模以及目标教育任务之外的任务上也有一致增益。可见信息中没有完整列出训练集规模、模型清单和每项指标的绝对值，精读时需要检查 judge 与专家偏好的一致性，以及多轮演化是否存在模式收敛或多样性下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 分钟。优先看 Figure 1 和 Methodology，抓住 OVS 流程、steady-state update rule、elitist preservation 这三个点。实验部分重点看 intrinsic / extrinsic / human-calibrated 三类验证是否互相支持，尤其是 DEV300 和专家偏好实验。教育目标定义可以略读，除非关注弱可验证教育场景。若目标是构建通用 SFT 或偏好数据流水线，最值得借鉴的是“候选与父样本比较后再准入”的数据演化机制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses synthetic supervision construction for weakly verifiable human-centered objectives. These objectives, such as value guidance, affective support, and creativity in education, lack deterministic labels or stable automatic checks, so iterative rewriting can silently accept worse samples.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about post-training data construction, but it is relevant to data feedback loops around foundation models. Its main lesson is that, once generation is cheap, selection becomes the bottleneck. For noisy judge settings, data pipelines should avoid blindly replacing old samples with newly generated ones. Conservative pairwise admission against the current sample can reduce regression. The direct connection to pretraining is limited, but the mechanism is useful for SFT data, preference data, AI-feedback data, and continual dataset maintenance.
summary_en.technical_approach: ADE models dataset construction as evolution over data snapshots rather than one-shot generation and filtering. Its Observation–Variation–Selection protocol is run by role-specialized LLM agents. Observation routes each instance to a target dimension and produces critique evidence. Variation generates candidate revisions, including conservative and more exploratory variants. Selection compares each candidate with the current parent answer and admits a revision only when comparative evidence supports improvement. Otherwise, the parent sample is preserved. The steady-state admission rule with elitist preservation is the central design choice. It differs from standard self-refinement by controlling dataset-level update trajectories, not only improving individual outputs locally.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports intrinsic, extrinsic, and human-calibrated validation. Intrinsic evaluation shows sustained answer-level improvement across evolution rounds. Extrinsic evaluation shows that models post-trained on evolved supervision behave better on DEV300. In expert evaluation, evolved answers are preferred in 66.11% of cases. Additional experiments indicate gains across post-training methods, model scales, and tasks beyond the target educational objectives. The available text does not include all model names, dataset sizes, or absolute metric values, so the full experimental section should be checked for judge reliability, expert agreement, and possible loss of diversity across rounds.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20 minutes. Read Figure 1 and the Methodology section first, focusing on OVS, steady-state admission, and elitist preservation. Then inspect the intrinsic, extrinsic, and human-calibrated evaluations, especially DEV300 and expert preference results. The education-specific objective definitions can be skimmed unless that domain is relevant. For general SFT or preference-data pipelines, the most transferable idea is parent-versus-candidate admission under noisy supervision.

recommendation.zh: 读 OVS 和 admission 机制即可；数字要保留，但“弱验证下保守接纳”值得放进内部合成数据流水线对照。
recommendation.en: Read the OVS and admission mechanism; keep the numbers at arm’s length, but conservative admission under weak verification is worth ablation in data pipelines.

paper.title: PROOF-Gen: From Optimized Data to Better Distillation
paper.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories is the standard first stage for distilling tool-calling capabilities into deployable models. Post-training pipelines that drive shipped tool-calling agents re-run this stage on a daily or weekly cadence, paying the frontier-teacher cost each cycle, yet the mechanism is generate-and-filter (keep the teacher's passing trajectories, discard the rest) and each cycle leaves behind the same hard scenarios because failures supply no signal. On τ2

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是工具调用蒸馏中的数据生成瓶颈：teacher 失败轨迹通常被二值过滤直接丢弃，导致困难场景长期缺席于 SFT 数据。作者关注的不是学生模型训练算法，而是上游 demonstration 是否能覆盖那些 teacher 接近成功但被一个关键决策点卡住的场景。
summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接关联不强，主要属于 post-train 数据构造与 agent/tool-use 蒸馏。但它有一个有用启发：在有 executor 和 verifier 的任务中，失败样本不是噪声，失败轨迹加上验证反馈可以转化为高价值监督数据。这个思路可迁移到代码、数学、工具调用等可验证任务的数据合成流程，也能解释为什么只做 rejection sampling 会系统性漏掉困难分布。
summary.technical_approach: PROOF-Gen 在标准 generate-and-filter 后增加失败恢复步骤。teacher 先为每个任务生成轨迹，成功的直接保留；失败的轨迹交给 reflector 模型读取 execution trace 和 verifier feedback，生成一个只针对该场景的 cheatsheet，并追加到 teacher system prompt。teacher 随后从头重新执行任务。如果仍失败，reflector 根据新反馈继续修订 cheatsheet，最多迭代 K=10。成功后只保留最终轨迹，cheatsheet 会在训练前移除，因此 student 学到的是完整成功行为，而不是提示脚手架。这个设计不同于通用 prompt optimization：它不追求一个跨任务 prompt，而是为每个失败场景单独优化，用一次性 prompt 换取可训练轨迹。
summary.experiments: 论文主要在 τ2-bench 和 BFCL v4 multi-turn 上验证。文中指出，在 τ2-bench 上 GPT-4o 的 teacher trials 有 57% 失败，其中约三分之二是 near-miss；67% 的失败 GPT-4o 轨迹已经正确执行超过一半所需 tool calls。官方分项中 GPT-4o 在 telecom、airline、retail 上的 pass rate 分别约为 23.5%、45.5%、63.4%，说明 benchmark 留有大量失败恢复空间。一个关键消融是 partial-credit baseline：只强化失败轨迹中的正确局部动作，会把 tool-call accuracy 提升约 25 个百分点，但没有带来 end-to-end task completion 改善。这支持了作者的判断：问题不在于中间 tool-call 普遍不会做，而在于某个状态相关的关键决策没有被成功轨迹覆盖。论文还报告两个小型 instruction-tuned student 在 recovered data 上 fine-tune 后，在两个 benchmark 上都有提升，并提到该流程已进入生产工具调用 agent 的 post-training 系统；提供片段中没有给出完整提升数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 near-miss 失败的统计，以及 Figure 2 对失败轨迹局部正确率的分析；这部分解释了为什么 binary filtering 和 partial credit 都不够。Method 部分看 per-scenario cheatsheet、GEPA/reflector 迭代、K=10 上限，以及训练前移除 cheatsheet 的设计。实验部分优先看 RQ1 的恢复率、RQ2 中 filtered-only 与 filtered+recovered 的对比、partial-credit 消融，以及 production evaluation 是否暴露了 benchmark 外的分布问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a data-generation bottleneck in tool-use distillation. Standard SFT pipelines keep teacher trajectories that pass execution-based verification and discard all failures. This removes exactly the hard scenarios where the teacher nearly succeeds but misses one state-dependent decision, so the student never observes a complete solution for those cases.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly a post-training data construction work rather than a pretraining paper. Its useful lesson for foundation-model training is about supervision extraction: when a domain has an executor and a verifier, failed rollouts can contain recoverable training signal. Rejection sampling wastes that signal and can systematically under-cover hard parts of the task distribution. The idea is relevant to verifiable data synthesis for code, math, tool use, and other process-supervised settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: PROOF-Gen augments generate-and-filter with failure recovery. A teacher first produces one trajectory per task; passing trajectories are kept. For a failed trajectory, a reflector model reads the execution trace and verifier feedback, then writes a per-scenario cheatsheet appended to the teacher’s system prompt. The teacher re-runs the task from scratch. If it still fails, the reflector revises the cheatsheet using the new trace and feedback, up to K=10 iterations. Once the run passes all evaluators, the trajectory is kept but the cheatsheet is removed before student training. The main distinction from standard prompt optimization is the objective: the prompt is not meant to generalize across tasks. It is a disposable scaffold used to recover one high-quality demonstration.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluations are on τ2-bench and BFCL v4 multi-turn. The paper reports that 57% of GPT-4o teacher trials fail on τ2-bench, and about two thirds of those failures are near misses. Among failed GPT-4o trajectories, 67% already execute more than half of the required tool calls correctly. Reported GPT-4o pass rates on τ2-bench subdomains are about 23.5% for telecom, 45.5% for airline, and 63.4% for retail. A key ablation is the partial-credit baseline: training on locally correct tool calls improves tool-call accuracy by about 25 percentage points, but does not improve end-to-end task completion in any model–benchmark pair. This supports the claim that the missing supervision is the full successful trajectory through the decisive failure point, not more reward on already-correct intermediate actions. The paper also reports gains for two small instruction-tuned students trained on recovered data and mentions deployment-scale use in a production tool-calling post-training system; exact improvement numbers are not available in the provided text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the failure analysis in the introduction and Figure 2, especially the near-miss statistics and the partial-credit argument. Then read the method details around per-scenario cheatsheets, reflector updates, GEPA-style prompt optimization, and the removal of the scaffold before training. In the experiments, prioritize RQ1 recovery rate, RQ2 filtered-only versus filtered-plus-recovered comparisons, the partial-credit ablation, and any production evaluation details.

recommendation.zh: 关注数据合成中的 '废物利用'，通过反思机制修复 near-miss 轨迹，对构建高质量 SFT 数据集（特别是 Agent/Tool-calling 场景）有启发。
recommendation.en: Focuses on 'waste utilization' in data synthesis, repairing near-miss trajectories via reflection, offering insights for building high-quality SFT datasets, especially for Agent/Tool-calling.

paper.title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents can interact with external environments through tool invocation, but this capability also introduces security risks such as file modification, information leakage, and unauthorized actions. Existing guardrails often evaluate completed trajectories, leaving pre-execution monitoring of step-level actions underexplored. We propose StepGuard, a step-level guard model that can audit completed agent trajectories and check tool actions before they are executed. To train StepGuard, we i

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 工具调用中的安全问题，尤其是如何在动作执行前做 step-level 风险审计，而不是只在整条轨迹结束后做事后判断。
summary.importance: 属于后训练与安全对齐方向。对基座预训练研究员的价值主要在训练信号设计：同上下文下构造安全/不安全动作对，以及如何在 guard model 训练中平衡过防御与漏防御。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StepGuard，一个可用于轨迹审计和执行前检查的 step-level guard model。训练数据由 StepGen 自动生成：在相同上下文下，只替换风险步骤的动作，形成 safe/unsafe 对照。训练上再引入 Balance-GRPO，根据 safe/unsafe 两类动作当前准确率动态调节学习权重，试图同时压低 over-defense 和 under-defense。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 StepGuard 在 open-weight guard models 中平均准确率最高，性能接近 GPT-5.4，并能在 Agent 安全评测上有效保护下游 agent。未给出模型规模、数据量和具体 benchmark 名称，因此目前更像值得跟踪的工程型后训练工作，而不是可直接迁移到 pretrain 的方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses safety in tool-using LLM agents, focusing on step-level auditing before an action is executed rather than only judging a completed trajectory afterward.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and alignment paper. Its relevance to pretraining researchers mainly comes from training-signal design: constructing safe/unsafe action pairs under identical context, and balancing over-refusal against missed detections during guard-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes StepGuard, a step-level guard model for both trajectory auditing and pre-execution action checking. Training data are generated by StepGen, which creates paired safe and unsafe trajectories by changing only the risky action under the same context. Training then uses Balance-GRPO, which dynamically reweights learning on safe versus unsafe actions based on observed accuracy to reduce both over-defense and under-defense.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims the best average accuracy among open-weight guard models, with performance comparable to GPT-5.4, and improved protection for downstream agents on agent-safety evaluations. However, model size, data scale, and benchmark details are missing from the abstract, so this currently looks more like a practical post-training systems paper than something directly transferable to pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 的直接价值有限，但“同上下文只改危险动作”的对比式数据构造很干净；只看数据引擎和 Balance-GRPO 即可。
recommendation.en: Limited direct pretraining value, but the paired same-context action construction is clean; read the data engine and Balance-GRPO parts, skip the rest.

paper.title: DIAG: Diagnostic Iterative Alignment and Generation for Data-Efficient Mathematical Preference Distillation
paper.abstract: Iterative preference optimization is essential for aligning Large Language Models on mathematical reasoning tasks, yet its efficiency is often throttled by signal scarcity: as the model improves, static problem sets become increasingly mismatched to the model's evolving competence, producing rollouts that are either too easy or too hard and therefore non-informative, which leads to a scarcity of valid preference pairs. We propose DIAG, a Diagnostic Iterative Alignment and Generation framework th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是在线数学偏好蒸馏里的一个数据效率问题：随着 student 变强，固定题库越来越不匹配当前能力边界，导致 rollouts 不是太容易就是太难，最终拿不到足够多“一个对、一个错”的自然偏好对。DPO 或其他 preference optimization 在数学任务上往往受限于这种 signal scarcity，而不是单纯受限于优化器或模型容量。DIAG 试图把这个问题显式建模成 practice distribution 的控制问题：每一轮训练后先诊断当前题目分布还能产出多少有效 preference pairs，再据此调整下一轮题目主题和难度，让生成集中在 student 的决策边界附近。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有现实意义。它提醒人注意一个常被忽略的事实：在线对齐或推理蒸馏的瓶颈，很多时候不是缺 teacher，也不是缺算力，而是缺“信息密度足够高的训练样本”。这个视角和持续预训练、mid-training、reasoning data synthesis 是相通的。若把数学偏好蒸馏换成更一般的能力蒸馏，DIAG 代表的是一种 signal-aware curriculum：不是盲目扩大数据池，而是根据当前模型错误分布去生成下一轮数据。这个思路对合成预训练数据、continual pretrain 中的数据配比、以及 RL/SFT 阶段如何避免样本过易或过难，都有启发。不过它仍然偏 post-train，且场景限定在可验证数学推理，外推到开放域任务时需要谨慎。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Diagnose-and-Generate 两阶段闭环。第一阶段 Diagnose & Allocate，目标是估计当前 practice distribution 的“有效监督产率”，也就是给定一批题目和当前 student，多大概率能采到既有正确轨迹又有错误轨迹的 rollout 集合，从而形成可用 preference pair。作者没有把 topic-level 统计直接拿来做硬决策，而是引入 Empirical Bayes shrinkage 来平滑低样本主题的估计，避免某些主题因为偶然几次高收益就被过度放大，或者因为样本太少被过早放弃。与此同时，系统会在 exploration 和 exploitation 之间做配额分配：一部分预算继续覆盖更广主题，防止课程塌缩；另一部分预算集中到当前高产率区域。

第二阶段是 mistake-conditioned generation。与其从静态候选池里做 active selection，DIAG 让 teacher 根据 student 最近的错误轨迹生成后续题目。这样生成出来的问题更贴近 student 当前失败模式，也更可能落在“差一点会、但还没完全会”的区域。文中还提到 uncertainty-weighted resampling，用来把计算预算进一步压到决策边界附近，而不是平均撒在所有主题上。

这个方法和传统 active learning 的区别在于，它不是从现成题库里挑高不确定样本，而是根据 student 的错误结构主动生成新题；和 brute-force 扩大 rollout width 的区别在于，它优先提高每个样本产生有效 preference signal 的概率，而不是单纯多采样。若从训练信号角度看，DIAG 关心的是 pair yield 和 pair quality 两件事：前者决定监督密度，后者决定偏好学习是否真的贴着能力边界发生。
summary.experiments:
从已给出的全文内容看，实验重点不是追求单次 benchmark 的绝对分数，而是证明 DIAG 在相同或更低预算下能产出更多有效 preference pairs，并把这些更高信息密度的样本转化为更好的数学推理性能。引言里明确声称：静态 practice distribution 会导致 natural contrastive supervision 快速下降；DIAG 通过 signal-aware pacing、Empirical Bayes topic scoring 和错误条件生成，提高了 preference-pair yield，并且单位预算的信息密度更高。

由于当前提供的正文片段没有完整实验表和具体数字，能确认的实验结论主要是方向性的：一，随着迭代进行，固定题库越来越难提供有效 pair；二，按 topic 做稳健配额分配优于直接按原始统计贪心采样；三，mistake-conditioned generation 比 practice-agnostic generation 更能贴近 student 的能力边界，因此更容易形成有区分度的偏好监督。若阅读全文，建议重点核对三类数字：每轮有效 pair 比例、总训练预算下的最终数学 benchmark 提升、以及不同 topic allocation 策略下的方差和稳定性。没有这些数字，很难判断它到底是“更省数据”还是只是“更会造题”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓住一个主线：这不是在改 DPO 目标，而是在改 DPO 的数据生成闭环。先看 Introduction 和方法总图，理解作者为何把问题定义成 signal-yield problem。然后重点看 Diagnose & Allocate 的公式和算法，尤其是 Empirical Bayes shrinkage 如何处理低计数主题；再看 mistake-conditioned generation 的 prompt 设计和 uncertainty-weighted resampling。最后看实验里关于 pair yield 随迭代变化的曲线，这比最终 benchmark 分数更能说明方法是否成立。

预计 15 到 25 分钟可以完成有效泛读。若要继续深挖，建议重点问四个问题：一，valid preference pair 的判定是否依赖可验证答案，因此方法是否只适用于数学这类可判题任务；二，teacher 根据 student 错误生成新题时，是否会逐渐收缩到狭窄题型，造成泛化下降；三，Empirical Bayes 的先验设定对 topic allocation 有多敏感；四，pair yield 提高后，最终收益来自更好的 curriculum，还是来自 teacher 生成题目本身更接近测试分布。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a data-efficiency bottleneck in online mathematical preference distillation. As the student improves, a fixed prompt pool becomes increasingly mismatched to the model’s competence boundary, so rollouts are often either too easy or too hard. In both cases, the system fails to produce enough natural preference pairs with one correct and one incorrect trajectory. DIAG reframes this as a curriculum-control problem: after each alignment round, diagnose how much usable preference signal the current practice distribution still yields, then reshape the next round of practice so that generation stays near the student’s decision boundary.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. The paper highlights a practical point that often gets missed: in online alignment and reasoning distillation, the bottleneck is frequently not teacher quality or raw compute, but the density of informative supervision. That perspective transfers to synthetic data generation, continual pretraining, mid-training curricula, and reasoning-focused post-training. In a broader sense, DIAG is a signal-aware curriculum method: instead of scaling the prompt pool blindly, it adapts future data generation to the student’s observed failure modes. The caveat is that the current setting is verifiable mathematical reasoning, so generalization to open-ended domains is not automatic.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is a two-stage Diagnose-and-Generate loop. In the first stage, Diagnose & Allocate, the system estimates the effective supervision yield of the current practice distribution: given the current student and a set of prompts, how likely is it that sampled rollouts will contain both correct and incorrect trajectories, producing a usable preference pair? Rather than making topic-level decisions from raw counts, DIAG uses Empirical Bayes shrinkage to stabilize estimates under low sample counts. This prevents overreacting to noisy topics that happen to look good or bad due to small numbers. It also allocates budget between exploration and exploitation, so the curriculum does not collapse too early onto a narrow subset of topics.

In the second stage, the teacher generates follow-up problems conditioned on the student’s recent mistakes. This is the key departure from standard active learning. Instead of selecting uncertain prompts from a static candidate pool, DIAG actively creates new prompts that target the student’s current failure modes. The paper also uses uncertainty-weighted resampling to concentrate compute near the competence boundary rather than spreading it uniformly.

Conceptually, the method optimizes two quantities at once: pair yield and pair quality. Pair yield determines how much supervision is available per unit budget. Pair quality determines whether preference learning happens on examples that are actually informative for the current student. Compared with brute-force scaling of rollout width, DIAG tries to increase the probability that each sampled problem produces useful contrastive signal.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text content, the experimental emphasis is not on a single benchmark headline but on showing that DIAG produces more informative preference pairs under the same or lower budget, and converts that higher signal density into better mathematical reasoning performance. The introduction explicitly claims that static practice distributions cause a rapid decline in natural contrastive supervision, while DIAG improves preference-pair yield through signal-aware pacing, Empirical Bayes topic scoring, and mistake-conditioned generation.

Because the supplied text does not include the full result tables, the confirmed findings are directional rather than fully numeric. First, fixed prompt pools become less effective over iterations as the student improves. Second, robust topic allocation outperforms greedy allocation based on raw observed yields. Third, mistake-conditioned generation is better than practice-agnostic generation at staying near the student’s competence boundary, which increases the chance of obtaining discriminative preference supervision. When reading the full paper, the most important numbers to verify are: the valid-pair rate per iteration, final benchmark gains under matched training budgets, and the variance or stability of different topic-allocation strategies. Without those, it is hard to tell whether the method is truly data-efficient or simply benefits from stronger synthetic problem generation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, keep one thread in mind: the paper is not changing the DPO objective, it is changing the data-generation loop around DPO. Start with the introduction and the method overview to see why the authors cast the problem as signal yield. Then focus on the Diagnose & Allocate component, especially how Empirical Bayes shrinkage handles low-count topics. After that, read the mistake-conditioned generation setup and the uncertainty-weighted resampling mechanism. In the experiments, the most informative plots should be the curves showing how valid preference-pair yield evolves over iterations; those matter more than the final benchmark score alone.

A useful skim should take about 15 to 25 minutes. If reading more carefully, track four questions. Does the definition of a valid preference pair rely on verifiable answers, making the method specific to math-like domains? Does mistake-conditioned generation gradually narrow the curriculum too much and hurt generalization? How sensitive is topic allocation to the Empirical Bayes prior? And when performance improves, how much comes from better curriculum control versus the teacher generating prompts that are simply closer to the evaluation distribution?

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和数据选择 ablation；把 preference-pair yield 当课程信号这点值得在内部 RLVR 数据管线复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and data-selection ablations; using preference-pair yield as a curriculum signal is worth reproducing in an internal RLVR pipeline.

paper.title: Thinking Beyond Videos: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Open-World Video Agents
paper.abstract: Open-world video understanding often requires a model to locate sparse visual evidence and acquire external knowledge that is absent from the video and its parametric memory. While Thinking-with-Videos enables active temporal perception and Deep Research supports multi-step information seeking, the two capabilities are typically developed in isolation. We introduce VideoRover, a unified Video Deep Research framework that iteratively coordinates video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage brow

summary.core_problem: 开放世界视频理解任务通常需要模型定位稀疏的视觉证据，并获取视频和参数记忆中缺失的外部知识，但现有的视频推理（Thinking-with-Videos）和深度研究（Deep Research）能力通常是孤立发展的。
summary.importance: 提出了 VideoRover，一个统一的视频深度研究框架，首次将视频时间定位与多模态开放世界检索结合，实现了视频观察与外部检索的迭代协调，为解决复杂的开放世界多模态任务提供了新范式。
summary.technical_approach: VideoRover 通过迭代协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索和网页浏览来解决问题。每个工具的结果都会更新共享的研究状态，并指导下一步操作：局部视频片段指导外部检索，检索到的证据触发进一步的视频检查和验证。为了训练该模型，构建了一个自动化的数据整理管道，生成了 26K 验证过的 SFT 样本和 3K 具有挑战性的 RL 实例，并引入了 VideoRover-Bench 进行评估。
summary.experiments: 在 VideoDR 和 VideoRover-Bench 上的实验表明，VideoRover 在视频深度研究任务上表现出色。消融实验和训练动态验证了互补的工具设计以及通过 RL 学习到的长程协调能力的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Task Formulation 部分，了解如何将视频推理和深度研究统一到一个框架中，以及工具的迭代协调机制。预计阅读时间 10 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Open-world video understanding often requires locating sparse visual evidence and acquiring external knowledge missing from the video and parametric memory, but existing Thinking-with-Videos and Deep Research capabilities are typically developed in isolation.
summary_en.importance: Proposes VideoRover, a unified Video Deep Research framework that, for the first time, combines video temporal grounding with multimodal open-world retrieval, enabling iterative coordination between video observation and external search, providing a new paradigm for complex open-world multimodal tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: VideoRover iteratively coordinates video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing. Each tool result updates a shared research state and guides the next action: localized video clips guide external retrieval, and retrieved evidence triggers further video inspection and verification. To train the model, an automated data curation pipeline is constructed, generating 26K verified SFT examples and 3K challenging RL instances, and VideoRover-Bench is introduced for evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on VideoDR and VideoRover-Bench demonstrate strong performance in Video Deep Research tasks. Ablation studies and training dynamics validate the effectiveness of the complementary tool design and long-horizon coordination learned through RL.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Task Formulation section to understand how video reasoning and deep research are unified into a single framework and the iterative coordination mechanism of the tools. Estimated reading time: 10 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将视频理解与 Deep Research 结合的 Agent 框架，其构建 26K SFT 和 3K RL 轨迹的数据合成 pipeline 对多模态后训练有参考价值。
recommendation.en: An agent framework combining video understanding with Deep Research. Its data synthesis pipeline for 26K SFT and 3K RL trajectories is valuable for multimodal post-training.

paper.title: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks
paper.abstract: High-quality long-horizon training data for terminal agents is expensive to produce, often costing hundreds to thousands of dollars per task, because each task must keep the instruction, environment, reference solution, and verifier mutually consistent. Human authoring does not scale, and direct generation with large language models (LLMs) often breaks these dependencies. We present Recursive Synthetic Terminal Tasks (RST), a recursive verified synthesis framework for constructing long-horizon t

summary.core_problem: 终端智能体的长程训练数据需保持指令、环境、参考解、验证器四者一致，人工编写成本极高且不可扩展，直接用LLM生成易破坏依赖关系，现有方法无法规模化构造高质量可验证的终端智能体数据。
summary.importance: 递归验证式合成范式为零人工介入的智能体训练数据规模化提供了可行路径，对长程终端智能体的SFT/RL数据集构造有直接参考价值，也为通用可验证合成数据的生成提供了解优先的落地思路。
summary.technical_approach: RST（递归合成终端任务）是一套递归验证式的任务合成框架。它从已验证的种子任务出发，先扩展参考解得到更长更复杂的解题流程，再同步调整验证器和指令以匹配新解，最后在独立沙箱中完成全任务验证，要求参考解必须通过私有验证器。通过验证的任务既可用于收集训练轨迹，也可作为下一轮合成的种子。该框架采用解优先设计，每个被接受的任务都自带可执行的可解性证明。
summary.experiments: 以DeepSeek-V4-Pro为生成模型，15轮递归从639个种子任务得到37484个验证通过的终端任务，单任务成本约0.05美元，全程无人工介入。任务难度随轮次显著提升：中位解长度增长5.6倍，命令使用量增长6.1倍，指令长度仅增长1.4倍。同一求解器的通过率从种子轮到第15轮大幅下降：DeepSeek-V4-Pro从72%降至4%，GPT-5.6-sol从72.2%降至7%。用Qwen3.5自生成轨迹做SFT，在三个终端基准上Qwen3.5-27B和Qwen3.5-122B-A10B最高提升10个点；PPO训练进一步让Qwen3.5-27B在三个基准上分别提升8.24%、9.33%、3.97%。15轮后递归仍未饱和，任务产出率和多样性保持稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中长程终端任务数据的核心约束，以及RST框架的递归验证流程设计。实验部分关注多轮递归后的难度增长幅度与训练数据有效性验证。预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: High-quality long-horizon training data for terminal agents requires strict consistency across instructions, execution environments, reference solutions, and verifiers, making human authoring prohibitively expensive and unscalable, while direct LLM generation frequently breaks these dependencies, and existing methods cannot produce verified terminal-agent data at scale.
summary_en.importance: The recursive verified synthesis paradigm enables scalable agent training data generation without human intervention, offers direct reference for constructing SFT/RL datasets for long-horizon terminal agents, and demonstrates a solution-first approach for building general verifiable synthetic data pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: RST (Recursive Synthetic Terminal Tasks) is a recursive verified task synthesis framework. Starting from verified seed tasks, it first extends the reference solution to create a longer and more complex workflow, then realigns the verifier and instruction to match the new solution, and finally validates the complete task in an isolated sandbox where the reference solution must pass the private verifier. Accepted tasks are used both to collect training trajectories and as seeds for the next synthesis round. Built on a solution-first design, every accepted task carries an executable proof of solvability.
summary_en.experiments: Using DeepSeek-V4-Pro as the generator, 15 rounds of recursive synthesis produce 37,484 verified terminal tasks from 639 seeds, at approximately $0.05 per passed task with no human involvement. Task difficulty grows substantially across rounds: median solution length increases 5.6×, command usage 6.1×, while instruction length only grows 1.4×. Pass rates of identical solvers drop sharply from seed round to round 15: 72% to 4% for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and 72.2% to 7% for GPT-5.6-sol. SFT with Qwen3.5 self-collected trajectories improves Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B by up to 10 points on three terminal benchmarks. PPO training further boosts Qwen3.5-27B by 8.24%, 9.33%, and 3.97% on the three benchmarks respectively. No saturation is observed after 15 rounds, with stable task yield and preserved diversity.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core constraints of long-horizon terminal task data in the introduction, and the recursive verification pipeline design of RST. For experiments, pay attention to difficulty growth across recursive rounds and the validation of training data effectiveness. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

paper.title: Once a Response, Always a Response: Detecting LLM-generated Text via Latent Prompt Restoration
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and convincing text at scale, creating growing risks for misinformation dissemination, educational misuse, and platform governance. These concerns make robust detection of machine-generated text increasingly necessary. Recent zero-shot detectors mainly exploit probability-based statistical discrepancies, but they do not explicitly account for the training process of LLMs, which leaves a distinct generation mechanism insufficiently modeled and limi

summary.core_problem: 检测一段文本是否由 LLM 生成，尤其是在零样本检测器容易被改写、采样策略和模型差异影响的情况下提升稳健性。
summary.importance: 贡献是生成文本检测方法，不是预训练核心问题；间接价值在于它利用“LLM 回复通常隐含上游 prompt 条件”这一生成机制假设，可用于理解合成数据污染和平台治理。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EchoPrompt，一个免训练检测器：给待测文本前置统一的 generic assistant-response prefix，尝试恢复隐藏的助手回复上下文；随后用 instruction-tuned 模型测量由该前缀带来的 likelihood gain，并用校准项区分人类文本和机器回复。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出数据集、模型规模、baseline 和数值；声称相较主要概率统计类零样本检测器，显式建模 latent prompt dependency 能改善检测鲁棒性，需读正文查看跨模型、跨改写和跨领域表现。
summary.authors_note: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences；University of Chinese Academy of Sciences；Zhejiang University；Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to detect LLM-generated text under settings where zero-shot statistical detectors are fragile to paraphrasing, decoding changes, and generator mismatch.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generation-text detector rather than a core pretraining method. Its indirect value is the use of an explicit generation-mechanism assumption: LLM responses often retain a hidden dependency on an upstream prompt.
summary_en.technical_approach: EchoPrompt is a training-free detector. It prepends a unified generic assistant-response prefix to partially restore the latent response context, measures the induced likelihood gain with an instruction-tuned model, and calibrates the gain to separate human-written text from machine responses.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full datasets, model sizes, baselines, or numeric gains. It claims improved robustness over probability-based zero-shot detectors by modeling latent prompt dependency; cross-generator, paraphrase, and domain robustness need to be checked in the paper.
