paper.title: Multi-Turn Reasoning When Context Arrives in Pieces: Scalable Sharding and Memory-Augmented RL
paper.abstract: When a user reveals task-critical information across several conversation turns, LLM accuracy drops by up to 65% despite full context availability. We show that this Lost in Conversation degradation can be substantially mitigated by training models to maintain a compact rolling memory instead of attending to a growing history. To make such training scalable, we introduce a low-cost sharding pipeline that converts single-turn QA datasets into multi-turn fragmented-information episodes, eliminatin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多轮对话里信息分片到达时，模型明明已经见过全部关键信息，却仍然在最终求解时明显掉点的问题。作者把这个现象放在 Lost in Conversation 框架下，进一步指出两个更具体的训练瓶颈：一是现有多轮碎片化数据太贵，难以支撑 RLVR 规模训练；二是让模型始终依赖完整历史并不是一个稳健策略，因为历史越长，检索和整合越差，训练时也缺少一个明确的“跨轮压缩与保留”机制。论文想解决的不是普通长上下文 QA，而是增量式信息暴露下，模型如何在每一轮主动写出可持续使用的中间记忆，并靠最终可验证奖励把这种能力学出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的启发主要有三点。第一，它把“记忆写入”从 agent 工程技巧推进成了可训练的策略对象，而且证明这种对象可以只靠终局可验证奖励学出来，不需要中间记忆标注。第二，它给出了一条低成本数据构造路径：把单轮 QA 数据自动切成多轮信息碎片，从而把原本稀缺的多轮推理训练信号扩展到 RL 可用规模。这对 reasoning-oriented continual pretrain、mid-train、以及面向 agent 交互的 post-train 都有现实意义。第三，结果显示 memory-only 条件下训练出来的策略，不只是更省上下文，而且在 full-history 推理条件下也优于直接训练 full-history 的模型，说明“受限记忆”可能是一种更强的训练归纳偏置，而不只是推理时的压缩技巧。这一点对长上下文预训练、外显 scratchpad 设计、以及对话式 reasoning recipe 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成。第一部分是 sharding 数据管线。作者把 GSM8K、MATH500 这类单轮数学题，先用 LLM 按“最小逻辑单元”切分，再做完整性和非冗余校验，最后把核心问题单独抽出并在每一轮重复提供，而证据碎片按轮次逐步揭示。这样做的关键，不是简单随机切块，而是尽量保留原题的推理依赖结构，让模型必须跨轮累积信息。对 LongBench 这类文档 QA，则退回到按句边界对齐的固定长度 chunk，因为这类数据没有天然的离散推理单元。作者还构造了 Full-question 和 Mixed 两种变体：前者把完整问题随机放在某一 shard，其余位置塞入 Wikitext 噪声，测试模型是否只是在做相关内容识别；后者把逻辑分片和噪声交织，测试在干扰下的记忆提取能力。

第二部分是 memory-augmented RL。每一轮 t，策略接收问题 q、当前记忆 m_t 和新到达的 shard s_t，输出重写后的自然语言记忆 m_{t+1}。记忆长度上限固定为 256 token，故意不让模型把所有历史原样抄进去，而是逼它做选择性保留、压缩和整合。最后一轮只基于 q 和终态记忆 m_K 生成答案。训练上沿用 DAPO 风格的多轨迹 RLVR：每个样本采样 G=4 条轨迹，用规则验证器对最终答案给标量奖励，再做 group-relative advantage。一个重要设计是，作者不做中间 turn 级别 credit assignment，而是把同一条轨迹的优势统一传播到所有记忆更新步骤。理由是中间记忆的“正确写法”并不唯一，若强行监督某一轮该记什么，反而会把策略空间收窄。优化器层面使用 dual-clipped PPO surrogate，并按 token mean 聚合所有轮次损失，避免较长的记忆输出在梯度里占比过大；另加独立 KL 项约束策略漂移。对照组则是 full-history policy：每轮直接看累计聊天历史，不显式维护压缩记忆。评测时两类模型都在 memory 和 full-history 两种推理条件下测试，用来区分收益到底来自“训练结构”还是“推理时压缩”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两个模型尺度：Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-4B-Thinking，训练在 2×A100 上完成，每个 prompt 采样 4 条轨迹。核心结果有几层。

第一，LiC 掉点可以被大幅收回。引言给出的数字是，在 GSM8K 上最多可恢复 60 个点的 Lost in Conversation 性能损失，说明这不是边际修补，而是把“跨轮累积失败”变成了可训练能力。

第二，memory-trained policy 在所有评测条件下都超过 full-history baseline。这里最重要的不是 memory inference 优于 full-history inference，而是同一个 memory-trained 模型即便在推理时给它完整历史，也仍然优于专门按 full-history 训练的模型。这说明收益主要来自训练时被迫做信息筛选和状态更新，而不是单纯因为测试时上下文更短。

第三，泛化比任务表面形式更强。模型只在 sharded GSM8K 上训练，却能 zero-shot 迁移到更难的 MATH500，以及 out-of-domain 的 LongBench 长文档 QA。这个结果支持作者的判断：学到的不是某个数据集的题型模板，而是“如何把分步到达的信息压进有限状态并在终局取用”的策略。

第四，数据结构和噪声设置带来可解释消融。Sharded、Full-question、Mixed 三种训练集的比较，用来区分逻辑分解、相关内容识别、以及抗干扰能力各自的作用；MATH500 上插入 n∈{2,4} 个噪声 shard 的测试，则检查记忆策略在更长、更脏对话中的稳健性。虽然给出的全文片段没有列出全部表格数字，但实验设计本身很扎实，能回答“为什么 memory RL 有效”而不只是“它有效”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Method 的问题设定，再看实验主表和消融。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主线。

重点有四处。第一，看 sharding pipeline 的定义方式，尤其“最小逻辑单元”“问题重复暴露、证据逐步揭示”这两个设计，它们决定了训练信号是不是在逼模型做跨轮整合，而不是普通摘要。第二，看 memory state 的接口：每轮只传 q、m_t、s_t，且记忆上限 256 token，这里体现了作者想把记忆训练成受限状态机，而不是缩短版上下文。第三，看 advantage 如何统一传播到所有 turn，以及为什么不做中间监督；这是整篇里最有方法论意味的取舍。第四，看 memory-trained vs full-history-trained 在两种 inference condition 下的交叉评测，这组实验最能说明收益来自训练归纳偏置，而不是测试时 token 节省。

如果时间更少，只看三样：任务构造图、主结果表、Sharded/Full-question/Mixed 消融表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in multi-turn interaction: task-critical information arrives incrementally across turns, the model has technically seen all of it, yet final accuracy collapses. The authors frame this as Lost in Conversation, then sharpen the problem into two training bottlenecks. First, existing fragmented multi-turn datasets are too expensive to build for RL with verifiable rewards. Second, relying on full conversation history is a weak strategy because retrieval and integration degrade as history grows, and the model is never forced to learn an explicit cross-turn state update mechanism. The target is therefore not generic long-context QA, but learning how to write and rewrite a compact intermediate memory under delayed supervision.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model researchers is that it turns memory maintenance from an inference-time systems trick into a trainable policy. More importantly, the policy is learned from final verifiable reward only, without gold intermediate memories. That matters for the pretrain–posttrain interface: if multi-turn state tracking can be induced from cheap synthetic restructuring of single-turn corpora, then reasoning-oriented mid-training or RL stages can target a capability that standard next-token training does not isolate well. A second contribution is the data recipe itself: converting abundant single-turn QA into fragmented multi-turn episodes at low annotation cost. A third and more subtle point is the empirical result that memory-trained models beat full-history-trained baselines even when both are evaluated with full history. That suggests bounded memory is not merely a compression device at inference time; it acts as a stronger inductive bias during training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two components. The first is a sharding pipeline. For GSM8K and MATH500, an LLM decomposes each problem into minimal logical units, verifies completeness and non-redundancy, and withholds the core question from the shard sequence while repeating that question at every turn. Evidence is then revealed piece by piece. This is not random chunking: the goal is to preserve the dependency structure of the original reasoning problem so the model must accumulate state across turns. For LongBench QA, where such discrete reasoning units are less natural, the authors instead chunk documents into fixed-size sentence-aligned segments. They also build two ablation variants. Full-question places the full question in one random shard and fills the rest with Wikitext noise, testing whether the model is only learning relevance detection. Mixed interleaves logical shards with noise, testing robustness under distraction.

The second component is memory-augmented RL. At turn t, the policy receives the question q, current memory m_t, and incoming shard s_t, then generates a rewritten memory m_{t+1}. The memory is free-form natural language capped at 256 tokens, intentionally too small to copy the full history verbatim. At the final turn, the model answers using only q and the terminal memory m_K. Training extends the DAPO-style multi-conversation RLVR setup: for each sample, G=4 trajectories are sampled, a rule-based verifier scores only the final answer, and group-relative advantages are computed. A key design choice is to propagate the same trajectory-level advantage to all intermediate memory-writing steps rather than assigning turn-level credit. The rationale is that there is no unique correct intermediate memory, so direct supervision would overconstrain the policy. Optimization uses a dual-clipped PPO surrogate with token-mean aggregation across turns, preventing long memory outputs from dominating gradients, plus a separate KL penalty to limit policy drift. The main baseline is a full-history policy that sees the concatenated conversation history instead of an explicit compressed state. Both model families are evaluated under both memory-only and full-history inference conditions, which cleanly separates training effects from inference-time context compression.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use two model scales: Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B-Thinking, trained with 4 sampled trajectories per prompt on 2×A100 GPUs. Several findings stand out.

First, the Lost in Conversation degradation is substantially recoverable. The paper reports up to a 60-point recovery on GSM8K, which indicates that the failure is not an immutable consequence of fragmented context but a learnable deficiency in state maintenance.

Second, memory-trained policies outperform full-history baselines under every evaluation condition. The strongest evidence is the cross-condition result: a model trained with bounded memory still beats a model trained on full history even when both are given full history at test time. This argues that the gain comes from the training objective and state-update discipline, not simply from shorter inference context.

Third, the learned behavior transfers beyond the training domain. Models trained only on sharded GSM8K generalize zero-shot to the harder MATH500 benchmark and to out-of-domain LongBench QA. That supports the claim that the model is learning a reusable information-accumulation strategy rather than memorizing a dataset-specific format.

Fourth, the ablations are informative rather than cosmetic. Comparing Sharded, Full-question, and Mixed isolates the role of logical decomposition versus relevance filtering versus noise robustness. Additional MATH500 variants with n in {2, 4} inserted noise shards test whether the memory policy remains stable as conversations become longer and dirtier. The excerpt provided does not include all table values, but the experimental structure is strong enough to answer why the method works, not only whether it works.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim-level read, start with the problem setup in the introduction, then move to the memory interface and the main result tables. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough to capture the core idea.

There are four places worth focusing on. First, inspect how the sharding pipeline defines minimal logical units and why the question is repeated while evidence is fragmented; this is what turns the task into cross-turn accumulation rather than ordinary summarization. Second, look closely at the memory interface: each turn only gets q, m_t, and s_t, with a 256-token cap. That design reveals the intended inductive bias. Third, read the discussion around trajectory-level advantage propagation and the decision not to supervise intermediate memories. That is the most methodologically interesting choice in the paper. Fourth, examine the cross-evaluation matrix between memory-trained and full-history-trained models under both inference conditions. That is the cleanest evidence that the benefit comes from training structure rather than token savings at test time.

If time is limited, read the task construction figure, the main performance table, and the Sharded/Full-question/Mixed ablation table.

paper.title: Ouroboros-Spatial: Closing the Data-Model Loop for Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches largely rely on large-scale, statically curated datasets, where all training samples are treated uniformly regardless of the model's evolving capabilities. This static paradigm is inherently data-inefficient: training capacity is often spent on samples that are either trivial or overly difficult for the model at its current stage. To address this limitation, we propose Ouroboros-Spa

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在空间推理任务中，静态训练数据导致的数据效率低下问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种自演化的训练框架，通过模型自我生成和筛选数据，动态调整训练难度，提升了空间推理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Ouroboros-Spatial 框架，模型扮演 proposer 和 solver 两个角色。Proposer 利用 3D 场景元数据和视频帧生成空间 QA 对及可执行代码获取 ground truth；Solver 在接受的样本上微调，其预测置信度作为难度信号反馈给 Proposer，指导下一轮生成更具挑战性的数据。
summary.experiments: 在空间推理任务上验证了该自演化框架的有效性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学和上海人工智能实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the data inefficiency in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for spatial reasoning caused by static training datasets.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a self-evolving training framework that dynamically adjusts training difficulty through model self-generation and filtering, improving spatial reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Ouroboros-Spatial framework, where the model acts as both a proposer and a solver. The proposer generates spatial QA pairs and executable code for ground truth from 3D scene metadata and video frames. The solver is fine-tuned on accepted samples, and its prediction confidence serves as a difficulty signal fed back to the proposer to guide the generation of more challenging data in the next iteration.
summary_en.experiments: Validated the effectiveness of the self-evolving framework on spatial reasoning tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Peking University and Shanghai AI Laboratory.

paper.title: INFUSER: Influence-Guided Self-Evolution Improves Reasoning
paper.abstract: Self-evolution offers a scalable path to stronger reasoning: a pretrained language model improves itself with only minimal external supervision. Yet existing methods either depend on extensively curated or teacher-generated training data, or, when the generator runs unsupervised, reward it by a difficulty heuristic that need not improve the solver. We introduce INFUSER, an iterative co-training framework with two co-evolving roles: a Generator that drafts questions and reference golden answers f

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM自演进方法要么依赖大量人工/教师生成的训练数据，要么在无监督生成时用困难度启发式奖励generator，而困难度不一定真正提升solver。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出influence-guided自演进框架INFUSER，首次使用optimizer-aware influence score来奖励数据generator，使生成的问题真正有助于改进solver；同时提出DuGRPO dual-normalization适配连续噪声奖励信号。

summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，完整实验结果未给出。核心创新在方法设计和理论基础。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括普林斯顿大学的Jose Blanchee（统计/ML知名学者）、Zhuoran Yang（普林斯顿/DeepMind）、Tianhao Wang（普林斯顿）。属于知名学术团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM self-evolution methods either rely on extensively curated/teacher-generated training data, or reward the generator by a difficulty heuristic that does not necessarily improve the solver when run unsupervised.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes INFUSER, an influence-guided self-evolution framework using optimizer-aware influence scores to reward the data generator such that generated questions actually improve the solver. Also proposes DuGRPO, a dual-normalization GRPO variant for continuous noisy reward signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-role co-training framework: Generator drafts questions and reference golden answers from unstructured documents; Solver improves by training on them with standard correctness rewards. The generator is rewarded by an optimizer-aware influence score measuring whether each question actually improves the solver on the target distribution. Proposes DuGRPO (dual-normalization GRPO) since standard GRPO is poorly suited for continuous noisy influence scores.

summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Jose Blanchet (Princeton, prominent statistics/ML researcher), Zhuoran Yang (Princeton/DeepMind), and Tianhao Wang (Princeton). Work from a well-known academic group.

paper.title: FineGen: A VLM-based Multi-Agent Framework for Fine-Grained Image-Text Dataset Construction
paper.abstract: The scarcity of hard negative samples in current vision-language datasets significantly hinders fine-grained perception. To address this, we propose FineGen, a VLM-based Multi-Agent framework for automated dataset construction. By employing a collaborative Generation-Verification-Correction pipeline with a closed-loop feedback mechanism, FineGen ensures synthesized hard negatives are semantically valid yet strictly contradictory to visual content. Applying this to ImageNet, we construct FineGen-

summary.core_problem: 如何解决当前视觉-语言数据集中缺乏困难负样本（hard negative samples）导致模型细粒度感知能力受限的问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于 VLM 的多智能体框架，用于自动化构建包含高质量困难负样本的细粒度图文数据集，显著提升了下游细粒度感知任务的性能。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FineGen 框架，采用协作的生成-验证-修正（Generation-Verification-Correction）pipeline 和闭环反馈机制。确保合成的困难负样本在语义上有效，但与视觉内容严格矛盾。应用于 ImageNet 构建了 FineGen-100K 数据集。
summary.experiments: 构建了包含 14.7 万个特定属性困难负样本的数据集，正负样本比为 1:10。评估确认属性有效率达 96.7%。在 FG-OVD 基准上微调，困难样本准确率提升了 +14.4%。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the lack of hard negative samples in current vision-language datasets, which hinders models' fine-grained perception capabilities?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a VLM-based multi-agent framework for automatically constructing fine-grained image-text datasets with high-quality hard negatives, significantly improving performance on downstream fine-grained perception tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the FineGen framework, employing a collaborative Generation-Verification-Correction pipeline with a closed-loop feedback mechanism. Ensures synthesized hard negatives are semantically valid yet strictly contradictory to visual content. Applied to ImageNet to construct the FineGen-100K dataset.
summary_en.experiments: Constructed a dataset with 147,000 attribute-specific hard negatives and a 1:10 positive-to-negative ratio. Evaluation confirms a 96.7% attribute validity rate. Fine-tuning on FG-OVD benchmark yields a +14.4% accuracy improvement on hard samples.

recommendation.zh: 利用 VLM 多智能体合成高质量 hard negative 文本数据来增强多模态对比学习，对 VLM 预训练数据构造有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Utilizes VLM multi-agents to synthesize high-quality hard negative text data to enhance multimodal contrastive learning, offering reference value for VLM pre-training data construction.

paper.title: SpectCount: Spectrotemporal Counting via Synthetic Signals Improves Large Audio Language Models
paper.abstract: Large audio language models (LALMs) extend large language models with an audio encoder and large-scale audio data. However, the scarcity of high-quality annotated audio data remains a fundamental bottleneck for scaling. Through probing signal detectability analysis, we identify fine-grained spectrotemporal perceptual weaknesses in a foundation LALM. To address these challenges, we propose Spectrotemporal Counting (SpectCount), a data-efficient fine-tuning approach based on fully synthetic audio

summary.core_problem: 解决大音频语言模型在高质量标注音频稀缺条件下，细粒度时频感知能力不足的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在于又做一个音频 benchmark，而在于提出一种弱点驱动的合成信号微调范式：不用真实音频、人工标注或预训练生成器，也能补齐基础模型的感知短板。对统一多模态预训练和数据合成都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先通过 probing signal detectability analysis 定位基础 LALM 的细粒度 spectrotemporal 弱点，再提出 SpectCount：在线生成全合成音频信号，以计数式、可控的时频结构任务进行数据高效微调。核心思想是用可解析、可控的合成刺激去定向修补模型感知盲区，而不是继续堆真实数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模和具体基线名称，但声称在一个 foundation LALM 上，SpectCount 不仅修复了探测到的时频弱点，还在声音、音乐、语音等多个未见过的听觉 benchmark 上带来泛化提升。若正文实验干净，这会是“合成 probing→定向补训”闭环的一个不错案例。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单中有 Nam Soo Kim，长期从事语音与音频建模。摘要无法确认更具体机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets fine-grained spectrotemporal weaknesses in large audio language models under the scarcity of high-quality annotated audio data.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not just another audio benchmark result. The interesting part is a weakness-targeted synthetic-signal finetuning paradigm: no real audio, no human annotations, and no pretrained generator, yet measurable gains on an audio foundation model. That is relevant to multimodal pretraining and synthetic data design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first use probing signal detectability analysis to identify spectrotemporal perceptual blind spots in a foundation LALM, then introduce SpectCount: an on-the-fly synthetic audio finetuning method built around controllable counting-style spectrotemporal signals. The key idea is to repair model weaknesses with analyzable synthetic stimuli rather than simply adding more real data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size or exact baselines, but claims that SpectCount both fixes the detected weaknesses and improves performance on diverse unseen auditory benchmarks spanning sound, music, and speech. If the full setup is clean, this is a useful closed-loop example of probing-to-targeted-remediation.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Nam Soo Kim, known for speech and audio modeling. The abstract alone does not confirm more detailed institutional context.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是方法论，不是分数：先用可控 probing 找盲点，再用纯合成刺激补训；做多模态 pretrain 的人应复现这条闭环。
recommendation.en: Read it for the methodology, not the benchmark numbers: probe the blind spot with controllable stimuli, then patch it with synthetic finetuning; that loop is worth porting to multimodal pretraining.

We present a multi-aspect iterative refinement framework that generates high-quality translation references and preference data through specialized LLM translators, each targeting a distinct quality dimension. summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of high-quality supervision and unstable preference optimization in literary translation, focusing on how to generate better training signals for SFT and RL.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is in post-training data synthesis and RL recipe design. The value for a foundation-model researcher is not the translation task itself, but the cleaner signal that in highly subjective generation settings, DPO may be less stable than an explicit reward model with online exploration.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a multi-aspect iterative refinement framework where specialized LLM translators target different quality dimensions such as fluency and literary effect, producing improved references and preference data. These are then used for SFT, followed by a comparison between DPO and GRPO with an explicit reward model.
summary_en.experiments: The resulting LitMT-8B and LitMT-14B reach 67.25 and 69.07 CEA100 on MetaphorTrans English-to-Chinese literary translation. Generated references improve SFT by 8.65 CEA100 over original ground truth, while explicit-reward GRPO adds another 1.51 points and DPO degrades performance. 训练得到 LitMT-8B 和 LitMT-14B，在 MetaphorTrans 英译中文学翻译任务上分别达到 67.25 和 69.07 CEA100。生成参考用于 SFT 时，相比原始 ground truth 提升 8.65 CEA100；RL 阶段中，DPO 会退化，而显式 reward model + GRPO 额外提升 1.51 分。摘要未给出更细的 baseline 族谱与训练 token 规模。

paper.title: QUBRIC: Co-Designing Queries and Rubrics for RL Beyond Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Rubric-based RL is a promising route for extending reinforcement learning beyond verifiable rewards, yet existing methods optimize rubrics while treating the query distribution as fixed. We identify a structural bottleneck: rubric quality is constrained by query structure. Open-ended queries yield vague rubrics; naively narrowing them introduces fabricated references that no model can verify, so all responses fail and training receives no reward signal. We present QUBRIC, a framework that co-des

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是开放式指令场景中，rubric-based RL 缺少稳定奖励信号的问题。关键点不只是“rubric 写得不够好”，而是原始 query 太开放，导致 rubric 无法形成可判定标准；如果强行把 query 改窄，又容易编造不存在的参考材料或约束，使所有回答都无法通过，训练信号失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有启发。它把“训练样本是否可学习”拆成 query 结构、rubric 可判定性、policy 当前能力三者的耦合问题。这一点对非数学、非代码领域的 RL 数据构造有参考意义：奖励质量不只取决于 judge 或 rubric，还取决于任务本身是否被改写成可评价、可区分、难度合适的形式。
summary.technical_approach: QUBRIC 是一个离线 query-rubric 共设计流程，然后用固定 rubric 做 GRPO。第一步从四个 teacher model 的参考回答中抽取 atomic key points，并优先处理 teacher 分歧大的开放式 query，因为这类 query 的答案空间更宽。改写时只选一到两个 key points，构造带角色、约束、具体数据和回答格式限制的场景化问题，让 key points 通过推理自然成为答案，而不是直接暴露答案。第二步做 contrastive rubric generation：比较 teacher response 和当前 policy response，把二者差距转成 query-level criteria，避免生成泛泛的“清晰、全面、有帮助”式 rubric。第三步做 learnability filtering，只保留 policy pass rate 落在合适区间的 query-rubric pair，过滤过易、过难或奖励全零的样本。它和单独优化 rubric、单独 query narrowing 的区别在于，query 改写受到 teacher key points 约束，rubric 又来自 teacher-policy gap，二者共同决定奖励是否可用。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 instruction following、跨领域迁移和一个 proprietary shopping helpfulness 场景。主要结果是：在 challenging instruction-following benchmark 上，相比 SFT baseline，QUBRIC 在 ArenaHard 上提升 5.5 分。只用 instruction-following 数据训练后，模型还能迁移到 legal、moral、narrative reasoning 三个 held-out benchmark，平均提升 6.3 分，提升主要集中在 reasoning-related dimensions。消融部分强调两个失败模式：开放 query 会产生模糊 rubric；naive narrowing 会引入不存在的 guideline、glossary 或 document，rubric 退化成检查模型是否拒答。matched controls 显示，收益需要 query 与 rubric 联合构造，单独做 rubric RL 或单独收窄 query 不够稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Section 3，理解 key-point extraction、scenario construction、contrastive rubric generation、learnability filtering 的数据流。再看 Section 5.2 和 Table 4，那里展示了 naive narrowing 与 vague rubric 的具体失败案例，是这篇论文最有信息量的部分。实验部分重点看 ArenaHard、held-out reasoning benchmark，以及 matched control ablation。若关注 RL 数据合成，可以细看 validation prompt 和 difficulty corridor 的设计；若关注基座预训练本身，可只读方法和消融，不必深挖 shopping benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a reward-design failure in rubric-based RL for open-ended instructions. The central issue is not merely weak rubric wording. If the query is too broad, no rubric can specify stable, checkable criteria. If the query is narrowed naively, the rewrite may introduce nonexistent references or constraints, causing every response to fail and removing the useful reward signal.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training than to base pretraining, but it gives a useful lesson for the pretrain–posttrain interface. It frames training data quality as a coupled property of the query, the rubric, and the current policy. For RL beyond math and code, reward quality depends not only on the judge or the rubric, but also on whether the task has been transformed into an evaluable and learnable form.
summary_en.technical_approach: QUBRIC builds query-rubric pairs offline and then optimizes the policy with GRPO using fixed rubrics. It first samples reference answers from four teacher models and extracts atomic key points. Queries with high teacher disagreement are prioritized because they have broader answer spaces. The rewrite selects one or two key points and builds a self-contained scenario with role, constraints, concrete context, plausible alternatives, and an answer-format constraint. The goal is to make the selected key points emerge through reasoning rather than direct recall. It then generates query-level rubrics contrastively by comparing teacher responses with policy responses and converting the teacher-policy gap into concrete criteria. A learnability filter keeps only examples whose policy pass rate lies in an informative difficulty band. This differs from rubric-only RL or query rewriting alone because the rewrite is grounded by teacher key points, while the rubric is grounded by actual policy failures.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers instruction following, cross-domain transfer, and a proprietary shopping helpfulness setting. On challenging instruction-following benchmarks, QUBRIC improves ArenaHard by 5.5 points over the SFT baseline. Trained only on instruction-following data, it transfers to three held-out benchmarks covering legal, moral, and narrative reasoning, with an average gain of 6.3 points. The gains are concentrated in reasoning-related dimensions. The ablations identify two main failure modes: open-ended queries lead to vague rubrics, while naive narrowing fabricates references such as guidelines or glossaries that do not exist. Matched controls show that the gains require joint query-rubric construction rather than rubric RL alone or query narrowing alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with Figure 1 and Section 3 to understand the full pipeline: key-point extraction, scenario construction, contrastive rubric generation, and learnability filtering. Then read Section 5.2 and Table 4, which contain the clearest evidence for the structural bottleneck. In the experiments, focus on ArenaHard, the held-out reasoning benchmarks, and the matched-control ablations. Readers interested in RL data construction should inspect the validation and difficulty-filtering details. Readers focused strictly on base pretraining can skim the proprietary shopping evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 query-rubric 联合设计和 learnability filter；它提醒我们 RL 失败常来自样本结构，不只是 reward 噪声。
recommendation.en: Read the query-rubric co-design and learnability filter; it is a clean reminder that RL failures often come from sample structure, not just reward noise.

paper.title: Synthetic Hallucinations, Real Gains: Hard Negatives from Frontier Models for FIM Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Small open-source code models that power IDE autocomplete still emit hallucinated Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) completions: syntactically natural calls to methods, parameters, variables, and imports that do not exist in the surrounding project. Existing mitigations either require per-language execution sandboxes that do not apply at mid-keystroke or preference-optimisation pipelines that need large human-labelled corpora. We propose an execution-free alternative: use frontier code models to synthesi

summary.core_problem: 缓解小型开源代码补全模型在 IDE Fill-in-the-Middle 场景中生成不存在 API、变量、参数和 import 的幻觉问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码模型后训练数据构造和负样本学习。它关心的是 mid-keystroke 自动补全中的项目上下文一致性，和通用代码 LM 的实用失效模式相关，但不是基座预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是用多个 frontier code model 为真实 GitHub FIM 上下文合成“看起来合理但错误”的 hard negatives，并把这些负样本与真实开发者编辑形成对比监督信号，用于小模型 SFT；幻觉类型参考 Delulu taxonomy，避免依赖执行沙箱或大规模人工偏好标注。
summary.experiments: 数据来自 public GitHub，覆盖八种编程语言；每个上下文由三个 frontier generator 生成四类幻觉负样本之一。摘要提到使用 Docker 验证的多语言 FIM hallucination benchmark，但未给出模型参数量、训练 token 数、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Illinois Chicago；摘要未显示与大型代码模型预训练团队的直接关联。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets hallucinated Fill-in-the-Middle completions in small open-source code models, especially nonexistent APIs, variables, parameters, and imports in IDE autocomplete.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a post-training data construction recipe for code models using hard negatives. The problem is relevant to practical code LM reliability, but it is not a foundation pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline asks multiple frontier code models to synthesize plausible-but-wrong FIM completions for real GitHub contexts, then contrasts those synthetic hallucinations with the ground-truth developer edit as a supervised fine-tuning signal. The hallucination types follow the Delulu taxonomy and avoid execution sandboxes or large human preference datasets.
summary_en.experiments: The data are scraped from public GitHub across eight languages. Three frontier generators are used to create hard negatives across four hallucination categories, and the paper mentions a Docker-verified multilingual FIM hallucination benchmark. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training scale, baselines, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is University of Illinois Chicago; no clear tie to a major code-model pretraining group is visible from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 可看数据构造流程，不必细读；对代码预训练的价值主要是 hard negative 采样思路。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look for the hard-negative data recipe; it is not a pretraining result, and the main value is the sampling setup.

institutions: Mahdi Erfanian University of Illinois Chicago

paper.title: Exploring Autonomous Agentic Data Engineering for Model Specialization
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on general tasks, while often struggling to adapt to specialized domains without high-quality domain-specific data. Existing LLM-based data curation methods primarily rely on human-designed workflows, leaving it unexamined whether LLMs can autonomously execute an end-to-end data engineering pipeline for model specialization. We formalize \textbf{Autonomous Agentic Data Engineering}, a novel task designed to evaluate LLMs as autono

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 LLM agent 能否在很少人工流程设计的情况下，独立完成面向模型专用化的数据工程：理解目标任务、设计数据策略、调用固定 teacher 合成数据、校验格式与质量、用固定 student 做 SFT，并根据验证反馈迭代优化数据。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练大模型本身，而在把“数据”明确放进可搜索、可优化的闭环里。它提供了一个观察点：当模型能力足够强时，数据配方的一部分可以从人工规则迁移到 agent 生成的程序与策略。对基座研究员更有用的是它的评估框架，而不是具体某个领域的结果。固定 teacher、student、finetune recipe 和预算后，性能提升主要来自数据构造能力，这种控制变量设计适合用于研究数据质量、合成数据覆盖度、训练反馈噪声，以及 post-training 信号如何反向塑造数据分布。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 Agentic Data Engineering 形式化为闭环优化问题。给定目标任务，agent 生成一个数据整理程序，通过 teacher model API 合成候选训练集；student model 在该数据上做标准化 SFT；评测器给出 public set 或 private set 反馈；agent 再根据反馈调整数据策略。论文设置了两类 agent：One-Shot 只一次性生成数据；Iterative Agent 可以多轮使用外部反馈优化。实验中 teacher 和 student 被固定，默认 teacher 是 Qwen3-30B-A3B，student 是 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct。agent 不能直接手写最终 submission，而必须写代码并通过 teacher API 生成样本，这个约束减少了“硬编码答案”对评测的污染。与常见 LLM 数据合成工作相比，它不是给定人工 pipeline 后让模型填充样本，而是让模型自己设计 domain specification、prompt、生成逻辑、验证规则和迭代策略。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Science、Code、Finance 三类 QA/reasoning 任务，并比较从零开始与给定 seed data 两种条件。评价指标是 student 在合成数据 SFT 后的 hidden private set 性能增益。论文报告现代 LLM agent 已能从任务描述中推断监督信号，生成较贴合任务的数据；其中 GPT-5.2 在迭代设置下取得平均 57.29% 的相对性能增益，并超过人工设计的数据合成 pipeline。One-Shot 与 Iterative 的对比显示，外部反馈对数据分布修正有明显帮助。失败案例集中在 post-generation QA：格式一致性、标签可靠性、样本多样性和难度控制仍不稳定，说明 agent 会生成“看起来合理但训练信号有噪声”的数据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。重点看任务形式化和环境设计部分，尤其是固定 teacher/student 后如何隔离数据工程能力；再看 One-Shot 与 Iterative Agent 的实验表格，关注 seed data、反馈轮数和预算约束对增益的影响。失败模式分析值得多看，因为它比平均分更能说明当前 agentic data curation 的瓶颈：生成数据不是难点，稳定地产生可训练、可验证、分布合适的数据才是难点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether an LLM agent can run an end-to-end data engineering pipeline for model specialization with minimal human-designed workflow: infer the task, plan a data strategy, synthesize examples through a fixed teacher model, validate the data, fine-tune a fixed student model, and iteratively improve the data using feedback.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining-oriented research is not a new base-model training method, but a controlled way to study data as an optimizable object. By fixing the teacher, student, fine-tuning recipe, and budgets, the measured improvement is largely attributed to the agent’s data-curation strategy. This is useful for studying synthetic data quality, coverage, feedback noise, and the interface between post-training performance signals and data distribution design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate Agentic Data Engineering as a closed-loop optimization problem. For each target task, the agent writes a data-curation program that calls a teacher model API to synthesize a candidate dataset. A fixed student model is then fine-tuned on that dataset under standardized hyperparameters and evaluated by a deterministic evaluator. The feedback can be used by an iterative agent to revise the curation strategy. The default setup uses Qwen3-30B-A3B as the teacher and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct as the student. The agent must generate the final submission through executable code and teacher API calls rather than directly writing examples, which reduces trivial leakage and forces the system to express an actual curation procedure. Compared with typical LLM-based data synthesis pipelines, the key difference is that the model is responsible for the full recipe: task specification, prompt design, data generation, validation, and optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans Science, Code, and Finance QA/reasoning tasks, under both from-scratch and seed-data settings. The main metric is the private-set performance gain of the fine-tuned student. The paper reports that current LLM agents can infer missing supervision patterns and synthesize task-aligned instances. In the iterative setting, GPT-5.2 achieves an average relative gain of 57.29% and outperforms human-crafted synthesis pipelines. The comparison between One-Shot and Iterative Agent settings shows that external feedback is useful for correcting the generated data distribution. The main failure modes are in quality assurance after generation: format consistency, label reliability, diversity, and difficulty control remain brittle.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes around 25–35 minutes. Focus on the task formulation and environment design, especially how fixing the teacher and student isolates the agent’s contribution to data engineering. Then read the tables comparing One-Shot and Iterative settings, and check how seed data, feedback rounds, and budget constraints affect gains. The failure-mode analysis is particularly informative, because it shows that producing plausible synthetic examples is easier than producing stable training signals with the right distribution.

recommendation.zh: 读方法闭环和消融即可；若反馈信号干净，这类 data-as-policy 会直接影响 mid-train/SFT 数据管线。
recommendation.en: Read the loop design and ablations; if the feedback signal is clean, this data-as-policy setup matters for mid-train and SFT pipelines.

paper.title: Scaling Multi-Hop Training Data via Graph-Constrained Path Selection
paper.abstract: Endowing large language models with compositional reasoning over specialized documents requires multi-hop training data at scale, where such data rarely exists outside of curated benchmarks built on structured sources. To construct it directly from plain, unannotated text, existing methods ask a single teacher model to jointly discover an evidence path through a document and verbalize it as a question-answer pair. However, these methods degrade sharply when documents are structured around repeti

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是专门领域多跳训练数据难以规模化生成的问题。现有合成流水线通常让 teacher LLM 同时完成两件事：在长文档里搜索证据路径，并把路径写成 QA。面对合同这类模板重复、交叉引用密集、语义差异细小的文本时，这个联合任务失败率很高，生成预算增加也难以线性转化为可用样本。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的相关性有限，更接近 post-train 数据合成和领域 SFT。但它提供了一个有用的数据工程信号：合成数据扩展时，瓶颈不一定是 teacher 的写作能力，而是把搜索、结构约束和语言生成压进同一个 prompt 后造成的有效产率下降。把“证据路径枚举”和“问题答案 verbalization”拆开，可以显著提高过滤后的样本数量。这个思路可迁移到通用推理数据构造，但论文里的实验证据主要停留在法律合同域，泛化到通用多跳推理的增益很小。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 Graph-Constrained Semantic Chain Synthesis，简称 GCSCS。流程分四步。第一步按合同的 Article、Section、Clause、Paragraph、Schedule、Exhibit 等天然边界切分文本，并把片段转成 keyword-grounded 的原子 QA facts。第二步构造 contextual keyword centroids，用中心向量表达每个概念在上下文中的语义 footprint。第三步在 FAISS 索引上搜索非循环的、满足拓扑约束的路径，并用五类几何约束过滤，提前保证跨条款连接是可用的。第四步才调用 teacher LLM，让它基于已经装配好的 evidence chain 写出最终 QA。关键区别是 teacher 不再负责隐式图搜索，只做单次语言表达。
summary.experiments: 在 CUAD 合同数据上，随机多文档链通过结构化 JSON quality gate 的比例只有 22.0%，可用语料约停在 18K。GCSCS 把通过率提升到 94.5%，可用样本扩大到 80K，约为 4.4 倍。用这批数据微调 Qwen3-32B，在严格 source-contract split 的 closed-book 设置下，Token F1 从 21.66% 提升到 38.58%。18K matched-size ablation 显示，在相同训练规模下 constrained 和 unconstrained chains 的下游表现接近，说明主要收益来自数据产率和规模，而不是单条 chain 质量更高。零样本迁移到 HotpotQA 和 MuSiQue 的提升为正但很小，HotpotQA 约 +0.56%，说明模型主要学到法律回答风格和合同域知识组织方式，而不是通用多跳能力。作者还发现 citation-as-suffix 行为：模型会把 citation ID 当成答案后缀格式习惯；加入检索上下文后，CFR 从 89% 降到 8%，说明原先 citation 并不代表真实 grounding。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 15-25 分钟即可。重点看 Introduction 对 cognitive synthesizability bottleneck 的定义，以及 Methodology 中路径枚举和 teacher fusion 的拆分。实验部分建议看三处：22.0% 到 94.5% 的 quality-gate yield，18K matched-size ablation，以及 citation-as-suffix 分析。若关注通用 LLM 训练数据，这篇的可取之处是数据管线分工和过滤产率分析；法律合同任务本身不必细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the difficulty of scaling synthetic multi-hop training data in specialized document collections. A single teacher model is often asked to both find an evidence path and write a question-answer pair. In legal contracts, where clauses are repetitive, densely cross-referenced, and semantically close, this coupled operation has low usable yield.
summary_en.importance: The work is closer to post-training data generation than to foundation-model pretraining. Its main lesson is still useful for LLM data pipelines: synthetic data scaling can be limited by effective yield, not by raw generation volume. When path search and verbalization are merged into one prompt, the teacher fails mechanically even if the underlying evidence paths exist. Decoupling graph construction from language generation improves yield substantially. The evidence for general reasoning transfer is weak; most of the gain appears domain-specific.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed pipeline, Graph-Constrained Semantic Chain Synthesis (GCSCS), separates topology discovery from teacher verbalization. It first chunks contracts along native legal boundaries such as articles, sections, clauses, schedules, and exhibits. It then converts content into keyword-grounded atomic QA facts and builds contextual keyword centroids that represent the semantic footprint of each concept. A FAISS index is used to search for non-looping, topologically admissible evidence paths under several geometric constraints. Only after this path is pre-validated does the teacher model generate the final QA pair. The teacher is therefore used for articulation rather than implicit graph search.
summary_en.experiments: On CUAD-style contract data, random multi-document chains pass the structured JSON quality gate only 22.0% of the time, and the usable corpus saturates around 18K examples. GCSCS raises the pass rate to 94.5% and produces 80K usable examples, a 4.4x increase. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B on this corpus improves closed-book Token F1 from 21.66% to 38.58% under a strict source-contract split. A matched 18K ablation shows that constrained and unconstrained chains perform similarly at equal data size, indicating that the main improvement comes from higher data yield rather than better individual chains. Zero-shot transfer to HotpotQA and MuSiQue is positive but small, with HotpotQA improving by about 0.56%. The paper also identifies a citation-as-suffix artifact: the model learns to append citation IDs as a format habit, and when retrieved context is injected at inference time, the citation failure rate drops from 89% to 8%.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim of 15-25 minutes is enough. Read the problem framing around the cognitive synthesizability bottleneck, then inspect the methodology for how path enumeration is separated from teacher fusion. In the experiments, focus on the quality-gate yield, the matched-size ablation, and the citation-as-suffix diagnostic. For general LLM training, the reusable part is the pipeline design and yield analysis, not the legal contract task itself.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim 方法部分：把路径验证从 teacher 里拿出来是干净的 data pipeline prior，可复查内部多跳合成流程。
recommendation.en: Skim the method: moving path validation outside the teacher is a clean data-pipeline prior worth checking against internal multi-hop synthesis.

paper.title: GenesisFunc: Multi-Agent Data Generation for Accurate and Generalizable Function-Calling
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) extend their capabilities through function-calling (FC), which relies on training data with high quality, diversity, and broad coverage of scenario. However, obtaining and annotating real function-calling data is challenging, while synthetic data from existing pipelines often suffers from unreliable APIs, limited tool scalability, insufficient diversity, and weak quality control. To address these, we present GenesisFunc, an automated pipeline for generating FC traini

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何再做一个 function-calling 模型”，而是更前面的瓶颈：如何稳定地产出可用于训练的高质量 FC 数据。作者指出现有合成流程有四个老问题：API 来源不可靠、工具集合难扩展、对话场景单薄、质量控制弱。结果是模型在 benchmark 上可能能学会格式，但一到真实多轮、多工具、参数约束复杂的场景就容易失真。GenesisFunc 的目标，是把“工具选择—多轮对话生成—执行校验—数据筛选”做成一条自动化流水线，让生成数据同时满足可执行、覆盖广、对话自然、可扩展到下游工具四个条件。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是训练目标或 scaling 层面的工作，更接近 post-train 数据工程；但对“模型如何学会调用外部环境”这个接口问题有现实意义。它的价值主要有三点。第一，它把 function-calling 数据构造从单轮模板扩展到多轮、多任务、带历史依赖的对话，这比只做 schema matching 更接近真实 agent 使用形态。第二，它强调 API 可靠性和可执行验证，而不是只靠模型自评，这一点对任何工具学习数据合成都重要。第三，它展示了同一套生成数据既可用于 SFT，也可进一步接到 RL 强化多轮工具使用，这对 pretrain↔post-train 闭环有一点启发。不过从贡献量级看，它更像一套做得较完整的数据生成 recipe，而不是改变建模范式的方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三段。第一段是工具种子选择。作者没有从开放网页随意抓 API，也没有完全手工写 toy tools，而是从 BFCL 中挑选经过验证、覆盖多个领域的工具作为 seed set。这样做的原因很直接：如果 API 本身不稳定，后面生成再多数据也只是把噪声放大。第二段是多智能体对话生成模块，这是全文的主体。其设计重点不是简单让多个 agent 轮流写对话，而是给不同 agent 明确分工，用历史感知的角色分化和参数槽位控制来提升场景多样性。可以理解为：有的 agent 负责构造用户意图和上下文，有的负责规划工具使用路径，有的负责填充参数与单位，有的负责从对话历史中制造合理的追问、修正和多任务切换。这样生成出来的样本不只是“用户一句话—模型调一个函数”，而是包含多轮澄清、参数补全、跨工具组合、上下文延续等结构。第三段是多阶段评估模块。作者把规则校验、模型判分和人工抽检串起来：规则层主要检查 schema 一致性、参数合法性、调用可执行性；模型层评估对话自然度、任务完成度和工具调用合理性；最后再做定向人工复核。这个设计的关键点在于把“语言上像对的”和“执行上真能跑的”分开处理，避免只优化表面流畅度。
summary.experiments: 实验设置是用生成数据对 Qwen3-8B 做监督微调，得到 GenesisFunc-8B，然后在 BFCL、API-Bank、ACEBench 上做 zero-shot 评测。作者强调了两个维度：一是 in-domain，即工具来源相关的 BFCL；二是 out-of-domain，即 API-Bank 和 ACEBench，用来看泛化。全文给出的结论是，GenesisFunc-8B 在统一评测协议下持续超过同规模开源基线，并且和若干 API-based 闭源模型保持接近竞争力。就论文提供的信息看，最重要的不是某一个绝对分数，而是三类实验信号。其一，数据质量控制确实有用：多阶段过滤后，训练样本的准确性和可执行性提升，模型最终 FC 成功率也随之上升。其二，多智能体生成比单一生成器更能覆盖多轮和多任务场景，尤其在需要历史依赖和参数补全的样本上更明显。其三，作者还验证了生成数据可继续用于 RL，进一步改善多轮对话中的 function-calling 表现，这说明数据格式和环境接口设计不是只服务于一次性 SFT。遗憾的是，当前给出的全文片段没有完整保留所有表格数字，因此无法在这里精确复述每个 benchmark 的具体分数、提升幅度和样本规模；精读时需要直接核对实验表与附录。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看三处。第一是 Introduction 和方法总览图，先确认作者到底把问题定义成“数据生成”还是“工具学习算法”；这决定了阅读预期。第二是多智能体生成模块，尤其是各 agent 的职责划分、历史感知机制、参数槽位选择策略，以及它们如何具体增加多样性而不牺牲正确性。第三是 evaluation pipeline 和消融实验，要看清楚规则校验、模型打分、人工审核各自拦住了什么类型的坏样本。实验部分建议优先看 BFCL→API-Bank/ACEBench 的迁移结果，以及单轮/多轮、多工具/单工具的拆分表现。如果时间有限，30–40 分钟足够抓住主线；如果要判断是否能复用到自己的数据合成流程，再补看附录中的 prompt、过滤规则和人工评审协议。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a data bottleneck rather than a new function-calling model. The central question is how to build training data for tool use that is executable, diverse, multi-turn, and scalable across tools. Existing synthetic pipelines often fail for four recurring reasons: unreliable APIs, poor tool scalability, shallow scenario coverage, and weak quality control. As a result, models may learn output format compliance but still fail in realistic settings involving clarification turns, parameter completion, multi-tool composition, and history-dependent interaction. GenesisFunc is designed as an end-to-end pipeline that turns tool selection, dialogue synthesis, execution checking, and data filtering into a more controlled production process.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense; it sits closer to post-training data construction. Still, it matters for foundation-model researchers because tool use is increasingly the interface between pretrained models and external environments. The contribution is practical rather than paradigm-shifting. First, it pushes FC data generation beyond single-turn schema matching toward multi-turn, multi-task, history-aware dialogues. Second, it treats API reliability and executability as first-class constraints, instead of relying mainly on model-side self-evaluation. Third, it shows that the resulting data can support both SFT and subsequent RL for multi-turn tool use, which is relevant to the pretrain-to-posttrain loop. The paper is best read as a fairly complete recipe for synthetic FC data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three stages. Stage one is tool seed selection. Instead of scraping arbitrary APIs or handcrafting toy tools, the pipeline starts from curated tools in BFCL. The motivation is straightforward: if the API layer is noisy, later data generation only amplifies that noise. Stage two is the multi-agent dialogue generation module, which is the main technical component. The key idea is not merely to let several agents write a conversation, but to assign differentiated roles with history-aware coordination and parameter-slot control. In practice, different agents handle user intent construction, tool-use planning, parameter and unit filling, and dialogue continuation such as clarification, correction, or task switching. This makes the generated samples structurally richer: not just one user utterance followed by one tool call, but multi-turn interactions with context carryover and compositional tool usage. Stage three is a multi-stage evaluation module that combines rule-based checks, model-based scoring, and targeted human review. Rule-based checks focus on schema conformity, argument validity, and executability; model-based scoring covers dialogue quality and tool-use plausibility; human review is used as a final safeguard. The important design choice is to separate linguistic plausibility from actual executable correctness.
summary_en.experiments: The main setup fine-tunes Qwen3-8B on GenesisFunc-generated data and evaluates the resulting GenesisFunc-8B in zero-shot mode on BFCL, API-Bank, and ACEBench. The benchmark choice is deliberate: BFCL tests in-domain performance because the tool seeds come from there, while API-Bank and ACEBench probe transfer to unseen tool settings. The headline result is that GenesisFunc-8B consistently beats open-source baselines of similar scale under a unified evaluation protocol and remains competitive with API-based proprietary systems. The most useful experimental signals are qualitative in structure. First, stronger filtering improves both data executability and downstream FC success. Second, multi-agent generation yields better coverage of multi-turn and multi-task scenarios than simpler generation pipelines, especially when history tracking and parameter completion matter. Third, the generated data is not limited to SFT; the paper also reports that it can be used in an RL stage to further improve multi-turn function-calling behavior. The full text excerpt provided here does not include all tables and exact numbers, so the precise benchmark scores, gains, and dataset sizes should be checked directly in the experimental section and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the pipeline overview to pin down the problem formulation: this is a data-generation paper, not a new tool-learning architecture. Second, inspect the multi-agent generation module, especially role decomposition, history-aware generation, and parameter-slot selection, because that is where most of the novelty sits. Third, read the evaluation pipeline and ablations to see which failure modes are removed by rule checks, model scoring, and human review respectively. In the experiments, prioritize BFCL versus API-Bank/ACEBench transfer, and any breakdown by single-turn vs multi-turn or single-tool vs multi-tool settings. Around 30–40 minutes should be enough for the main ideas; read the appendix only if you want to reuse the prompts, filtering rules, or annotation protocol.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“FC 数据工厂”配方看：重点盯多阶段评估/过滤怎么做、失败样例是什么；若无强消融，结论当中等强度信号。
recommendation.en: Read it as a function-calling data-factory recipe: focus on the multi-stage eval/filtering and failure cases; without strong ablations, treat gains as medium-strength evidence.

paper.title: DenoiseRL: Bootstrapping Reasoning Models to Recover from Noisy Prefixes
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for advancing reasoning in large language models, yet most existing methods still depend on stronger teacher models or heavily curated difficult datasets, limiting scalable capability improvement. In this paper, we introduce DenoiseRL, a reinforcement learning framework that substitutes external supervision with recovery-oriented optimization over failures from weak models. Instead of relying on stronger supervision or carefully engineered dat

summary.core_problem: 在没有更强教师模型或人工构建的高难度数据集的情况下，如何通过强化学习（RL）持续提升大语言模型的推理能力？
summary.importance: 提出了一种不依赖外部强监督信号的 RL 范式，将弱模型的错误转化为训练信号，为解决 RL 训练中数据扩展性和教师模型依赖问题提供了一条新路径，对 self-correction 机制的训练有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DenoiseRL 框架，将弱模型生成的错误推理轨迹作为“结构化噪声前缀”注入到策略模型的生成过程中。模型被要求从这些错误的中间状态中恢复，并继续推理出正确答案。这种方法将推理 RL 转化为一个去噪问题，通过强制模型在训练中面对并纠正错误，隐式地增加了训练难度，并显式地将自我纠错（self-correction）作为训练目标，而非仅仅是涌现能力。
summary.experiments: 在数学和通用推理基准测试中，DenoiseRL 稳定提升了 GRPO 和 DAPO 的性能。消融实验揭示了两个关键设计原则：1. 噪声强度需适中，过长或过错的前缀会导致模型陷入过度思考（overthinking）和训练不稳定；2. 在 PPO 风格的优化中，对 off-policy 的前缀进行更新会导致训练不稳定，应进行掩码处理。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对 weak-to-strong 范式局限性的分析，以及 Method 部分关于如何将错误前缀转化为去噪目标的具体实现。实验部分关注前缀长度对模型 overthinking 现象的影响分析。

summary_en.core_problem: How to continuously improve the reasoning capabilities of LLMs via Reinforcement Learning (RL) without relying on stronger teacher models or manually curated hard datasets?
summary_en.importance: Introduces a novel RL paradigm that eliminates the need for external strong supervision by repurposing weak model errors as training signals. This offers a scalable solution to the data bottleneck and teacher dependency in RL, providing direct insights into training self-correction mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DenoiseRL, a framework that injects erroneous reasoning trajectories generated by a weak model as 'structured noisy prefixes' into the policy model's rollouts. The model is trained to recover from these corrupted intermediate states and deduce the correct answer. This casts reasoning RL as a denoising problem, implicitly increasing training difficulty and explicitly targeting self-correction as a training objective rather than relying on it as an emergent behavior.
summary_en.experiments: DenoiseRL consistently improves the performance of GRPO and DAPO across math and general reasoning benchmarks. Ablation studies reveal two critical design principles: 1. Noise intensity must be controlled; overly long or severely corrupted prefixes induce overthinking and training instability. 2. Updating off-policy prefixes in PPO-style optimization leads to instability and should be masked.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the critique of the weak-to-strong paradigm, and the Method section for the mechanics of converting error prefixes into denoising targets. In the experiments, pay attention to the analysis of how prefix length affects the overthinking phenomenon.

recommendation.zh: 用模型自身错误轨迹做RL恢复训练的思路值得关注，减少对强教师的依赖，但实验细节未完整展示，建议关注后续完整版本。
recommendation.en: The idea of using a model's own error trajectories for RL recovery training is interesting for reducing teacher model dependence, but experimental details are incomplete—watch for the full version.

paper.title: The Strongest Teacher Is Not Always the Best Teacher: Student-Centric Answer Selection
paper.abstract: LLM training increasingly relies on teacher-generated supervision, from synthetic responses to reasoning traces and tool-use demonstrations. Current practice often chooses the highest-performing teacher to generate student training data, implicitly treating teacher test performance as a proxy for teaching quality. We show that this assumption can fail: even when multiple teachers provide correct answers to the same question, the answer from the strongest teacher is not necessarily the best super

summary.core_problem: 在“多教师生成、答案都正确”的前提下，如何为特定学生模型选择更合适的监督答案：教师越强并不必然越会教，强教师生成的正确答案可能对当前学生的学习更新代价更高、反而学得更差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在数据合成/蒸馏与持续训练接口：1）把“合成数据质量”从 teacher-centric（看教师测评分）改成 student-centric（看学生当前参数状态下的学习成本）；2）提供一个可计算、近似前向的打分指标，适合在大规模合成数据管线里做在线/迭代式筛选；3）对多教师混合、self-distill、curriculum、以及 mid-train 阶段的“数据配比与难度控制”有直接可用的机制。它更偏 post-train/蒸馏 recipe，但方法论上能反哺 continual pretrain 的数据选择。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 SCAS（Student-Centric Answer Sampling）。设每个问题 q 有一组“已验证正确”的教师答案集合 A(q)，训练时不是固定选某个最强教师，而是在候选答案里按“学生中心学习成本”采样。
关键在于如何定义并高效估计学习成本：
- 从监督微调的梯度出发，考虑对学生某个权重矩阵 W 的梯度 ∂L/∂W 的平方 Frobenius 范数，作为该 (q,a) 序列对学生造成的更新负担。
- 将 token 位置划分为问题 token（conditioning, Q）与答案 token（A），把梯度范数展开成 token 两两内积的和，并分解成 AA（答案-答案）、AQ/QA（答案-问题交互）、QQ（问题-问题）三块。这个分解解释了“同样正确的答案”也会因为 token 交互结构不同而对学生产生不同更新压力。
- 为避免对每个候选答案都做反向传播，作者推导了一个 forward-only 的代理指标来近似上述学习成本（核心是用前向可得的表征与误差信号去估计梯度交互项），从而能在大候选池里快速打分。
- 训练时按该成本进行采样：优先选择低成本、与当前学生更匹配的答案，而不是默认选择最强教师的答案。整体是一个可迭代的过程：学生更新后，成本估计也随之变化，形成隐式 curriculum。
summary.experiments:
实验设置强调“控制变量”：比较不同教师的教学效果时，只在“九个教师都答对”的最大公共子集上生成训练数据，从而把差异尽量归因于答案作为监督的可学性，而不是正确率。
作者在 DeepScaleR、GSM8K、MATH 等任务上，用 Qwen2.5 不同尺寸学生做对比，观察到教师测试准确率与学生最终准确率不单调对应。
更大规模实验：从约 30 个开源/闭源模型收集候选答案，在 6 个学生基座、6 个任务上评估 SCAS。论文摘录未包含具体提升数字与统计显著性细节；需要在结果表中核对：
- SCAS 相对“选最强教师/随机选/按 teacher 分数选”的提升幅度；
- forward-only 代理与真实梯度成本的相关性；
- 采样温度/成本归一化等超参敏感性；
- 是否存在偏向短答案或模板化答案的副作用（这会影响泛化）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 45–60 分钟）：
- 先看引言里的 controlled comparison（九教师公共正确子集）与 Figure 2：这是“强教师不一定会教”的核心证据。
- 然后精读方法 2.2：forward-only 代理怎么从梯度分解落到可计算打分，哪些近似假设最关键。
- 最后看实验消融：代理相关性、不同学生规模下的收益、以及候选池大小对收益的影响。
如果只想拿来用：重点关注实现细节（验证正确性的流程、候选答案去重/过滤、以及在线更新时的计算开销）。

summary_en.core_problem: Given multiple verified-correct teacher answers per question, how to select supervision that best teaches a specific student model—since the highest-performing teacher’s answer is not necessarily the most learnable or beneficial for that student.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly to synthetic-data distillation and continual training pipelines: it reframes supervision quality as student-dependent, introduces a scalable scoring proxy that can be used in large answer pools, and implicitly implements a curriculum that adapts as the student changes. This is closer to post-training / distillation recipe work than core pretraining, but the data-selection principle is directly reusable in mid-training and continual pretraining where synthetic instruction data is mixed in.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SCAS (Student-Centric Answer Sampling) operates in a candidate-answer setting: for each question q, there is a set of verified-correct teacher answers A(q). Instead of picking the strongest teacher, SCAS samples answers according to an estimated student-centric learning cost.
The cost is motivated by gradient mechanics in SFT:
- Consider the squared Frobenius norm of the gradient on a student weight matrix W induced by the concatenated sequence x=[q;a].
- Expand the gradient norm into pairwise token interaction terms, then partition token indices into question (Q) and answer (A) positions, yielding AA (answer–answer), AQ/QA (answer–conditioning interactions), and QQ (conditioning–conditioning) blocks.
- This decomposition explains why two correct answers can differ in how much parameter change they demand from the current student.
- To avoid per-candidate backprop, the paper derives a forward-only proxy to approximate the learning cost using signals available from forward passes (representations and error-related quantities), enabling efficient scoring over large candidate pools.
Training then samples lower-cost answers more often, aligning supervision with the student’s current capabilities and effectively creating an adaptive curriculum.
summary_en.experiments:
A key design is a controlled teacher comparison: when evaluating “teaching quality,” they restrict training to the largest common subset of questions where all compared teachers are correct, so differences are not driven by answer correctness.
They test across reasoning tasks such as DeepScaleR, GSM8K, and MATH with Qwen2.5 students of multiple sizes, showing teacher test accuracy does not monotonically predict student gains.
They also collect candidate answers from ~30 open/closed models and evaluate across 6 student base models and 6 tasks. The provided excerpt does not include the exact deltas; in the full paper, the critical checks are: SCAS vs strongest-teacher selection, correlation between the proxy and true gradient cost, sensitivity to sampling hyperparameters, and whether the method implicitly favors shorter/more templated answers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes):
- Start with the controlled comparison setup (and the main figure showing non-monotonic teacher→student transfer). That is the empirical motivation.
- Then read the derivation of the forward-only proxy (Section 2.2): identify the approximations and what signals are required from the student forward pass.
- Finally, scan ablations: proxy-vs-true-cost correlation, gains across student sizes, and scaling with candidate pool size.
If you want to implement it, focus on the “verified correct” filtering pipeline, candidate deduplication, and the runtime overhead of scoring during iterative training.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它直接挑战“强教师=好监督”这个偷懒 prior；先看方法推导和多教师对比表，若 proxy 与真实学习收益相关性站得住，内部数据筛选策略该立刻重做。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it directly challenges the lazy prior that the strongest teacher gives the best supervision; check the proxy derivation and multi-teacher tables first—if the correlation with actual student gain is clean, your synthetic data selection pipeline likely needs revision.

paper.title: CUA-Gym: Scaling Verifiable Training Environments and Tasks for Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven breakthroughs in domains such as math, tool-use, and software engineering, yet its extension to computer-use agents (CUAs) has been bottlenecked by the scarcity of scalable training data with deterministic rewards. Constructing such data for CUAs requires consistent task instruction, executable environment, and verifiable reward. However, hand-curated benchmarks achieve high reward fidelity but cover few applications and LLM-as-jud

summary.core_problem: 计算机使用代理（CUA）的可验证强化学习（RLVR）训练存在结构性数据瓶颈：手工构建的基准应用覆盖范围窄，LLM打分的数据集奖励信号不可靠，代码原生环境管道规模有限。没有现有方法能同时满足CUA RLVR的三个核心要求：确定性可验证奖励、广泛应用覆盖、可扩展任务多样性，导致CUA无法复刻数学、代码领域RLVR带来的能力跃升。
summary.importance: 将RLVR的规模化数据合成范式拓展到CUA领域，打通了CUA能力 scaling 的核心数据瓶颈；提出环境多样性是独立于任务数据量的新增scaling轴，补充了现有智能体scaling law的研究维度；生成的数据集和可复用环境池可直接支撑开源CUA基座的RL后训练，验证了小参数量MoE模型通过RLVR可匹配10倍参数的未训练基座性能，为低资源智能体训练提供了可落地的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 多代理协同的任务三元组联合生成管道：Generator代理构造初始环境和任务完成后的黄金环境，Discriminator代理仅基于任务描述编写奖励函数，Orchestrator代理驱动二者迭代验证，直到奖励函数能在执行时准确区分两种环境状态；2. 采用严格信息隔离机制防止奖励黑客，最后通过LLM多数投票+代理轨迹回放过滤不合格样本；3. 环境规模化方案：基于O*NET职业分类和Anthropic经济指数的软件使用分布选择目标应用，通过多代理合成自包含的模拟网页应用并做自动化交互测试，形成可复用、可重置的CUA-GYM-HUB环境池，将环境构建与任务生成解耦，每个环境可生成数千个不同任务。
summary.experiments: 生成32112个经过验证的RLVR训练三元组，覆盖110个环境（16个桌面应用+94个模拟网页应用）；使用GSPO算法在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B和Qwen3.5-397B-A17B两个MoE基座上做RLVR训练，在OSWorld-Verified基准上分别达到62.1%和72.6%的准确率，35B模型的性能与未训练的397B基座相当，参数量仅为后者的1/10左右；训练后的模型在WebArena基准上也有性能提升，验证了模拟环境到真实浏览器的迁移性；性能随数据量和环境池规模平滑提升，环境池从10个扩展到80个带来的收益无法通过单纯增加轨迹数量覆盖；RL训练自发涌现多动作工具调用能力，相同任务性能下轨迹长度压缩33%-45%。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第3章的多代理生成管道设计细节，重点关注信息隔离和迭代验证机制；精读第4章的环境规模化方法和CUA-GYM-HUB的实现逻辑；重点看第5章的scaling实验结果，尤其是环境多样性与数据量的scaling曲线对比，以及RL训练涌现多动作调用的消融分析；附录的环境列表和数据过滤规则可作为实际构建训练数据的参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Scalable verifiable reinforcement learning (RLVR) training data for computer-use agents (CUAs) faces a structural bottleneck: hand-curated benchmarks have narrow application coverage, LLM-as-judge datasets produce unreliable reward signals, and code-native environment pipelines lack sufficient scale. No existing approach simultaneously meets the three core requirements for CUA RLVR: deterministic verifiable rewards, broad application coverage, and scalable task diversity, preventing CUAs from replicating the capability gains RLVR has delivered in math and code domains.
summary_en.importance: It extends the scalable RLVR data synthesis paradigm to the CUA domain, removing the core data bottleneck for CUA capability scaling. It identifies environment diversity as an independent scaling axis complementary to task volume, expanding existing research on agent scaling laws. The released dataset and reusable environment pool directly support RL post-training for open-source CUA base models, and validates that smaller MoE models can match the performance of 10x larger untrained base models via RLVR, providing actionable guidance for low-resource agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. A multi-agent collaborative pipeline for joint generation of task tuples: a Generator agent constructs the initial environment state and golden post-task state, a Discriminator agent writes reward functions solely based on task descriptions, and an Orchestrator agent drives iterative refinement until the reward function reliably distinguishes the two states during execution. 2. Strict information isolation prevents reward hacking, and a final filtering step combining LLM majority voting and agent rollouts removes low-quality tuples. 3. An environment scaling framework: target applications are selected based on O*NET occupational taxonomies and Anthropic Economic Index software usage distributions. Multi-agent synthesis builds self-contained mock web applications with automated interactive testing, forming the reusable, resettable CUA-GYM-HUB environment pool that decouples environment construction from task generation, enabling thousands of distinct tasks per environment.
summary_en.experiments: The pipeline produces 32,112 verified RLVR training tuples across 110 environments (16 desktop applications + 94 synthetic mock web applications). RLVR training with GSPO on two open-source MoE backbones (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) reaches 62.1% and 72.6% accuracy respectively on OSWorld-Verified, with the 35B model matching the performance of the untrained 397B base at ~1/10 the parameter count. Trained checkpoints also show improvements on the WebArena benchmark, demonstrating transfer from synthetic mock environments to real browser settings. Performance scales smoothly with both data volume and environment pool size; expanding the environment pool from 10 to 80 delivers gains that cannot be replicated by increasing trajectory volume alone. RL training also spontaneously induces multi-action tool calls, reducing trajectory length by 33-45% at matched task performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for details of the multi-agent generation pipeline, especially the information isolation and iterative verification mechanisms. Read Section 4 for the environment scaling methodology and CUA-GYM-HUB implementation logic. Prioritize Section 5's scaling experiment results, specifically the comparison of environment diversity vs. data volume scaling curves, and ablation analysis of emergent multi-action tool calls. The appendix environment list and data filtering rules serve as a practical reference for building custom training datasets.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法和过滤 ablation；它把 RLVR 的瓶颈从“有没有题”推进到“奖励函数能否被程序化合成”。
recommendation.en: Read the method and filtering ablations; it shifts the RLVR bottleneck from task availability to whether reward functions can be programmatically synthesized.

paper.title: AnE: Pushing the Reasoning Frontier of Multimodal LLMs via Anchor Evolution
paper.abstract: Post-training via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) is crucial for enhancing reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet existing paradigms often reach a performance bottleneck due to the limitations of static data. While current methods leverage self-reflection or self-evolution to push these boundaries, they still suffer from cognitive drift and hallucinated reasoning paths caused by low-quality synthetic data. To address these challenges, we propose A

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多模态推理模型在后训练阶段很容易遇到的一个具体瓶颈：静态 SFT/RL 数据很快被模型吃干，后续提升缺少针对性；而纯自演化合成数据虽然能持续扩展难度，却容易把错误推理路径、幻觉知识和教师分布偏差一并放大。论文想解决的不是单次训练技巧，而是如何让后训练数据随着模型能力一起演化，同时又不把训练过程带偏。它把问题落在“失败前沿”上：先找出模型当前最容易出错、但又最有提升空间的区域，再用可验证的真实知识作为锚点去扩展训练样本，最后把外部提示逐步蒸馏成模型自身能力。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它虽然是多模态 post-train 工作，但核心关切其实是训练信号质量与数据闭环设计，这和预训练里的数据配比、数据清洗、持续训练中的分布漂移问题是同一类问题。第二，它给出了一种比“模型自己造数据再自己学”更稳的演化路线：用真实数据库检索到的 truth anchors 约束数据生成，再用 SFT+RL 分工完成能力注入与模板去除。这个思路对 reasoning continual training、mid-train curriculum、以及 RL 不能凭空创造新能力的讨论都有直接参考价值。贡献量级上，它更像一个扎实的训练框架与数据构造范式，而不是新的基础模型架构。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三个环节组成，而且三者是串起来的。第一步是 Failing-Frontier Discovery。作者不是直接在全量种子集上做扩充，而是先让当前模型对种子数据做多次 rollout，观察哪些题目稳定失败、哪些推理轨迹暴露出明显短板。随后再用教师模型对这些失败样本做诊断，抽取失败相关的关键词、知识点和提示信息。这样做的目的，是把后续数据构造对准模型当前能力边界，而不是泛泛增加训练量。

第二步是 Truth Anchor Expansion。这是全文最关键的设计。作者不信任闭环自生成数据的事实性和逻辑一致性，因此引入外部真实数据库，从失败样本对应的知识点出发检索“truth anchors”。这些 anchor 不是直接当答案，而是作为高保真参考，用来构造新的训练样本、补充背景知识、校正推理链中的事实节点。和常见 self-evolution 不同，这里数据扩展的约束来自外部可验证知识，而不是教师模型自由发挥。这样可以减少 synthetic QA 中常见的逻辑错配、答案漂移和越迭代越偏的问题。

第三步是 Scaffold-Stripping Mechanism。作者把教师提示显式写进训练样本，先形成 scaffold-augmented supervision，让模型在带脚手架的条件下学会正确推理路径；然后再通过 RL 去掉这些脚手架，让模型不依赖固定提示模板也能完成推理。这里的分工很清楚：SFT 负责把新知识和正确轨迹灌进去，RL 负责把外显提示内化成行为习惯。这个设计背后有一个明确判断：如果直接用 RL 从稀疏正确率奖励里学复杂多模态推理，信号太弱；如果只做 SFT，模型又容易记住模板而不是形成稳定能力。

从方法定位看，AnE 不是单纯的数据检索增强，也不是普通 teacher-student 蒸馏。它更像一个面向 reasoning frontier 的迭代式训练循环：失败诊断决定学什么，truth anchor 决定学的内容是否可信，scaffold stripping 决定能力能否脱离外部支架独立存在。
summary.experiments:
论文以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 为底座，在 8 个多模态推理 benchmark 上评测。文中给出的总结果是：相对 base model，AnE 多轮迭代后平均提升 10.3%。作者特别强调在 MathVision 和 EMMA 这类较难数据集上保持了领先表现，说明收益不只来自简单题或分布内题目。

从实验结构看，最值得注意的不是单个分数，而是“持续提升”这一点。作者把 AnE 和静态数据后训练、以及纯 self-evolution 路线做比较，结论是静态数据方法很快进入平台期，而 AnE 在多轮迭代中还能继续涨，说明 failing frontier 驱动的数据更新确实在不断对准新短板。另一组关键对比是 truth anchor 的作用：去掉真实锚点后，性能提升会变弱，而且更容易出现 reasoning drift，说明外部可验证知识不是锦上添花，而是闭环演化能否稳定的核心条件。

脚手架机制的消融也很重要。只做 scaffold SFT 而不做后续 RL，模型会更依赖提示格式，泛化和自由生成能力不足；只做 RL 而没有前面的 scaffold supervision，则很难稳定学到正确轨迹。两者结合时效果最好，和作者在引言里对 SFT 与 RL 分工的判断一致。

受限于给出的全文片段，部分 benchmark 的逐项数字、迭代轮数细节、以及各消融的精确幅度没有完全展开；但从正文描述可以确认，实验重点是验证三件事：一是相对静态数据的持续增益，二是相对纯合成演化的数据质量优势，三是 SFT 注入 + RL 内化这一训练分工的必要性。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只花一小时，优先看三处。第一是方法总览图和 Failing-Frontier Discovery 部分，理解作者如何定义“失败前沿”，以及为什么要用多次 rollout 而不是单次错误样本筛选。这里关系到整个框架是不是在做真正的 targeted training。第二是 Truth Anchor Expansion 的实现细节，重点看 anchor 的来源、检索条件、如何从 anchor 构造成新样本，以及它和教师生成内容各自承担什么角色。这里决定这篇工作的含金量。第三是 scaffold-stripping 的训练流程和消融表，判断 RL 到底是在提升正确率，还是在做模板去除与行为内化。

图表上建议重点看：总框架图、不同迭代轮次的性能曲线、truth anchor 与无 anchor 的对比、以及 scaffold/RL 相关消融。如果有案例分析，优先看失败样本如何被诊断、检索、再构造成训练数据，这能直接看出方法是否真的避免了 synthetic drift。

值得深挖的点有三个。其一，truth anchor 的质量上限由外部数据库覆盖率决定，这会不会把方法限制在可检索知识密集的任务上。其二，教师模型在失败诊断和提示生成中仍然扮演重要角色，教师偏差是否会通过 scaffold 间接注入。其三，这套框架能否迁移到纯文本 reasoning continual pretrain，或者更一般的 mid-training data refresh 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in multimodal reasoning post-training: static SFT/RL datasets saturate quickly, while self-evolving synthetic data can keep expanding but often amplifies logical errors, hallucinated reasoning paths, and teacher-distribution mismatch. The real problem is not just data scarcity. It is how to keep training data adaptive to the model’s current failure frontier without letting the optimization loop drift away from reliable knowledge. AnE frames this as a closed-loop evolution problem: identify where the model currently fails, retrieve verified external anchors around those failures, and then convert teacher-guided reasoning into internalized capability.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the value is less about multimodal benchmark chasing and more about training-signal design. The paper is a useful case study in how data quality, adaptivity, and distribution alignment interact in iterative training. It also reinforces a view that has become increasingly important in reasoning work: SFT is better at injecting new patterns and knowledge, while RL is better at consolidating and de-scaffolding behavior. In that sense, AnE is relevant to continual pretraining, mid-training curriculum refresh, and any setting where synthetic data loops risk compounding model errors. The contribution is a practical training paradigm rather than a new base architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AnE consists of three tightly coupled stages.

First, Failing-Frontier Discovery. Instead of expanding data uniformly, the model is rolled out multiple times on a seed set to expose unstable or consistently failing regions. A teacher model then analyzes these failures and extracts failure-relevant keywords, hints, and diagnostic signals. This makes the next round of training target the model’s current capability boundary rather than a generic task distribution.

Second, Truth Anchor Expansion. This is the central idea. Rather than trusting synthetic QA pairs generated inside a self-evolution loop, the method retrieves verified samples from an external real-world database as truth anchors. These anchors are used as high-fidelity references for constructing new training examples, enriching missing knowledge, and correcting factual or logical nodes in reasoning chains. The key distinction from standard self-evolution is that data growth is constrained by externally grounded evidence, not only by teacher generations. That directly addresses cognitive drift and hallucinated trajectories.

Third, Scaffold-Stripping Mechanism. Teacher hints are first injected explicitly into training examples, producing scaffold-augmented supervision for SFT. This gives the student a guided path toward correct reasoning. RL is then used to remove the scaffolds, so the model learns to reproduce the behavior without depending on explicit templates or hints. The division of labor is deliberate: SFT introduces the reasoning pattern and missing knowledge; RL turns externally visible guidance into an internalized policy.

Conceptually, AnE is not just retrieval augmentation and not just distillation. It is an iterative reasoning-training loop where failure diagnosis decides what to learn, truth anchors decide what can be trusted, and scaffold stripping decides whether the learned behavior survives after the support is removed.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the base model and evaluate on eight multimodal reasoning benchmarks. The headline result reported in the paper is an average improvement of 10.3% over the base model after multiple AnE iterations. The paper also highlights strong performance on difficult benchmarks such as MathVision and EMMA.

The more interesting result is the shape of improvement over iterations. Static-data post-training reaches a plateau relatively early, while AnE continues to improve across rounds, which supports the claim that failure-frontier targeting keeps exposing useful new supervision. Another important comparison is the role of truth anchors. Removing the anchor mechanism weakens gains and makes the evolution loop more prone to reasoning drift, suggesting that verified external grounding is not optional but central to stability.

The scaffold mechanism is also tested through ablations. Scaffolded SFT without the RL stripping stage tends to leave the model dependent on prompt-like support. RL without prior scaffold supervision struggles to learn stable reasoning from sparse answer rewards alone. The combination works best, matching the paper’s broader argument about the complementary roles of SFT and RL.

The provided full-text excerpt does not expose every benchmark-level number or all ablation magnitudes, but the experimental logic is clear: sustained gains over iterative rounds, better stability than synthetic-only evolution, and a meaningful benefit from the SFT-then-RL decomposition.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the method overview figure and the section on Failing-Frontier Discovery. The key question is whether the paper is truly doing targeted training or just relabeling hard-example mining. Then read Truth Anchor Expansion carefully. Focus on where anchors come from, how retrieval is conditioned on failures, and how anchors are turned into new supervision. That is the part that determines whether the framework is genuinely more reliable than synthetic self-evolution.

After that, read the scaffold-stripping section together with its ablations. The main thing to verify is what RL is actually contributing: better reasoning, better template removal, or both. If the paper includes case studies, inspect examples where a failed trajectory is diagnosed, linked to an anchor, and reconstructed into a training sample. Those examples are often more revealing than aggregate scores.

The most useful figures and tables are the iterative performance curves, anchor vs. no-anchor comparisons, and scaffold/RL ablations. For deeper follow-up, three questions matter: how dependent the method is on database coverage, how much teacher bias still enters through failure diagnosis and hints, and whether the same recipe could transfer to text-only reasoning continual training.
