paper.title: QUEST: Training Frontier Deep Research Agents with Fully Synthetic Tasks
paper.abstract: Deep research agents extend the role of search engines from retrieving keyword-matched pages to synthesizing knowledge, fundamentally changing how humans interact with information. However, frontier systems remain proprietary, while existing open agents often generalize poorly across different task types, leaving unclear how to train a broadly capable deep research agent. We release QUEST, a family of open models (ranging from 2B to 35B) that serve as general-purpose deep research agents designe

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单点能力，而是“通用 deep research agent 怎么训练”这个配方问题。作者把任务拆成三类彼此相关但训练信号不同的能力：fact seeking、citation grounding、report synthesis。难点在于，这三类能力横跨客观可验证任务和开放式主观任务，现有开源工作通常只覆盖其中一类，或者只有 SFT，没有把中期训练、长轨迹上下文管理、rubric 驱动的 RL 放进同一套流程里。Quest 试图回答的是：在完全开源、且大量依赖合成任务的条件下，能否训练出一个在长时程检索、证据归因和报告写作上都比较均衡的研究代理。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发大于对纯 pretrain 本身的直接推进。它的重要性主要有三点。第一，它把 deep research agent 的训练拆成可复现的 recipe：mid-training → SFT → RL，而不是只给一个 agent scaffold。第二，它强调“任务可验证性结构”本身就是训练信号设计的核心，尤其是 tree-structured rubric 这一层，把开放式报告任务也部分转成了可优化的分层奖励。第三，它给出一个比较清楚的结论：如果目标是长时程信息搜集与综合，单靠 instruction tuning 不够，模型需要在中期训练阶段先适应搜索式轨迹和外部证据读写，再用 rubric 奖励做能力整合。对做通用 agent pretraining、tool-use mid-training、以及 synthetic curriculum 的人，这篇比单纯 benchmark paper 更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三根主线。第一是数据合成。作者构建 Quest-8K，一条样本不是简单的 query-answer，而是“复杂查询 + task-specific rubric tree”。这个 rubric tree 用来刻画完成任务需要覆盖的子问题、证据要求和输出结构，因此它既是监督信号，也是后续 RL 的奖励依据。相比只合成最终答案，这种做法更适合长时程任务，因为 agent 的中间行为和最终报告都能被分层评估。

第二是上下文管理。长轨迹 web research 的典型问题是上下文爆炸：搜索结果、网页片段、已发现事实、未解决子问题会迅速堆积。Quest 引入 compact summary 式的 context management，在轨迹推进过程中持续维护压缩后的信息状态，而不是把完整历史无差别塞回上下文。这个设计的意义不只是省 token，更是在训练时显式鼓励“记忆抽象”而不是“原文堆叠”。对 agent 来说，这比普通 RAG 式拼接更接近真实工作流。

第三是训练流程。论文强调完整配方是 MT、SFT、RL 三阶段，而不是任选其一。mid-training 用来让底座模型适应 deep research 相关分布和行为模式；SFT 负责把任务格式、工具调用、报告输出对齐到目标接口；RL 则利用 rubric-based signal 做最后的能力整合，尤其补 report synthesis 和 citation grounding 这类难以靠 exact match 学好的目标。与已有开源系统相比，Quest 的差异不在某个单独模块，而在于把三类能力放进统一训练目标，并且让客观任务和开放任务共享一套 rubric 驱动优化框架。
summary.experiments:
从文中给出的主结果看，Quest 覆盖 2B 到 35B 多个尺度，并在 8 个 benchmark 上评估三类能力。最关键的几个数字是：Quest-35B 在 BrowseComp 上 64.6%，在 Mind2Web 2 上 30.7%，在 DeepResearch Bench 上 48.2%，作者声称超过 OpenAI DeepResearch 等强闭源系统。这个结果如果按论文设定成立，说明统一 recipe 没有明显牺牲某一类能力来换另一类能力。

更有信息量的是训练阶段消融。图 2 和正文都在强调，已有开源方法往往只做 fact seeking 或 report synthesis，且常缺 mid-training 或 rubric RL。Quest 的对比意图很明确：只做 SFT 的系统能力覆盖不完整；加入 MT 后，模型对搜索式任务和长轨迹状态管理更稳；再加 RL，开放式报告和引用约束进一步提升。虽然当前给出的全文片段没有完整消融表数字，但作者明确把 controlled studies 作为主要贡献之一，并且指出小模型也能受益：Quest-2B-SFT、Quest-4B-SFT 已经有“impressive performance”。这说明收益不只来自大模型容量，也来自训练信号设计。

另一个值得注意的实验结论是 scaling。作者覆盖 2B、4B、9B 到 35B，意图展示 deep research agent 能力随模型规模提升，但不是只有大模型才可用。对隐私敏感场景，本地可部署的小模型 research agent 被单独点出，这意味着他们观察到 recipe 在小尺度上也有较好的 sample efficiency 或任务迁移性。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐段细抠。建议先看 Introduction 里对三类能力的定义，以及 Figure 2 的训练配方对比，先建立作者到底在补什么缺口。然后重点看数据合成部分，尤其 Quest-8K 和 rubric tree 的构造方式；这里决定了后面 RL 信号是否可信。再看 context management 章节，关注它维护了什么状态、压缩频率如何、是否会丢失证据链。最后看训练与消融，重点确认三件事：MT 到底喂了什么数据；RL 的 reward 如何从 rubric tree 落到可执行打分；不同能力上哪一阶段贡献最大。

如果时间只有 20–30 分钟，建议顺序是：Figure 1/2 → 数据合成章节 → 训练 recipe 章节 → 主结果表。若要深挖，优先看 rubric-based RL 的实现细节，因为这部分最接近可迁移的方法论；其次看小模型结果，判断这套配方到底是在“放大底座能力”，还是主要依赖大模型先验。
summary.authors_note: OSU NLP 团队；从正文页眉可见为 Ohio State University 相关工作。当前给出的全文片段未包含完整作者列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a recipe question rather than a single capability: how to train a broadly capable deep-research agent in an open and reproducible way. The authors frame the problem around three coupled abilities with different supervision regimes: fact seeking, citation grounding, and report synthesis. Existing open systems usually cover only one slice of this space, or rely on SFT alone, leaving unclear how to combine long-horizon search behavior, evidence tracking, and open-ended writing into one trainable pipeline. Quest is an attempt to build that unified recipe under fully synthetic task generation.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is at the pretrain/post-train boundary, not in core language-model pretraining alone. Three points matter. First, it turns deep-research-agent training into a concrete stack: mid-training, then SFT, then RL, instead of presenting only an agent framework. Second, it argues that task structure itself should be part of the training signal; the tree-structured rubric is not just an evaluator, but a way to make open-ended report writing partially optimizable. Third, it suggests that instruction tuning alone is insufficient for long-horizon evidence-seeking agents. Models benefit from an intermediate adaptation stage to search-style trajectories and external evidence handling, followed by rubric-based RL to integrate capabilities. That makes the paper relevant to tool-use mid-training, synthetic curricula, and agent-oriented continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. The first is synthetic data construction. Quest-8K is built as more than query-answer pairs: each instance couples a complex research query with a task-specific rubric tree. The rubric encodes subgoals, evidence requirements, and output structure, so it serves both as supervision and as the basis for downstream reward design. Compared with synthesizing only final answers, this is better aligned with long-horizon tasks because both intermediate behavior and final reports can be assessed in a structured way.

The second component is context management. Long web-research trajectories quickly run into context bloat: search results, snippets, discovered facts, unresolved subproblems, and partial drafts all accumulate. Quest maintains compact summaries of the evolving information state instead of naively replaying the full history into the context window. This is not only a token-saving trick. It pushes the model toward abstraction and state tracking, which is closer to how a practical research agent should operate than simple retrieval concatenation.

The third component is the training pipeline itself. The paper emphasizes a full MT → SFT → RL recipe. Mid-training adapts the base model to the distribution and behavior patterns of deep-research tasks. SFT aligns the model to the target interfaces for tool use, task formatting, and report generation. RL then uses rubric-based signals to improve the harder objectives, especially report synthesis and citation grounding, where exact-match supervision is weak or unavailable. The novelty is less about a single module and more about unifying objective and open-ended tasks under one rubric-driven optimization framework.
summary_en.experiments:
The reported results span model sizes from 2B to 35B and evaluate across eight benchmarks covering the three capability groups. The headline numbers are Quest-35B reaching 64.6% on BrowseComp, 30.7% on Mind2Web 2, and 48.2% on DeepResearch Bench, with the paper claiming it surpasses strong proprietary systems including OpenAI DeepResearch. If these results hold under the paper’s setup, the important point is that the unified recipe does not appear to trade away one capability class to gain another.

The more informative part is the stage-wise ablation story. Figure 2 and the surrounding discussion make a clear argument: prior open systems often support only fact seeking or only report synthesis, and many omit either mid-training or rubric-based RL. Quest is designed to show that SFT alone gives incomplete coverage; adding mid-training improves adaptation to search-style tasks and long-horizon state handling; adding RL further improves open-ended report quality and citation-constrained behavior. The excerpt provided here does not include the full ablation tables, but the paper explicitly positions controlled studies as a core contribution.

Another notable result is scaling behavior. The study covers 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B models, aiming to show that deep-research-agent capability scales with model size but is not exclusive to large models. The authors also highlight strong small-model results, including Quest-2B-SFT and Quest-4B-SFT, suggesting that the gains come not only from model capacity but also from better training signals and task structure.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, so read for recipe design rather than implementation minutiae. Start with the introduction and Figure 2 to understand the gap the authors are trying to fill: unified support for fact seeking, citation grounding, and report synthesis. Then read the synthetic data section carefully, especially how Quest-8K and the rubric trees are built, because that determines whether the later RL signal is meaningful. After that, inspect the context-management section and ask what state is preserved, how aggressively it is compressed, and whether evidence chains are lost. Finish with the training and ablation sections, focusing on three questions: what exactly is used in mid-training, how rubric trees are converted into executable rewards, and which stage contributes most to each capability.

If time is limited to 20–30 minutes, the best path is Figure 1/2, then the data synthesis section, then the training recipe, then the main result tables. If you want one part to study more deeply, choose the rubric-based RL design. That is the most transferable idea in the paper.

paper.title: MindLoom: Composing Thought Modes for Frontier-Level Reasoning Data Synthesis
paper.abstract: Although LLMs have made substantial progress in reasoning, systematically producing frontier-level reasoning data remains difficult. Existing synthesis methods often have limited visibility into the structural factors that govern problem difficulty, which can result in narrow diversity and unstable difficulty control. In this work, we view the difficulty of a reasoning problem as arising from the accumulation of atomic knowledge-reasoning transformations, which we term thought modes. Building on

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图解决高难推理 SFT 数据难以系统合成的问题：现有方法能生成题目或筛数据，但对“题目为什么难”的结构性控制较弱。
summary.importance: 它属于 post-train 数据合成工作，对预训练研究的启发主要在数据生成范式。论文把推理难度拆成可组合的 thought modes，即原子级知识-推理转换，再用这些单元生成新题。这种思路比直接让强模型“出难题”更可控，也更接近数据配方问题：不是只追求更多样本，而是控制样本中的推理结构分布。对基座训练而言，它提示 reasoning data 的质量可以从结构组合、覆盖度、稀缺模式采样等角度定义，而不只是按模型答错率或 benchmark 标签筛选。
summary.technical_approach: MindLoom 是四阶段 pipeline。第一阶段从已有高难题及其 verified solutions 出发，反向分解解题过程，抽取 thought mode chain。这里的反向分解不是恢复原作者如何命题，而是把复杂问题拆成一串可复用的知识-推理变换，形成 thought mode bank。第二阶段训练 embedding-based retriever，学习在给定问题状态下应该检索哪些 thought mode。第三阶段进行 distribution-aligned synthesis：从 seed question 出发，迭代检索并施加 thought modes，用相似性和稀缺性之间的权衡控制选择，避免生成题集中在常见推理类型上。第四阶段用多次 rollout、LLM judging、source provenance filtering 过滤生成样本，把判定正确的推理轨迹转成 SFT records。与普通蒸馏或自生成题不同，它的核心是先显式建模难度结构，再做组合式合成。
summary.experiments: 论文在 9 个 benchmark 上评估，覆盖 5 个 STEM 学科和 4 个数学推理任务，包括竞赛级题目。模型侧覆盖 Qwen3 和 Qwen3.5 系列的 4 个规模。对比基线包括 base model 直接推理、DS-V3.2 Distill、MegaScience、OpenThought 等外部 reasoning corpus。结果显示，使用 MindLoom 数据微调后的模型在多个任务上稳定优于这些基线，竞赛风格数学推理提升更明显。消融实验用于验证 thought mode extraction、retrieval、distribution-aligned sampling、rollout filtering 等模块各自的贡献；分布分析和 case study 用来说明生成题在 reasoning composition 上更分散，而不是只做表面改写。给定材料未提供具体分数表，因此不宜补写精确增益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–40 分钟。优先看方法部分的四阶段 pipeline，尤其是 thought mode 的定义、solution reverse engineering 的 prompt/过程、similarity-scarcity trade-off 如何控制采样。实验部分重点看与 OpenThought、MegaScience、distillation 数据的对比，以及 ablation 表。若关心预训练或 mid-training 数据配方，可以重点看 thought mode 分布分析；它比最终 benchmark 分数更能说明这套方法是否能带来可复用的数据构造信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of synthesizing frontier-level reasoning data in a controlled way. Existing methods can generate problems or select hard examples, but they often lack an explicit model of what makes a reasoning problem structurally difficult.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training data synthesis paper with useful implications for pretraining data design. Its main idea is to decompose reasoning difficulty into reusable atomic knowledge-reasoning transformations, called thought modes. This shifts reasoning data construction from generic hard-question generation to controlled composition over reasoning structures. For base-model researchers, the useful signal is that reasoning data quality can be characterized by structural coverage and scarcity of reasoning patterns, not only by model failure rate or benchmark labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: MindLoom uses a four-stage pipeline. First, it reverse-engineers verified solutions of hard problems into chains of thought modes, building a bank of reusable reasoning transformations. This is not meant to reconstruct the original problem-writing process; it is an operational decomposition that makes synthesis possible. Second, it trains an embedding-based retriever to choose the next applicable thought mode for a given problem state. Third, it performs distribution-aligned synthesis: starting from seed questions, it iteratively retrieves and applies thought modes through an LLM, using a similarity–scarcity trade-off to avoid overusing common reasoning types. Fourth, it runs multi-rollout inference, LLM-based judging, provenance filtering, and converts judged-correct traces into supervised fine-tuning records. The key difference from standard distillation or self-generated data is the explicit intermediate representation of difficulty.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers nine benchmarks across five STEM disciplines and four mathematical reasoning tasks, including competition-level problems. The authors test across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 model families with four model sizes. Baselines include direct base-model inference, DS-V3.2 Distill, MegaScience, and OpenThought. Models fine-tuned on MindLoom-generated data show consistent gains across the benchmark suite, with larger improvements on competition-style mathematical reasoning. Ablations examine the contribution of thought-mode extraction, retrieval, distribution-aligned sampling, and rollout filtering. Distribution analyses and case studies are used to show that the generated data is more diverse in reasoning composition rather than merely paraphrased. The provided text does not include exact score tables, so precise numerical gains should be checked in the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Read the method section first: the definition of thought modes, the reverse-engineering process for verified solutions, and the similarity–scarcity sampling rule are the most informative parts. In the experiments, focus on comparisons against OpenThought, MegaScience, and distillation-based data, then check the ablation table. For readers interested in pretraining or mid-training data recipes, the thought-mode distribution analysis is more informative than the final aggregate benchmark scores.

paper.title: RankJudge: A Multi-Turn LLM-as-a-Judge Synthetic Benchmark Generator
paper.abstract: As interactive LLM-based applications are created and refined, model developers need to evaluate the quality of generated text along many possible axes. For simpler systems, human evaluation may be practical, but in complicated systems like conversational chatbots, the amount of generated text can overwhelm human annotation resources. Model developers have begun to rely heavily on auto-evaluation, where LLMs are also used to judge generation quality. However, existing LLM-as-a-judge benchmarks l

summary.core_problem: RankJudge 解决的是 LLM-as-a-Judge 自身如何被可靠评测的问题，重点放在多轮、基于参考文档的对话场景。现有 judge benchmark 多数只评单轮问答，难以暴露跨轮矛盾、约束遗失、引用依据错误等真实助手系统中的常见失败。更关键的是，只看判哪边更好，会把“判断正确”和“理由正确”混在一起。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 和模型发布评测很有用。judge 模型现在常被用于偏好数据筛选、checkpoint 选择、自动打分和 leaderboard 排名。如果 judge 的能力边界不清，训练信号会被污染，模型选择也会偏移。RankJudge 的价值在于把 judge 评测从 verdict accuracy 推到更细粒度的诊断：不仅要选对更好的对话，还要指出错误发生在哪一轮、属于哪类失败。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是一个合成 benchmark generator。每个样本包含两段基于同一参考文档生成的多轮对话，其中较差的一段只在一个指定轮次注入一种指定失败类型。生成时同时控制两个轴：用户行为 archetype 和助手失败类型。这样 ground truth 在生成提示中已经确定，包括 better conversation、flawed turn 和 failure category。评测时，judge 需要联合预测三元组，只有三项都正确才算正确。这比只做 pairwise preference 更严格，可以过滤掉凭整体印象猜对 verdict 的情况。为降低合成数据噪声，RankJudge 使用三层自动 verifier 检查对话一致性、指令遵循和文档 grounding，并要求非目标错误之外的内容都被参考文档支持。之后再用 Bradley-Terry / Elo 对 item 难度建模，剔除最高难度尾部，因为这部分在人工审计和 held-out fine-tuning 实验中都更容易对应标签噪声。
summary.experiments: 实验构造了三个知识密集领域的评测集：Machine Learning、Biomedicine 和 Finance。作者评测了 21 个 proprietary 和 open-weight judge。leaderboard 在 Elo 尺度上拉开接近 1200 分的差距，说明该任务对 judge 能力有较强区分度。部分 open-weight checkpoint 排在一些 proprietary judge 之前。排名在 match subsampling、较粗粒度 correctness criterion、EIP cross-check 下保持稳定。弱 judge 还表现出系统性类别偏置：预测会塌缩到少数 failure category，而不是在错误类型空间内合理分布。对一个中等排名的 frontier judge 做 targeted prompt rewrite，也未能把它推到 accuracy-cost Pareto frontier，说明某些差距不是简单提示词能补上的。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，样本生成部分，尤其是如何把 user behavior 和 assistant failure 解耦；第二，joint correctness 设计，它决定了这个 benchmark 和普通 pairwise judge benchmark 的差异；第三，Elo-based curation 和 human audit / held-out fine-tuning 的对应关系，这部分关系到合成评测集的可信度。leaderboard 结果可以快速扫读，重点关注弱 judge 的 failure category collapse 和 prompt rewrite 失败的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: RankJudge targets the evaluation of LLM-as-a-judge systems in multi-turn, reference-grounded conversations. Most existing judge benchmarks focus on isolated single-turn answers, so they miss failures that arise over interaction: contradictions across turns, dropped constraints, and unsupported document-grounded claims. A second issue is diagnostic ambiguity. A judge may pick the better conversation while attributing the error to the wrong turn or the wrong failure type.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining method, but it matters for the training and release pipeline. Judge models are increasingly used to filter preference data, compare checkpoints, score model outputs, and build leaderboards. If the judge is weak, downstream optimization can reward the wrong behavior. RankJudge is useful because it evaluates not only the final preference decision, but also whether the judge can localize and classify the underlying failure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is generated synthetically. Each item contains two multi-turn conversations grounded in the same reference document. One branch contains exactly one injected flaw at a known turn, with a known failure category. The generator conditions on two axes: a user behavior archetype and a targeted assistant failure type. This makes the ground-truth tuple—better conversation, flawed turn, and failure category—available before any judge sees the item. At evaluation time, a judge must predict all three components, and credit is given only when the full tuple matches. This is stricter than pairwise preference accuracy and separates correct reasoning from lucky verdicts. To control label noise, the pipeline uses a three-layer verifier cascade for coherence, adherence, and grounding, then applies Bradley-Terry / Elo modeling to estimate item difficulty and remove the highest-difficulty tail. Human audit and a held-out fine-tuning experiment both identify this tail as a noisier slice.
summary_en.experiments: The authors instantiate RankJudge in three knowledge-intensive domains: machine learning, biomedicine, and finance. They evaluate 21 proprietary and open-weight judge models. The resulting leaderboard spans nearly 1200 Elo points, indicating strong separation among judges. Some open-weight checkpoints rank above proprietary judges. The ranking remains stable under match subsampling, a coarser correctness criterion, and an EIP cross-check. The analysis also shows a capability ceiling for weaker judges: their predictions collapse onto a small set of failure categories instead of distributing across the taxonomy. Prompt rewrites for a mid-ranked frontier judge do not move it onto the accuracy-cost Pareto frontier, suggesting that the gap is not only a prompting issue.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. The most useful parts are the item construction procedure, the joint correctness formulation, and the verifier-plus-Elo curation pipeline. The leaderboard can be read selectively; the more informative pieces are the failure-category collapse analysis and the prompt-rewrite experiment, because they show where judge capability fails beyond simple verdict accuracy.

paper.title: PlanningBench: Generating Scalable and Verifiable Planning Data for Evaluating and Training Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Planning is a fundamental capability for large language models (LLMs) because such complex tasks require models to coordinate goals, constraints, resources, and long-term consequences into executable and verifiable solutions. Existing planning benchmarks, however, usually treat planning data as fixed collections of instances rather than controllable generation targets. This limits scenario coverage, ties difficulty to surface-level proxies rather than structural sources, and offers limited suppo

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是规划能力评测和训练数据的可扩展生成问题。现有 planning benchmark 多是固定题集，覆盖面有限，难度控制常依赖题长、约束数量等表层指标，也缺少可自动验证的训练信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 的启发在于：复杂推理数据不应只靠收集静态 benchmark，而可以被设计成可控生成、可验证、可用于 RL 的数据分布。PlanningBench 的价值不在某个具体旅行或日程任务，而在于把现实规划任务抽象成任务类型、子任务、约束族和难度因子，再用 verifier 形成训练闭环。这类方法适合作为 reasoning-oriented mid-training、SFT/RL 数据生成的参考模板，尤其适合研究 verifier-based RL 是否能带来跨任务迁移。
summary.technical_approach: PlanningBench 从真实规划场景出发，由领域专家抽象出规划工作流 taxonomy。这个 taxonomy 包含 30 多类规划任务，每类任务带有多个子任务和任务相关约束。数据生成不是简单模板填充，而是先采样结构化的 task-constraint configuration，再实例化成完整问题；随后通过受控难度增强和质量过滤生成样本。难度控制强调结构因素，包括约束紧度、资源稀缺、目标冲突、子任务依赖和全局协调要求，而不是只增加 prompt 长度或 checklist 数量。每个样本都绑定自动验证规则，用来检查约束满足和目标质量。训练侧使用 verified PlanningBench data 做 GRPO 强化学习，并测试在分布外规划 benchmark 和更广泛指令/推理任务上的迁移。
summary.experiments: 论文测试了开源和闭源前沿模型，结论是即便最强模型在 PlanningBench 上的 solve rate 也有限，说明生成任务没有被现有模型轻易饱和。作者还按任务主题、prompt 长度、checklist item 数量分析规划成功率，观察场景结构和约束复杂度如何影响模型表现。训练实验使用 PlanningBench 验证数据进行 GRPO，报告在未见过的 TravelPlanner 和 ChinaTravel 上有提升，并在 Multi-Challenge、Inverse IFEval、Collie 等更广泛指令遵循和复杂推理 benchmark 上也有增益。给出的全文片段没有包含具体模型规模、样本量、训练步数和提升幅度，因此需要读实验表确认收益大小和统计稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看数据生成 pipeline 图，确认它如何从真实任务抽象到 task-constraint configuration，再到 verifier。随后看 taxonomy 和 difficulty factor 的定义，这决定数据是否真的比固定 benchmark 更有诊断性。实验部分重点看三类结果：不同模型的 solve rate、按结构难度拆分的 error pattern、GRPO 训练后的分布外迁移。若只关心预训练/后训练数据，优先读 generation、verification 和 RL training setup；具体场景案例可以快速扫过。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses scalable generation of planning data for both evaluation and training. Existing planning benchmarks are mostly fixed collections of instances, with limited coverage, weak structural difficulty control, and insufficient automatic verification for training.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to reasoning data construction rather than to a specific planning application. PlanningBench treats planning tasks as controllable, verifiable data distributions. This is useful for SFT or RL pipelines where a model needs dense, reliable training signals on globally constrained problems. The framework also provides a template for verifier-based reasoning data: define structured task constraints, generate diverse instances, verify feasibility and objective quality, and then train with RL such as GRPO.
summary_en.technical_approach: PlanningBench begins with real planning scenarios and abstracts them into a taxonomy of task types, subtasks, constraint families, and difficulty factors. The taxonomy covers more than 30 planning tasks, each with multiple subtasks and task-specific constraints. The generation pipeline samples structured task-constraint configurations, instantiates them into self-contained planning problems, applies controlled difficulty enhancement, and filters for quality. Difficulty is controlled through structural factors such as constraint tightness, scarce resources, conflicting objectives, subtask dependencies, and global coordination requirements, rather than only surface features like prompt length. Each instance is paired with automatic verification rules that check constraint satisfaction and objective quality. For training, the authors use verified PlanningBench data with GRPO and evaluate out-of-distribution transfer.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates both open-source and closed-source frontier models and reports that even the strongest models have limited solve rates on PlanningBench. It analyzes performance by task topic, prompt length, and number of checklist items to understand how scenario structure and constraint complexity affect success. For training, GRPO on verified PlanningBench data improves transfer to unseen planning benchmarks such as TravelPlanner and ChinaTravel, and also brings gains on broader instruction-following and complex-reasoning benchmarks including Multi-Challenge, Inverse IFEval, and Collie. The provided text does not include concrete model sizes, data volume, training budget, or numerical gains, so the scale and reliability of the improvements need to be checked in the tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20–30 minutes. Start with the data construction pipeline and the verifier design. Then read the taxonomy and difficulty-factor definitions, because these determine whether the benchmark measures structural planning ability rather than prompt-length sensitivity. In the experiments, focus on model solve rates, breakdowns by structural difficulty, and the GRPO transfer results. If the goal is to reuse the idea for post-training data, the generation and verification sections are more important than individual planning scenario examples.

Each instance is paired with automatic verification rules that check constraint satisfaction and objective quality. paper.title: Know When To Fold 'Em: Token-Efficient LLM Synthetic Data Generation via Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection
paper.abstract: While synthetic data generation with large language models (LLMs) is widely used in post-training pipelines, existing approaches typically generate full outputs before applying quality filters, leading to substantial token waste on samples that are ultimately discarded. To address this, we propose Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection (MSIFR), a lightweight, training-free framework that detects and terminates low-quality generation trajectories at intermediate checkpoints before they reach full comple

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是合成数据生成里的 token 浪费问题。常见流程是先让模型把整条样本生成完，再做质量过滤；如果样本中途已经暴露出算术错误、格式错误或明显幻觉，后续 token 其实都是无效开销。作者要解决的是：能不能在生成过程中分阶段做轻量校验，尽早终止低质量轨迹，从而在不训练额外控制器的前提下，降低合成数据成本并维持数据质量。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练不是直接相关，更接近 post-train 数据管线优化，所以只适合 skim。但对做 SFT/RL 数据合成的人有现实意义：一是把“质量过滤”从生成后处理前移到生成过程中，二是把 token 预算视为可优化资源，而不是默认接受完整采样成本。对于依赖大规模合成数学/科学推理数据的团队，这种方法能直接影响数据生产效率，也会间接影响后续训练信号的噪声水平。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection，核心是把一条 problem-solution 生成轨迹拆成多个阶段，在阶段边界上运行快速、规则驱动的 validator。校验内容包括算术一致性、幻觉模式、格式约束等；一旦某阶段失败，就立刻停止后续生成。作者把这个过程形式化为 sequential decision problem，并给出 stage-wise token savings 分解，强调越早拒绝，节省越大。

和已有 early-exit 工作的区别在于，后者通常是针对单次推理，试图缩短本来正确的推理链；MSIFR 的目标不是让正确答案更短，而是尽早砍掉错误样本，避免把预算花在注定会被过滤掉的轨迹上。因此它是数据生成管线里的 rejection mechanism，而不是推理时的 reasoning truncation。作者还声称 conditional utility estimate 构成 martingale，因此早拒绝不会引入期望效用偏差；这个理论部分更像是为策略合理性提供解释，而不是方法成立的必要条件。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个 7B-8B 级指令模型：Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、DeepSeek-7B、Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B；任务覆盖 GSM8K、MATH500、SVAMP、MAWPS、MathQA、MMLU-Chem、DeepMind Mathematics。结果上，作为独立方法，MSIFR 相比完整生成流程可减少 11%-77% 的 token 消耗，文中提到在 GSM8K 上最高可到 42%；与已有 early-exit 方法结合时，最高可到 78.2% 的 token 节省，同时在各 benchmark 上保持或提升准确率。

这些结果说明它在“生成后再过滤”的低效场景里确实有用，但也要注意边界：收益高度依赖 validator 的质量和任务结构。数学、科学问答这类中间状态容易校验的任务更适合；开放式对话、创作类数据则未必有同样效果。论文如果没有报告误杀率、不同 validator 的单独贡献、以及被拒样本对最终训练收益的影响，那方法的泛化性仍需保留判断。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。先看方法总览，明确它不是训练新模型，而是改造 synthetic data generation pipeline。然后看理论部分里 sequential decision 和 martingale 的定义，理解作者想证明什么，不必在形式化细节上停留太久。实验部分重点看三类表：不同模型上的 token 节省幅度、与 early-exit 组合后的增益、以及准确率是否真的没有因早拒绝而下降。如果你关心的是 post-train 数据生产效率，20-25 分钟足够抓住主要信息；如果你关心 pretrain，本篇不需要深读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses token waste in synthetic data generation. In the standard pipeline, an LLM generates a full sample first and quality filters are applied only afterward. If the sample already shows arithmetic errors, hallucination patterns, or formatting failures halfway through generation, the remaining tokens are effectively wasted. The paper asks whether low-quality trajectories can be rejected during generation, stage by stage, without training an additional controller.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training data pipeline paper rather than a pretraining paper, so it belongs in skim territory. Its practical relevance is straightforward: if a team relies heavily on synthetic math or science data for SFT or RL, moving quality control into the generation loop can reduce token cost and improve the effective cleanliness of the retained dataset. The contribution is less about model capability and more about data production efficiency under a fixed inference budget.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed framework, Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection (MSIFR), decomposes generation into sequential stages and runs lightweight rule-based validators at intermediate checkpoints. These validators check arithmetic consistency, hallucination indicators, and formatting constraints. If a sample fails at any stage, generation is terminated immediately, preventing further token expenditure on a trajectory that would likely be discarded anyway.

The paper formulates this as a sequential decision problem and derives a stage-wise token-savings decomposition, emphasizing that earlier rejection yields larger savings. This is importantly different from prior early-exit methods, which usually try to shorten correct reasoning traces at inference time. MSIFR is not trying to make valid answers shorter; it is trying to stop invalid samples before they fully unfold. The authors also provide a theoretical argument that conditional utility estimates form a martingale, which is used to justify that early rejection preserves unbiased expected utility. That theory is more of a consistency argument than the core source of empirical gains.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans five instruction-tuned models in the 7B-8B range: Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, DeepSeek-7B, Phi-3-mini, and Mistral-7B. Benchmarks include GSM8K, MATH500, SVAMP, MAWPS, MathQA, MMLU-Chem, and the DeepMind Mathematics Dataset. As a standalone method, MSIFR reduces token consumption by 11% to 77% relative to full-generation pipelines, with up to 42% savings reported on GSM8K. When combined with existing early-exit methods, the savings reach as high as 78.2%, while maintaining or improving evaluation accuracy across the tested benchmarks.

The empirical message is clear for structured reasoning tasks with easy-to-check intermediate states. The main caveat is transferability: the method depends heavily on the availability and quality of validators. It is naturally better suited to math and science generation than to open-ended dialogue or creative writing. In the full paper, the most important details to inspect are false rejection rates, the contribution of each validator type, and whether the retained data actually improves downstream training quality rather than just lowering generation cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: A quick skim is enough. Start with the pipeline overview to understand that this is a training-free modification to synthetic data generation, not a new model or decoding algorithm in the usual sense. Then glance at the theoretical section on sequential decisions and the martingale argument to see what is being formalized, but do not spend too much time there unless you care about the decision-theoretic framing. In the experiments, focus on three things: token savings across models, gains when composed with early-exit baselines, and whether accuracy is preserved under aggressive rejection. If your main interest is post-training data efficiency, 20-25 minutes should be enough. If your focus is foundation-model pretraining, this paper is peripheral.

recommendation.zh: 无训练开销的合成数据降本方案，可直接集成到内部SFT数据生成 pipeline，重点看§2的规则校验器设计即可。
recommendation.en: This training-free synthetic data cost reduction framework can be directly integrated into SFT data generation pipelines, refer to §2 for rule validator design.

paper.title: NodeSynth: Socially Aligned Synthetic Data for AI Evaluation
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in generative AI facilitate large-scale synthetic data generation for model evaluation. However, without targeted approaches, these datasets often lack the sociotechnical nuance required for sensitive domains. We introduce NodeSynth, an evidence-grounded methodology that generates socially relevant synthetic queries by leveraging a fine-tuned taxonomy generator (TaG) anchored in real-world evidence. Evaluated against four mainstream LLMs (e.g., Claude 4.5 Haiku), NodeSynth el

summary.core_problem: NodeSynth 解决的是安全与社会技术评测数据生成的问题：普通合成提示词规模可扩展，但往往缺少敏感议题、地域、身份群体、使用场景和用户画像之间的细粒度交叉，导致评测很难触发真实部署中的失败模式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练目标或模型结构，而在评测数据生成。它的启发点是：模型安全和偏见评测不能只依赖宽泛 policy label 或人工少量样本，需要把抽象安全概念展开成可追踪的层级 taxonomy，再用真实证据约束提示词生成。对基座模型团队而言，这类方法可用于 pretrain/posttrain 数据审计、red-teaming 数据扩展，以及 guard model 的盲点定位。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是三步式数据生成管线。第一步，把目标概念 C 映射为三层 taxonomy T，包括 L1、L2、L3。系统先用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 生成 L1/L2，再由社会技术和语言专家审阅。第二步，用 2,576 条专家生成并审核的数据对 Gemini 2.5 Flash 做 SFT，得到 taxonomy generator，即 TaG，用来自动生成更细的 L3 扩展。训练数据包含生成式 AI 安全政策和敏感领域样本，字段包括目标概念、描述、L1-L3、国家和语言，覆盖英语、印尼语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语和墨西哥西班牙语。第三步，把 taxonomy 节点和外部证据源结合，生成带有敏感主题、地域、人口属性、场景和 persona 的评测 query。与直接让通用 LLM 生成测试问题相比，NodeSynth 的关键差异是先结构化地扩展概念空间，再把提示词锚定到现实材料上，而不是依赖模型自由发挥。
summary.experiments: 论文用四个主流模型做评测，包括 GPT o4-mini 和 Claude 4.5 Haiku。NodeSynth 生成的数据在特定测试架构下触发的失败率最高达到人工编写 benchmark 的 5 倍。消融结果显示，taxonomy 的细粒度扩展是失败率提升的主要来源，说明 L3 级别的具体社会语境和敏感交叉项比宽泛主题更容易暴露模型缺陷。专家审核部分有 11 位研究者参与，每个样本由 3 人审核，采用 2/3 多数决定，L1/L2 taxonomy 的一致性达到 90% 以上。论文还用独立验证检查 guard model，指出 Llama-Guard-3 这类安全分类器在细粒度社会语境下存在明显漏检。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20-30 分钟。重点看 NodeSynth Approach 中 taxonomy 构建、TaG SFT 数据设计和证据锚定流程。实验部分应关注三类结果：NodeSynth 与人工/普通合成数据的 failure rate 对比，taxonomy depth 的消融，guard model 验证。对预训练研究员更有用的是数据生成管线，而不是具体敏感领域结论。可特别检查 Appendix A/B 中 taxonomy prompt、训练字段和类别覆盖，因为这些细节决定方法是否能迁移到模型数据审计或对齐评测。

summary_en.core_problem: NodeSynth targets a data-generation problem in sociotechnical model evaluation. Generic synthetic prompts are scalable, but they often miss the fine-grained intersections among sensitive topics, geography, demographic attributes, use cases, and user personas. As a result, they under-sample the kinds of prompts that reveal failures in deployed systems.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model evaluation and data governance. Its main lesson is that safety and bias evaluation should not rely only on broad policy labels or small human-written sets. A structured taxonomy, grounded in external evidence, can expose failure modes that broad synthetic generation misses. For foundation-model teams, this is useful for red-teaming data generation, pretrain/posttrain data audits, and diagnosing blind spots in guard models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline first maps a target concept C into a three-level taxonomy T with L1, L2, and L3 nodes. Gemini 2.5 Flash is used to draft the L1/L2 taxonomy, which is then reviewed by domain experts. Since manual L3 annotation does not scale, the authors fine-tune Gemini 2.5 Flash into a taxonomy generator, TaG, using 2,576 expert-created and reviewed instances. Each instance contains the target concept, description, L1-L3 labels, country, and language. The data covers generative-AI safety policies and sensitive domains, with examples in English, Indonesian, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, and Mexican Spanish. The generated taxonomy nodes are then combined with external evidence sources to produce evaluation queries. The key distinction from ordinary LLM-based query generation is that NodeSynth first expands the concept space in a controlled hierarchy, then grounds prompts in documented real-world contexts.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers four mainstream models, including GPT o4-mini and Claude 4.5 Haiku. NodeSynth prompts elicit failure rates up to five times higher than human-authored benchmarks under the reported testing setup. Ablations show that granular taxonomic expansion is a major driver of the higher failure rate, suggesting that L3-level context and demographic intersections are more diagnostic than broad topic labels. The taxonomy validation involved 11 researchers; each sample was reviewed by three annotators with a two-out-of-three majority rule, and L1/L2 agreement was at least 90%. The paper also reports weaknesses in independent guard models such as Llama-Guard-3 when evaluated on these fine-grained sociotechnical prompts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20-30 minutes. Focus on the NodeSynth Approach section, especially taxonomy construction, TaG fine-tuning data, and evidence-grounded query generation. In the experiments, look for three results: failure-rate comparisons against human and generic synthetic baselines, ablations on taxonomy depth, and guard-model validation. For pretraining researchers, the reusable part is the evaluation-data pipeline rather than the domain-specific findings. Appendix A/B are worth checking for taxonomy prompts, training fields, and category coverage.

recommendation.zh: 安全评测数据合成比常规红队更系统；只看 taxonomy 扩展消融，别把失败率当训练收益。
recommendation.en: The safety-data synthesis is more systematic than ad hoc red-teaming; read the taxonomy ablation, but do not treat higher failure rates as training gains.

paper.title: Towards Resource-Efficient LLMs: End-to-End Energy Accounting of Distillation Pipelines
paper.abstract: The rise in deployment of large language models has driven a surge in GPU demand and datacenter scaling, raising concerns about electricity use, grid stress, and the impacts of modern AI workloads. Distillation is often promoted as one of the most effective paths to obtain cheaper, more efficient models, yet these claims rarely account for the full end-to-end energy and resource costs, including crucial teacher-side workloads such as data generation, logit caching, and evaluation. We present a c

summary.core_problem: 评估蒸馏是否真的节省资源时，不能只看学生模型训练和推理成本，还要计入教师模型生成数据、logit caching、评测等完整流水线能耗。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工程测量与资源核算框架。它挑战了“蒸馏天然更省”的粗粒度叙事，对模型压缩、合成数据 SFT 和大规模部署成本评估有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出端到端 energy accounting framework，对蒸馏流水线各阶段进行 GPU device power consumption 的分阶段记录。比较两类常见蒸馏：logit-based knowledge distillation 和 synthetic-data supervised fine-tuning，并构造 energy-quality Pareto frontiers。
summary.experiments: 实验分离记录教师侧、学生侧、缓存、评测等阶段的经验能耗和排放。摘要未给出模型规模、GPU 类型、数据量、质量指标和 Pareto 数值，但明确覆盖经典 logit 蒸馏与合成数据 SFT 两条路线。
summary.authors_note: Sasha Luccioni 长期参与 AI 能耗、碳排和模型环境影响测量相关工作；论文信息未提供明确机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that claims about distillation efficiency must include the full pipeline cost, not just student training or inference, because teacher generation, logit caching, and evaluation can dominate the budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an engineering measurement and resource-accounting framework. It questions the coarse claim that distillation is automatically resource-efficient and is relevant to compression, synthetic-data SFT, and deployment cost analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose an end-to-end energy accounting framework that logs GPU device power stage by stage across distillation pipelines. They compare logit-based knowledge distillation with synthetic-data supervised fine-tuning and build energy-quality Pareto frontiers.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments empirically separate energy use and emissions across teacher-side work, student-side training, caching, and evaluation. The abstract does not provide model sizes, GPU types, dataset sizes, quality metrics, or exact Pareto numbers, but it covers both classic logit distillation and synthetic-data SFT.
summary_en.authors_note: Sasha Luccioni is known for work on AI energy use, carbon accounting, and environmental impact measurement. The provided paper metadata does not list a specific institution.

recommendation.zh: 结论不会改预训练方法，但会约束蒸馏项目立项；只看能耗分解表和 Pareto 曲线即可。
recommendation.en: It will not change pretraining methods, but it should constrain distillation project planning; read the stage-wise energy tables and Pareto curves.

paper.title: FrontierSmith: Synthesizing Open-Ended Coding Problems at Scale
paper.abstract: Many real-world coding challenges are open-ended and admit no known optimal solution. Yet, recent progress in LLM coding has focused on well-defined tasks such as feature implementation, bug fixing, and competitive programming. Open-ended coding remains a weak spot for LLMs, largely because open-ended training problems are scarce and expensive to construct. Our goal is to synthesize open-ended coding problems at scale to train stronger LLM coders. We introduce FrontierSmith, an automated system

summary.core_problem: 开放式编码任务（如集群调度、启发式搜索等缺乏已知最优解的问题）是LLM的薄弱环节，核心瓶颈是训练数据稀缺——人工构建每个开放式问题需要设计优化目标、连续评分验证器和测试用例，成本极高。现有编码数据合成方法均针对有二元正确性验证的封闭式任务，无法迁移到开放式场景。
summary.importance: 首次提出从封闭式编码问题自动演化生成开放式训练数据的完整流水线。对预训练研究的启示在于：(1) 证明了已知数据资源（封闭式题库）可以通过定向突变转化为更高价值的训练信号；(2) 提出的idea divergence度量为评估合成数据质量提供了可量化的筛选信号；(3) 用合成数据训练后的模型在FrontierCS和ALE-bench上取得了显著收益，验证了开放式数据对提升LLM复杂编码能力的价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是将封闭式问题（如竞赛编程题）沿三个维度突变为开放式变体：改变目标（将精确求解改为优化某个连续指标）、限制输出（禁止特定解法以迫使策略多样化）、泛化输入（扩大输入规模使精确解法不可行）。关键创新是idea divergence度量——通过两个独立求解器采用不同核心算法的概率来量化问题的开放程度，先基于LLM比对解策略，再基于测试得分相似度验证。生成的问题经多智能体重叠验证后加入种子池，形成迭代演化循环。
summary.experiments: 用200个合成问题训练Qwen3.5-9B和27B模型，采用GRPO。9B模型在FrontierCS上提升+8.82分，ALE-bench上提升+306.36（Elo分）；27B模型分别提升+12.12和+309.12。对照组实验表明，封闭式HardTests数据和随机奖励效果显著更差（FrontierCS上分别低5.24和7.58分），确认开放式表述和真实奖励信号均不可或缺。消融实验显示移除idea divergence筛选器使FrontierCS性能下降2.05分。合成问题还能复现人类标注问题引发的长程行为模式（更多轮次、工具调用、思考token）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读Method章节的三个突变维度设计和idea divergence的两阶段计算方式（§3），以及实验部分的对照组对比（§4）。迭代演化循环的设计（图1）值得关注——种子池自更新的思路对其他数据合成任务有迁移价值。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Open-ended coding tasks (e.g., cluster scheduling, heuristic search—problems lacking known optimal solutions) are a weak point for LLMs. The core bottleneck is training data scarcity: manually constructing each open-ended problem requires designing optimization objectives, continuous-scoring verifiers, and test cases, making it prohibitively expensive. Existing code data synthesis methods exclusively target closed-ended tasks with binary correctness verification and do not transfer to open-ended settings.
summary_en.importance: This is the first full pipeline for automatically evolving closed-ended coding problems into open-ended training data. For pretraining research, it demonstrates that: (1) existing data resources (closed-ended problem banks) can be transformed into higher-value training signals via targeted mutations; (2) the proposed idea divergence metric provides a quantifiable filtering signal for synthetic data quality; (3) training on synthetic data yields significant gains on FrontierCS and ALE-bench, validating the value of open-ended data for improving LLM coding capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core method mutates closed-ended problems (e.g., competitive programming questions) into open-ended variants along three axes: changing goals (replacing exact solution requirements with continuous metric optimization), restricting outputs (prohibiting specific solutions to force strategy diversity), and generalizing inputs (scaling input sizes to make exact solutions intractable). The key innovation is the idea divergence metric—quantifying openness via the probability that two independent solvers employ different core algorithms, estimated first via LLM-based strategy comparison and then via test-score similarity. Validated problems join the seed pool, creating an iterative evolutionary loop.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen3.5-9B and 27B models were trained on 200 synthetic problems using GRPO. The 9B model gained +8.82 on FrontierCS and +306.36 (Elo) on ALE-bench; the 27B model gained +12.12 and +309.12 respectively. Control experiments with closed-ended HardTests data and random rewards performed substantially worse (lower by 5.24 and 7.58 on FrontierCS respectively), confirming that both open-ended formulations and genuine reward signals are necessary. Ablation showed removing the idea divergence filter drops FrontierCS performance by 2.05 points. Synthetic problems also reproduce the long-horizon behavior patterns (more turns, tool calls, thinking tokens) elicited by human-curated problems.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the three mutation dimensions and the two-stage idea divergence computation in the Method section (§3), and the control group comparisons in Experiments (§4). The iterative evolution loop design (Figure 1) — where the seed pool self-updates — is worth noting for transfer to other data synthesis tasks. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

paper.title: Evolutionary Task Discovery: Advancing Reasoning Frontiers via Skill Composition and Complexity Scaling
paper.abstract: The reasoning frontier of Large Language Models (LLMs) has advanced significantly through modern post-training paradigms (e.g., Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)). However, the efficacy of these methods remains fundamentally constrained by the diversity and complexity of the training data. One practical solution is data synthesis; yet, prevalent methods relying on unstructured mutation or exploration suffer from homogeneity collapse, failing to systematically expand the reaso

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 RLVR 训练中的推理数据扩展问题：现有合成方法常用“改得更难”“增加约束”这类非结构化提示，容易生成近重复样本，或者只覆盖技能标签而没有系统控制题目复杂度。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练的直接贡献不大，但对 post-train 数据引擎有参考价值。它把推理数据合成从文本扰动推进到结构化搜索：同时控制“需要什么算法技能”和“实例复杂度如何变化”。这个视角适合用于 RLVR、SFT 数据构造，也能反哺预训练阶段对算法题、数学题、程序合成数据的组织方式。贡献量级属于方法框架和数据生成范式改进，不是模型架构或预训练目标的改动。
summary.technical_approach: EvoTD 将 reasoning task 表示为两个相对独立的维度：Algorithmic Skills 和 Complexity Attributes。前者描述逻辑骨架，例如二分、堆、图算法；后者描述结构约束，例如输入规模、图大小、约束数量。方法包含两个演化算子：Attribute Mutation 用来放大或改变复杂度属性，Skill Crossover 用来组合不同技能，生成新的复合任务。系统采用 proposer-solver 流程：proposer 生成任务，solver 在这些任务上训练。为了避免样本太简单或完全不可学，作者引入基于当前 solver policy 的 Zone of Proximal Development 过滤，只保留处在当前模型可学习区间内的样本。随着 solver 变强，过滤器会接受更难的任务，从而形成动态课程。另一个过滤环节使用 LLM 的自评能力检查合成任务是否真的匹配目标技能，避免技能标签和题目内容脱节。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖代码生成和数学推理等五类 benchmark。作者报告 EvoTD 在多种 backbone 上都优于启发式合成方法，包括 Qwen3、LLaMA，不同预训练状态的 Base/Instruct 模型，以及 3B 到 8B 参数规模。以 Qwen3-4B reasoning model 为例，AIME 24 提升 8.2 个百分点，AIME 25 提升 7.2 个百分点。增益还能迁移到 MMLU-Pro、SuperGPQA 等通用推理评测，主要集中在 STEM 相关科目。文中给出的实验信息说明，收益不只来自生成更多样本，而是来自技能组合、复杂度扩展和动态可学习性过滤的配合。不过从摘要和正文片段看，仍需要重点检查合成成本、验证器误判、以及生成题目和真实 benchmark 分布之间的距离。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–20 分钟。优先看方法部分对 Algorithmic Skills / Complexity Attributes 的形式化定义，再看 Attribute Mutation、Skill Crossover 和 ZPD 过滤流程。实验部分重点看三类内容：与普通 prompt mutation 的对比、去掉两个演化算子的消融、不同模型规模和 Base/Instruct 设置下的稳定性。如果时间有限，只看任务空间建模和过滤器设计即可；这是对 RLVR 数据合成最有信息量的部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a data-scaling bottleneck in RLVR: current synthetic reasoning data pipelines often rely on unstructured prompt mutations, which tend to produce near-duplicates or broaden skill coverage without systematically increasing instance complexity.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training data engines than to core pretraining objectives, but it carries useful lessons for pretraining data construction as well. Its main contribution is a structured view of reasoning-data synthesis: control the algorithmic skill being exercised and the complexity attributes of the instance separately. This is a practical abstraction for RLVR curricula, SFT data generation, and possibly large-scale algorithmic data mixtures in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoTD models a reasoning task along two axes: Algorithmic Skills, which specify the logical backbone such as binary search, heaps, or graph algorithms; and Complexity Attributes, which specify structural constraints such as input size, graph size, or the number of conditions. The framework introduces two evolutionary operators. Attribute Mutation scales or changes complexity attributes. Skill Crossover composes skills to discover new compound tasks. A proposer generates candidate tasks, and a solver learns from tasks that pass filtering. The key filter is based on the solver’s current policy and keeps tasks in the model’s zone of proximal development: not already trivial, but not impossible either. As the solver improves, the accepted task distribution shifts toward harder instances. The pipeline also uses an LLM-based metacognitive check to verify that the generated task aligns with the intended skills.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five benchmarks across code generation and mathematical reasoning. The reported results show consistent gains over heuristic synthesis methods across Qwen3 and LLaMA backbones, Base and Instruct variants, and model sizes from 3B to 8B. On Qwen3-4B reasoning model, EvoTD improves AIME 24 by 8.2 percentage points and AIME 25 by 7.2 percentage points. Gains also transfer to MMLU-Pro and SuperGPQA, with stronger effects on STEM-adjacent categories. The reported evidence suggests that the benefit comes from the combination of skill composition, complexity scaling, and learnability filtering rather than from simply adding more generated examples. The remaining questions are generation cost, verifier reliability, and distributional distance between synthesized tasks and target benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim is enough. Focus on the formalization of Algorithmic Skills and Complexity Attributes, then read the definitions of Attribute Mutation, Skill Crossover, and the solver-dependent filtering rule. In the experiments, check comparisons against plain prompt mutation, ablations of the two evolutionary operators, and robustness across model scale and Base/Instruct settings. If time is limited, the task-space abstraction and filtering mechanism are the most useful parts.

recommendation.zh: 看任务空间定义和去重实验；若复杂度轴干净，可直接借到 internal RLVR 数据管线。
recommendation.en: Read the task-space definition and dedup tests; if the complexity axis is clean, it is usable for internal RLVR data pipelines.

paper.title: OpenSearch-VL: An Open Recipe for Frontier Multimodal Search Agents
paper.abstract: Deep search has become a crucial capability for frontier multimodal agents, enabling models to solve complex questions through active search, evidence verification, and multi-step reasoning. Despite rapid progress, top-tier multimodal search agents remain difficult to reproduce, largely due to the absence of open high-quality training data, transparent trajectory synthesis pipelines, or detailed training recipes. To this end, we introduce OpenSearch-VL, a fully open-source recipe for training fr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体、也很难复现的问题：如何用开放数据和开放训练流程，把多模态 deep search agent 训练到接近前沿闭源系统的水平。难点不在单轮 VQA，而在长轨迹、多工具、图像证据不完美、检索链条多跳、以及 RL 训练中频繁出现的工具失败。全文围绕三个瓶颈展开：高质量多跳图文搜索数据从哪里来；工具环境如何覆盖真实视觉输入中的预处理需求；长轨迹 agentic RL 遇到中途 fatal failure 时，怎样保留前半段有效学习信号而不过度污染梯度。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接相关性不如纯预训练论文强，但它在 pretrain↔post-train 接口上有实质信息量，尤其适合关注 tool-use、agentic RL、数据合成和多模态训练配方的人。价值主要有三点。第一，它把“搜索能力”拆成了可训练的数据结构，而不是只靠人工标注或闭源轨迹蒸馏，这对后续构造知识密集型多模态训练集有参考意义。第二，它提出的 fatal-aware RL 处理长轨迹失败的方式很工程化，也很贴近真实 agent 训练中的噪声来源。第三，它把视觉预处理工具和检索工具放进同一决策回路，说明多模态 agent 的瓶颈不只是 reasoning，也包括输入清洗和证据可读性。贡献量级在 agent 方向里算扎实，尤其因为数据、代码、模型都计划开放；但如果只从“LLM 预训练新范式”看，它更偏 post-train/agent recipe，而不是基座建模本身。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案由数据、工具、训练三部分组成。数据方面，作者从 Wikipedia hyperlink graph 出发采样多跳实体路径，再把中间实体改写成模糊描述，构造成需要逐步定位实体、验证证据、再继续搜索的图文问答样本。这里的关键不是简单把 wiki 页面转成 QA，而是通过 fuzzy entity rewriting 和过滤机制，尽量避免模型靠一步图像检索或表面匹配走捷径。作者还做了 source-anchor visual grounding，把问题和图像中的可见锚点、页面来源、后续检索链条绑定起来，提升训练轨迹的可执行性。最终形成两个数据集：SearchVL-SFT-36k 用于监督微调，SearchVL-RL-8k 用于 agentic RL。工具环境方面，除了常规 search，还加入 OCR、crop、sharpen、super-resolution、perspective correction 等视觉工具。这样设计的原因很直接：真实图片常常模糊、倾斜、分辨率低，若不先做视觉修复，后续检索查询本身就会失真。训练方面，作者基于 GRPO 做长轨迹多轮工具使用 RL，并针对 fatal failure 设计了两点改动。其一是 fatal-aware token masking：一旦某步工具调用彻底失败，后续无意义 token 不参与优化，避免错误后缀把梯度带偏。其二是 one-sided advantage clamping：保留失败前有价值的推理和动作片段，让部分成功轨迹仍能提供正向学习信号，而不是整条 rollout 作废。这个设计明显是在解决 agent RL 中 credit assignment 粗糙、失败传播过强的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个多模态 deep search benchmark，摘要里明确给出相对 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B agentic baseline 的平均分从 47.8 提升到 61.6，平均增幅 13.8 分。分项提升包括 VDR +13.3、MMSearch +24.5、FVQA +10.2、InfoSeek +16.2，说明收益不局限于单一数据集。模型名显示主力系统是 OpenSearch-VL-30B-A3B，底座应为 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B。全文主张其在若干 benchmark 上可比甚至超过部分闭源商业模型，这一点如果精读时建议核对具体表格中的评测设置和是否使用相同工具预算。更值得看的是消融：数据构造中多跳路径采样、模糊实体改写、过滤策略分别贡献多少；工具集合里视觉预处理工具对低质图像样本的提升有多大；fatal-aware masking 与 one-sided advantage clamping 各自带来多少收益。就摘要和正文前半部分看，作者强调简单丢弃失败轨迹会浪费 pre-failure reasoning，而保留完整失败轨迹又会引入噪声，说明他们的 RL 改动在长轨迹任务上应当有稳定收益。若全文表格完整，建议重点核对成功率、平均工具步数、失败类型分布，以及 RL 前后在不同难度样本上的提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇值得精读，但要带着问题读。先看 Introduction 和方法总览，明确作者解决的是哪三类瓶颈：数据、工具、RL。然后重点读数据构造章节，尤其是 Wikipedia path sampling、fuzzy entity rewriting、source-anchor grounding 和过滤规则，因为这部分决定了模型学到的是“多跳搜索”还是“模板化检索”。接着读 RL 章节，重点看 fatal-aware token masking 和 one-sided advantage clamping 的公式、伪代码、以及失败轨迹示例。这里最值得深挖的是：他们如何定义 fatal failure，mask 到哪里为止，advantage clamp 是否会引入偏差，以及为什么不用更常见的 trajectory-level filtering。实验部分建议优先看主表、数据消融、工具消融、RL 消融，以及按图像质量或问题类型分组的结果。若时间有限，1 小时可抓住主线；若你做 agent RL 或多模态 post-train，建议花 2 小时把附录里的 prompt、工具接口、奖励设计和失败案例也看掉。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a concrete and difficult reproducibility problem: how to train a strong multimodal deep-search agent with an open recipe rather than proprietary data and hidden trajectories. The challenge is not single-turn VQA. It is long-horizon, tool-using search over imperfect visual inputs, multi-hop evidence chains, and reinforcement learning under frequent tool failures. The full paper is organized around three bottlenecks: how to build high-quality multimodal multi-hop search data, how to provide a tool environment that handles real visual noise before retrieval, and how to train with agentic RL when many rollouts become partially invalid after a fatal tool error.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant at the pretrain/post-train interface, especially for researchers interested in tool use, agentic RL, multimodal data construction, and training recipes. Its main value comes from three places. First, it turns search capability into a data-generation problem with explicit structure, rather than relying only on manual annotation or closed trajectory distillation. That is useful for future knowledge-intensive multimodal training sets. Second, the fatal-aware RL design addresses a real failure mode in long-horizon agent training: useful reasoning often exists before a rollout collapses, and standard filtering wastes it. Third, the paper integrates visual preprocessing tools with retrieval tools in one decision loop, which is an important reminder that multimodal agent performance depends not only on reasoning but also on making evidence legible. The contribution is substantial within the agent setting, though it is better viewed as a post-training/agent recipe than as a new foundation-modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach has three components: data, tools, and training. For data, the authors start from the Wikipedia hyperlink graph, sample multi-hop entity paths, and convert them into image-grounded question-answer instances by rewriting intermediate entities into fuzzy descriptions. This is meant to suppress shortcut behavior such as one-hop image lookup or direct string matching. They further add source-anchor visual grounding so that the question, visible image anchors, source pages, and downstream retrieval chain remain executable as a training trajectory. The resulting datasets are SearchVL-SFT-36k for supervised fine-tuning and SearchVL-RL-8k for agentic RL. For tools, the environment includes not only search but also OCR, cropping, sharpening, super-resolution, and perspective correction. That design choice is practical: many real images are blurry, skewed, low-resolution, or cluttered, so retrieval quality depends on visual cleanup before querying external knowledge. For training, the paper builds on GRPO for long-horizon multimodal tool use and introduces two modifications for fatal failures. Fatal-aware token masking removes invalid post-failure suffix tokens from optimization once a tool call irrecoverably fails. One-sided advantage clamping preserves useful pre-failure reasoning and action segments so partially successful rollouts still contribute learning signal. Together, these changes target a common agent-RL problem: coarse credit assignment under cascading failures.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers seven multimodal deep-search benchmarks. The headline result is an average score improvement from 47.8 to 61.6 over a Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B agentic baseline, a gain of 13.8 points. Reported benchmark gains include +13.3 on VDR, +24.5 on MMSearch, +10.2 on FVQA, and +16.2 on InfoSeek. The main model appears to be OpenSearch-VL-30B-A3B built on top of Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B. The paper also claims performance comparable to, and in some cases better than, proprietary commercial systems on several benchmarks; when reading closely, it is worth checking tool budgets and evaluation conditions for those comparisons. The most informative parts are likely the ablations: how much comes from multi-hop path sampling, fuzzy entity rewriting, and filtering in the data pipeline; how much the visual preprocessing tools help on degraded images; and how much each RL component contributes. The paper explicitly argues that discarding failed trajectories wastes useful pre-failure reasoning, while keeping full failed rollouts injects noisy gradients, so the RL modifications are intended to produce stable gains specifically in long-horizon settings. If the full tables are available, the most useful metrics to inspect are success rate, average number of tool steps, failure-type breakdown, and gains by difficulty or image quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one deserves a full read, but with a clear agenda. Start with the introduction and method overview to frame the three bottlenecks: data, tools, and RL. Then read the data-construction section carefully, especially Wikipedia path sampling, fuzzy entity rewriting, source-anchor grounding, and filtering rules. That part determines whether the model is learning genuine multi-hop search or just templated retrieval. Next, read the RL section in detail, focusing on the formal definition of fatal failure, the masking boundary, the one-sided advantage clamping rule, and the rollout examples. The key questions are why this is preferable to trajectory-level filtering, what bias the clamping may introduce, and how much useful signal survives after masking. In experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, data ablations, tool ablations, RL ablations, and any breakdown by image quality or question type. About one hour is enough to get the main ideas; if you work on agent RL or multimodal post-training, two hours on the appendix is justified for prompts, tool interfaces, reward design, and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但数据构造把“检索捷径”当训练信号问题来处理，这点很对；只看数据 pipeline 和 RL 设定，别被 agent 榜单带跑。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it treats retrieval shortcuts as a training-signal design problem, which is the right lens; read the data pipeline and RL setup, ignore the leaderboard theater.

paper.title: Rethinking Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Evaluating and Advancing Retrievers in Agentic Search Systems
paper.abstract: Reasoning-intensive retrieval aims to surface evidence that supports downstream reasoning rather than merely matching topical similarity. This capability is increasingly important for agentic search systems, where retrievers must provide complementary evidence across iterative search and synthesis. However, existing work remains limited on both evaluation and training: benchmarks such as BRIGHT provide narrow gold sets and evaluate retrievers in isolation, while synthetic training corpora often

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic search 中“检索要服务推理而非只做主题匹配”的问题，并补足这类检索器缺少合适 benchmark 与训练语料的缺口。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark + 合成训练数据 + 检索器微调，属于 agent/search 基础设施工作。对预训练研究员的价值在于：它把“证据组合”而非“单段相关性”明确成训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BRIGHT-Pro，扩展查询的多方面 gold evidence，并同时在静态检索和 agentic search 协议下评测；再构造 RTriever-Synth，把查询分解为 aspect，生成互补 positives 和 positive-conditioned hard negatives，并用它 LoRA 微调基于 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 的 RTriever-4B。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验覆盖多个检索器与两类搜索协议，并比较原始 embedding model、现有 retriever 与经合成数据微调后的 RTriever-4B。论文强调在 reasoning-intensive retrieval 上有稳定提升，但摘要未给出具体分数和增益幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Arman Cohan。若属 Yale NLP 相关团队，这条线在检索增强与长文档问答上有持续积累。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses retrieval for agentic search where the goal is to support downstream reasoning, not just topical matching, and fills the gap in both evaluation and training data for that setting.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly benchmark, synthetic data, and retriever fine-tuning. For pretraining researchers, the useful angle is the explicit shift from single-passage relevance to evidence portfolio construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces BRIGHT-Pro, which expands each query with multi-aspect gold evidence and evaluates retrievers under both static and agentic protocols. It also builds RTriever-Synth, an aspect-decomposed synthetic corpus with complementary positives and positive-conditioned hard negatives, then LoRA-tunes RTriever-4B based on Qwen3-Embedding-4B.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates comparisons across multiple retrievers and both static and agentic search settings, including the base embedding model and the fine-tuned RTriever-4B. It reports consistent gains on reasoning-intensive retrieval, though exact numbers are not exposed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Arman Cohan. If this is indeed from the Yale NLP line, the team has prior work in retrieval-augmented QA and long-context evidence use.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“检索单元”从相关段落改成证据组合，这个目标定义值得借去做 RAG-pretrain 或 synthetic curriculum；读 benchmark 设计和负例构造即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the move from passage relevance to evidence portfolios is a useful objective shift for RAG-style pretraining; read the benchmark design and negative construction.

paper.title: SciResearcher: Scaling Deep Research Agents for Frontier Scientific Reasoning
paper.abstract: Frontier scientific reasoning is rapidly emerging as a key foundation for advancing AI agents in automated scientific discovery. Deep research agents offer a promising approach to this challenge. These models develop robust problem-solving capabilities through post-training on information-seeking tasks, which are typically curated via knowledge graph construction or iterative web browsing. However, these strategies face inherent limitations in frontier science, where domain-specific knowledge is

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个当前很实际的瓶颈：深度研究型 agent 想在前沿科学问题上变强，缺的不是通用网页检索能力，而是高质量、可自动扩展、能覆盖稀疏学术证据和科学计算过程的训练数据。现有自动构造信息寻求任务的方法，大多依赖 Wikipedia 式实体图谱或连续网页浏览，适合事实检索，不适合前沿科学里那种知识分散、概念异构、还需要公式和参数计算的长链条推理。SciResearcher 的核心目标，就是搭一个全自动数据构造框架，把“前沿科学推理”拆成可规模化生成的训练样本，并验证这些样本能否真正提升 deep research agent 的能力。
summary.importance: 从 pretrain/post-train 接口看，这篇工作的价值不在模型结构，而在训练信号设计。它给出了一条比较清楚的路径：当目标能力不是一般问答，而是长时程、工具密集、证据稀疏、带计算环节的科学推理时，数据构造方式本身就是主要瓶颈。贡献有三层。第一，提出了面向 frontier science 的自动数据生成框架，而不是把通用信息检索 recipe 直接搬过来。第二，数据不只覆盖概念性问答，还显式覆盖 computational reasoning，这一点对 agent 能力形态影响很大，因为它迫使模型学会把检索、建模、参数抽取和求解串起来。第三，作者把数据构造、SFT、RL、行为分析连成闭环，展示了 post-training 如何改变 agent 的轨迹长度、工具调用频率和难度自适应策略。对基座研究员来说，这篇工作更像一个高质量案例：当训练目标从“答对”转向“会找、会算、会分配推理预算”时，数据生成器本身就成了能力上限的一部分。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案分为数据构造和 agent 训练两部分。数据构造侧，作者先建立一个 curated 的 frontier scientific entities 池，作为问题生成的起点。随后分成两条流水线。第一条是 conceptual pipeline：让 web agent 从种子科学实体出发浏览学术来源，收集证据，生成有依据的问题；然后引入 iterative anchor-based task augmentation，把一个问题围绕关键锚点实体不断增广，提升复杂度和多证据依赖。这里“anchor”不是普通实体标签，而是问题里决定性、可作为推理抓手的科学对象。第二条是 computational pipeline：针对与种子实体相关的科学模型，做三级证据筛选，抽取可形成计算题的 governing equations、机制解释和所需参数，再生成问题，并通过 voting-based solver verification 得到参考答案。这个设计的关键不是简单让模型做数值题，而是把“找到模型—确认方程—补齐参数—执行求解”作为训练监督的一部分。基于这两条流水线，作者构建了 SciResearcherQA。训练侧，作者采用较标准但执行完整的 deep research post-training recipe：先在 Qwen3-8B 基座上做带 rejection sampling 的 SFT，再用 GRPO 做强化学习，得到 SciResearcher-8B。值得注意的是，这里 RL 的作用不只是提高最终正确率，还在于塑造更长、更工具化、且会按任务难度调整预算的轨迹策略。与已有工作相比，区别主要有三点：一是数据源从实体中心网页转向异构学术证据；二是任务目标从事实检索扩展到科学计算；三是复杂度提升不是靠人工模板堆叠，而是通过 anchor augmentation 和 solver verification 形成较稳定的自动闭环。
summary.experiments: 实验结果有几个值得记住的数字。基于 Qwen3-8B 训练得到的 SciResearcher-8B，在 HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold 上达到 19.46% pass@1 和 31.54% pass@3，超过了以 GPT-4.1 为骨干的 SciMaster，并接近 OpenAI Deep Research 这类前沿专有系统的水平。除此之外，在 SuperGPQA-Hard-Biology 和 TRQA-Literature 上分别带来 13.04% 和 14.54% 的绝对提升。作者还分析了行为轨迹：相较 baseline，post-training 后 agent 的轨迹长度增加到原来的 0.3–2.7 倍区间，同时工具调用频率更高。更有意思的是 RL 相对 SFT 呈现出难度自适应效应：在更难的 HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold 上，agent 学会分配更多步骤和更多工具调用；而在相对容易的 benchmark 上，步骤数略减但性能仍提升，说明 RL 学到的不是单纯“更长链条”，而是更合适的预算控制。摘要里没有展开全部消融细节，但从正文主线看，作者至少验证了三件事：自动构造数据能带来跨 benchmark 泛化；概念题和计算题的混合监督能提升 frontier science reasoning；SFT+RL 不只是提分，还改变了 agent 的搜索与求解行为模式。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时建议按“问题定义—数据流水线—训练闭环—行为分析”四步看。先读引言和 Figure 2，理解作者为什么认为现有 KG-based 和 browsing-based task construction 不适合 frontier science。然后重点看两条数据流水线：conceptual pipeline 里 anchor-based augmentation 的定义、例子和过滤机制；computational pipeline 里三级证据筛选、方程/参数抽取和 solver verification，这部分决定了数据质量上限。接着看 SciResearcherQA 的统计和样例，判断任务是否真的覆盖多证据与计算。训练部分重点看 SFT 与 GRPO 的配方、采样和奖励设置，尤其是 rejection sampling 与 RL 各自承担什么角色。最后看行为分析图表：轨迹长度、工具调用次数、不同 benchmark 上的预算分配变化，这些结果比单纯分数更能说明 agent 学到了什么。若时间有限，优先读引言、方法总览图、数据构造章节、主结果表，以及 RL 后行为变化的分析图。值得深挖的点有两个：一是自动生成的科学计算题如何控制伪解和答案泄漏；二是这种 post-training 数据是否能反哺更一般的预训练目标，比如把检索、建模、求解统一成更原生的训练范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical bottleneck in deep research agents for frontier science: the limiting factor is not generic web search, but scalable training data that captures sparse academic evidence, heterogeneous scientific concepts, and nontrivial scientific computation. Existing automated information-seeking pipelines are mostly built around Wikipedia-like entity graphs or iterative browsing over densely linked webpages. Those recipes work for factual retrieval, but they break down in frontier science, where knowledge is fragmented across papers and solving a problem often requires equations, parameters, and multi-step computation. SciResearcher is designed to automate the construction of such training data and test whether it can materially improve scientific deep-research agents.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is not a new model architecture but a stronger training signal for agent post-training. The paper shows that when the target capability is long-horizon, tool-using, evidence-sparse scientific reasoning, data construction becomes the central bottleneck. There are three concrete contributions. First, it proposes an automated task-construction framework tailored to frontier science rather than reusing general-domain information-seeking recipes. Second, it explicitly includes computational scientific reasoning, not just conceptual QA, forcing the agent to chain retrieval, model identification, parameter extraction, and solving. Third, it closes the loop from data construction to SFT to RL to trajectory analysis, showing how post-training changes not only benchmark accuracy but also search depth, tool-use frequency, and adaptive budget allocation. For researchers interested in the pretrain/post-train interface, this is a useful case study in how the structure of generated supervision shapes the resulting reasoning policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main parts: automated data construction and agent post-training. On the data side, the authors start from a curated pool of frontier scientific entities. They then build two pipelines. The first is a conceptual pipeline: a web agent browses academic sources starting from seed entities, gathers evidence, and generates grounded questions. Complexity is then increased through iterative anchor-based task augmentation, where an anchor is the decisive scientific entity that serves as the central handle for the question. The second is a computational pipeline: the system performs a three-level evidence selection process to identify scientific models associated with seed entities, including governing equations, mechanistic understanding, and required input parameters. It then generates computational questions and obtains reference answers through voting-based solver verification. The key idea is not merely to add arithmetic, but to supervise the full chain of finding the right model, extracting the right quantities, and executing the computation. These pipelines produce SciResearcherQA. On the training side, the authors follow a fairly standard but carefully executed deep-research post-training recipe on top of Qwen3-8B: supervised fine-tuning with rejection sampling, followed by reinforcement learning with GRPO, yielding SciResearcher-8B. A notable point is that RL is used not only to improve final accuracy but also to shape longer, more tool-intensive, and difficulty-adaptive trajectories. Compared with prior work, the main differences are the shift from entity-centric web knowledge to heterogeneous academic evidence, the inclusion of computational reasoning as a first-class target, and a more stable automatic loop built from anchor augmentation and solver verification rather than shallow template expansion.
summary_en.experiments: Several numbers stand out. SciResearcher-8B, trained from Qwen3-8B, reaches 19.46% pass@1 and 31.54% pass@3 on HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold. It outperforms SciMaster built on GPT-4.1 and approaches the level of frontier proprietary deep-research systems such as OpenAI Deep Research. It also improves absolute performance by 13.04% on SuperGPQA-Hard-Biology and 14.54% on TRQA-Literature. The behavioral analysis is equally important: compared with the baseline, post-training produces trajectories that are 0.3x to 2.7x longer and uses tools more frequently. More interestingly, RL induces adaptive behavior relative to the SFT checkpoint. On the harder HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold benchmark, the agent learns to allocate more steps and more tool calls; on easier benchmarks, it uses slightly fewer steps while still improving performance. That suggests RL is not simply encouraging longer chains, but learning a better policy for reasoning-budget allocation. While the provided text does not list every ablation in detail, the main empirical message is clear: automatically constructed scientific data transfers across multiple benchmarks, mixing conceptual and computational supervision improves frontier-science reasoning, and SFT plus RL changes the agent’s search and solving behavior, not just its final score.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in four passes: problem definition, data pipelines, training loop, and behavior analysis. Start with the introduction and the motivating figure to understand why knowledge-graph-based and browsing-based task construction are insufficient for frontier science. Then study the two pipelines carefully. In the conceptual pipeline, focus on how anchor-based augmentation is defined, instantiated, and filtered. In the computational pipeline, pay close attention to the three-level evidence selection process, equation and parameter extraction, and solver verification, because these determine the quality ceiling of the generated data. Next, inspect the SciResearcherQA statistics and examples to judge whether the dataset really captures multi-evidence and computational reasoning. In the training section, focus on the roles of rejection sampling in SFT and GRPO in RL, especially what each stage contributes. Finally, read the trajectory analysis figures on step count, tool-use frequency, and benchmark-dependent budget allocation; these are more informative than the headline scores alone. If time is limited, prioritize the introduction, the method overview figure, the data-construction sections, the main results table, and the RL behavior analysis. Two deeper questions are worth following up: how robust the computational pipeline is against spurious solutions or answer leakage, and whether this style of post-training data could feed back into more native pretraining objectives that unify retrieval, modeling, and solving.
